papers.title: On the global feature importance for interpretable and trustworthy heat demand forecasting
papers.abstract_en: The paper introduces the ante-hoc Explainable AI methodology to assess the global feature importance of the Machine Learning models used for heat demand forecasting in intelligent control of District Heating Systems, with motivation to facilitate their interpretability and trustworthiness, hence addressing the challenges related to adherence to communal standards, customer satisfaction and liability risks. Methodology includes use of four different approaches, namely intrinsic interpretability of Gradient Boosting method and selected post-hoc methods, namely Partial Dependence, Accumulated Local Effects and SHAP. None of the selected methods assume feature permutation or perturbations which can introduce bias due to introduction of random unrealistic values of data instances. Discussion of results is provided, including the assessment of complementarities where applicable, with specific interpretations in context of the district heating processes.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. This preprint corresponds to the paper published in Thermal Science 2025 Volume 29, Issue 5 Part A, Pages: 3355-3365
papers.journal_ref: Thermal Science 2025 Volume 29, Issue 5 Part A, Pages: 3355-3365
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出一种 ante-hoc 可解释 AI 方法，用于评估区域供热系统智能控制中热需求预测机器学习模型的全局特征重要性，目标是提升模型可解释性与可信度。方法结合梯度提升的内在可解释性与部分依赖 (Partial Dependence)、累积局部效应 (Accumulated Local Effects) 和 SHAP 等事后方法，并强调这些方法都不依赖特征置换或扰动。摘要对结果进行了讨论，并在供热过程背景下评估了各方法的互补性。
Motivation: 区域供热系统智能控制中的机器学习模型缺乏足够的可解释性与可信度，会带来遵循社区标准、客户满意度和责任风险等方面的挑战。
Method: 采用四种互补的可解释性方法：梯度提升方法的内在可解释性，以及部分依赖、累积局部效应和 SHAP 三种事后 (post-hoc) 方法；所选方法均不涉及特征置换或扰动，以避免因引入随机不真实数据实例而产生的偏差。
Result: 摘要未给出量化实验数据，而是提供了结果讨论，包括各方法在区域供热过程背景下的具体解释以及适用处的互补性评估。
Conclusion: 作者认为该 ante-hoc XAI 框架有助于促成热需求预测模型的可解释性和可信度，并且避免置换/扰动带来的偏差；摘要未明确说明方法的适用范围或局限性。

papers.title: Spatially-Grounded Text-to-Video Generation via Inference-Time Gradient-Free Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformer Text-to-Video models have achieved remarkable synthesis quality, yet fine-grained spatial controllability remains a significant challenge. While existing training-free methods produce solid overall results in spatially grounded generation, \ie, placing a specific object in a designated location, they rely on gradient-based optimization techniques that incur prohibitive computational overhead, a bottleneck amplified in modern large-scale architectures. To address this limitation, we present Gradient-free Analytical Trajectory Optimization Video Generation (GATO-Vid), a novel training-free and gradient-free approach for precise spatial guidance. Rather than relying on costly backward passes, we introduce an alternative cross-attention score and solve it analytically to obtain an exact, closed-form solution. To use our analytical solution, we propose an on-the-fly injection mechanism tailored to the topological manifold of the transformer's latent space. Our experiments demonstrate that GATO-Vid significantly outperforms existing baselines in localization accuracy while introducing minimal computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GATO-Vid（Gradient-free Analytical Trajectory Optimization Video Generation），一种针对扩散 Transformer 文生视频模型的训练无关、梯度无关的空间引导方法。通过构造替代的交叉注意力分数并解析求解闭式解，配合按 Transformer 潜空间拓扑流形设计的即时注入机制，实现精确的物体定位。实验表明该方法在定位精度上显著超过现有基线，且计算开销很小。
Motivation: 现有训练无关的空间接地生成方法依赖基于梯度的优化，需要大量反向传播，在规模化扩散 Transformer 架构上计算代价过高，限制了细粒度空间可控性的实际应用。
Method: 提出不依赖反向传播的交叉注意力替代分数，并解析求解得到精确的闭式解；同时设计一种针对 Transformer 潜空间拓扑流形的即时注入机制（on-the-fly injection）来使用该解析解。
Result: 实验结果显示 GATO-Vid 在定位精度上显著优于现有基线，同时引入的计算开销极小。
Conclusion: 摘要强调训练无关且梯度无关的解析轨迹优化能够以低开销实现精确的空间引导；其适用范围限定在扩散 Transformer 文生视频模型的空间接地生成任务。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: UniTraffic-Agent: Unified Traffic Video Reasoning for AI City Challenge 2026 Track 3 with Two Out-of-Domain Evaluations
papers.abstract_en: Traffic video understanding has become an important problem in intelligent transportation, as road videos provide direct evidence for accidents, violations, and interactions between vehicles and vulnerable road users. A useful system should explain how a traffic event develops, why it happens, and when the relevant interaction occurs, yet this remains difficult for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) because traffic videos contain sparse events and varied viewpoints. We introduce UniTraffic-Agent, the MR-CAS solution for Track~3 of the 10th AI City Challenge, which includes Traffic Anomaly Reasoning (TAR) and two out-of-domain evaluations: FETV for fisheye traffic events and PSI-VQA for pedestrian intention reasoning. UniTraffic-Agent follows an observe--reason--act--verify workflow that samples timestamped visual evidence, reasons over all questions from the same clip in one request, and converts responses through task-specific action adapters. On the official Public leaderboards, MR-CAS ranks 16th on TAR with a score of 0.5780, 2nd on FETV with 0.4884, and 4th on PSI-VQA with 64.4161. The code is available at https://github.com/Roclp/UniTraffic-Agent.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted to ECCV 2026 AI City Challenge Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniTraffic-Agent，这是面向 AI City Challenge 2026 Track 3 的 MR-CAS 解决方案，涵盖交通异常推理（TAR）以及两个域外评测：鱼眼交通事件（FETV）和行人意图推理（PSI-VQA）。系统采用 observe–reason–act–verify 工作流，对同一片段的所有问题做联合推理，并通过任务专用适配器输出答案，官方公共榜单上取得 TAR 第 16、FETV 第 2、PSI-VQA 第 4 的成绩。
Motivation: 交通视频理解需要解释事件如何发展、为何发生以及交互发生在何时，但多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在面对事件稀疏、视角多样的交通视频时仍然困难。
Method: UniTraffic-Agent 采用观察-推理-行动-验证（observe–reason–act–verify）流程：先采样带时间戳的视觉证据，再在单次请求中推理同一视频片段的所有问题，最后通过任务特定的行动适配器（action adapter）转换响应。
Result: 官方公共榜单上，MR-CAS 在 TAR 上得分 0.5780 排名第 16，在 FETV 上得分 0.4884 排名第 2，在 PSI-VQA 上得分 64.4161 排名第 4。
Conclusion: 摘要表明统一的推理工作流与任务适配器能够应对交通视频理解及其域外评测，并公开了代码。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Static analysis-guided agentic AI translation enables Rust as a full stack bioinformatics language
papers.abstract_en: The field of bioinformatics struggles with legacy code - old code that is commonly used but may no longer have a maintainer, or may be written in an now-unfamiliar language (e.g. Perl, Fortran). This incurs maintenance cost (technical debt), but dynamically typed languages also negatively impacts the environment and fail to make use of modern hardware. Legacy code may also have security or safety problems that make it unsuited for use in clinical settings. Here we show that agentic AI, combined with static analysis, can be used to translate legacy code to the modern language Rust. We provide prompts and supporting software to aid systematic translation, and evaluate it on common software for NGS and imaging. We showcase the result on our software Bascet: Size was reduced by ~80x, build time decreased by ~10x, and performance of key steps improved >3x. Unix dependencies were also removed, making Bascet the only single-cell pipeline able to run on native Windows, without a container. Large-scale refactoring of bioinformatics software is thus now possible at a limited budget, enabling more complex tools to be developed.

papers.title: RGB-D Video Generation for Improving Human-to-Robot Object Handover Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Human-to-robot (H2R) object handover is a fundamental capability for human-robot collaboration, yet progress is hindered by the scarcity of large-scale, human-centric datasets and the significant sim-to-real gap. To address these challenges, we introduce Hand2Bot, an RGB-D video dataset that provides rich contextual information such as body posture and facial expressions, specifically collected for handover scenarios with real-world noise patterns. We further propose PassGen, a generative pipeline that leverages stable video diffusion and an Intention-Aware Temporal Face Encoder to synthesize realistic handover sequences while ensuring hand-object consistency. To bridge the sim-to-real gap, we implement a morphology-based depth editing strategy that replicates realistic sensor noise found in physical depth maps. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that our framework achieves high intention identification accuracy and low false trigger rates in both ablation studies and real-world deployment on a physical robot platform. Our results confirm that training on PassGen allows for robust zero-shot transfer and earlier intention anticipation compared to traditional hand-centric baselines, effectively enabling socially aware robotic behavior in shared workspaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hand2Bot，一个针对人-机器人 (H2R) 物体交接场景采集的 RGB-D 视频数据集，并设计 PassGen 生成管线，利用稳定视频扩散 (stable video diffusion) 和意图感知时序人脸编码器合成逼真交接序列。为弥合 sim-to-real 差距，作者提出基于形态学的深度编辑策略以复现真实深度图中的传感器噪声。实验表明该方法在意图识别准确率和低误触发率上表现良好，并支持零样本迁移与更早的意图预判。
Motivation: 人-机器人物体交接能力受限于大规模、以人为中心的数据集稀缺以及显著的 sim-to-real 差距，阻碍了社交感知机器人在共享空间中的部署。
Method: 引入 Hand2Bot 数据集和 PassGen 生成管线：采用稳定视频扩散与意图感知时序人脸编码器 (Intention-Aware Temporal Face Encoder) 合成交接序列并保证手-物一致性，再通过基于形态学的深度编辑策略模拟真实深度图的传感器噪声。
Result: 实验显示框架在消融研究和物理机器人平台真实部署中均取得高意图识别准确率和低误触发率；与以手为中心的基线相比，PassGen 训练支持鲁棒的零样本迁移和更早的意图预判。
Conclusion: 作者认为训练于 PassGen 可有效实现社交感知的机器人行为，但摘要未明确讨论局限性与边界条件。

papers.title: Incremental Evaluation and Training in Relational Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Relational Deep Learning (RDL) models multi-tabular databases as temporal heterogeneous graphs to enable end-to-end representation learning. However, prevailing RDL evaluation practices rely on static, single-episode dataset snapshots, overlooking the continuous, time-evolving nature of real-world databases. Consequently, current RDL benchmarks fail to capture how model performance changes as new data accumulates over time. To address this limitation, we introduce an incremental, multi-episode evaluation and training paradigm to assess and improve the temporal robustness and adaptability of state-of-the-art RDL models. Using established large-scale datasets, we examine data evolution and model training dynamics, demonstrating that temporal concept drifts occur in the majority of predictive tasks. We present multiple incremental training regimes for fine-tuning the models and demonstrate that transfer learning is both feasible and highly effective in the RDL setting. Alongside a new temporal evaluation metric that prioritizes near-future accuracy, we show that our incrementally fine-tuned models consistently outperform the standard, expensive, from-scratch trained baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对关系深度学习 (Relational Deep Learning, RDL) 中常见的静态单片段评估范式，提出一种增量式、多片段 (multi-episode) 的评估与训练框架。作者利用已有大规模数据集考察数据演化与模型训练动态，发现大多数预测任务存在时间概念漂移，并提出多种增量微调策略。结果显示增量微调模型在优先考虑近期精度的新时序评估指标下，持续优于从头训练的标准基线。
Motivation: 现有 RDL 评估依赖静态、单一时间切片的数据库快照，忽略了真实数据库随时间连续演化的特性，导致基准无法反映新数据累积过程中模型性能的变化。
Method: 提出增量式多片段评估与训练范式，设计多种增量微调 (incremental fine-tuning) 训练方案，并引入一个优先衡量近期预测精度的新时序评估指标。
Result: 在大规模数据集上观察到大多数预测任务存在时间概念漂移；证明迁移学习在 RDL 场景下可行且高效；增量微调模型在时序评估中一致优于昂贵的从头训练基线。
Conclusion: 增量式评估与训练能提升 RDL 模型的时间鲁棒性和适应性，且相比从头训练更为高效。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Foundations of MT-PDCL: Measure-Theoretic Probabilistic Definite Clause Logic
papers.abstract_en: Standard probabilistic logic programming frameworks typically rely on grounding logic programs into discrete propositional representations. This operational requirement restricts exact inference to finite domains and discrete probability distributions. In this paper, we introduce Measure-Theoretic Probabilistic Definite Clause Logic (MT-PDCL), a generalized foundational framework that eliminates this finite-domain restriction. By explicitly defining stochastic variables over bounded index domains and equipping the interpretation space with standard Borel $σ$-algebras, MT-PDCL allows logical variables to operate natively over continuous measurable spaces. Building on Continuous Distribution Semantics, MT-PDCL models probabilistic rules as mutually independent causal events. However, rather than aggregating these derivations via finite boolean circuits, declarative entailment is formally defined through exact Lebesgue integration over the continuous measure space. We introduce a continuous immediate consequence operator that unifies the integration of continuous prior distributions with the evaluation of exact continuous observations. We demonstrate that this approach replaces the combinatorial bottleneck of discrete grounding with exact, algebraic, and structurally differentiable inference. While this transition trades discrete combinatorics for the geometric curse of dimensionality, it achieves the expressive power of continuous probabilistic models while preserving the pure declarative syntax of definite clause logic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出测度论概率确定子句逻辑 (MT-PDCL)，一个消除有限域限制的概率逻辑编程基础框架。通过在带界指标域上定义随机变量，并为解释空间配备标准 Borel σ-代数，逻辑变量可直接作用于连续可测空间。语义基于连续分布语义 (Continuous Distribution Semantics)，将概率规则视作相互独立的因果事件，并通过精确 Lebesgue 积分而非有限布尔电路来定义声明性蕴含。
Motivation: 标准概率逻辑编程依赖将逻辑程序 grounding 为离散命题表示，使精确推理局限于有限域和离散概率分布。本文旨在突破这一限制，使逻辑变量能原生处理连续可测空间。
Method: 引入 MT-PDCL 框架：在界指标域上显式定义随机变量，为解释空间配备标准 Borel σ-代数；基于连续分布语义将概率规则建模为相互独立的因果事件；用连续立即后果算子统一连续先验分布的积分与精确连续观测的求值，并通过精确 Lebesgue 积分定义声明性蕴含。
Result: 该方法将离散 grounding 的组合瓶颈替换为精确、代数且结构可微的推理；代价是从离散组合学转向几何维度灾难 (curse of dimensionality)。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架在保留确定子句逻辑纯声明式语法的同时，获得连续概率模型的表达能力。这是迈向连续域概率逻辑编程的基础性工作。

papers.title: EgoPHI: Estimating Contact and Force from Egocentric Vision
papers.abstract_en: Understanding hand-object interaction from egocentric vision is essential for modeling how people physically engage with the surrounding world. Yet reasoning about physically grounded interaction requires estimating the forces acting on hands and objects, beyond localizing contact. We present EgoPHI, the first method that jointly estimates dense contact maps and 3D force distributions on hand and object meshes from a single monocular RGB image and object geometry. To address the lack of scalable ground-truth force annotations, we introduce a physics-based simulation pipeline that augments existing hand-object datasets with dense per-vertex force supervision. EgoPHI then learns dense 3D contact and force on interacting hand and articulated object meshes, extending vision-based force estimation beyond image-space or planar settings. Our evaluation on in-distribution and out-of-distribution benchmarks shows that EgoPHI improves force estimation over existing approaches while generalizing to unseen datasets. To evaluate sim-to-real transfer, we constructed two physical objects that capture dense object contact and force magnitude and used them to record a dataset of interactions from eight participants across diverse touch and grasp types. Our results demonstrate that EgoPHI recovers meaningful 3D contact and force distributions in simulated, out-of-distribution, and real-world settings, advancing egocentric hand-object understanding from contact localization toward physically grounded interaction reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EgoPHI，据称是第一个从单目 RGB 图像和物体几何同时估计手和物体网格上密集接触图与 3D 力分布的方法。为缓解缺少可扩展力标注的问题，作者引入基于物理的仿真流程，为现有手-物数据集生成逐顶点力监督。在分布内、分布外和真实世界基准上的实验表明，该方法能恢复有意义的 3D 接触与力分布，将自我中心手-物理解从接触定位推进到物理接地交互推理。
Motivation: 自我中心视觉中的手-物交互理解通常只定位接触，而缺乏对作用在手和物体上力的估计；同时可扩展的真实力标注稀缺，限制了物理接地的交互推理。
Method: 提出 EgoPHI，以单目 RGB 图像和物体几何为输入，联合估计手和可动（articulated）物体网格上的密集接触和 3D 力。为了解决标注瓶颈，构建物理仿真管线为现有手-物数据集补充逐顶点力监督。
Result: 在模拟、分布外和真实世界数据上，EgoPHI 较现有方法改进力估计并泛化到未见数据集。作者还制作了两个物理物体记录 8 名参与者的交互数据，验证 sim-to-real 迁移。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该方法可恢复有意义的 3D 接触与力分布，推动自我中心手-物理解从接触定位走向物理接地交互推理。

papers.title: Structure-aware Riemannian Growth Fields for 4D Plant Modeling
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce a novel framework for 4D plant growth modeling that reconstructs the continuous geometric and topological evolution of plants from sparse temporal observations. Existing methods mainly rely on dense registration, yet reliable dense sequences are hard to obtain due to scanning constraints and self-occlusions, leaving these approaches struggling under large temporal gaps where rapid organ emergence violates local rigidity. To overcome this, we bridge these gaps by formulating plant morphogenesis as a continuous procedural process on a structure-aware Riemannian growth field; this jointly models topology evolution and geometric deformation, preserving botanical hierarchies and stable spatio-temporal correspondences across distant timepoints. Our key idea is to ground symbolic growth rules within a continuous geodesic flow, where organ development follows biologically modulated trajectories that preserve structural coherence under topological changes. We further contribute a 10-day dual-species dataset with dense geometric and semantic annotations. Experiments demonstrate that our method accurately tracks individual organ growth over time and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both geometric accuracy and correspondence consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向4D植物生长建模的框架，从稀疏时间观测重建植物连续的几何与拓扑演化。作者将植物形态建成建模为结构感知黎曼生长场 (structure-aware Riemannian growth field) 上的连续程序化过程，联合建模拓扑演化与几何变形，并贡献一个10天双物种的稠密标注数据集。实验表明该方法能准确追踪单个器官的生长，在几何精度和对应一致性上显著优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有植物生长建模方法主要依赖密集配准，但扫描约束和自遮挡使得可靠的密集时间序列难以获得；在大时间间隔下快速器官出现会使局部刚性假设失效，导致这些方法表现不佳。
Method: 将植物形态建成建模为连续的程序化过程，并形式化为结构感知的黎曼生长场；核心思想是把符号生长规则嵌入连续测地流 (geodesic flow)，使器官发育沿生物学调制的轨迹进行，从而在拓扑变化下保持结构一致性。此外还构建了带稠密几何与语义标注的10天双物种数据集。
Result: 实验显示该方法能准确追踪单个器官随时间生长的过程，并在几何精度与对应一致性两方面显著优于state-of-the-art基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过连续程序化过程弥合大时间间隔、保持植物学层次结构与跨时间点稳定时空对应是该方法的要点。该工作面向植物生长建模与4D视觉领域，与天气降水相关主题无关。

papers.title: PixSDS: Why Latent SDS Makes Noisy Pixels
papers.abstract_en: Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) enables text-to-3D generation by optimizing rendered images with a pretrained diffusion prior, but latent SDS often produces structured color artifacts and high-frequency texture noise. We identify a failure mode of latent SDS caused by VAE-induced pixel drift: the optimized image can move along pixel-space directions that are weakly constrained by the VAE encoder, so its latent representation remains clean and semantically meaningful while the image itself accumulates visible artifacts. We support this diagnosis with controlled 2D SDS experiments, VAE-only optimization, and a simplified analysis showing that encoder-like latent objectives can amplify image-space noise when the inverse mapping to pixels is underconstrained. Motivated by this observation, we propose PixSDS, a lightweight VAE-consistent gradient repair method. PixSDS decodes a latent SDS lookahead step and uses the decoded image as a clean direction for pixel-space optimization, reducing motion in VAE-inconsistent directions without retraining the diffusion model, changing the renderer, or replacing the SDS objective. Experiments in 2D optimization and text-to-3D generation show that PixSDS substantially reduces structured artifacts while preserving semantic content. Code is publicly available at https://sevashasla.github.io/pixsds-webpage/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析潜在 Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) 在文本到 3D 生成中产生结构化颜色伪影和高频噪声的原因，指出 VAE 诱导的像素漂移是主要失败模式：优化图像沿 VAE 编码器弱约束的像素方向移动，潜在表示保持干净但像素空间累积可见伪影。作者提出 PixSDS，一种轻量级 VAE 一致的梯度修复方法，通过对潜在 SDS 前瞻步骤解码并用解码图像作为像素空间优化的干净方向来减少伪影，无需重新训练扩散模型或更换渲染器。
Motivation: 潜在 SDS 在文本到 3D 生成中常产生结构化颜色伪影和高频纹理噪声，现有方法未能从 VAE 编码器约束角度解释这一失败模式。
Method: 通过受控 2D SDS 实验、仅 VAE 优化和简化分析诊断 VAE 诱导的像素漂移问题；提出 PixSDS，解码潜在 SDS 前瞻步并将解码图像作为像素空间优化的干净方向，以减少 VAE 不一致方向的运动。
Result: 在 2D 优化和文本到 3D 生成实验中，PixSDS 显著减少结构化伪影，同时保留语义内容。
Conclusion: PixSDS 提供了轻量级修复方案，无需重新训练扩散模型、改变渲染器或替换 SDS 目标，即可改善潜在 SDS 的图像质量。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: OGR-MARL: Option-Guided Residual Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Heterogeneous USV Cooperative Pursuit in Constrained Port Waterways
papers.abstract_en: Heterogeneous USV cooperative pursuit in constrained port waterways requires evader interception under navigation, traffic, and role constraints. This paper proposes OGR-MARL, an option-guided residual multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that is decoupled from a specific MARL algorithm. OGR-MARL integrates shared evader belief, role-conditioned option targets, adaptive rule penalties, and residual policy learning, allowing different MARL algorithms to learn corrective actions on top of rule-guided behaviors rather than exploring constrained port environments from scratch. We instantiate OGR-MARL with representative continuous-control MARL backbones, including MADDPG, MATD3, MAPPO, and MASAC, yielding OGR-MADDPG, OGR-MATD3, OGR-MAPPO, and OGR-MASAC. Experiments in an abstract Xiazhimen port-waterway scenario show that the OGR-MASAC instantiation achieves a 75.0% capture rate, promising mission-effective rule compliance, and the best heterogeneous coordination among the tested methods. Without retraining, zero-shot transfer to a QGIS/AIS-informed Xiazhimen map achieves promising results, demonstrating the generalization potential of OGR-MARL in more complex port scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OGR-MARL，一个与具体多智能体强化学习算法解耦的 options 引导残差学习框架，用于受限港口航道中异构无人水面艇 (USV) 的协同追捕。框架引入共享逃逸者信念、角色条件化的 option 目标、自适应规则惩罚和残差策略学习，使不同 MARL 算法能在规则引导行为之上学习纠偏动作。作者用 MADDPG、MATD3、MAPPO、MASAC 实例化该框架，并在抽象的夏之门港口航道场景中测试，其中 OGR-MASAC 达到 75.0% 的捕获率，且在异构协调上表现最佳；零样本迁移到 QGIS/AIS 信息支撑的夏之门地图也展现了泛化潜力。
Motivation: 异构 USV 在受限港口航道中协同追捕逃逸者，需要同时满足导航、交通和角色约束，而现有 MARL 方法通常在受限环境中从零探索，学习效率和解约束能力不足。
Method: 提出 OGR-MARL 框架，将共享逃逸者信念、角色条件化 option 目标、自适应规则惩罚与残差策略学习结合，使底层 MARL 算法在规则引导行为上学习纠偏动作；并以 MADDPG、MATD3、MAPPO、MASAC 作为代表性连续控制骨干进行实例化。
Result: 在抽象夏之门港口航道场景中，OGR-MASAC 实例实现 75.0% 的捕获率，兼具任务有效性与规则合规性，并在异构协调方面优于所测方法；不经重训练的零样本迁移到 QGIS/AIS 信息支撑的夏之门地图也取得较有前景的结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架通过残差策略学习叠加于规则引导行为，避免从零探索受限港口环境，并在更复杂港口场景中展现出泛化潜力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Balanced Adaptive Prototype Selection for Scalable TabPFN Inference on Large-Scale Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained tabular foundation models have demonstrated strong predictive capability; however, their application to large-scale datasets remains constrained by the limited inference context. This paper introduces Balanced Adaptive Prototype Selection (BAPS), a framework for constructing compact, information-preserving contexts for scalable TabPFN inference. Without modifying or retraining the pretrained model, BAPS jointly preserves representative structure, informative decision boundaries, local density, class balance, and feature-space diversity. Experiments on the million-row HIGGS and SUSY datasets show that 512 prototypes retain strong predictive performance and reliable calibration, corresponding to an approximately 1,953-fold context compression. All experiments were conducted on an Intel Core i7 CPU with 16 GB RAM and no GPU acceleration. These findings establish effective context construction as a practical mechanism for extending pretrained tabular foundation models to million-scale datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出平衡自适应原型选择（Balanced Adaptive Prototype Selection, BAPS）框架，在不修改或重新训练预训练模型的前提下，为大规模表格数据构造紧凑且信息保持的上下文，以扩展 TabPFN 推理能力。在百万行 HIGGS 和 SUSY 数据集上，512 个原型即可保持较强预测性能和可靠校准，对应约 1,953 倍的上下文压缩，且全部实验在无 GPU 的 CPU 环境下完成。
Motivation: 预训练表格基础模型虽具强预测能力，但受限于有限推理上下文，难以直接用于大规模数据集。需要一种不改变预训练模型的上下文构造方案，使这类模型能扩展到百万级数据。
Method: BAPS 通过联合保持代表性结构、信息性决策边界、局部密度、类别平衡与特征空间多样性来选取原型，从而构建紧凑上下文；该方法不修改或重训练预训练模型。
Result: 在 HIGGS 和 SUSY 百万行数据集上，512 个原型保持了较强的预测性能与可靠校准，实现约 1,953 倍上下文压缩；实验仅在 Intel Core i7 CPU、16 GB RAM、无 GPU 加速的条件下完成。
Conclusion: 摘要将有效上下文构造确立为把预训练表格基础模型扩展到百万级数据集的实用机制。论文聚焦表格数据分类与推理效率，与降水、临近预报、天气预测等关键词没有直接关联。

papers.title: Machine learning correction of satellite precipitation is governed by mechanism purity, not algorithmic complexity: a proof-of-concept study in Hunan, China, with pre-registered cross-regional validation
papers.abstract_en: Satellite precipitation products such as IMERG exhibit biases that vary with terrain, season, and precipitation regime, leaving the applicability boundaries of machine learning correction unclear. This study proposes the Terrain-Moisture-Intensity (TMI) framework, centered on mechanism purity, extending the correction problem from purely algorithmic optimization to physical consistency diagnosis. A proof-of-concept study in Hunan Province employs IMERG V07, SRTM DEM, and ERA5 variables (tcwv, u10, v10). Ablation results indicate that, under the conditions of this study, terrain-moisture relationships are predominantly additive: RF-Full yields merely +0.001 R^2 gain over LR-Full, while bias rises to 1.282 mm d^-1; MAE decreases by approximately 14%, reflecting a trade-off between tail-fitting improvement and mean shift. SHAP diagnostics identify three categories of boundaries. Spatially, Central Hunan exhibits significant degradation (R^2=0.133) despite strong variable activation, consistent with mechanism fragmentation induced by mixed terrain. Temporally, u10 undergoes directional reversal between summer and spring (+0.096 to -0.156), presenting "silent failure." Extreme precipitation (>=50 mm d^-1) approximates a mechanism saturation frontier rather than isolated out-of-distribution samples, with DEM showing the largest relative amplification in SHAP disorder (+150%). The results demonstrate that machine learning correction performance is primarily constrained by mechanism purity. A pre-registered cross-regional test (Hunan, Guangxi, Guangdong) confirms this screening capability out of sample: a priori coherence proxies predict correction efficiency with a mean absolute error of 2.6 percentage points, while the transfer-versus-retraining contrast separates mechanism mismatch (coastal Guangdong) from portability (Guangxi), establishing the framework as a validated applicability screen.
papers.comment: 44 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables; supplementary material included (8 tables, 2 figures)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出以“机制纯度”（mechanism purity）为核心的 Terrain-Moisture-Intensity (TMI) 框架，将卫星降水（IMERG V07）的机器学习修正问题从算法优化扩展为物理一致性诊断。基于湖南的 proof-of-concept 研究表明，在研究所用条件下地形-湿度关系以加性效应为主，RF-Full 相比 LR-Full 仅提升 0.001 的 R^2 但偏差升至 1.282 mm/d，MAE 下降约 14%；SHAP 诊断识别出三类边界，跨区域预注册验证（湖南、广西、广东）表明先验一致性代理能以 2.6 个百分点平均绝对误差预测修正效率。
Motivation: IMERG 等卫星降水产品在随地形、季节和降水类型变化时存在偏差，机器学习修正的适用范围边界不清晰；现有研究多聚焦算法优化，缺乏对物理一致性的系统诊断。
Method: 提出 TMI 框架，使用 IMERG V07、SRTM DEM 和 ERA5 变量（tcwv、u10、v10），通过加性/非线性对比消融（RF-Full 与 LR-Full）、SHAP 诊断以及预注册的跨区域验证来评价机制纯度并筛选可移植性。
Result: 在湖南消融中，RF-Full 相对 LR-Full 的 R^2 增益仅 +0.001，偏差升至 1.282 mm/d，MAE 下降约 14%；湖南中部 R^2 仅 0.133，u10 在夏季与春季发生方向反转（+0.096 到 -0.156）；极端降水（>=50 mm/d）下 DEM 的 SHAP 无序度相对放大 150%。跨区域验证中，先验一致性代理预测修正效率的平均绝对误差为 2.6 个百分点，并能区分广东的机制不匹配与广西的可移植性。
Conclusion: 机器学习修正性能主要受机制纯度约束，而非算法复杂度；TMI 框架可作为经过验证的应用适用性筛选工具，但研究以湖南为 proof-of-concept，并依赖预注册的跨区域测试确认其筛选能力。

summary_sections.method: 提出 TMI 框架，使用 IMERG V07、SRTM DEM 和 ERA5 变量（tcwv、u10、v10），通过加性/非线性对比消融（RF-Full 与 LR-Full）、SHAP 诊断以及预注册的跨区域验证来评价机制纯度并筛选可移植性。
summary_sections.result: 在湖南消融中，RF-Full 相对 LR-Full 的 R^2 增益仅 +0.001，偏差升至 1.282 mm/d，MAE 下降约 14%；湖南中部 R^2 仅 0.133，u10 在夏季与春季发生方向反转（+0.096 到 -0.156）；极端降水（>=50 mm/d）下 DEM 的 SHAP 无序度相对放大 150%。跨区域验证中，先验一致性代理预测修正效率的平均绝对误差为 2.6 个百分点，并能区分广东的机制不匹配与广西的可移植性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 机器学习修正性能主要受机制纯度约束，而非算法复杂度；TMI 框架可作为经过验证的应用适用性筛选工具，但研究以湖南为 proof-of-concept，并依赖预注册的跨区域测试确认其筛选能力。

papers.title: Generative Universal Multimodal Retrieval with Dual-role Identifiers
papers.abstract_en: Generative information retrieval (GIR) has emerged as a compelling alternative to the conventional index-retrieve-then-rank retrieval pipeline by training a generator to produce the identifiers of relevant items directly. Despite its promise, a number of open challenges still remain. First, constrained left-to-right decoding is vulnerable to prefix-level errors and local optima. Second, most prior GIR research remains largely unimodal, leaving instruction-aware retrieval across text, image, and mixed image-text items underexplored. Third, although discrete identifier-based GIR offers higher efficiency, its retrieval accuracy still lags behind that of the cutting-edge dense-vector-based retrieval methods. Motivated by these challenges, we propose DrIG, a novel Generative framework for universal multimodal retrieval featuring Dual-role Identifiers, which supports diverse retrieval tasks across multiple modalities and domains. Each candidate is assigned a single residual-quantized identifier that serves two complementary roles. In its sequential role, the identifier is decoded autoregressively, where the first token explicitly models modality and the remaining tokens capture progressively finer semantics. In its set-based role, the same tokens are reinterpreted as an unordered set to provide a prefix-independent relevance prior, which guides constrained beam search and alleviates local-optimum errors. Extensive experiments on the M-BEIR benchmark and the text-to-image evaluation datasets show that:(1)DrIG consistently outperforms state-of-the-art generative multimodal baselines across diverse tasks, while hybrid reranking achieves a favorable efficiency-effectiveness trade-off against strong dense retrievers. (2)Ablation and scaling analyses reveal how the base LMM, beam size, reranking depth, and fusion strategy affect retrieval performance, providing practical guidance for system design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DrIG，一种面向通用多模态检索的生成式框架，采用双重角色标识符 (Dual-role Identifiers)。每个候选项被分配一个残差量化标识符，既可自回归解码（首个 token 显式建模模态，其余 token 捕捉逐级精细语义），也可被重释为无序集合，为受限束搜索提供与前缀无关的相关性先验。在 M-BEIR 基准和文本到图像评估数据集上的实验显示，DrIG 在多种任务上持续优于最先进的生成式多模态基线，且混合重排在效率与效果之间取得有利权衡。
Motivation: 现有生成式信息检索 (GIR) 存在三个未解挑战：受限的左到右解码易受前缀级错误和局部最优影响；大部分 GIR 研究仍停留在单模态，指令感知的跨文本、图像及混合图像-文本条目检索尚未充分探索；离散标识符式 GIR 虽有更高效率，但检索准确率仍落后于先进的稠密向量检索方法。
Method: 提出 DrIG 框架，为每个候选项赋予一个残差量化 (residual-quantized) 标识符，该标识符承担两种互补角色：序列角色下按自回归方式解码，首个 token 显式建模模态，其余 token 捕捉越来越精细的语义；集合角色下将同一组 token 视为无序集合，提供与前缀无关的相关性先验，用于引导受限束搜索并缓解局部最优错误。
Result: 在 M-BEIR 基准和文本到图像评估数据集上的实验表明，DrIG 在多样任务上一致优于最先进的生成式多模态基线；混合重排在面对强稠密检索器时实现了有利的效率-效果权衡。消融与缩放分析还揭示了基础 LMM、束大小、重排深度和融合策略对检索性能的影响。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DrIG 通过双重角色标识符统一支持跨模态、跨领域的多种检索任务，并为系统设计提供了实用指导；摘要未明确说明方法的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning the Mathematical Property for Designing Low Mutual Coherence Binary Sensing Matrices
papers.abstract_en: In this research work, we are constructing the sensing matrix, which is essential for the success of the compressive sensing technique. We have chosen a learning-based technique for the construction of the sensing matrix. The novelty and uniqueness of the proposed technique is that it does not use any data set and also does not use a specific application. It uses the mathematical property/constraint for the construction of the sensing matrix for the perfect recovery of the signal. The perfect recovery of signals is an old and still very challenging problem in real-world applications. In late 2000, compressive sensing became a popular mathematical tool for the perfect recovery of sparse signals. The core of the compressive technique is the construction of the sensing matrix, which satisfies certain special properties such as restricted isometry property (RIP), null space property (NSP), and spark property (SP). All these properties are NP-hard problems and hence computationally challenging to solve. For all practical purposes, the construction of the sensing matrix needs to achieve low mutual coherence to achieve the perfect recovery of the signals. We have used a neural network for the construction of the sensing matrix, and this framework constructs a binary sensing matrix with low mutual coherence. The entries in the matrix are generated through a shared underlying rule. The proposed architecture is simple and does not use large-scale training data sets. Such uniqueness and novelty bring a drastic reduction in computational cost, and also, for the first time in literature, the use of a mathematical property for defining the loss function. In this proposed research work, the mutual coherence property has been used in the neural network framework. Such a neural network framework brings generality, robustness, and reduces storage requirements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需数据集的神经网络框架来构造二值感知矩阵 (binary sensing matrix)，以压缩感知中的低互相干性 (mutual coherence) 作为损失函数约束。摘要称该框架不使用任何训练数据，也不针对特定应用，而是仅依赖数学性质/约束来生成矩阵，从而降低计算成本、提升泛化性并减少存储需求。
Motivation: 压缩感知的成功依赖满足 RIP、NSP、spark 等性质的感知矩阵，但验证这些性质均为 NP-hard 问题。实际中常通过降低互相干性来逼近完美恢复条件，而现有学习式矩阵构造通常依赖数据集或特定应用，本文希望摆脱这种依赖。
Method: 使用神经网络构造二值感知矩阵，矩阵元素通过共享的底层规则生成，并将互相干性这一数学性质直接用作损失函数，从而避免使用大规模训练数据。
Result: 摘要报告该方法首次在文献中把数学性质用于定义损失函数，带来计算成本的大幅下降，并宣称具备通用性、鲁棒性以及更低的存储需求；未给出定量实验数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为仅利用数学约束而非数据驱动的学习框架即可构造低互相干性二值感知矩阵，从而支持信号的完美恢复；其范围限于二值矩阵与互相干性性质。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DiCoR: Decoupled Referent Disambiguation and Contour Recalibration for Efficient Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Referring remote sensing image segmentation (RRSIS) aims to delineate targets specified by natural language expressions in remote sensing imagery. Existing methods mainly follow joint fusion segmentation (JFS) or decoupled prompt segmentation (DPS). JFS is efficient but often suffers from limited accuracy because referent localization and mask delineation are optimized under a unified objective, whereas DPS separates localization from mask generation using spatial prompts and foundation segmenters at the cost of higher memory consumption and inference latency. To bridge this gap, we propose DiCoR, a decoupled referent disambiguation and contour recalibration framework built on an efficient JFS pipeline. DiCoR addresses two key challenges: distinguishing the correct referent from ambiguous candidates and refining coarse masks after localization. A disambiguation-aware localization guidance strategy ranks salient candidate regions with adaptive linguistic cues and injects the resulting localization prior into fused features. A lightweight contour recalibration module further predicts residual corrections to coarse logits under localized contour supervision, improving mask quality with limited computational overhead. Experiments on RefSegRS, RRSIS-D, and RISBench show that DiCoR achieves the best segmentation accuracy across all three benchmarks. On RefSegRS, it improves mIoU and gIoU by 5.28% and 2.87% over a competitive JFS method while running 4.7% faster than a representative DPS method, demonstrating a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off. Code is available at https://github.com/zyGao1126/DiCoR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiCoR，一个用于遥感图像指代分割（RRSIS）的解耦指代消歧与轮廓校正框架，构建在高效的联合融合分割（JFS）流水线之上。它通过消歧感知的定位引导策略和轻量级轮廓校正模块，分别处理指代目标消歧与粗掩膜细化，在 RefSegRS、RRSIS-D 和 RISBench 三个基准上取得最佳分割精度。
Motivation: 现有 RRSIS 方法主要分为联合融合分割（JFS）和解耦提示分割（DPS）。JFS 高效但精度受限，因为指代定位与掩膜生成在统一目标下优化；DPS 用空间提示和基础分割器分离两者，却带来更高内存消耗和推理延迟。论文旨在弥合效率与精度之间的差距。
Method: 提出 DiCoR，包含一个消歧感知的定位引导策略，用自适应语言线索对显著候选区域排序并将定位先验注入融合特征；以及一个轻量级轮廓校正模块，在局部轮廓监督下预测粗 logits 的残差修正，以有限计算开销提升掩膜质量。
Result: 在 RefSegRS、RRSIS-D 和 RISBench 三个基准上均取得最佳分割精度。在 RefSegRS 上，相比强 JFS 方法，mIoU 和 gIoU 分别提升 5.28% 和 2.87%，同时比代表性 DPS 方法快 4.7%，展示了良好的精度-效率权衡。
Conclusion: DiCoR 通过解耦指代消歧与轮廓校正，在保持 JFS 高效性的同时显著提升分割精度，验证了该框架在精度与效率之间的有利折衷。摘要未提及明确局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond Handcrafted Security: Towards Self-Evolving Defense for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: The expanding operational capabilities of large language model (LLM) agents introduce sophisticated security threats. Runtime defenses have emerged as an effective approach to mitigating these risks by integrating security mechanisms into the agent execution loop. However, existing runtime defenses rely heavily on manually designed interventions and lack a principled framework for their construction and maintenance. In this work, we first develop a harness-level formulation of runtime defense that systematically characterizes how harness mechanisms enable defense construction and provides a unified view of existing runtime defense interventions from a harness perspective. Building on this formulation, we propose HARD (Harness-based Autonomous Runtime Defense Evolution), a self-evolving runtime defense framework that automatically identifies appropriate intervention strategies and iteratively improves defense artifacts based on observed failure traces. HARD transforms runtime defense development from manual engineering into an autonomous evolution process, and extensive experiments demonstrate that it improves security performance over existing handcrafted defenses while preserving benign task utility. Our findings highlight autonomous defense evolution as a promising new paradigm for securing deployed LLM agents, enabling agents to identify defense weaknesses and continuously improve their protection mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HARD（Harness-based Autonomous Runtime Defense Evolution），一个面向 LLM 智能体的自演进运行时防御框架。作者先给出 harness 层面的运行时防御形式化，以统一视角刻画现有防御干预，然后基于失败轨迹（failure traces）自动识别干预策略并迭代改进防御工件。实验表明它在安全性能上优于现有手工防御，同时保持良性任务效用。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体运行时防御高度依赖手工设计的干预，缺乏构建和维护防御的原则性框架，难以应对智能体操作能力扩张带来的复杂安全威胁。
Method: 提出 harness 层面的运行时防御形式化，并在此基础上构建 HARD 框架：自动识别合适的干预策略，根据观测到的失败轨迹迭代改进防御工件，将防御开发从手工工程转化为自主演化过程。
Result: 大量实验显示 HARD 在安全性能上优于现有手工防御，同时保持良性任务效用（benign task utility）；摘要未报告具体数值或基准名称。
Conclusion: 作者强调自主防御演化是保护已部署 LLM 智能体的有前景的新范式，使智能体能够识别防御弱点并持续改进保护机制；摘要未明确讨论局限。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Comment on "Modeling rapid language learning by distilling Bayesian priors into artificial neural networks"
papers.abstract_en: McCoy & Griffiths (2025, henceforth M&G) suggest that a Bayesian prior can be distilled into Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) through Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML, Finn et al., 2017). They support this empirically by showing that meta-trained networks demonstrate formal language learning abilities comparable to Yang & Piantadosi (2023)'s Bayesian learner, significantly outperforming standard ANNs. We point out that under the standard interpretation of a prior, M&G's procedure does not actually instill one; it merely initializes network weights favorably, leaving the objective function unchanged. We then consider a more permissive interpretation, where the system as a whole can be seen as implementing a Bayesian learner even without an explicit prior in the objective. We show that this interpretation faces nontrivial challenges. Finally, we assess how well MAML approximates the empirical results of Bayesian learning, showing that unlike genuine Bayesian learners, M&G's model overfits and generalizes poorly to unseen data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对 McCoy & Griffiths (2025) 的评论文章，针对其通过 Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML) 将贝叶斯先验蒸馏进人工神经网络 (ANN) 的主张。作者指出，在先验的标准解释下，M&G 的程序并未真正注入先验，而只是对网络权重进行了有利的初始化；即使是更宽松的解释也面临挑战；并且与真正的贝叶斯学习器不同，M&G 的模型会过拟合，对未见数据的泛化能力较差。
Motivation: M&G 声称通过 MAML 将贝叶斯先验蒸馏到 ANN 中，并在形式语言学习任务上取得接近贝叶斯学习器的表现。本文旨在检验这一说法在概念上和经验上是否成立，因为它关系到对 meta-learning 与贝叶斯推断关系的理解。
Method: 本文是一篇评论性论文，从标准先验定义出发审视 M&G 的 MAML 训练流程，论证其只改变权重初始化而不改变目标函数；随后讨论一种更宽松的、把整个系统视为贝叶斯学习器的解释，并指出该解释存在非平凡困难；最后通过评估 MAML 对贝叶斯学习经验结果的逼近程度，检验其泛化行为。
Result: 作者认为 M&G 的程序并没有真正注入先验；更宽松的解释也面临困难；并且与真正的贝叶斯学习器不同，M&G 的模型在未见数据上过拟合且泛化不佳。
Conclusion: 作者认为 M&G 关于将贝叶斯先验蒸馏进 ANN 的主张在标准解释下不成立，且其经验结果不能支持其结论；评论提示对 MAML 作为贝叶斯近似工具的适用性需持谨慎态度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Online Inference for Quantile Temporal Difference Learning in Distributional Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study how to perform statistical inference for quantile temporal difference learning (QTD) in distributional reinforcement learning. Assuming access to a generative model, we first establish functional central limit theorems for both synchronous and asynchronous QTD, which show that the averaged iterates of QTD converge weakly to a rescaled Brownian motion. We next provide online inference methods. Based on random scaling, the inference procedure constructs an asymptotically pivotal statistic for inference by using the information along the whole QTD path. Meanwhile, the proposed statistic can be computed online without storing the entire trajectory of QTD iterates. This substantially reduces the memory requirement and enables efficient statistical inference in distributional reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分布式强化学习（distributional reinforcement learning）中分位数时序差分学习（QTD）的统计推断问题。作者在可访问生成模型（generative model）的假设下，为同步和异步QTD建立了函数中心极限定理，表明其平均迭代弱收敛于重标度布朗运动。基于随机缩放（random scaling）构造渐近枢轴统计量，并可在线上计算，无需存储整个QTD迭代轨迹，从而显著降低内存需求。
Motivation: QTD在分布式强化学习中缺乏严格的统计推断理论基础，而传统推断方法通常需要存储全部迭代轨迹，内存开销大。该工作旨在为QTD提供具有理论保证且内存高效的在线推断方法。
Method: 假设可以访问生成模型，推导同步与异步QTD的函数中心极限定理；利用随机缩放构造渐近枢轴统计量，该统计量沿QTD整条路径构造，但采用在线更新方式计算，无需保存完整轨迹。
Result: 摘要报告的理论结果表明，同步和异步QTD的平均迭代弱收敛到重标度布朗运动；所提出的统计量是渐近枢轴的（asymptotically pivotal），且在线计算大幅降低了存储需求。
Conclusion: 该工作为分布式强化学习中的QTD提供了一种低内存的在线统计推断框架，核心贡献在于随机缩放方法及沿路径信息的利用。摘要未提及实验验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bias Mitigation in Face Recognition via Demographic-based Supervised Contrastive Learning
papers.abstract_en: Face recognition systems have been shown to be biased toward certain demographic groups by exhibiting different error rates across gender, age, or ethnicity. Though the imbalance of the training data with respect to these demographics is one cause of this bias, training on artificially balanced groups does not completely mitigate the problem. For deployment, face recognition typically works at operating points allowing very low false match rates and, hence, on the tail of the non-match score distribution. While class balancing can improve the means of these distributions, the aim of our approach is to improve fairness by addressing the behavior in the tail. Particularly, we propose the Demographic-based Supervised Contrastive loss (DeSCon) for face recognition, which relies on a well-designed composition of training batches and demographic-aware pair selection. Our experimental evaluation on both demographically-labeled datasets and standard verification benchmarks shows that DeSCon can improve fairness beyond balancing training datasets while maintaining competitive verification performance. Source code is available upon request.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Demographic-based Supervised Contrastive loss (DeSCon)，用于人脸识别中的偏见缓解。该方法通过精心设计的训练批次组成和人口统计感知的样本对选择，直接改善非匹配分数分布的尾部行为，而非只优化分布均值。实验表明，在人口统计标注数据集和标准验证基准上，DeSCon 能在保持有竞争力验证性能的同时，超越仅平衡训练数据所带来的公平性提升。
Motivation: 人脸识别系统在性别、年龄、族裔等人口统计群体上表现出不同错误率，训练数据不平衡是原因之一，但简单地用人工平衡的群体数据训练并不能完全解决该问题；部署时人脸识别通常在极低假匹配率的操作点工作，问题集中在非匹配分数分布的尾部，而已有的类平衡方法只能改善分布均值。
Method: 提出 Demographic-based Supervised Contrastive loss (DeSCon)，核心包括训练批次的组合设计 (batch composition) 与人口统计感知的样本对选择 (demographic-aware pair selection)，以针对非匹配分数分布的尾部进行优化。
Result: 摘要报告，在人口统计标注数据集和标准验证基准上的实验显示，DeSCon 能够比平衡训练数据集更有效地提升公平性，同时维持有竞争力的验证性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过专门处理非匹配分数分布的尾部行为，可以在数据平衡之外进一步改善人脸识别的公平性；源代码可按需提供。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Understanding Backdoor Vulnerabilities in Vertical Federated Learning: The Gap Between Research and Practice
papers.abstract_en: Vertical Federated Learning (VFL) enables organizations holding complementary features of shared entities to collaborate and train models. In this setting, the initiator can withhold information about the learning task, while other contributors participate without exposing their local datasets, creating an asymmetric information structure aligned with growing privacy demands. However, this asymmetry is a double-edged sword. Among various threats, backdoor attacks are particularly concerning because VFL not only enables malicious contributors to poison the model during training, but also allows them to activate the backdoor at inference time to manipulate predictions. Although prior work has reported near-perfect attack success rates and proposed effective defenses, we find that most findings fail to hold under realistic conditions, exposing a fundamental gap between research and practice. In this paper, we present a systematic, practice-oriented study of backdoor vulnerabilities in VFL, revealing this gap in both methodological design and evaluation practices. We show that existing approaches overlook key practical constraints and therefore rely on unrealistic prior knowledge. Furthermore, these limitations have remained hidden due to poorly designed evaluation practices in the literature. To bridge this gap, we redefine threat models under realistic constraints, propose practical backdoor workflows, and introduce BVBench, a backdoor-centric benchmark that enables fair, practical, and comprehensive evaluation, preloaded with state-of-the-art baselines. BVBench provides strong evidence of the fragility of the current understanding of VFL backdoor risks and establishes a foundation for steering research toward uncovering practical vulnerabilities and developing more meaningful defenses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统地研究纵向联邦学习 (Vertical Federated Learning, VFL) 中的后门攻击 (backdoor attacks) 脆弱性，指出现有研究在方法设计和评估实践两方面都与现实条件存在明显差距。作者重新定义在现实约束下的威胁模型，提出实用的后门攻击工作流，并发布后门中心化基准 BVBench，预置了当前最先进的基线。摘要称 BVBench 提供了证据表明现有对 VFL 后门风险的理解是脆弱的，旨在引导研究转向发现实际漏洞和开发更有意义的防御。
Motivation: VFL 中发起方可以隐瞒学习任务信息、参与方无需暴露本地数据，这种不对称信息结构在满足隐私需求的同时也带来了后门攻击风险。尽管已有工作报告接近完美的攻击成功率和有效防御，但这些结论大多在现实条件下不成立，文献中缺乏对实际约束和评估方式的系统审视。
Method: 作者在现实约束下重新定义威胁模型，提出实用的后门攻击工作流，并引入后门中心化基准 BVBench，提供公平、实用且全面的评估框架，并预加载了当前 state-of-the-art 的基线方法。
Result: 摘要报告发现大多数已有结论在现实条件下无法成立，现有方法依赖不切实际的先验知识，且这些问题因文献中设计不良的评估实践而长期未被发现；BVBench 的证据表明当前对 VFL 后门风险的理解具有脆弱性。
Conclusion: 本文通过实践导向的研究揭示了 VFL 后门研究与实践之间的差距，强调需要重新审视威胁模型和评估标准，以推动发现实际脆弱性并发展更有意义的防御。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Moose: Latent concept learning with reasoning-shortcut awareness in $\mathcal{EL}^{++}$
papers.abstract_en: The OWL 2 EL profile is used in some of the largest production ontologies, including the Gene Ontology and SNOMED CT. Existing neuro-symbolic (NeSy) learning methods accept propositional theories or Datalog, and reasoning-shortcut (RS) awareness has not been investigated in ontology settings. We present Moose, a method that compiles an $\mathcal{EL}^{++}$ TBox and finite ABox to a Sentential Decision Diagram (SDD). The SDD acts as a differentiable weighted-model-counting layer, and we add closure clauses outside the $\mathcal{EL}^{++}$ profile on declared exhaustive families to overcome the limited expressivity of $\mathcal{EL}^{++}$ under partial supervision. We show termination, soundness, completeness, and polynomial intermediate sizes, and validate the proofs in Lean. We then define the first formal partial-supervision latent-concept-learning task over an OWL EL ontology, i.e., learning per-individual classifiers for latent concepts from observed ABox literals, and evaluate Moose on MNIST-with-ontology and Pizzaïolo. Moose improves over propositional-NeSy, fuzzy-logic, and ontology embedding baselines, and presents the first reasoning-shortcut analysis in an OWL EL setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Moose，一种在 OWL 2 EL 本体（例如 Gene Ontology、SNOMED CT）上做潜在概念学习（latent concept learning）的神经符号方法，并首次在该设定下研究推理捷径（reasoning shortcut）。Moose 将 EL++ TBox 与有限 ABox 编译为 Sentential Decision Diagram（SDD），作为可微的加权模型计数层，并在声明的穷尽族上加入 EL++ profile 之外的闭包子句以弥补表达力不足。文中证明了终止性、可靠性、完备性和多项式中间规模，并用 Lean 验证证明；在 MNIST-with-ontology 与 Pizzaïolo 上的实验显示其优于命题式神经符号、模糊逻辑和本体嵌入基线，同时给出 OWL EL 设定下首个推理捷径分析。
Motivation: 现有神经符号（NeSy）学习方法多面向命题理论或 Datalog，尚未在真实本体设定下考虑推理捷径问题；而 OWL 2 EL 被用于大规模生产本体，需要能利用本体结构进行部分监督学习的可扩展方法。
Method: Moose 将 EL++ TBox 和有限 ABox 编译成 SDD，将其作为可微加权模型计数层，并通过在声明为穷尽族（exhaustive families）的类上添加闭包子句来克服 EL++ 在部分监督下的表达力局限。作者形式化了首个 OWL EL 本体上的部分监督潜在概念学习任务，即为潜在概念学习逐个体分类器。
Result: 摘要报告 Moose 在 MNIST-with-ontology 和 Pizzaïolo 上优于命题式 NeSy、模糊逻辑和本体嵌入基线，并给出 OWL EL 设定下首个推理捷径分析；同时证明了终止性、可靠性、完备性和多项式中间规模，证明在 Lean 中得到验证。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过将本体编译为 SDD 并加入闭包子句，可以在 OWL EL 本体上实现可证明且学习效果更好的潜在概念学习，并开启本体设定下的推理捷径研究。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.motivation: 现有神经符号（NeSy）学习方法多面向命题理论或 Datalog，尚未在真实本体设定下考虑推理捷径问题；而 OWL 2 EL 被用于大规模生产本体，需要能利用本体结构进行部分监督学习的可扩展方法。
summary_sections.method: Moose 将 EL++ TBox 和有限 ABox 编译成 SDD，将其作为可微加权模型计数层，并通过在声明为穷尽族（exhaustive families）的类上添加闭包子句来克服 EL++ 在部分监督下的表达力局限。作者形式化了首个 OWL EL 本体上的部分监督潜在概念学习任务，即为潜在概念学习逐个体分类器。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 Moose 在 MNIST-with-ontology 和 Pizzaïolo 上优于命题式 NeSy、模糊逻辑和本体嵌入基线，并给出 OWL EL 设定下首个推理捷径分析；同时证明了终止性、可靠性、完备性和多项式中间规模，证明在 Lean 中得到验证。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为通过将本体编译为 SDD 并加入闭包子句，可以在 OWL EL 本体上实现可证明且学习效果更好的潜在概念学习，并开启本体设定下的推理捷径研究。

papers.title: A Deep RL based Framework for Targeted White Matter Tractography
papers.abstract_en: Fiber tractography's ability to reconstruct the brain's structural pathways, has made it a crucial component of modern neuroimaging, enabling detailed, non-invasive mapping of structural connectivity and supporting a wide range of neurological research and clinical applications. However, despite its importance, tractography remains a challenging task due to the inherent complexity of white matter structure and its susceptibility to false positives, which can lead to the misrepresentation of critical pathways. To overcome these limitations, in this thesis, we propose a hybrid framework that integrates reinforcement learning with supervised learning for refining RL policies, specifically tailored for tract-specific tractography. Notably, our framework does not rely on ground-truth fibers for training. Moreover, the tract-specific formulation bypasses the need for an explicit segmentation process, simplifying the overall pipeline. Our work includes two main contributions, each building upon the previous. First, we introduce a hybrid approach that combines reinforcement learning with supervised learning (specifically, GPT-based policy learning) to refine policies in a tract-specific context. Second, we propose a scalable framework for data-driven multi-policy fusion, which leverages the complementary strengths of multiple RL policies to improve tractography performance and robustness. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework through extensive validation on benchmark public datasets including TractoInferno, HCP, and ISMRM-2015, highlighting its ability to generalize across data sources and accurately reconstruct brain white matter tracts. We believe that these contributions represent significant advancements in the field of tractography, improving robustness, reliability, and accuracy while reducing dependence on ground-truth annotations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 IIT Mandi 的 MTech 研究论文，提出一个将强化学习与监督学习相结合的混合框架，用于束特异白质纤维束成像 (tractography)。框架不依赖真实纤维 (ground-truth fibers) 进行训练，也无需显式的分割流程，并进一步提出数据驱动的多策略融合 (multi-policy fusion) 方案。作者在 TractoInferno、HCP 与 ISMRM-2015 等公共数据集上验证了其跨数据源泛化和准确重建脑白质纤维束的能力。
Motivation: 纤维束成像虽能无创重建脑结构连接，但白质结构的固有复杂性和对假阳性的敏感性可能导致关键通路被错误呈现。现有方法常依赖分割流程或 ground-truth 纤维标注，作者希望在不依赖这些条件的前提下提升束特异追踪的性能与鲁棒性。
Method: 提出两阶段混合框架：首先将强化学习与监督学习（具体为基于 GPT 的策略学习）结合，在束特异上下文中细化 RL 策略；其次提出一个可扩展的数据驱动多策略融合框架，利用多个 RL 策略的互补优势来提升追踪性能与鲁棒性。
Result: 摘要报告在 TractoInferno、HCP 和 ISMRM-2015 等公开基准数据集上的广泛验证，表明框架能够跨数据源泛化并准确重建脑白质纤维束。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作提升了纤维束成像的鲁棒性、可靠性与准确性，同时减少了对 ground-truth 标注的依赖。

papers.title: The Objective Is the Bottleneck: Latent World Models Encode What Their Planners Cannot Use
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models are judged by how well they predict, so when planning fails at long horizons the natural reading is that the predictor degrades. On a reproduction of LeWorldModel on TwoRoom we show the binding constraint is the planner's objective instead. The predictor is not the limit: its imagined state seventy-five environment steps ahead is still only 0.189 as wrong as assuming the world froze, while the planner never imagines beyond twenty-five. The objective is. Cross-entropy-method planning minimises squared latent distance, which tracks true distance at r = 0.426, saturates by about eighty arena units and decreases beyond a hundred and twenty, so moving away from the goal can lower the cost. The information is present throughout: a ridge probe recovers position from the frozen embedding at R^2 0.9922. The pathology is the method's, not one reimplementation's. It is present in the authors' released weights, and across four checkpoints long-horizon success rank-orders exactly with metric quality and inversely with prediction accuracy. Replacing only the objective, with nothing retrained and no GPU, lifts goals reached at offset 100 from 26.0% to 98.0%, equals the 98.0% at offset 25, and reaches 92.0% under a third of the budget: planning stops depending on the horizon. The best cost is not the most accurate. A head learned from frame separation alone predicts spatial distance worse than a position probe (r = 0.819 against 0.9897) yet plans better, charging 24% more to cross the environment's dividing wall where squared latent distance charges 4% less. It has learned reachability, not proximity.
papers.comment: Follow-up to arXiv:2608.10145. All experiments run on a laptop CPU; no model was trained or fine-tuned. Code, checkpoints and every measurement: github.com/joyjeet-singh/tinylab
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 LeWorldModel 于 TwoRoom 环境的复现实验上论证：长时程规划失败的瓶颈不是潜在世界模型的预测能力，而是规划器的目标函数。预测器在 75 步前的想象状态误差仅为假设世界冻结的 0.189 倍，但规划器从不越过 25 步想象；交叉熵方法规划所最小化的平方潜在距离与真实距离仅相关 r=0.426，并在约 80 个环境单位后饱和、超过 120 后反而下降。仅替换目标函数、不重训模型且不使用 GPU，即可将 offset 100 的目标达成率从 26.0% 提升到 98.0%。
Motivation: 潜在世界模型通常以预测质量衡量，当长时程规划失败时容易被归因于预测器退化；本文旨在检验真正的约束是否在于规划器的目标函数而非模型预测。
Method: 在单 CPU 笔记本上复现 LeWorldModel/TwoRoom，不训练或微调任何模型；通过岭探针（ridge probe）从冻结嵌入恢复位置，对比平方潜在距离、位置探针预测与仅由帧间隔学习的头部，并仅替换规划目标函数进行实验。
Result: 冻结嵌入的岭探针恢复位置达 R^2 0.9922，说明信息全程存在；平方潜在距离在约 80 环境单位处饱和并在 120 后下降，导致远离目标可能降低成本。仅替换目标函数后，offset 100 目标达成率由 26.0% 升至 98.0%（与 offset 25 持平），并能在三分之一的预算下达到 92.0%；预测更准确的位置探针头（r=0.9897）反而规划更差，而帧分离学习的头（r=0.819）规划更好，跨越环境隔墙多收费 24%，平方潜在距离则少收费 4%。
Conclusion: 作者认为障碍在于规划器目标而非预测器：最佳成本函数不是最准确的，模型学到的是可达性（reachability）而非邻近性；该病理现象在作者发布的权重和四个检查点上稳定出现，验证了方法层面的系统性而非单个复现实现的问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: I-SDPO: Instance-Level Adaptive Self-Distillation Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) learns from reward differences within a rollout group, but receives no useful relative signal when every sampled response is incorrect. Privileged self-distillation can fill this gap with dense token supervision, yet applying it throughout training creates a different failure mode: the teacher is a biased, low-variance surrogate for the reward objective, so persistent imitation can oppose reward-improving updates after the policy becomes capable of producing successful trajectories. We introduce I-SDPO (Instance-Level Adaptive Self-Distillation Policy Optimization), which treats teacher reliance as capability-dependent. I-SDPO makes one routing decision per input instance and shares it across that instance's rollout group: all-incorrect groups use a privileged self-distillation objective, whereas any-success groups remain intact for GRPO. This design uses imitation only where group-relative rewards are uninformative. A local analysis characterizes when teacher and reward directions align and shows that a non-vanishing biased distillation weight induces an optimization bias floor. The routing rule automatically reduces the expected distillation rate as success probability rises, withdrawing teacher influence without a hand-designed schedule. On SciKnowEval, I-SDPO obtains the best result in all four scientific domains and improves average mean@16 accuracy from 56.67% with GRPO to 70.31%, with a maximum domain gain of 18.24 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 I-SDPO (Instance-Level Adaptive Self-Distillation Policy Optimization)，针对 GRPO 在整组采样均错误时缺乏有效相对奖励信号的问题，按输入实例做路由：全错组改用特权自蒸馏目标，含成功样本的组维持 GRPO。在 SciKnowEval 四个科学领域上均取得最佳结果，平均 mean@16 精度从 GRPO 的 56.67% 提升到 70.31%。
Motivation: GRPO 依赖组内奖励差异，当一组响应全部错误时没有可用的相对信号；而全程使用特权自蒸馏又会引入有偏、低方差的教师代理目标，在策略能生成成功轨迹后持续模仿会阻碍奖励改进的更新。
Method: I-SDPO 将教师依赖视为随能力变化的因素，每个输入实例做一次路由决策并共享给该实例的整组 rollout：全部错误的组使用特权自蒸馏目标，而有成功响应的组保持 GRPO 目标，使模仿仅出现在组相对奖励无信息时。作者还给出了局部理论分析，刻画教师方向与奖励方向一致的条件，并指出非零的有偏蒸馏权重会导致优化偏差下界。
Result: 在 SciKnowEval 上，I-SDPO 在全部四个科学领域取得最优结果，平均 mean@16 精度从 GRPO 的 56.67% 提升到 70.31%，最大单领域增益为 18.24 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该路由规则会在成功率上升时自动降低期望蒸馏率，无需手工设计的调度；理论分析显示有偏蒸馏权重不消失会造成偏差下限，这界定了方法的适用范围。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Unifying Depth and Width Pruning for LLMs via Binary Knapsack Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Structured pruning is a promising approach for compressing large language models (LLMs), yet existing methods rely heavily on greedy heuristics that produce myopic decisions, and often fail to precisely meet target compression budgets. We present SNIPER, a two-stage structured pruning framework that solves a knapsack optimization over coarse-granularity components to yield conditionally optimal parameter allocations with respect to fixed importance estimates, followed by a fine-grained pruning stage to meet strict budget constraints. We introduce the Compression Ratio Adherence Factor (CRAFT) to quantify budget fidelity, showing that while existing pruners deviate from target compression ratios by up to 33%, SNIPER achieves near-exact adherence with a CRAFT score of 0.98. Evaluations across four diverse architectures over a set of 18 tasks spanning five domains demonstrate SNIPER's consistent improvements in average performance retention and task-level stability over six state-of-the-art pruners. Across all pruning configurations, SNIPER achieves an excellent mean rank of 1.25, indicating its robust cross-architectural generalizability and excellent reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SNIPER，一种针对 LLM 结构化剪枝 (structured pruning) 的两阶段框架：先对粗粒度组件求解背包优化 (knapsack optimization) 以获得在固定重要性估计下的条件最优参数分配，再通过细粒度剪枝阶段满足严格的压缩预算。摘要报告 SNIPER 的 CRAFT 得分为 0.98，接近精确的预算保真度，并在四个架构、18 个任务上相对六个现有剪枝器取得一致改进，平均排名 1.25。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 结构化剪枝方法依赖贪心启发式，决策短视，且常常无法精确达到目标压缩预算。
Method: SNIPER 采用两阶段流程：第一阶段对粗粒度组件执行背包优化，得到给定重要性估计下的条件最优参数分配；第二阶段进行细粒度剪枝以满足严格预算约束。同时引入压缩比一致性因子 (CRAFT) 来量化剪枝后的预算保真度。
Result: 摘要称现有剪枝器与目标压缩比的偏差最高达 33%，而 SNIPER 的 CRAFT 得分达到 0.98。在四个多样架构、跨五个领域的 18 个任务上，SNIPER 相比六个 SOTA 剪枝器在平均性能保留和任务级稳定性上都有提升，所有配置下平均排名为 1.25。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SNIPER 能接近精确地实现目标压缩比，并具备跨架构泛化能力与可靠性，可作为 LLM 结构化剪枝的一种稳健方案。

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 SNIPER 能接近精确地实现目标压缩比，并具备跨架构泛化能力与可靠性，可作为 LLM 结构化剪枝的一种稳健方案。

papers.title: CardioState-JEPA: Delay-Aware Cross-Modal Learning of a Shared Cardiac Representation
papers.abstract_en: Electrocardiography (ECG), photoplethysmography (PPG), and phonocardiography (PCG) provide complementary views of the same cardiac cycle, yet existing cardiac foundation models are trained for a single sensing modality, leaving the shared physiology across sensors unexploited. We introduce CardioState-JEPA, a cardiac foundation model to learn a single shared representation jointly across ECG, PPG, and PCG, built on a physiology-aware joint-embedding predictive architecture. The model maps heterogeneous waveforms into a common token space, processes them with a single shared Transformer encoder, and learns by predicting masked latent cardiac states, placing the pretraining target on shared physiology rather than sensor-specific waveform appearance. To handle the temporal offsets between electrical, mechanical, and hemodynamic events, cross-modal prediction uses a learned delay aligner that matches signals at the corresponding cardiac time. Because synchronized multi-sensor recordings are scarce, CardioState-JEPA first learns within-modality structure from abundant unimodal data and then uses paired data to align modalities in latent cardiac time. Evaluated as a frozen encoder across 25 downstream tasks spanning ECG, PPG, and PCG, our encoder improves average PPG classification by 8.2 AUROC points, PCG murmur detection by 18.8 AUROC points, and ECG classification by 15.5 AUROC points over the best self-supervised signal baseline and matches or exceeds cardiac models trained with privileged clinical text or supervised labels on several ECG benchmarks. These results establish that heterogeneous cardiac signals can mutually supervise a single foundation model of cardiac physiology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CardioState-JEPA，一种面向心脏信号的基础模型，在 ECG、PPG 与 PCG 三种模态上联合学习单一共享表示。模型基于生理感知的联合嵌入预测架构 (joint-embedding predictive architecture)，将异构波形映射到公共 token 空间，用单个共享 Transformer 编码器处理，并通过预测掩码的潜在心脏状态进行预训练，使预训练目标落在共享生理而非传感器特有的波形外观上。同时引入可学习的延迟对齐器处理电、机械和血流动力学事件之间的时间偏移。
Motivation: 现有心脏基础模型均为单一传感模态训练，未能利用跨传感器共享的心脏生理信息；此外，同步多传感器记录稀缺，难以直接进行跨模态预训练。
Method: 采用生理感知的联合嵌入预测架构，将 ECG、PPG、PCG 波形统一映射到公共 token 空间并由共享 Transformer 编码；训练目标为预测被掩码的潜在心脏状态。跨模态预测使用可学习的延迟对齐器 (delay aligner) 在对应心脏时间上对齐信号。预训练分两阶段：先用丰富的单模态数据学习模态内结构，再用配对数据在潜在心脏时间上对齐模态。
Result: 作为冻结编码器在 25 个下游任务上评估，相较最佳自监督信号基线，平均 PPG 分类 AUROC 提升 8.2 点，PCG 杂音检测提升 18.8 点，ECG 分类提升 15.5 点；在若干 ECG 基准上达到或超过使用特权临床文本或监督标签训练的心脏模型。
Conclusion: 结果表明异构心脏信号可以相互监督、共同训练出一个单一的心脏生理基础模型；摘要强调将预训练目标置于共享生理而非传感器特定外观，并用延迟对齐处理时序偏移是该方法的关键。

papers.title: Diagnosing JEPA World Models with Action-Conditioned Predictive Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn world models that predict in a compact latent space rather than in pixels, reducing the pressure to model nuisance appearance. Yet this provides no guarantee against visual perturbations: they can still alter the encoded representation and affect subsequent action-conditioned predictions. Bisimulation captures this requirement precisely: two observations should be treated as the same state only when their action-conditioned consequences agree. Guided by this criterion, we introduce Action-Conditioned Predictive Consistency (ACPC), a diagnostic that measures how far a clean history and a visually perturbed view of it diverge after being rolled forward under the same action sequence. We prove that this divergence bounds the perturbation-induced change in multi-step prediction error and planner cost. Building on pairwise ACPC, we define two complementary measures: the Invariance Radius (IR) summarizes clean-perturbed rollout spread, while the Separation Rate (SR) checks whether different states remain distinguishable after rollout. Experiments on four visual control tasks show that pairwise ACPC predicts perturbation-induced prediction and cost changes. On LeWM, the IR-SR screen transfers across tasks, and the joint diagnostic remains informative under blur and resize. PLDM exhibits similar diagnostic trends under a different architecture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）世界模型在视觉扰动下的脆弱性，提出一种名为动作条件预测一致性（ACPC）的诊断方法。作者证明干净历史与视觉扰动视图在同一动作序列下滚动预测的差异，能够界定扰动引起的多步预测误差与规划器代价变化，并在此基础上定义互补的 Invariance Radius（IR）与 Separation Rate（SR）两个度量。实验在四个视觉控制任务上验证了 ACPC 对扰动导致预测与代价变化的预测能力。
Motivation: JEPA 在紧凑隐空间而非像素空间预测，虽然降低了对无关外观的建模压力，但视觉扰动仍可能改变编码表示并影响后续动作条件预测。作者以双模拟（bisimulation）准则为参照，指出需要一种诊断方法来量化干净历史与扰动历史在动作条件后果上的分歧。
Method: 引入 Action-Conditioned Predictive Consistency（ACPC）作为诊断指标，度量同一动作序列下干净历史与视觉扰动视图滚动后的发散程度；基于成对 ACPC 进一步定义 Invariance Radius（IR）以概括干净-扰动轨迹的散布，以及 Separation Rate（SR）以检验不同状态在滚动后是否仍可区分。
Result: 在四个视觉控制任务上的实验显示，成对 ACPC 能预测扰动引起的预测误差与代价变化；在 LeWM 上 IR-SR 筛选可在任务间迁移，且联合诊断在模糊与缩放扰动下仍保持信息量；PLDM 在另一种架构下呈现相近的诊断趋势。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该诊断从理论上建立了干净-扰动滚动发散对多步预测误差与规划器代价的界，并给出了可迁移的互补度量（IR 与 SR）；其适用范围主要在视觉控制世界模型评估，而非特定领域任务。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: AutoQuREO: A Framework for Automated Quantum Resource Estimation and Optimization
papers.abstract_en: As quantum computing progresses from proof-of-principle demonstrations toward practical utility, a significant impediment is the need to augment algorithmic feasibility with system-level optimization across heterogeneous hardware and software stacks. Quantum resource estimation (QRE) plays a central role in this transition, yet existing approaches remain largely compilation-heavy or domain-knowledge-guided symbolic annotations, and tightly coupled to long-term fault-tolerant assumptions, limiting their topical applicability. In this work, we introduce AutoQuREO, an Automated framework for full-stack Quantum Resource Estimation and Optimization. AutoQuREO is built around four core novelties: (i) a flexible, user-defined abstraction of the quantum computing stack; (ii) a modular library of reusable stack components enabling rapid full-stack prototyping; (iii) surrogate modeling of layer-wise resources via algorithmic profiling and neuro-symbolic learning; and (iv) integrated multi-objective optimization that embeds QRE directly into deployment pipelines. Together, these design choices enable AutoQuREO to serve as a digital twin for quantum computing stacks, supporting the tractable exploration of complex design spaces. We demonstrate the capabilities of AutoQuREO through representative co-design case studies, including early-fault-tolerant quantum algorithms, small error correction codes, gate decomposition and variational training of parametric quantum circuits. These examples illustrate how AutoQuREO enables systematic discovery of unexploited resource trade-offs that are computationally intractable or abstruse using existing QRE tools. AutoQuREO is positioned as a general-purpose platform for advancing quantum technology readiness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoQuREO，一个用于全栈量子资源估计与优化 (QRE) 的自动化框架。框架围绕四个核心创新：用户自定义的量子计算栈抽象、可复用的栈组件库、基于算法剖析与神经符号学习的逐层资源代理建模 (surrogate modeling)，以及集成多目标优化。作者通过早期容错量子算法、小规模纠错码、门分解和参数量子电路变分训练等协同设计案例展示其能力，并将 AutoQuREO 定位为量子技术就绪度提升的通用平台。
Motivation: 量子计算从原理验证走向实际效用时，需要在异构软硬件栈上进行系统级优化，而现有量子资源估计方法大多偏重编译或依赖领域知识引导的符号标注，且与长期容错假设紧密耦合，限制了其在各类应用场景中的适用性。
Method: 提出 AutoQuREO 框架，包含四项核心设计：(i) 灵活的用户自定义量子计算栈抽象；(ii) 可复用栈组件的模块化库以支持快速全栈原型构建；(iii) 通过算法剖析和神经符号学习对逐层资源进行代理建模；(iv) 将 QRE 直接嵌入部署管线的集成多目标优化。整体上作为量子计算栈的数字孪生 (digital twin)，支持复杂设计空间的可处理探索。
Result: 摘要通过代表性协同设计案例进行展示，包括早期容错量子算法、小规模纠错码、门分解和参数量子电路的变分训练；这些案例表明 AutoQuREO 能系统发现现有 QRE 工具在计算上难以处理或难以理解的资源权衡。摘要未给出量化结果。
Conclusion: 作者将 AutoQuREO 定位为推进量子技术就绪度的通用平台，强调其支持对复杂量子计算栈设计空间的系统探索。

papers.title: Decomposition of Evidence, Contradiction, and Fragility in Perturbation Responses
papers.abstract_en: Perturbation methods explain model decisions by measuring prediction changes under altered inputs, but response magnitude tells us only how much a model reacts, not what that reaction means. The same magnitude can support the final factual-counterfactual difference, oppose it, or arise strongly along the perturbation path yet vanish at the endpoint. We therefore track how the contrast develops as paired inputs are progressively revealed, using the final contrast to interpret the trajectory. We introduce DECAF (Decomposition of Evidence, Contradiction, And Fragility), which routes aligned, opposed, and endpoint-null responses into evidence E, contradiction C, and fragility F. The decomposition preserves ordinary magnitude exactly, Abs = E + C + F, and is unique under endpoint-relative axioms. Across controlled vision and tabular settings, the three components track independently measured behavior. In a 72-model ImageNet-9 audit, we compare cases with nearly identical response magnitude but different independently measured behaviors. The largest DECAF component agrees with an observed behavior in 96.4% of cases, compared with 35.0% for magnitude alone. Changing only the reveal path increases total response by nearly 80%, yet evidence barely changes while fragility grows by more than 4x. On FunnyBirds and ImageNet-1k, short forward-only DECAF trajectories outperform the tested general-purpose attribution baselines. On a 1B-scale DINOv2 model, a short trajectory matches a strong gradient-based baseline with 4.75x lower wall time and 2.36x lower peak memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扰动解释方法的一个盲点：响应幅度只表示模型反应有多大，无法说明反应的含义。作者提出 DECAF，将扰动响应分解为证据 E、矛盾 C 和脆弱性 F 三个成分，并严格保持原始幅度不变（Abs = E + C + F），且该分解在端点相对公理下唯一。在受控视觉与表格实验、72 模型 ImageNet-9 审计以及 FunnyBirds/ImageNet-1k 和 1B 规模 DINOv2 上的实验表明，三成分与独立测得的模型行为一致，并能提升解释效率。
Motivation: 现有扰动方法只报告响应幅度，而相同幅度可能支持最终事实-反事实差异、反对它，或在扰动路径中途很强但在端点消失；需要区分这些不同的语义含义，而不仅仅是反应大小。
Method: 提出 DECAF（Decomposition of Evidence, Contradiction, And Fragility），在成对输入逐步揭示的过程中追踪对比如何发展，并用最终对比解释轨迹，将一致、相反和端点为零的响应分别归入证据 E、矛盾 C 和脆弱性 F；分解满足 Abs = E + C + F，并在端点相对公理下唯一。
Result: 在 72 模型 ImageNet-9 审计中，最大 DECAF 成分与独立观测行为一致的比例为 96.4%，而仅用幅度时为 35.0%；只改变揭示路径可使总响应增加近 80%，但证据几乎不变而脆弱性增长超过 4 倍。在 FunnyBirds 和 ImageNet-1k 上，短的前向-only DECAF 轨迹优于所测试的通用归因基线；在 1B 规模 DINOv2 上，短轨迹达到强梯度基线的效果，同时墙钟时间降低 4.75 倍、峰值内存降低 2.36 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调扰动响应中“大小”与“含义”需要解耦，DECAF 的三成分分解能更准确地反映独立可观测行为，并可通过短前向轨迹获得高效解释；实验范围覆盖受控视觉和表格设置。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 在 72 模型 ImageNet-9 审计中，最大 DECAF 成分与独立观测行为一致的比例为 96.4%，而仅用幅度时为 35.0%；只改变揭示路径可使总响应增加近 80%，但证据几乎不变而脆弱性增长超过 4 倍。在 FunnyBirds 和 ImageNet-1k 上，短的前向-only DECAF 轨迹优于所测试的通用归因基线；在 1B 规模 DINOv2 上，短轨迹达到强梯度基线的效果，同时墙钟时间降低 4.75 倍、峰值内存降低 2.36 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调扰动响应中“大小”与“含义”需要解耦，DECAF 的三成分分解能更准确地反映独立可观测行为，并可通过短前向轨迹获得高效解释；实验范围覆盖受控视觉和表格设置。

papers.title: FlashDrive: Flash Vision-Language-Action Inference for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models promise to bring end-to-end reasoning to autonomous driving, but their computational cost remains far too high for real-time control. The core challenge is structural: VLA inference is not a single bottleneck but a cascade of four. Visual encoding wastes compute on overlapping video frames; language-model prefill recomputes context that could be carried over from the previous timestep; reasoning tokens are generated serially despite low entropy; and flow-matching denoising applies uniform compute to a non-uniform velocity field. Addressing any one stage in isolation leaves the others untouched. We propose FlashDrive, an algorithm-system co-design framework that targets all four stages simultaneously. Our key insight is that each bottleneck admits a distinct, lightweight algorithmic shortcut: temporal overlap enables streaming KV-cache reuse across frames; the low per-token entropy and strong intra-block correlations of driving-domain reasoning make a non-autoregressive diffusion drafter highly effective for speculative decoding; and the velocity field's structure---sharp at the endpoints, flat in the middle---permits adaptive step caching that concentrates compute where it matters. Layered on system-level CUDA Graph compilation and kernel fusion, these techniques compound. Applied to Alpamayo 1.5-10B with W4A8 quantization, FlashDrive reduces end-to-end latency from 717ms to 151ms (4.7x) while leaving accuracy essentially unchanged: minADE6@6.4s shifts by only 0.08m, minADE1 improves, and closed-loop collision and off-road rates improve in simulation. By raising a 10B-parameter reasoning VLA from 1.4~Hz to 6.6~Hz on a single GPU, FlashDrive moves end-to-end autonomous driving substantially closer to real-time deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlashDrive，一个针对自动驾驶视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型推理的四阶段算法-系统协同设计框架。作者识别出 VLA 推理中的四个级联瓶颈：视频帧重叠导致的视觉编码冗余、prefill 重复计算、低熵推理 token 的串行生成、以及 flow-matching 去噪中的均匀计算分配，并同时给出轻量级算法捷径与系统级优化。在 Alpamayo 1.5-10B 与 W4A8 量化条件下，端到端延迟从 717ms 降至 151ms（4.7 倍），精度基本不变。
Motivation: VLA 模型有望为自动驾驶带来端到端推理，但其计算成本远高于实时控制要求；问题本质上是结构性的，推理不是单一瓶颈而是一串四个级联瓶颈，单独优化任何一级都无法解决整体延迟。
Method: 提出同时针对四个阶段的算法-系统协同设计：利用时间重叠实现跨帧流式 KV-cache 复用；利用驾驶域推理的低 token 熵与块内强相关性，用非自回归扩散 draft 模型做投机解码 (speculative decoding)；利用速度场两端陡峭、中间平坦的结构做自适应步长缓存 (adaptive step caching)；并在系统层叠加 CUDA Graph 编译与内核融合。
Result: 摘要报告在 Alpamayo 1.5-10B 加 W4A8 量化下，端到端延迟从 717ms 降到 151ms（4.7 倍），单 GPU 上 10B 参数推理 VLA 从约 1.4Hz 提升到 6.6Hz；精度几乎不变：minADE6@6.4s 仅变化 0.08m，minADE1 提升，仿真中的闭环碰撞率与 off-road 率均有改善。
Conclusion: 作者认为同时处理四个瓶颈的算法-系统协同设计能有效压缩 VLA 推理延迟，使端到端自动驾驶更接近实时部署条件。

papers.title: Multi-perspective Imbalance-Conscious 6G Beamforming Optimization and Performance
papers.abstract_en: The study presents a systematic machine learning (ML) study of 6G-IoT beamforming optimization (6GBO) using supervised and unsupervised approaches. We compared the predictive power of network, environmental, device, and vision feature groups for 6GBO. Additionally, it addressed other unsupervised perspectives that can enhance 6GBO, including clustering network scenarios using methods such as K-means, DBSCAN, and hierarchical clustering. Several imbalance-aware experiments revealed that network features possess better prediction power than device, environmental, and vision feature groups, as evidenced by their recall, F1-score and ROC-AUC values. For unsupervised ML exploration (assessed using Elbow, Silhouette score, and Davies-Bouldin Index methods), the results indicate that the deployment environment and type of device primarily influence clustering, rather than mobility-based attributes. Furthermore, the explainability analysis showed that bandwidth, IoT sensors, and mobility possess higher global feature importance across the feature groups. In the future, we would apply deep and reinforcement learning techniques to predict throughput/latency or to optimize rewards determined by performance indicators like SNR enhancement
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 6G-IoT 波束成形优化（6GBO）做了系统的机器学习研究，比较了网络、环境、设备与视觉四类特征组的预测能力，并引入 K-means、DBSCAN、层次聚类等无监督视角以及不平衡感知实验。结果显示网络特征的预测能力最强，聚类主要受部署环境和设备类型影响，且带宽、IoT 传感器和移动性具有较高的全局特征重要性。
Motivation: 6G-IoT 波束成形优化需要同时考虑多类异构特征与数据不平衡问题，但现有工作缺乏对不同特征组预测能力、无监督聚类视角和可解释性的系统比较。
Method: 采用监督与无监督相结合的机器学习框架：用网络、环境、设备、视觉特征组分别做预测并比较；使用 K-means、DBSCAN、层次聚类对网络场景聚类，并通过 Elbow、轮廓系数（Silhouette score）和 Davies-Bouldin 指数评估；结合不平衡感知实验与可解释性分析。
Result: 网络特征组在 recall、F1-score 和 ROC-AUC 上优于设备、环境与视觉特征组；聚类分析显示部署环境和设备类型比移动性属性更能主导聚类；带宽、IoT 传感器和移动性是全局特征重要性最高的变量。
Conclusion: 摘要指出未来将采用深度学习和强化学习预测吞吐量/时延或优化由 SNR 增强等性能指标确定的奖励，说明当前工作尚未覆盖这些方向。

papers.title: Polish Medical Visual Question Answering: Vision-Language Models Underutilize Visual Evidence
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a Polish-language medical visual question answering (VQA) benchmark, built from Polish Board Certification Examination questions for licensed physicians and dentists pursuing specialist certification. The benchmark comprises image-containing questions spanning diverse medical specialties and visual domains, together with a text-only question answering (QA) control set. We evaluate Polish-oriented, general-purpose open-weight, and commercial vision-language models. The task remains challenging: the best model achieves 79.0\% accuracy on the full VQA set, and only GPT-5.6 surpasses the approximate human reference on the subset with available candidate responses; all other evaluated models perform worse than humans. To assess visual grounding, we compare complete inputs with configurations omitting the image, the question, or both, and categorize questions by image importance. Models derive more useful information from the question text than from the image and perform worse on image-dominant questions. Across both QA and VQA, they nevertheless achieve above-chance accuracy from the answer choices alone, showing that non-trivial performance can persist even when key task components are missing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个波兰语医学视觉问答 (medical VQA) 基准，数据来自波兰医师和牙医专科认证考试的含图题目，并配有纯文本问答 (QA) 控制集。作者评估了面向波兰语、通用开源及商业视觉-语言模型，发现最佳模型在完整 VQA 集上准确率为 79.0%，且仅 GPT-5.6 在含候选答案的子集上超过人类参考。通过消融图像、问题等输入组件，模型从问题文本中获得的有用信息多于图像，在图像主导问题上表现更差，并且仅凭选项也能达到高于随机的准确率。
Motivation: 现有医学 VQA 基准多集中于英语等资源丰富语言，缺少对低资源语言（如波兰语）以及模型视觉接地 (visual grounding) 能力的系统评估；本文旨在填补这一空白，并考察视觉-语言模型是否真正利用了视觉证据。
Method: 构建波兰语医学 VQA 基准（涵盖多医学专科与视觉领域）以及纯文本 QA 控制集；评估多类视觉-语言模型；通过比较完整输入与省略图像、省略问题或两者皆省略的配置，并按图像重要性对问题分类，来分析模型的视觉接地表现。
Result: 最佳模型在完整 VQA 集上达到 79.0% 准确率；在含候选答案的子集上，仅 GPT-5.6 超过人类参考，其余模型均低于人类。模型从问题文本中获取的有用信息多于图像，在图像主导问题上表现更差，且仅凭答案选项即可实现高于随机的准确率。
Conclusion: 作者认为该任务仍具挑战性，并指出当前视觉-语言模型在医学 VQA 中未充分使用视觉证据；即使在缺少图像或问题等关键组件时模型仍能获得非平凡表现，提示需要关注基准中的捷径 (shortcut) 现象。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: H-VAEP and H-xT: Valuing Offensive On-the-Ball Actions in Handball by Estimating Probabilities
papers.abstract_en: Traditional player evaluation in professional handball relies on basic box-score metrics or heuristic indices, which fail to credit the multi-player build-up chain. While football (soccer) analytics has adopted Expected Threat (xT) and Valuing Actions by Estimating Probabilities (VAEP), these event-based action valuation frameworks have not yet been adapted to handball. In this paper, we present the first comprehensive adaptation and evaluation of xT and VAEP for handball, utilizing five seasons of tracking-derived event data from the Handball Bundesliga. We develop Handball-xT (H-xT) using a handball-native court zoning layout, demonstrating via simulations that it is systematically more robust than standard rectangular grids. We optimize Handball-VAEP (H-VAEP) by tailoring its feature space and selecting the context length to limit team-identity leakage. Our evaluation shows that H-VAEP yields exceptionally stable, discriminative, and intuitive player ratings that highlight build-up play. Finally, we release our complete code repository to help professional clubs deploy these models.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Accepted at the 13th Workshop on Machine Learning and Data Mining for Sports Analytics (MLSA 2026), co-located with ECML PKDD 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将足球分析中的 Expected Threat (xT) 和 Valuing Actions by Estimating Probabilities (VAEP) 框架适配到手球，利用德国手球联赛 (Handball Bundesliga) 五个赛季的追踪事件数据，开发了 Handball-xT (H-xT) 和 Handball-VAEP (H-VAEP)。H-xT 采用手球原生场地分区布局，模拟显示其比标准矩形网格更稳健；H-VAEP 通过定制特征空间和选择上下文长度来限制团队身份泄露。评估表明 H-VAEP 能产生稳定、有区分度且直观的球员评分，并突出组织进攻 (build-up play) 的贡献。
Motivation: 传统手球球员评估依赖基础 box-score 指标或启发式指数，无法体现多球员进攻链的贡献，而足球分析中成熟的 xT 和 VAEP 框架尚未被适配到手球项目。
Method: 基于 Handball Bundesliga 的 tracking-derived event data，提出手球版 xT (H-xT)，使用手球原生场地分区布局，并通过模拟验证其相对标准矩形网格的稳健性；优化手球版 VAEP (H-VAEP)，定制特征空间并选择上下文长度以限制团队身份泄露。
Result: 摘要报告 H-xT 在模拟中系统性更稳健；H-VAEP 产生异常稳定、有区分度且直观的球员评分，并突出组织进攻 (build-up play) 方面的贡献。
Conclusion: 作者发布完整代码库，以帮助职业俱乐部部署这些模型；摘要未讨论明显局限。

papers.title: Momentum as Residual-Driven Multiplier Correction for Deep Learning Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Momentum-based optimizers are widely used in modern deep learning, yet the relations among momentum recursion, update geometry, and acceleration remain only partially understood. We develop an $\textbf{A}$DMM-$\textbf{I}$nspired $\textbf{M}$omentum (AIM) framework based on residual-penalty variable splitting, which interprets momentum as a multiplier-like correction driven by the splitting residual. AIM recovers the exponential moving average of gradients from an ADMM-style multiplier update and separates two mechanisms that are usually intertwined in practical optimizers: the residual penalty determines the update geometry, whereas the approximation of the objective-related subproblem determines the acceleration form. Building on AIM, we propose $\textbf{R}$elativistic $\textbf{A}$daptive gradient $\textbf{D}$escent with $\textbf{A}$ccelerated $\textbf{R}$esidual (RADAR), which combines relativistic adaptive geometry, decoupled residual correction, and second-order momentum filtering to improve the update direction and momentum estimation. We establish stochastic convergence through a variance-perturbed Lyapunov drift analysis. Experiments on supervised vision learning, language modeling, and reinforcement learning show that RADAR achieves consistent improvements over strong adaptive optimizer baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AIM（ADMM-Inspired Momentum）框架，从残差惩罚变量分裂的角度将动量解释为由分裂残差驱动的乘子式校正，并据此设计 RADAR 优化器，融合相对论自适应几何、解耦残差校正与二阶动量滤波。作者通过方差扰动的 Lyapunov 漂移分析建立随机收敛性，并在监督视觉学习、语言建模和强化学习实验中报告 RADAR 相对强自适应优化器基线的一致改进。
Motivation: 动量优化器应用广泛，但动量递归、更新几何与加速之间的关系尚未被完全理解。AIM 框架旨在用 ADMM 式乘子更新的视角解释动量，并将实践中通常纠缠在一起的更新几何与加速形式两个机制分离开来。
Method: 基于残差惩罚变量分裂建立 AIM 框架，使动量恢复为梯度的指数移动平均的乘子式更新；在该框架下提出 RADAR，结合相对论自适应几何、解耦残差校正和二阶动量滤波来改善更新方向与动量估计，并用方差扰动的 Lyapunov 漂移分析证明随机收敛。
Result: 在监督视觉学习、语言建模和强化学习等任务上的实验显示，RADAR 相对于强自适应优化器基线实现了一致改进；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 AIM 为理解动量优化中的几何与加速机制提供了统一视角，并表明 RADAR 在多种任务上有效。
Relevance: 5
