papers.title: Distribution Steering via Sliced Optimal Transport Control
papers.abstract_en: Distribution steering seeks feedback laws that drive the state law of a dynamical system between prescribed initial and terminal distributions. Optimal transport provides a natural geometric approach, but its implementation generally requires a transport map or coupling in the full state space. Sliced optimal transport avoids this full-dimensional construction through one-dimensional projections. Yet, the resulting projected maps specify only directional displacements and do not by themselves prescribe a realizable feedback law. To this end, we develop a finite-horizon control framework based on sliced optimal transport. At each sampling instant, a projected optimal transport map defines a directional terminal condition, whose minimum-energy realization yields a randomized single-direction controller. Averaging over projection directions gives a deterministic sliced feedback. For the single-integrator dynamics, the averaged feedback makes the sliced Wasserstein distance to the target non-increasing. For Gaussian endpoint laws, it is affine, preserves Gaussianity, and steers the mean and covariance to their prescribed terminal values. We further identify a law-dependent gain that yields linear decay of the sliced Wasserstein distance together with an explicit characterization of the control energy. We also prove that the randomized controller converges to the averaged sliced flow as the sampling period vanishes. Finally, we extend the construction to linear dynamical systems. Reachability-normalized coordinates allow instantaneous realization of the sliced velocity for uniformly fully actuated systems, while local controllability Gramians provide exact finite-step realization for general controllable systems. Numerical examples illustrate the resulting distributional flows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于切片最优传输 (sliced optimal transport) 的有限时域分布控制框架，用于为动力系统设计将状态分布从初始分布驱动到目标分布的反馈律。核心做法是在每个采样时刻通过一维投影的最优传输映射定义方向性终端条件，取最小能量实现得到随机单方向控制器，再对投影方向求平均得到确定性切片反馈；作者证明了对单积分器动力学该反馈使切片 Wasserstein 距离单调不增，对高斯端点律保持仿射性与高斯性，并给出线性动力系统的扩展与数值示例。
Motivation: 分布控制 (distribution steering) 需要将动力系统的状态分布从给定初始分布精确驱至终端分布，最优传输提供了几何框架，但通常需要在全状态空间构造传输映射或耦合，实现成本高；切片最优传输通过一维投影避开全维度构造，但其投影映射只给出方向位移，本身无法直接得到可实现的反馈律。
Method: 构建有限时域控制框架：每个采样时刻用一维投影上的最优传输映射定义方向性终端条件，以最小能量方式实现为随机单方向控制器，再对投影方向求平均得到确定性切片反馈。对高斯端点律给出仿射反馈并推导律相关的增益，证明随机控制器在采样周期趋零时收敛到平均切片流；对线性系统引入可达性归一化坐标与局部可控性 Gramian 以分别实现瞬时与有限步精确实现。
Result: 对单积分器动力学，平均反馈使切片 Wasserstein 距离到目标分布非增；对高斯端点分布，反馈是仿射的、保持高斯性，并能将均值与协方差精确驱动到指定终端值；还得到使切片 Wasserstein 距离线性衰减的律相关增益、控制能量的显式刻画，以及随机控制器到平均切片流的收敛性。
Conclusion: 切片最优传输控制为分布控制提供了避免全状态空间传输映射构造的可实现反馈方案，并推广到线性系统与均匀全驱动、一般可控系统等情形；摘要以数值示例展示分布流行为，未涉及实际降水或天气数据实验。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种基于切片最优传输 (sliced optimal transport) 的有限时域分布控制框架，用于为动力系统设计将状态分布从初始分布驱动到目标分布的反馈律。核心做法是在每个采样时刻通过一维投影的最优传输映射定义方向性终端条件，取最小能量实现得到随机单方向控制器，再对投影方向求平均得到确定性切片反馈；作者证明了对单积分器动力学该反馈使切片 Wasserstein 距离单调不增，对高斯端点律保持仿射性与高斯性，并给出线性动力系统的扩展与数值示例。
summary_sections.motivation: 分布控制 (distribution steering) 需要将动力系统的状态分布从给定初始分布精确驱至终端分布，最优传输提供了几何框架，但通常需要在全状态空间构造传输映射或耦合，实现成本高；切片最优传输通过一维投影避开全维度构造，但其投影映射只给出方向位移，本身无法直接得到可实现的反馈律。
summary_sections.method: 构建有限时域控制框架：每个采样时刻用一维投影上的最优传输映射定义方向性终端条件，以最小能量方式实现为随机单方向控制器，再对投影方向求平均得到确定性切片反馈。对高斯端点律给出仿射反馈并推导律相关的增益，证明随机控制器在采样周期趋零时收敛到平均切片流；对线性系统引入可达性归一化坐标与局部可控性 Gramian 以分别实现瞬时与有限步精确实现。
summary_sections.result: 对单积分器动力学，平均反馈使切片 Wasserstein 距离到目标分布非增；对高斯端点分布，反馈是仿射的、保持高斯性，并能将均值与协方差精确驱动到指定终端值；还得到使切片 Wasserstein 距离线性衰减的律相关增益、控制能量的显式刻画，以及随机控制器到平均切片流的收敛性。

papers.title: Validation of Smartphone-Based Photogrammetric 3D Body Scanning for Automated Anthropometric Measurements Compared with a Commercial Depth-Sensor-Based Body Scanner
papers.abstract_en: 3D body scanning has become an important tool in healthcare applications because of its rapid and non-invasive nature. While smartphone-based photogrammetric reconstruction provide a low-cost and accessible alternative to commercial 3D body scanners, their performance for whole-body scanning remains insufficiently validated. Thus, we designed this study to comprehensively validate the photogrammetric 3D scanning application by evaluating automatically extracted whole-body measurements and longitudinal body-shape monitoring. We evaluated a representative application, PolyCam, against the commercial depth-sensor-based Fit3D ProScanner using 144 pregnant participants scanned longitudinally throughout pregnancy. We designed an automatic circumference extraction pipeline to get measurements at four anatomical landmarks from paired 3D scans. A linear mixed-effects model was used to evaluate scanner effects and longitudinal body-shape changes. Measurement consistency was assessed using repeated PolyCam scans and tape measurements on a rigid mannequin. PolyCam demonstrated strong agreement with Fit3D, with average biases below 16 mm, intraclass correlation coefficients above 0.8, and Pearson correlation coefficients above 0.9 across all landmarks. Both systems captured comparable longitudinal body-shape changes. Mannequin experiments showed mean biases below 3.5 mm and no significant differences from tape measurements. These findings support smartphone photogrammetry as a potential accessible alternative to commercial body scanners and applicable for longitudinal 3D body-shape assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文验证了基于智能手机的摄影测量 (photogrammetric) 3D 身体扫描在自动人体测量中的表现，以 PolyCam 应用与商用深度传感器扫描仪 Fit3D ProScanner 进行对比。研究纳入 144 名孕妇在整个孕期纵向扫描，自动提取四个解剖标志处的周长测量，并用线性混合效应模型评估扫描仪差异和体形纵向变化。结果显示 PolyCam 与 Fit3D 一致性良好，平均偏差低于 16 mm，组内相关系数高于 0.8，Pearson 相关系数高于 0.9；刚性人体模型实验中平均偏差低于 3.5 mm。
Motivation: 智能手机摄影测量为商用 3D 人体扫描仪提供了低成本和易获取的替代方案，但其全身扫描性能尚未得到充分验证，尤其是缺乏针对全身体测量和纵向体形监测的系统性评估。
Method: 作者设计了自动周长提取流程，从配对的 3D 扫描中获取四个解剖标志处的测量值，并用线性混合效应模型检验扫描仪效应和纵向体形变化。同时通过重复 PolyCam 扫描和刚性人体模型上的卷尺测量评估测量一致性。
Result: PolyCam 与 Fit3D 在所有标志处表现出强一致性，平均偏差低于 16 mm，ICC 均高于 0.8，Pearson 相关系数均高于 0.9，且两种系统捕捉到的纵向体形变化可比。人体模型实验显示平均偏差低于 3.5 mm，与卷尺测量无显著差异。
Conclusion: 摘要结论认为智能手机摄影测量可作为商用人体扫描仪的潜在可访问替代方案，并适用于纵向 3D 体形评估。

papers.title: LocusGS: Spatially Grounded Tokens for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Recent query-based feed-forward 3DGS methods represent a scene using learnable queries, each aggregating multi-view evidence and decoding a group of Gaussians. Ideally, different queries should specialize in coherent local regions of the scene. However, we observe that Gaussians decoded from the same query often scatter across distant scene regions, resulting in weak query-level spatial coherence and poor alignment with the scene structure. We attribute this behavior to the purely latent representation of existing Gaussian queries. To address this limitation, we introduce LocusGS, which augments each Gaussian query with a 3D anchor state consisting of a center and a support radius. The anchor state is progressively refined across decoder layers and is used throughout query interaction, multi-view feature aggregation, and Gaussian generation. Specifically, an anchor-to-ray geometric bias guides each query toward spatially relevant image observations, while anchor-centered decoding organizes its Gaussians within a local region. Experiments on novel view synthesis benchmarks show that LocusGS improves rendering quality over query-based Gaussian token baselines under the same Gaussian budget. Further analysis shows that the learned anchors form coherent spatial layouts and lead to more structured Gaussian distributions, demonstrating that explicit anchor states improve the spatial organization. Our project page: https://leo-frank.github.io/LocusGS_viewer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LocusGS，一种前馈 3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）方法，通过为每个高斯查询引入由中心和支撑半径组成的 3D 锚点状态，改善查询级空间一致性。锚点状态在解码器各层间逐步精化，并贯穿查询交互、多视图特征聚合与高斯生成。在新视图合成基准上，LocusGS 在相同高斯预算下较基于查询的高斯 token 基线提升了渲染质量，并生成更结构化的高斯分布。
Motivation: 现有基于查询的前馈 3DGS 方法中，从同一查询解码的高斯常散落在场景的遥远区域，导致查询级空间一致性弱，难以对齐场景结构。作者将原因归结为现有高斯查询的纯潜在表示（purely latent representation）缺乏显式空间约束。
Method: LocusGS 为每个高斯查询附加一个由中心和支撑半径组成的 3D 锚点状态，该状态在解码器层间被渐进精化，并用于查询交互、多视图特征聚合和高斯生成。具体地，锚点到射线的几何偏置（anchor-to-ray geometric bias）引导查询关注空间相关的图像观测，而锚点中心解码（anchor-centered decoding）则将高斯组织在局部区域内。
Result: 在新视图合成基准上的实验表明，在相同高斯预算下，LocusGS 比基于查询的高斯 token 基线取得更好的渲染质量。进一步分析显示，学习到的锚点形成连贯的空间布局，并使高斯分布更具结构性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式锚点状态能够改善 3DGS 查询的空间组织，验证了将空间先验引入前馈高斯查询的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HiRoute: Hierarchical Routed Prompt Tuning for Safety Alignment of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to harmful requests and jailbreak attacks. Parameter-efficient safety alignment methods based on prompt tuning typically rely on a single global prompt or externally selected prompt modules. Such static designs struggle to maintain a cross-category safety boundary while generating constructive responses tailored to specific risks and avoiding over-refusal of benign inputs. To address these limitations, we propose HiRoute, an input-adaptive hierarchical prompt-tuning framework that separates category-agnostic safety control from category-specific response guidance. HiRoute first trains a lightweight hierarchical router on representations extracted from a frozen LLM to jointly detect harmful intent and predict multi-label risk scores. It then freezes both the backbone model and the router and uses preference optimization with alternating gradient updates to learn a shared coarse-grained prompt and a set of fine-grained prompt experts as continuous embeddings. At inference time, benign inputs bypass the safety branch, whereas risky inputs are processed using the shared prompt together with a router-weighted mixture of risk-specific prompt experts. Experiments across three instruction-tuned models show that HiRoute achieves high safety rates across multiple safety benchmarks while preserving safe-response helpfulness, reducing over-refusal, and maintaining competitive performance on general-purpose tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HiRoute，一种面向大语言模型安全对齐的输入自适应分层提示微调框架。HiRoute 先用冻结 LLM 的表征训练轻量级分层路由器，以联合检测有害意图并预测多标签风险分数；随后冻结骨干与路由器，用带交替梯度更新的偏好优化学习共享的粗粒度提示和一组细粒度风险专属提示专家。实验在三个指令微调模型上显示，HiRoute 在多个安全基准上保持高安全率，同时减少过度拒答、保持有用性与通用任务性能。
Motivation: 现有基于提示微调（prompt tuning）的参数高效安全对齐方法通常依赖单一全局提示或外部选定的提示模块，这种静态设计难以在跨类别安全边界与针对具体风险的构造性回复之间取得平衡，并容易过度拒答良性输入。
Method: 提出分层提示微调框架 HiRoute：先在冻结 LLM 的表征上训练轻量级分层路由器，联合检测有害意图并预测多标签风险分数；然后冻结骨干和路由器，使用交替梯度更新的偏好优化学习共享粗粒度提示和一组细粒度风险提示专家（continuous embeddings）。推理时良性输入绕过安全分支，风险输入则由共享提示与路由器加权的风险提示专家混合处理。
Result: 摘要报告在三个指令微调模型上的实验表明，HiRoute 在多个安全基准上取得高安全率，同时保持安全回复的有用性、降低过度拒答，并在通用任务上维持有竞争力的表现。
Conclusion: 论文的要点是将与类别无关的安全控制与类别相关的回复引导分离，通过输入自适应的分层提示设计同时改善安全性与有用性；摘要未提供具体数值或明确的局限性讨论。

papers.title: Structured Local Differential Modeling for AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of AI-generated content has made the reliable detection of generated images an increasingly critical challenge. Existing detection methods are often dominated during training by semantically salient components with high signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs), thereby suppressing subtler forensic cues associated with the underlying generation mechanisms and embedded in low-level statistical structures. From an information-theoretic perspective, we present a key insight: effective detection in the low-level statistical space requires mitigating the dominance of semantic components while emphasizing and amplifying responses to low-SNR forgery traces. Building on this insight, we propose RippleNet, an AI-generated image detection framework based on local differential signals. RippleNet adaptively identifies forgery-sensitive regions and constructs multi-directional, multi-scale differential representations within local neighborhoods, explicitly characterizing anomalous patterns in neighborhood statistics. More importantly, we refine the attention mechanism to operate within the local differential representation space, enabling the model to establish explicit dependencies at a finer statistical granularity. This design facilitates the capture of pixel-level forgery traces that are difficult to model using conventional convolutions or image-wide patch-level attention. Extensive experiments on multiple public benchmarks and under cross-generator evaluation settings demonstrate that RippleNet achieves consistently competitive performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RippleNet，一种基于局部差分信号 (local differential signals) 的 AI 生成图像检测框架。作者从信息论角度指出，低层统计空间中语义成分的高信噪比会压制生成机制留下的低信噪比伪造痕迹，因此 RippleNet 通过自适应定位伪造敏感区域并构建多方向、多尺度的局部邻域差分表示来放大这些痕迹。注意力机制被改造到局部差分表示空间内工作，以捕捉像素级伪造痕迹。在多个公开基准和跨生成器设置下取得一致的竞争力表现。
Motivation: 现有检测方法在训练中被高信噪比的语义显著成分主导，抑制了生成机制嵌入在低层统计结构中的细微取证线索，导致对生成图像的可靠检测受限。问题在于如何在低层统计空间中突出低信噪比的伪造痕迹。
Method: 提出 RippleNet，基于局部差分信号构建检测框架：自适应识别伪造敏感区域，在局部邻域内构造多方向、多尺度差分表示以刻画邻域统计异常；并将注意力机制限制在局部差分表示空间中，使模型在更细的统计粒度上建立显式依赖，从而捕获传统卷积或整图级 patch 注意力难以建模的像素级伪造痕迹。
Result: 在多个公开基准以及跨生成器 (cross-generator) 评估设置下的广泛实验表明，RippleNet 获得一致的竞争力检测性能。摘要未给出具体数值或数据集名称。
Conclusion: 作者认为在低层统计空间中抑制语义成分、放大低 SNR 伪造痕迹是提升检测的关键，RippleNet 通过局部差分建模实现了这一目标。摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出 RippleNet，基于局部差分信号构建检测框架：自适应识别伪造敏感区域，在局部邻域内构造多方向、多尺度差分表示以刻画邻域统计异常；并将注意力机制限制在局部差分表示空间中，使模型在更细的统计粒度上建立显式依赖，从而捕获传统卷积或整图级 patch 注意力难以建模的像素级伪造痕迹。
summary_sections.result: 在多个公开基准以及跨生成器 (cross-generator) 评估设置下的广泛实验表明，RippleNet 获得一致的竞争力检测性能。摘要未给出具体数值或数据集名称。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为在低层统计空间中抑制语义成分、放大低 SNR 伪造痕迹是提升检测的关键，RippleNet 通过局部差分建模实现了这一目标。摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Erase but Preserve: Controllable Removal of Copyrighted Animation Characters via Optimized Semantic Anchors
papers.abstract_en: The exceptional generation capabilities of text-to-image diffusion models have raised copyright concerns, particularly the unauthorized reproduction of animation characters. Existing concept erasure methods fall short for animation character erasure: model modification methods struggle to identify suitable anchors for diverse, highly distinctive characters; prompt-based steering methods lack fine-grained control for precise intervention. These approaches often yield incomplete erasure and degraded image fidelity, hindering real-world deployment. In this paper, we propose a controllable method operating on the model's continuous textual representation to erase target characters during generation. We optimizes an anchor embedding via structural and detailed constraints to serve as a character surrogate, then replaces target-related embeddings with the anchor via a structure-aware adaptive strategy. Experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art erasure effectiveness and image fidelity preservation, while supporting controllable erasure degree, multi-target removal, and model transferability. Moreover, our optimized anchors are plug-and-play with current model modification baselines to improve their erasure performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本到图像扩散模型生成中动画角色版权侵权问题，提出一种基于模型连续文本表示的可控擦除方法。作者通过结构约束和细节约束优化一个锚点嵌入 (anchor embedding) 作为角色替身，再以结构感知自适应策略替换目标相关嵌入。实验表明该方法在擦除有效性和图像保真度上达到当前最优，并支持可控擦除程度、多目标移除和模型迁移。
Motivation: 现有概念擦除方法对动画角色效果不佳：模型修改类方法难以针对多样且高度独特的角色找到合适的锚点，基于提示词的引导方法缺乏精细控制，导致擦除不彻底且图像保真度下降，难以实际部署。
Method: 直接在扩散模型的连续文本表示上进行操作，通过结构约束与细节约束优化锚点嵌入作为角色替身，再采用结构感知自适应策略将目标相关嵌入替换为该锚点，从而实现生成过程中的角色擦除。
Result: 实验显示该方法在擦除有效性和图像保真度保持上达到当前最优，支持可控擦除程度、多目标移除与模型迁移；优化后的锚点还可即插即用地嵌入现有模型修改基线，提升其擦除性能。
Conclusion: 本文提出一种可控且可迁移的动画角色版权擦除方法，能在保持生成图像质量的同时实现精细干预，并可与现有模型修改方法兼容使用。

papers.title: CoMedBench: A Multi-Source Benchmark of Synthetic Medical Data Fidelity and Downstream Utility
papers.abstract_en: Access to clinical data is essential for developing reliable healthcare machine learning systems, but direct use of electronic health records is constrained by privacy regulation, institutional review, data-use agreements, and the risk of re-identification. Synthetic data promises a practical alternative: it can preserve useful statistical and clinical structure while reducing exposure of sensitive patient records. Prior studies often evaluate a single generator, one dataset, or a narrow downstream task, making it difficult to know when synthetic data can support model development and when it fails to preserve task-critical signal. We introduce CoMedBench, a reproducible benchmark that evaluates a family of generators under a common clinical-validity framework and one shared training and evaluation engine, spanning static tabular and temporal downstream tasks on established critical-care datasets. In total the benchmark spans 37 dataset-task pairs across two modalities consists of 20 static tabular and 17 temporal ICU time-series-drawn from seven public data sources: three intensive-care databases (MIMIC-III, MIMIC-IV, and eICU) together with the UCI Machine Learning Repository, the CDC BRFSS diabetes cohort (2015), NHANES (1999-2014), and the pycox survival datasets (GBSG and METABRIC). The benchmark evaluates both statistical fidelity and task utility by comparing models trained and tested across real and synthetic data. In these settings, synthetic training data preserves most of the downstream signal: on tabular tasks the reference generator CoMed-CTGAN retains a mean AUROC utility (the synthetic-to-real performance ratio) of 90.6%, rising to 97.3% for the strongest generator, CoMed-TVAE. Temporal ICU tasks are harder and more generator-sensitive: CoMed-CTGAN retains 81.6% (AUROC) and only 64.0% under the imbalance-sensitive AUPRC, whereas CoMed-TVAE still retains ~95% (AUROC).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoMedBench 是一个可复现的医学合成数据基准，用于评估多种生成器在统一临床有效性框架和共享训练/评估引擎下的表现，覆盖静态表格与时间序列两类下游任务。基准包含来自七个公开数据源的 37 个数据集-任务对（20 个静态表格、17 个时间序列 ICU 数据），并从统计保真度和任务效用两方面评估。摘要报告在表格任务上合成训练数据保留大部分下游信号，最强生成器 CoMed-TVAE 的 AUROC 效用达 97.3%，而时间序列 ICU 任务更难且对生成器更敏感。
Motivation: 电子健康记录的直接使用受隐私法规、机构审查和数据使用协议限制，且存在重识别风险；现有研究通常只评估单一生成器、单一数据集或狭窄下游任务，难以判断合成数据何时能支持模型开发、何时会丢失任务关键信号。
Method: CoMedBench 在一个统一的临床有效性框架下评估一组生成器，并使用同一套训练与评估引擎，涵盖静态表格和时间序列 ICU 下游任务；数据来自 MIMIC-III/IV、eICU、UCI、CDC BRFSS、NHANES 和 pycox 生存数据集等七个来源，共 37 个数据集-任务对。
Result: 在表格任务上，参考生成器 CoMed-CTGAN 保留平均 90.6% 的 AUROC 效用（合成-真实性能比），最强生成器 CoMed-TVAE 达到 97.3%；在时间序列 ICU 任务上 CoMed-CTGAN 保留 81.6% AUROC 但仅在 64.0% AUPRC 下，而 CoMed-TVAE 仍保留约 95% AUROC。
Conclusion: 摘要强调合成训练数据在表格任务中能保留大部分下游信号，但时间序列 ICU 任务更难且对生成器更敏感，基准旨在帮助判断合成数据何时可用于模型开发。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fine-tuned Normalizing Flows for ALICE Zero Degree Calorimeter Fast Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Simulating the ALICE Zero Degree Calorimeter (ZDC) neutron detector responses at the LHC is computationally expensive, requiring complex Monte Carlo chains. We develop a generative surrogate, focusing on Normalizing Flows (NFs). Through transfer learning, we pre-train on the full imbalanced dataset and fine-tune specialized models for different particle types ($γ$, $n$, $Λ$, $K_S^0$, $Σ^+$) using two gradual-unfreezing schemes. As standard ZDC metrics like Wasserstein distance overlook conditional structure, we introduce refined metrics: conditional weighted MAE, dispersion ratio, and Jaccard co-activation error, that better capture physics-relevant input-output dependencies and response variability. Our ensemble of fine-tuned models achieves a Wasserstein distance of $1.61 \pm 0.02$, outperforming baselines across all metrics. This work provides a generalizable NF-based framework for LHC detector simulation, combining NFs, conditional fine-tuning, and physics-motivated evaluation.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation at the 16th International Conference on Parallel Processing & Applied Mathematics (PPAM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为 ALICE Zero Degree Calorimeter (ZDC) 中子探测器响应开发了基于 Normalizing Flows (NFs) 的生成式代理模型。通过迁移学习，在完整的不平衡数据集上预训练，并采用两种渐进解冻 (gradual-unfreezing) 方案针对不同粒子类型 (γ, n, Λ, K_S^0, Σ^+) 微调专用模型。作者还提出条件加权 MAE、离散度比和 Jaccard 共激活误差等新指标，以弥补 Wasserstein 距离忽略条件结构的不足。微调模型集成达到 1.61 ± 0.02 的 Wasserstein 距离，在所有指标上优于基线。
Motivation: 在 LHC 上模拟 ALICE ZDC 中子探测器响应需要复杂的蒙特卡洛链，计算成本高昂，因此需要快速的生成式替代模型；同时标准评估指标如 Wasserstein 距离无法捕捉物理相关的输入-输出条件依赖和响应变异性。
Method: 采用 Normalizing Flows 构建生成式代理，先在完整不平衡数据集上预训练，再通过两种渐进解冻方案对不同粒子类型进行条件微调 (conditional fine-tuning)，并提出条件加权 MAE、离散度比和 Jaccard 共激活误差三个物理动机驱动的评估指标。
Result: 摘要报告微调模型集成取得 1.61 ± 0.02 的 Wasserstein 距离，并在所有提出指标上优于基线。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个通用的基于 NF 的 LHC 探测器模拟框架，结合 Normalizing Flows、条件微调与物理驱动的评估；论文已被 PPAM 2026 接收。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Thermodynamics of Learning: A Typed Four-Component Accounting of Memory, Fit, and Value
papers.abstract_en: What a finite learning device has recorded and what will hold value for it on future tasks are not the same quantity. We develop a typed accounting for finite-state learning devices that separates four components: a training-side fit functional $Φ_{\mathrm{fit}}$, the record-correlation stock $J_{D}=I(M;D)$, an update-side search ledger $σ_{M}$, and an operational capital value $V(M;T,b)$. This value is the work gap between an informed protocol class and a blind class obtained by deleting the memory-read port and re-optimizing from scratch. (I) Separation: for every $n$, there is a device family on which record correlation and world correlation grow by $n\ln 2$ while the capital gain is exactly zero. In the $\mathrm{flat}^{*}$ regime, data-free updates never increase $V$. (II) Capitalization ledger: an exact $\mathrm{flat}^{*}$ extraction identity and a universal ledger identity give, for (F5$'$)-stable $M$-local updates under a no-discarded-record-correlation condition (f), the bound $η_{\mathrm{cap}}\le 1$ for the capitalization efficiency $η_{\mathrm{cap}}=ΔV/(k T\,σ_{M})$, together with necessary and sufficient conditions for equality. (III) Value retention: for the retention gap $L_{\mathrm{gen}}$ and retention ratio $ρ_{\mathrm{gen}}$ (the former carries no sign constraint; the latter is defined for positive training-side value and is not confined to $[0,1]$) we give a two-layer alignment domain: an exact exchange rate between value and the side-information-adjusted record fit $I(M';D\mid Y)$ without any record-side-information independence assumption, and a raw record-stock exchange rate under a joint side-information neutrality condition $(M,D)\perp Y$, whose boundary is marked by an explicit one-time-pad witness. These are statements about finite-device value retention under task-distribution shift, not a theory of statistical generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为有限状态学习设备建立一种带类型的核算框架，将学习过程拆分为训练侧拟合泛函 Φ_fit、记录-关联存量 J_D=I(M;D)、更新侧搜索账本 σ_M 以及操作资本价值 V(M;T,b)。作者给出分离性结果，表明记录关联与世界关联可增长 n ln 2 而资本增益恒为零，并导出资本化效率 η_cap≤1 以及价值保留间隙/保留比率的对齐域等理论命题。作者强调这些是关于任务分布偏移下有限设备价值保留的陈述，而非统计泛化理论。
Motivation: 现有对学习设备的描述混淆了“已经记录了什么”与“未来任务中有什么价值”这两个不同的量；作者希望建立一套能显式区分两者的会计框架。
Method: 提出四组件带类型核算：训练侧拟合 Φ_fit、记录-关联存量 J_D=I(M;D)、更新侧搜索账本 σ_M、操作资本价值 V(M;T,b)，其中 V 定义为删去存储读取端口并从头再优化后的盲协议类与知情协议类之间的功差；并据此推出一系列恒等式、效率界与对齐域。
Result: 摘要给出三类主要结果：(I) 分离性——存在设备族使记录关联与世界关联增长 n ln 2 而资本增益精确为零，在 flat* 区制下无数据更新不会增加 V；(II) 资本化账本——在 (F5') 稳定 M-局部更新与无丢弃记录关联条件 (f) 下，资本化效率 η_cap=ΔV/(k T σ_M) 满足 η_cap≤1，并给出取等的充要条件；(III) 价值保留——给出保留间隙 L_gen 与保留比率 ρ_gen 的两层对齐域，包括无需记录侧信息独立假设的精确汇率，以及在联合信息中立条件下由一次性密码本 (one-time pad) 见证标记边界的原始记录存量汇率。
Conclusion: 这些命题针对任务分布偏移下有限设备的价值保留，作者明确说明它们不是统计泛化理论；理论框架高度抽象，属于统计力学与信息论的交叉领域。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 摘要给出三类主要结果：(I) 分离性——存在设备族使记录关联与世界关联增长 n ln 2 而资本增益精确为零，在 flat* 区制下无数据更新不会增加 V；(II) 资本化账本——在 (F5') 稳定 M-局部更新与无丢弃记录关联条件 (f) 下，资本化效率 η_cap=ΔV/(k T σ_M) 满足 η_cap≤1，并给出取等的充要条件；(III) 价值保留——给出保留间隙 L_gen 与保留比率 ρ_gen 的两层对齐域，包括无需记录侧信息独立假设的精确汇率，以及在联合信息中立条件下由一次性密码本 (one-time pad) 见证标记边界的原始记录存量汇率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 这些命题针对任务分布偏移下有限设备的价值保留，作者明确说明它们不是统计泛化理论；理论框架高度抽象，属于统计力学与信息论的交叉领域。

papers.title: PIPES: Securing Agent Perception with Provenance and Priors
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using agents consume external data from sources with different levels of trust, yet tool responses rarely identify who produced each component or what it should convey. We show that this gap enables state-corruption attacks, in which attacker-controlled content makes environmental claims beyond the informational authority of its response component and corrupts the agent's perceived environment, making the resulting action appear justified to existing guardrails. We introduce PIPES (Provenance-Informed, Prior-Enforced Screening), which screens response units using semantic priors and source provenance. PIPES uses static field contracts when schemas provide stable expectations, and conditions screening of open-ended content on the pre-response trajectory and trusted provenance metadata. It marks units that violate their semantic prior or the provenance hierarchy; deployments may remove, warn, block, or escalate detected violations. We instantiate atomic removal and evaluate PIPES against adaptive PAIR-style attacks. Across the three VitaBench and three AgentDyn splits with Gemma 4 31B IT as the target agent, PIPES reduces average attack success from 84.7% to 2.3%, while preserving average benign utility (92.5% with PIPES versus 90.6% without defense).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出使用工具（tool-using）的智能体在消费外部数据时，工具响应很少标注各组成部分的来源（provenance）或应有语义，这一缺口可被利用来实施状态破坏（state-corruption）攻击，使攻击者控制的内容在超出其信息权限的范围内改变智能体感知的环境，并让后续动作对现有防护机制显得合理。作者提出 PIPES，利用语义先验（semantic priors）与来源元数据对响应单元进行筛查，并在 VitaBench 与 AgentDyn 基准上以 Gemma 4 31B IT 为目标智能体评估，将平均攻击成功率从 84.7% 降至 2.3%，同时保持约 92.5% 的正常任务效用。
Motivation: 工具型智能体面对来自不同信任级别的外部数据源，但工具响应缺乏关于每个组件由谁产生、应传达什么的信息；作者证明这一缺口使攻击者能实施状态破坏攻击，在智能体感知层面植入超出其响应组件信息权限的环境主张，从而绕过现有防护。
Method: PIPES 使用语义先验与来源溯源对响应单元进行筛查：当 schema 提供稳定预期时采用静态字段契约（static field contracts），对开放式内容则依据响应前轨迹（pre-response trajectory）与可信来源元数据条件化筛查，并将违反语义先验或来源层级（provenance hierarchy）的单元标记出来，部署方可选择移除、警告、阻止或升级处理；实验中实例化了原子移除（atomic removal）。
Result: 针对自适应 PAIR 风格攻击，在三个 VitaBench 与三个 AgentDyn 分割上以 Gemma 4 31B IT 为目标模型，PIPES 将平均攻击成功率从 84.7% 降至 2.3%，同时保持正常任务效用（有防御 92.5%，无防御 90.6%）。
Conclusion: 作者认为，结合来源信息的语义先验筛选能够有效保护智能体的环境感知免受状态破坏攻击，且检测到的违规可通过移除、警告、阻止或升级等灵活策略处理；摘要未讨论该方法在其他规模模型或更多任务上的泛化边界。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ARAC: Benchmarking Auto-Research's Alignment and Completeness on End-to-End Researchs
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of Auto-Research has surfaced a fundamental evaluation challenge: how can we measure the alignment, logical coherence, and evolutionary completeness of its research trajectory with human research behavior? We propose Auto-Research's Alignment and Completeness, ARAC-Bench: a Researcher-Mimicking Evaluation framework that shifts the objective from matching final answers to reproducing high-quality human research processes. The framework operates through two synergistic components: the Academic Cognition Skills system, which is the first to transforms implicit reviewer expertise into stage-calibrated, quantifiable rubrics; and a three-stage capability diagnostic protocol, which decomposes the research process under strict modular constraints into three traceable, mutually independent dimensions: Proposal, Experiment, and Synthesis. Systematic evaluation of 11 SOTA frameworks yields a best alignment score of only 67.9 of 100, revealing a significant gap in simulating rigorous human methodology. Validation against Ph.D. Candidates rankings shows a strong correlation of 0.8141, confirming that ARAC-Bench reliably reflects the dimensions researchers truly value. ARAC-Bench provides not only a fine-grained diagnostic tool but also a scalable reward signal for training the next generation of autonomous research systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ARAC-Bench，一个面向 Auto-Research 的评估基准，不再以最终答案匹配为目标，而是衡量研究轨迹与人类研究行为的对齐、逻辑一致性和演化完整性。框架包含 Academic Cognition Skills 系统和三阶段能力诊断协议（Proposal、Experiment、Synthesis），并对 11 个 SOTA 框架进行了系统评估。摘要报告最佳对齐分数仅 67.9/100，且与博士候选人排名的相关性为 0.8141，表明该基准能可靠反映研究者重视的维度。
Motivation: Auto-Research 的快速进展暴露出一个基础评估难题：如何度量其研究轨迹与人类研究行为之间的对齐性、逻辑连贯性和演化完整性。现有评估多关注最终答案匹配，缺少对研究过程质量的量化手段。
Method: 提出 Researcher-Mimicking 评估框架 ARAC-Bench，由两个协同组件构成：Academic Cognition Skills 系统首次将隐性审稿人专业知识转化为分阶段校准的可量化 rubric；三阶段能力诊断协议在严格模块化约束下将研究过程分解为 Proposal、Experiment、Synthesis 三个可追踪且相互独立的维度。
Result: 对 11 个 SOTA 框架的系统评估显示最佳对齐分数仅为 67.9/100，说明模拟严格人类方法论仍存在显著差距；与博士候选人排名的验证相关性达 0.8141，确认该基准能反映研究者真正重视的维度。
Conclusion: ARAC-Bench 不仅提供细粒度的诊断工具，还可作为可扩展的奖励信号，用于训练下一代自主研究系统。

papers.title: Beyond Correctness: Benchmarking and Aligning Response Behaviors in Hybrid-Thinking MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid-thinking multimodal large language models (MLLMs) allow a single model to alternate between deliberative thinking and latency-efficient non-thinking inference. Although these modes differ in reasoning budget, their delivered responses should satisfy the same user-facing standard. Correctness alone may not characterize this response quality; we therefore evaluate task accuracy and response-pattern failures as complementary outcomes. We study this gap through \textbf{response-pattern alignment}: whether thinking and non-thinking interfaces preserve acceptable final-response behavior. We introduce \textbf{PatternEval}, a failure-enriched diagnostic benchmark comprising 2,415 multimodal prompts spanning visual perception and grounding, structured image understanding, and multimodal knowledge reasoning. PatternEval tests four recurrent failures: chain-of-thought leakage, response repetition, logical contradiction, and performative reasoning. Response-pattern failures are widespread across models from different providers, with non-thinking inference exhibiting substantially higher failure rates and thereby creating systematic misalignment between thinking and non-thinking interfaces. Motivated by this diagnosis, we develop \textbf{PatternRM}, a response-level reward model, and \textbf{PatternRL}, which introduces pattern-specific penalties during reinforcement learning. Experiments on Qwen3-VL-4B and Qwen3-VL-8B show that incorporating pattern-specific penalties into reinforcement learning can mitigate cross-mode misalignment while incurring a marginal task performance trade-off. Together, PatternEval and PatternRL provide an evaluation-and-training framework for aligning user-visible response patterns across hybrid-thinking interfaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对混合思考多模态大语言模型 (hybrid-thinking MLLMs) 中思考模式与非思考模式响应不一致的问题，提出响应模式对齐 (response-pattern alignment) 作为评估视角。作者引入故障富集基准 PatternEval（含 2,415 个多模态提示）检测思维链泄漏、响应重复、逻辑矛盾和表演性推理四类失效，并开发响应级奖励模型 PatternRM 与强化学习惩罚框架 PatternRL。实验表明模式特定惩罚可缓解跨模式错位，仅带来轻微任务性能代价。
Motivation: 混合思考 MLLM 允许单模型在深思熟虑的思考推理与低延迟非思考推理之间切换，但两种模式在推理预算上不同，最终响应应满足相同的用户标准。仅用任务正确性无法充分刻画响应质量，而非思考模式表现出明显更高的响应模式失败率，造成系统性的跨模式错位。
Method: 提出 PatternEval，一个故障富集的诊断基准，覆盖视觉感知与定位、结构化图像理解、多模态知识推理，专门测试思维链泄漏、响应重复、逻辑矛盾和表演性推理四类失效。在此基础上构建 PatternRM（响应级奖励模型）和 PatternRL（在强化学习中引入模式特定惩罚），以对齐两种接口的输出行为。
Result: 实验基于 Qwen3-VL-4B 和 Qwen3-VL-8B，显示模式特定惩罚能缓解思考与非思考接口间的跨模式错位，同时只带来边际的任务性能权衡。
Conclusion: PatternEval 与 PatternRL 共同构成一个评估-训练框架，用于对齐混合思考接口中用户可见的响应模式；论文强调正确性之外的行为模式是衡量混合思考 MLLM 服务质量的关键维度。

papers.title: SCOPE: Subspace Clustering with Online Per-Head Top-K Estimation for Sparse Video Attention
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) incur quadratic self-attention cost over spatiotemporal tokens. Existing training-free sparse attention methods often construct sparse masks from block-level or cluster-level proxy scores, which can obscure fine-grained differences among keys and miss high contribution keys under aggressive sparsity. Moreover, such proxy scores may yield overly concentrated softmax distributions, causing Top-$p$ to retain too few keys for some query clusters. Although a fixed Top-$k$ minimum alleviates this failure mode, a shared value cannot adapt to variations across heads and inputs. To address both limitations, we propose SCOPE, a training-free sparse attention framework that combines 3D-RoPE-aligned key subspace clustering with online per-head Top-$k$ estimation for efficient video-DiT inference. SCOPE partitions post-RoPE keys into temporal, height, and width subspaces, clusters them independently, and aggregates the corresponding centroid scores through lookup tables to obtain per key proxy scores for each query cluster. Building on existing hybrid Top-$p$/fixed Top-$k$ selection, SCOPE derives a head-specific Top-$k$ value online by averaging the initial retained key counts within each head, weighted by query cluster size, and selects additional keys only for query clusters whose initial retained key counts fall below this value. Sparse attention is then computed over the selected original keys and values. Across six model--task configurations, SCOPE consistently outperforms existing training-free baselines in both fidelity and latency, achieving up to a $1.99\times$ end-to-end speedup on 720p HunyuanVideo with $28.46$ dB PSNR relative to dense attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCOPE，一种面向视频 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 推理的无训练稀疏注意力框架，结合 3D-RoPE 对齐的键子空间聚类与在线逐头 Top-k 估计。摘要报告在六个模型-任务配置上优于现有无训练基线，并在 720p HunyuanVideo 上相对密集注意力取得最高 1.99 倍端到端加速，PSNR 为 28.46 dB。
Motivation: DiT 对时空 token 的注意力为二次复杂度；现有无训练稀疏注意力基于 block 或 cluster 级代理分数构造掩码，会掩盖键间的细粒度差异，并在激进稀疏下漏掉高贡献键；同时代理分数可能导致 softmax 分布过度集中，使 Top-p 保留键过少，而固定 Top-k 又无法适应不同头和输入的差异。
Method: SCOPE 将 post-RoPE 键划分为时间、高度、宽度三个子空间并分别聚类，通过查找表聚合各聚类质心分数，为每个查询聚类得到逐键代理分数；在混合 Top-p/固定 Top-k 选择基础上，按查询聚类大小加权平均各头初始保留键数，在线推导头特定的 Top-k 值，仅为初始保留键数低于该值的查询聚类补充额外键，最后对选中的原始键和值计算稀疏注意力。
Result: 在六个模型-任务配置上，SCOPE 在保真度和延迟上均一致优于现有无训练基线；在 720p HunyuanVideo 上实现最高 1.99 倍端到端加速，相对密集注意力的 PSNR 为 28.46 dB。
Conclusion: SCOPE 同时解决代理分数掩盖细粒度差异和固定 Top-k 无法跨头/输入自适应两个局限，是面向高效视频 DiT 推理的无训练稀疏注意力方案。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: SCOPE 将 post-RoPE 键划分为时间、高度、宽度三个子空间并分别聚类，通过查找表聚合各聚类质心分数，为每个查询聚类得到逐键代理分数；在混合 Top-p/固定 Top-k 选择基础上，按查询聚类大小加权平均各头初始保留键数，在线推导头特定的 Top-k 值，仅为初始保留键数低于该值的查询聚类补充额外键，最后对选中的原始键和值计算稀疏注意力。
summary_sections.result: 在六个模型-任务配置上，SCOPE 在保真度和延迟上均一致优于现有无训练基线；在 720p HunyuanVideo 上实现最高 1.99 倍端到端加速，相对密集注意力的 PSNR 为 28.46 dB。
summary_sections.conclusion: SCOPE 同时解决代理分数掩盖细粒度差异和固定 Top-k 无法跨头/输入自适应两个局限，是面向高效视频 DiT 推理的无训练稀疏注意力方案。

papers.title: CRAFT: LLM-Based Iterative Refinement for Temporal Reasoning over Clinical Narratives
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the temporal progression of symptoms in clinical narratives is critical for disease monitoring, safety surveillance, and causality assessment. Clinical narratives, however, rarely provide explicit temporal anchors. Current approaches to temporal information reasoning focus predominantly on pairwise relation classification across multi-visit and timestamp-rich records, leaving the reconstruction of structured symptom trajectories from individual anchor-sparse reports largely unaddressed. We propose CRAFT, an LLM framework that pairs a generator with a constraint-based verifier to iteratively produce and refine stage-wise symptom timelines through targeted feedback. We conduct evaluation on MedTempo, a new benchmark of 5,347 vaccine adverse-event narratives spanning three COVID-19 vaccine types, with expert-validated temporal stage annotations for 3,166 reports. Experiments across four LLM backbones demonstrate that CRAFT consistently improves temporal ordering accuracy, with ablation analysis isolating the contribution of generator and verifier components across model capability levels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CRAFT，一个基于 LLM 的迭代细化框架，用于从锚点稀疏的临床叙述中重建分阶段症状时间线。CRAFT 将生成器与基于约束的验证器配对，通过针对性反馈迭代生成并优化时间线。作者在 MedTempo 新基准（5,347 条疫苗不良反应叙述，其中 3,166 条具有专家验证的时序阶段标注）上评估，四个 LLM 主干上均一致提升时序排序准确率。
Motivation: 临床叙述很少提供显式时间锚点，现有时间信息推理方法主要聚焦于多就诊、时间戳丰富记录上的成对关系分类，单份锚点稀疏报告中结构化症状轨迹的重建问题基本未得到解决。
Method: 提出 CRAFT 框架，由一个生成器（generator）和一个基于约束的验证器（constraint-based verifier）组成，通过生成—验证—针对性反馈的循环来迭代细化分阶段症状时间线。
Result: 在 MedTempo 基准上跨四种 LLM 主干进行实验，CRAFT 一致提升时序排序准确率；消融分析进一步分离了生成器与验证器在不同模型能力水平下的各自贡献。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CRAFT 能有效解决临床叙述中缺乏显式时间锚点时的症状轨迹重建问题；摘要未明确讨论方法局限。

papers.title: CW-BASS v2: Saturation-Aware Pseudo-Label Selection for Semi-Supervised Segmentation under Foundation-Model Teachers
papers.abstract_en: Semi-supervised semantic segmentation has long turned on one question, which pseudo-labels to trust, and a generation of selection rules, dynamic thresholds, per-class curricula, soft confidence weights, answered it for the noisy, under-confident ResNet teachers of their day. Self-supervised foundation encoders change the regime: with a DINOv2 teacher, confidence saturates, so the filtering that helped a weak teacher can hurt a strong one. We propose CW-BASS v2, a saturation-aware pseudo-label selection method that reads the teacher's confidence regime rather than committing to one rule. It pairs held-out calibration, an unbiased per-class noise estimate, with a self-adaptive confidence floor that provably bounds retention away from 1, and combines them in a one-pass gate: measure the reliability of the teacher's confident set, pi_kept = Pr[correct | c >= tau], on a held-out slice, and filter strictly when it meets the confidence demanded (pi_kept >= tau), falling back to the adaptive floor otherwise. The boundary is the pre-existing operating threshold, not a value tuned to mIoU, and across six DINOv2 teachers it makes the correct strict-vs-floor call blind. CW-BASS v2 thus recovers the UniMatch V2 operating point on the saturated benchmarks by selecting strict (Pascal VOC 1/8 87.4 against its reported 87.9; Cityscapes within 0.5), and improves on it where the confident set is unreliable (pi_kept ~ 89%, ADE20K), where the floor edges ahead (+1.5 mIoU, single seed). The gate is principled because the failure it avoids is measured, not assumed: on a reliable, saturated teacher the confidence distribution's dynamic range collapses (98% of Pascal pixels >= 0.95), so an adaptive cutoff floods the retention mask and self-training decays into confirmation bias.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE TPAMI. 22 pages, 11 figures, 17 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CW-BASS v2，一种面向基础模型教师（DINOv2）的饱和度感知伪标签选择方法，用于半监督语义分割。其核心是联合保留集校准（held-out calibration）与自适应置信度下限，形成单次门控：在保留切片上估计 pi_kept = Pr[correct | c >= tau]，当它满足置信要求时严格过滤，否则回退到自适应下限。在六个 DINOv2 教师上，门控能盲目地做出正确的严格/回退选择，并在饱和基准上恢复 UniMatch V2 工作点，在不可靠置信集上取得改进。
Motivation: 以往针对弱教师（如 ResNet）设计的伪标签选择规则——动态阈值、逐类课程、软置信权重——在 DINOv2 这类自监督基础编码器下失效，因为教师置信度饱和，原本帮助弱教师的过滤反而会损害强教师。
Method: CW-BASS v2 将无偏的逐类噪声估计（保留集校准）与可证明将保留率限制在 1 以下的自适应置信度下限相结合，组成单遍门控：先在保留数据切片上度量教师置信集的可靠性 pi_kept，若 pi_kept >= tau 则严格过滤，否则回退到自适应下限；边界采用预先存在的操作阈值而非针对 mIoU 调参。
Result: 在六个 DINOv2 教师上，门控盲选即得到正确的严格/回退判断；在饱和基准上恢复 UniMatch V2 工作点（Pascal VOC 1/8 为 87.4，对照报告值 87.9；Cityscapes 误差在 0.5 以内），而在置信集不可靠的 ADE20K（pi_kept 约 89%）上自适应下限领先 +1.5 mIoU（单种子）。饱和教师下 Pascal 有 98% 像素置信度不低于 0.95，动态范围坍缩。
Conclusion: 该门控的原则性在于其所规避的失败是被度量而非假设的：在可靠且饱和的教师下，自适应截断会淹没保留掩码，使自训练退化为确认偏差（confirmation bias）。

papers.title: Memorization Diagnostics for Code LLMs Should be Scale-Aware
papers.abstract_en: The extent to which large language models for code rely on memorization over genuine understanding remains highly debated. While current literature frequently reports widespread memorization, evaluating the underlying probing techniques across dense architectures reveals a severe breakdown in their utility at scale. Traditional encoder-style probes using perturbations such as synonym fuzzing or dead-code insertion struggle to expose memorization in scaled models, even on known-contaminated benchmarks, and decoder-style probes that rely on log probabilities show similar performance degradation. The specific mode of failure for these probes, particularly why such techniques disrupt smaller models but fail to impact larger ones, motivates us to untangle representation load from memorization rather than treating them as a single phenomenon. By applying invertible mathematical transforms to numeric problems, we isolate these two factors and reveal that scaled encoders successfully absorb substantial representation load while still converging on the correct family of solutions. In practical software engineering, this ability to adapt to varying surface forms is what truly matters for usability and generalizability in LLM and agentic applications. Whether a specific solution was seen during training becomes a much less pressing question because although memorization inflates scores on contaminated benchmarks, factoring out representation load makes it debatable how much we should truly care if a functional answer was originally memorized. Future evaluations must therefore be built around separating these phenomena rather than relying on methodologies that quietly entangle them.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Under review at EMSE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨代码大语言模型（code LLM）在规模化后记忆化（memorization）与真正理解之间的界限，发现传统编码器式探针（如同义词模糊测试、死代码插入）和解码器式 log 概率探针在大型模型上均失效，即使面对已知污染基准也无法暴露记忆化。作者通过可逆数学变换分离“表示负荷”（representation load）与记忆化，表明规模化编码器能吸收大量表示负荷并收敛到正确解族。
Motivation: 现有文献频繁报道代码 LLM 存在广泛记忆化，但评估这些探测技术在不同密集架构上的效用时，发现它们在规模化模型上严重失效。作者希望弄清探测技术为何能干扰小模型却无法影响大模型，从而将表示负荷与记忆化区分开，而不是当作单一现象。
Method: 对数值问题应用可逆数学变换，将表示负荷与记忆化两个因素隔离；同时对比编码器式探针（同义词模糊、死代码插入）和解码器式探针（基于 log 概率）在小型与规模化模型上的表现。
Result: 摘要报告传统编码器式探针在规模化模型上失效，即使使用已知污染基准；解码器式探针也表现出类似性能退化。可逆变换显示规模化编码器成功吸收大量表示负荷，同时仍收敛到正确解族。
Conclusion: 作者认为在实用软件工程中，适应不同表面形式的能力对 LLM 与智能体应用的可泛化性更重要；即使答案曾被记忆，在剔除表示负荷后，对污染基准的分数膨胀是否值得关注存疑。未来评估应围绕分离这两种现象来设计，而非依赖将其纠缠在一起的方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PatchGen: Learning Soft Intra-Image Predictive Subsets for Visual Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Visual classifiers are expected to generalize under data shifts, target shifts, and their combinations, yet most existing methods focus on domain invariance while failing to address intra-image predictive sufficiency. We investigate the structural hypothesis that each image contains a sample-adaptive oracle intra-image predictive subset sufficient for label prediction, while the remaining patches form non-essential complementary context that may correlate with the label. The theoretical analysis shows that restricting prediction to this oracle subset preserves the Bayes risk achievable by the full-patch representation while admitting a complexity bound that tightens with the oracle-subset size. Based on this view, we propose PatchGen, a text-free module that learns a sample-dependent soft predictive-subset mask as a task-driven proxy for the unobserved oracle subset mask. Specifically, histopathology visualizations suggest that PatchGen assigns higher scores to tumor-consistent regions than to some frequently co-occurring inflammatory context. Extensive experiments on natural and histopathological image benchmarks spanning all three shift settings show that PatchGen improves average performance over matched-backbone baselines in most evaluated configurations, enhances generalization to unknown classes, and remains competitive with vision-language methods without text supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出文本无关的模块 PatchGen，用于视觉分类器在数据偏移、目标偏移及其组合下的泛化。作者提出结构假设：每张图像存在样本自适应的 oracle 子集足以预测标签，其余 patch 构成非必要上下文；理论分析表明仅用该子集预测可保持全 patch 表示的 Bayes 风险，并给出随子集大小收紧的复杂度界。PatchGen 学习样本相关的软预测子集掩码作为 oracle 掩码的任务驱动代理，在自然图像和组织病理图像基准上提升多数配置下的平均性能，并在无文本监督下与视觉-语言方法表现相当。
Motivation: 现有视觉分类器大多关注域不变性，未解决图像内部预测充分性的问题；在数据偏移、目标偏移及其组合下，分类器泛化仍受限。
Method: 提出 PatchGen，一种不需要文本的模块，学习样本相关的软预测子集掩码，作为不可观测的 oracle 子集掩码的任务驱动代理，从而将预测限制在样本自适应的信息子集上。
Result: 理论分析显示限制到 oracle 子集可保持 Bayes 风险并收紧复杂度界；组织病理学可视化显示 PatchGen 对肿瘤区域打分高于常共现的炎症背景；在涵盖三种偏移设置的自然图像和组织病理图像基准上，PatchGen 在多数评估配置下提升匹配主干的平均性能，增强未知类泛化，且不依赖文本监督即可与视觉-语言方法竞争。
Conclusion: 摘要强调图像内部预测充分性对视觉泛化的重要性，并提出 PatchGen 作为无需文本监督的可行方案。

papers.title: Beyond Outcome Rewards: Step-Level Self-Distilled Policy Optimization for Deep Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: Deep search agents operate over trajectories spanning dozens of steps, yet standard reinforcement learning provides only a single outcome reward per trajectory, which is far too sparse for effective credit assignment. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) addresses this by using the model's own logits as dense token-level teachers, but extending it to search agents introduces a fundamental tension: the teacher, having access to privileged information such as the correct answer, produces a distribution that differs systematically from the student's exploration-based reasoning, and naive distillation causes the student to inherit this information asymmetry rather than learn better search strategies. We resolve this tension through two contributions. First, we construct Evidence Anchors, which are concise, step-level evidence snippets extracted from the web, as privileged information that captures key reasoning steps without revealing the entire answer path. Second, we propose Step-Level Self-Distilled Policy Optimization (SSPO), which converts teacher-student disagreement into step-level advantage weights within GRPO, applied exclusively to incorrect trajectories. This design decouples what to update from how much to update: the outcome reward determines the direction of policy change, while the teacher modulates its magnitude at each step. Correct trajectories are left untouched, preserving their diversity. On Qwen3-8B, SSPO consistently outperforms GRPO across BrowseComp, GAIA, and FRAMES, surpassing or matching GRPO trained with twice as many gradient steps while adding only about 5 percent overhead per step from a single additional forward pass.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度搜索智能体（deep search agents）在数十步轨迹上仅有单个结果奖励、难以进行信用分配的问题，提出 Step-Level Self-Distilled Policy Optimization (SSPO)。作者一方面从网页中构造 Evidence Anchors 作为不泄露完整答案路径的步骤级特权信息，另一方面把教师-学生分布不一致转化为 GRPO 内的步骤级优势权重，且只作用于错误轨迹。在 Qwen3-8B 上，SSPO 在 BrowseComp、GAIA、FRAMES 上一致优于 GRPO，并超过或追平两倍梯度步数的 GRPO，每步额外开销仅约 5%。
Motivation: 标准强化学习对每条搜索轨迹只给一个结果奖励，这对数十步的搜索过程过于稀疏；将 on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) 扩展到搜索智能体时，掌握正确答案等特权信息的教师分布与学生基于探索的推理分布存在系统性差异，朴素蒸馏会使学生继承这种信息不对称而非学到更好的搜索策略。
Method: 提出两个贡献：一是构造 Evidence Anchors，即从网页中抽取的简洁步骤级证据片段，作为抓住关键推理步骤但不暴露完整答案路径的特权信息；二是提出 SSPO，将教师与学生的分歧转换为 GRPO 内部的步骤级优势权重，并且仅应用于错误轨迹。该设计把“更新什么”与“更新多少”解耦：结果奖励决定策略更新方向，教师调节每步更新的幅度；正确轨迹保持原样以保留多样性。
Result: 在 Qwen3-8B 上，SSPO 在 BrowseComp、GAIA、FRAMES 上一致优于 GRPO，超过或匹配用两倍梯度步数训练的 GRPO，而每步只额外引入约 5% 的开销（来自一次附加 forward pass）。
Conclusion: 作者认为证据锚与步骤级蒸馏的结合可以缓解搜索智能体中的奖励稀疏与教师-学生信息不对称问题；arXiv 注释标为 Work in progress，属于尚未正式定稿的工作。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PROVE-RT: Generating Mechanized Theorem Prover Scripts for Real-Time Systems using LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Schedulability analysis is essential for certifying real-time systems, but existing tests are often developed through pen-and-paper proofs that are difficult to scale, validate, and maintain. Mechanized verification in PROSA/ROCQ offers a rigorous alternative, yet manually constructing such proofs requires substantial domain expertise and proof-engineering effort. Recent successes of large language models (LLMs) across a wide range of tasks make them promising candidates for generating PROSA/ROCQ scripts for mechanized theorem provers. However, state-of-the-art LLMs often lack the PROSA-specific knowledge required to correctly use its modeling abstractions and proof patterns. This paper introduces PROVE-RT, an LLM-assisted framework for generating PROSA/ROCQ scripts to mechanize schedulability analyses in real-time systems literature. PROVE-RT guides generation through dependency-aware informal sketches, retrieval from processed PROSA documentation, staged skeleton generation, and proof completion. We construct a mechanization-oriented corpus from 1, 191 real-time systems papers, containing 13, 134 informal sketches with dependency information. On a curated evaluation set, direct prompting of state-of-the-art LLMs fails to reliably generate valid PROSA mechanizations, whereas PROVE-RT achieves a success rate of 44.7%. These results show that retrieval-guided and staged LLM assistance can improve automated mechanization of schedulability analysis in PROSA/ROCQ.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PROVE-RT，一个利用大型语言模型（LLM）辅助生成 PROSA/ROCQ 定理证明脚本的框架，用于实时系统文献中可调度性分析（schedulability analysis）的机械化验证。框架通过依赖感知的非正式草图、从处理后的 PROSA 文档检索、分阶段骨架生成和证明补全来引导 LLM。摘要报告在精选评估集上 PROVE-RT 的机械化为有效脚本的成功率达到 44.7%，而直接提示最先进 LLM 无法可靠生成有效 PROSA 机械化。
Motivation: 实时系统认证依赖可调度性分析，但现有笔纸证明难以扩展、验证和维护；PROSA/ROCQ 的机械化验证虽然严谨，却需要大量领域专业知识和证明工程努力。LLM 在广泛任务上表现出潜力，但缺乏 PROSA 特定知识，难以正确使用其建模抽象和证明模式。
Method: 提出 PROVE-RT 框架，结合依赖感知的非正式草图（dependency-aware informal sketches）、从处理后的 PROSA 文档检索、分阶段骨架生成（staged skeleton generation）和证明补全（proof completion）来引导 LLM。作者从 1,191 篇实时系统论文构建了包含 13,134 个带依赖信息非正式草图的机械化导向语料库。
Result: 在精选评估集上，直接提示最先进 LLM 无法可靠生成有效的 PROSA 机械化，而 PROVE-RT 的成功率达到 44.7%。
Conclusion: 检索引导和分阶段 LLM 辅助可以提高 PROSA/ROCQ 中可调度性分析的自动化机械化水平。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Correct Is Not Governed: Provenance Integrity in Agentic Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Agentic workflows are commonly evaluated by whether they reach the correct outcome. That is insufficient in institutional settings, where a correct action may rely on the wrong authority, an unsupported completion claim, or work made stale by a later change. We define governed execution as work whose decisions, completion, and response to change are supported by inspectable provenance. We present Matrix, a deterministic causal-state layer that records authority and fact dependencies, verifies completion evidence, and selectively invalidates affected work. Across controlled comparisons, governed and direct workflows often reached the same outcomes, but only the governed path consistently preserved governing evidence, refused unsupported closure, and limited recovery to dependent tasks. A role-separated transfer challenge then failed: a deterministically enforced completeness contract severely over-blocked synthetic packets produced outside its authoring context. These results do not establish Matrix as a general accuracy enhancer; they support its primary role as an institutional integrity layer for making agentic work auditable and independently verifiable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证仅凭"达到正确结果"不足以评估智能体工作流（agentic workflows），提出"治理执行"（governed execution）概念，并实现一个名为 Matrix 的确定性因果状态层，记录权威与事实依赖、验证完成证据并选择性失效受影响工作。受控对比显示治理与非治理流程常得到相同结果，但只有治理路径能一致保留治理证据、拒绝未经支持的关闭，并把恢复范围限制在依赖任务上；角色分离的传输挑战则失败，说明该完整性契约可能过度拦截其创作上下文外产生的对象。作者明确不将 Matrix 定位为通用精度增强器，而是作为机构场景下的可审计完整性层。
Motivation: 智能体工作流通常以是否达成正确结果来评估，但在机构化环境中这并不充分：正确的行动可能依赖错误的权威、缺乏支持的完成声明或被后续变更作废的工作。需要一种能支撑决策、完成与变更响应可被审查的治理执行机制。
Method: 提出 Matrix，一个确定性因果状态层：记录权威依赖（authority dependencies）与事实依赖（fact dependencies），验证完成证据（completion evidence），并选择性使受影响的旧工作失效。
Result: 在受控比较中，治理流程与直接流程经常得到相同结果，但只有治理路径一致地保留治理证据、拒绝未支持的关闭，并将恢复操作限制在依赖任务上。在角色分离的传输挑战中，确定性强制的完整性契约严重过度拦截了在其创作上下文之外产生的合成数据包。
Conclusion: 这些结果并不表明 Matrix 能普遍提升准确性；其作用定位为一种机构完整性层（institutional integrity layer），使智能体工作可审计、可独立验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Difference-of-Convex Regularization for Graph Learning by Differentiable Programming
papers.abstract_en: Laplacian-regularized minimization is fundamental in signal processing and machine learning, but is limited by the dense and ill-conditioned nature of the graph Laplacian pseudoinverse. While the Laplacian itself is sparse, its pseudoinverse is dense and often ill-conditioned, rendering direct computation impractical at scale. Moreover, pseudoinverse learning is more challenging than Laplacian learning. To address this challenge, this paper considers the setting where the graph Laplacian is given and proposes a Difference-of-Convex Regularizer (DCR) graph learning framework that approximates the spectral action of the Laplacian pseudoinverse without direct inversion via regularized Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE). By reformulating Laplacian-Regularized Nonnegative Least Squares (LR-NNLS) through a dual representation, DCR decouples pseudoinverse learning from instance-specific inference and enables efficient primal solution reconstruction via a differentiable dual-guided learning scheme. We establish theoretical guarantees on stability and the existence of a unique fixed point for DCR algorithm. Numerical experiments demonstrate improved performance over convex solvers and graph filtering baselines and robust performance across diverse graph topologies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于差凸正则化 (Difference-of-Convex Regularizer, DCR) 的图学习框架，在给定图拉普拉斯矩阵的前提下，通过正则化极大似然估计 (MLE) 逼近拉普拉斯伪逆的谱作用，避免直接求逆。作者利用对偶表示重写拉普拉斯正则化非负最小二乘 (LR-NNLS)，将伪逆学习与实例级推断解耦，并通过可微对偶引导的学习方案高效重构原始解。文中给出了稳定性和 DCR 算法唯一不动点的理论保证，数值实验显示其优于凸求解器和图滤波基线，且在多种图拓扑下表现稳健。
Motivation: 拉普拉斯正则化最小化是信号处理和机器学习中的基础工具，但图拉普拉斯伪逆稠密且常为病态，直接计算在大规模场景下不可行；且伪逆学习比拉普拉斯本身的学习更具挑战性。
Method: 提出 DCR 图学习框架，通过对偶表示将 LR-NNLS 重新表述，从而在不直接求逆的情况下近似拉普拉斯伪逆的谱作用；配合可微对偶引导学习实现原始解的重建，并给出稳定性和唯一不动点的理论分析。
Result: 数值实验表明，DCR 在性能上优于凸求解器和图滤波基线，并在不同图拓扑下保持稳健表现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法能够在不直接求逆的前提下逼近伪逆谱作用，具备理论保证和实验上的优越性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ReconSpan: Reconstruction-Guided Adaptive Latent Tokenization
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive latent tokenization maps a fine-grained input to a shorter sequence of continuous representations associated with input-dependent spans. We introduce ReconSpan, which divides text into chunks that a backward decoder can reconstruct from a single contextual prefix code and retains one such code as the latent token for each chunk. The reconstruction criterion is applied when chunks are formed, allowing one trained autoencoder to produce average chunk lengths from 6.5 to 12.2. At matched average length, reconstruction-guided boundaries preserve more text than random boundaries. Readers of the resulting latent sequence recover topic information reliably but struggle to extract exact details.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReconSpan，一种自适应隐式分词 (adaptive latent tokenization) 方法：将文本划分为可由反向解码器从单个上下文前缀码重构的块，并每块保留一个这样的码作为隐式 token。重构准则在分块时即被应用，使单个训练好的自编码器能产生 6.5 到 12.2 的平均块长；在平均长度匹配时，重构引导的边界比随机边界保留更多文本，但读者难以从中提取精确细节。
Motivation: 自适应隐式分词旨在把细粒度输入映射为更短、依赖输入的连续表示序列，但如何划分输入块是核心难题，需要一种能保证块可被有效重建的分块准则。
Method: ReconSpan 将文本切分为块，每个块由一个反向解码器从单一上下文前缀码中重构；分块形成时即应用重构准则，并让每个块保留一个隐式 token，从而用一个训练好的自编码器实现端到端的隐式分词。
Result: 单个训练好的自编码器可产生 6.5 至 12.2 的平均块长；在平均长度匹配条件下，重构引导的边界比随机边界保留更多文本信息，且生成的隐式序列能可靠传递主题信息，但难以恢复精确细节。

papers.title: Decentralized Multi-Player Q-Learning in Episodic Markov Decision Processes with Information Asymmetry
papers.abstract_en: We study decentralized multi-player reinforcement learning in episodic tabular Markov decision processes (MDPs) under three forms of information asymmetry: (A) unobserved actions with common rewards, (B) observed actions with independent rewards, and (C) unobserved actions with independent rewards. Players cannot communicate during learning but may agree on a protocol a priori. For Problems A and B we propose \texttt{mQ-learning} and \texttt{mQ-learning-intervals}, achieving $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{H^4 S A_{\text{joint}}\, T})$ regret, where $H$ is the horizon, $S$ the state count, $T = KH$ the total steps, and $A_{\text{joint}} = \prod_{i=1}^M |\mathcal{A}_i|$ the joint action space across $M$ players. For Problem C we give \texttt{mEXC} and \texttt{mEXC-Bellman}, two-phase explore-then-commit algorithms with regret $\tilde{O}(H (S A_{\text{joint}})^{1/3} T^{2/3})$. Against the centralized joint-action benchmark, decentralized learning under information asymmetry matches the single-agent Q-learning rate of \cite{jin2018q} up to logarithmic factors. Because $A_{\text{joint}}$ grows exponentially in $M$, the bounds are most meaningful for small $M$ or small per-player action sets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 episodic tabular MDP 中多玩家在信息不对称条件下的分散式强化学习。作者提出 mQ-learning 与 mQ-learning-intervals 处理公共奖励但动作不可观测、以及动作可观测但奖励独立两类问题，并给出 mEXC 与 mEXC-Bellman 两阶段算法处理动作与奖励均独立的问题。摘要报告这些算法相对集中式联合动作基准的 regret 界，并指出联合动作空间随玩家数指数增长使结果在小规模设定下最有意义。
Motivation: 多玩家强化学习中玩家在学习过程中无法通信、只能事先约定协议，且存在动作不可观测或奖励独立等不对称信息，这使现有集中式或可通信假设下的算法不再适用。
Method: 针对信息不对称的三种形式分别设计算法：对问题 A（未观测动作、共同奖励）与 B（观测动作、独立奖励）提出 mQ-learning 与 mQ-learning-intervals；对问题 C（未观测动作、独立奖励）提出两阶段 explore-then-commit 的 mEXC 与 mEXC-Bellman。
Result: 问题 A/B 的 regret 为 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{H^4 S A_{\text{joint}} T})$，问题 C 的 regret 为 $\tilde{O}(H (S A_{\text{joint}})^{1/3} T^{2/3})$；与集中式联合动作基准相比，分散式学习在这些信息不对称设定下匹配单智能体 Q-learning 的 regret 速率，仅差对数因子。
Conclusion: 由于 $A_{\text{joint}}$ 随玩家数 $M$ 指数增长，所得 regret 界在小规模 $M$ 或每玩家动作集较小时最具实际意义。

papers.title: SynAct: A Reasoning-Acting Large Language Model Agent for Adaptive Synthesis Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Logic synthesis transforms RTL designs into gate-level netlists, where PPA results are highly sensitive to the choice of optimization commands, making synthesis tuning both high-dimensional and expensive. Previous approaches fall into two categories: automated methods, which perform black-box search over fixed action spaces with limited decision-level interpretability, and LLM-based methods, which typically generate static scripts upfront and cannot adapt to evolving circuit states. We present SynAct, an adaptive closed-loop LLM reasoning--acting agent that iteratively diagnoses live synthesis reports and reasons over the current circuit state, retrieved tool knowledge, and historical optimization experience to issue targeted commands. SynAct focuses on improving timing, particularly worst negative slack (WNS), while maintaining balanced area and power trade-offs. Experiments on a commercial synthesis tool across 14 designs show that SynAct reduces average WNS to 27% of that from bootstrap synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SynAct，一种用于逻辑综合优化的自适应闭环 LLM 推理-行动智能体 (reasoning-acting agent)。SynAct 迭代诊断实时综合报告，并基于当前电路状态、检索到的工具知识与历史优化经验发出针对性命令，主要改善最差负裕量 (WNS)，同时维持面积与功耗的平衡。在商用综合工具上对 14 个设计进行实验，SynAct 将平均 WNS 降至 bootstrap 综合结果的 27%。
Motivation: 逻辑综合中 PPA 结果对优化命令的选择高度敏感，调参空间高维且昂贵。现有方法分为黑盒搜索（可解释性有限）和 LLM 生成静态脚本（无法适应不断变化的电路状态），SynAct 针对这两种局限提出自适应闭环方案。
Method: SynAct 采用 LLM 推理-行动 (reasoning-acting) 的闭环框架：在每次迭代中诊断实时综合报告，综合当前电路状态、检索到的工具知识以及历史优化经验，决策并发出下一条综合命令，从而动态调整优化策略。
Result: 在商用综合工具上的 14 个设计实验中，SynAct 将平均 WNS 降低到 bootstrap 综合结果的 27%。摘要未报告其他基准或消融数据。
Conclusion: 作者强调基于实时电路状态的迭代式 LLM 推理能够替代静态脚本，显著改善时序（尤其 WNS）并兼顾面积与功耗权衡。摘要未讨论局限性或可移植性细节。

papers.title: PatientAct: Theory-Grounded Mental Health Client Simulation
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based simulated clients are increasingly used to train novice counselors, evaluate LLM therapists, and generate synthetic data. However, current simulators produce overly cooperative clients that disclose too readily, accept therapeutic reframes without resistance, and resolve core issues within a single session. We trace these issues to profiles that lack causal depth and behavioral mechanisms that treat all content as equally accessible. We present PatientAct, a framework for client simulation grounded in established clinical theories. Our profiles integrate the 5Ps clinical case formulation, providing causal depth without tying the design to any single therapeutic modality. During simulation, profiles include a dynamic memory layer in which items carry trust thresholds (e.g., symptoms are available early, whereas formative memories require a sustained therapeutic alliance). At each turn, the client's emotional reaction and behavior are modeled before generating a response. If the therapist approaches gated content, PatientAct expresses resistance in terms of quantity, content, and style rather than defaulting to cooperation or a single resistance pattern. We evaluate our framework on 40 clinical situations and demonstrate that it generates diverse profiles with high clinical plausibility. Moreover, PatientAct significantly outperforms the baselines, yielding substantial gains in resistance quality and behavioral realism. Our code and data will be publicly available via github.com/Sahandfer/PatientHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PatientAct，一个基于临床理论的心理健康客户模拟框架，用于训练新手咨询师、评估 LLM 治疗师和生成合成数据。针对现有 LLM 模拟客户过于顺从、过早披露、不加抵抗地接受治疗性重构的问题，框架引入 5Ps 临床案例公式化、带信任阈值的动态记忆层以及逐轮情绪与行为建模。作者在 40 个临床情境上评估，结果显示其能生成多样化且临床合理性高的画像，并在抵抗质量和行为真实性上显著优于基线。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 模拟客户倾向于过分合作：披露过快、不加抵抗地接受治疗重构、并在单次会话内解决核心问题。作者将原因归结为画像缺乏因果深度，以及行为机制把所有记忆内容视为同等可访问，这会影响咨询师训练、治疗师评估和合成数据的可靠性。
Method: PatientAct 的画像整合 5Ps 临床案例公式化以提供因果深度，同时不绑定单一治疗流派。模拟过程中加入动态记忆层，各记忆项携带信任阈值，例如症状可早期获得，而形成性记忆需要持续治疗联盟；每一轮对话先生成情绪反应和行为，再生成文本回应。当治疗师触及门控内容时，模型按数量、内容和风格表达抵抗，而非默认合作或使用单一抵抗模式。
Result: 在 40 个临床情境上的评估表明，PatientAct 能生成多样化且临床合理性高的画像，并在抵抗质量和行为真实性上显著优于基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 PatientAct 在临床合理性、多样化画像和抵抗行为真实性方面的收益，并说明代码和数据将通过公开仓库发布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scaling Representation Diversity: Modulated Attention and Reconstructive Regularization for Visual Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Referring Expression Comprehension (REC) is commonly studied under dataset-specific fine-tuning, resulting in specialist models with limited cross-dataset generalization. In this work, we revisit REC from the perspective of unified open-vocabulary grounding and identify representation degeneration as a key obstacle to scaling a single generalist model. To preserve representation diversity, we propose a holistic data-model co-design framework. Architecturally, we introduce the Modulated Attention-Contrastive Head (mACH) for efficient token-level vision-language alignment and a text-conditioned JEPA auxiliary stream that provides complementary gradient support to preserve alignment-active representations without inference overhead. On the data side, we introduce Objects365-Caption, enriching Objects365 with context-aware referring expressions for large-scale language supervision. We further provide a theoretical analysis showing that complementary gradient subspaces preserve alignment capacity and thereby scale representation diversity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our single-checkpoint framework achieves highly competitive performance on standard REC benchmarks while exhibiting strong generalization across heterogeneous grounding datasets without benchmark-specific adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从统一开放词汇视觉定位 (open-vocabulary grounding) 的角度重新审视 Referring Expression Comprehension (REC)，指出表示退化 (representation degeneration) 是扩展单一通用模型的主要障碍。作者提出数据-模型协同设计框架：引入 Modulated Attention-Contrastive Head (mACH) 和文本条件的 JEPA 辅助流，并构建 Objects365-Caption 数据集以提供大规模语言监督。实验表明该单检查点框架在标准 REC 基准上具有竞争力，且无需针对基准适配即可在异构定位数据集上展现强泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有 REC 研究通常在数据集特定的微调下进行，得到的是跨数据集泛化有限的专才模型。作者认为表示退化阻碍了单一通用模型 (generalist model) 的规模化，因此需要从数据与模型两方面保持表示多样性 (representation diversity)。
Method: 提出数据-模型协同设计框架：在架构上引入 mACH 以进行高效的 token 级视觉-语言对齐，并加入文本条件的 JEPA 辅助流提供互补梯度支持，从而保留对齐活跃表示且不增加推理开销；在数据上提出 Objects365-Caption，为 Objects365 补充上下文感知的指代表达式。还给出理论分析，说明互补梯度子空间 (complementary gradient subspaces) 能保持对齐容量并扩展表示多样性。
Result: 实验表明，该单检查点框架在标准 REC 基准上取得具有竞争力的性能，并且在无需基准特定适配的情况下，对异构 grounding 数据集展现出较强的跨数据集泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过数据-模型协同设计保留表示多样性，可以推动统一开放词汇 grounding 模型的规模化；摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dual-Stream Cross-Anchor Correction Grounding Long-Form Captions and the Domain Limits of Object-Level Anchors
papers.abstract_en: Object hallucination in multimodal large language models arises when language priors and corpus co-occurrence bias outweigh the visual evidence, with nothing tying an individual object mention to what the image shows. Most remedies intervene at decoding time without training, yet under a unified protocol their benefit is confined to short captions;supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on a detail- rich corpus lengthens captions, but over forty percent still name absent objects. This paper proposes Dual-Stream Cross-Anchor Correction (DSCC). Unlike work that post-processes decoding, DSCC is the first to inject object-level visual anchors into the language model itself during fine- tuning: a perception stream aligns object-level hidden states at an intermediate layer to frozen text anchors by a bidirectional contrastive objective; a cognition stream lets deeper layers query those anchors by cross-attention at every generation step; and a two-stage curriculum gate couplesthem, making evidence retrieval a structural constraint at each autoregressive step. Under one backbone and one scoring protocol, experiments span long-caption hallucination, object-existence discrimination and cross-domain generalisation, with vanilla SFT on the same corpus and schedule as a length- and density-matched control, so gains are attributed layer by layer. DSCC is the only method reaching the long-caption, low-hallucination region: captions roughly 1.9 times the baseline length at 88.19% precision per object mention, the highest under a density-independent criterion. Ablations expose a synergy: the perception stream alone degrades precision yet reverses sign when stacked on the cognition stream. No universal superiority is claimed: three out-of- domain benchmarks yield a predictable, falsifiable domain-conditionality, the synergy being bound to the anchors' semantic domain and breaking on charts and optical illusions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型中的对象幻觉问题，提出 Dual-Stream Cross-Anchor Correction (DSCC)，在微调阶段将对象级视觉锚点注入语言模型本身：感知流通过双向对比学习将中间层对象级隐藏状态对齐到冻结文本锚点，认知流在每一生成步骤通过交叉注意力查询锚点，并由两阶段课程门控耦合，使证据检索成为自回归每一步的结构性约束。实验采用统一骨干和评分协议，覆盖长字幕幻觉、对象存在判别和跨域泛化，DSCC 在长字幕低幻觉区域达到约 1.9 倍基线长度的字幕且每个对象提及的精度为 88.19%。
Motivation: 对象幻觉源于语言先验和语料共现偏差压过视觉证据，且现有解码期干预在统一协议下仅对短字幕有效；基于细节丰富语料的监督微调 (SFT) 能加长字幕，但超过 40% 仍提及不存在的对象，说明需要将视觉证据约束直接引入模型结构。
Method: 提出 DSCC，由感知流 (perception stream)、认知流 (cognition stream) 和两阶段课程门控组成：感知流用双向对比目标把中间层对象级隐藏状态对齐到冻结文本锚点；认知流让深层网络在每步生成时通过交叉注意力查询这些锚点；两阶段课程门控将它们耦合，使证据检索成为自回归生成的结构性约束。
Result: 在统一骨干和评分协议下，DSCC 是唯一达到长字幕低幻觉区域的方法：字幕长度约为基线 1.9 倍，每个对象提及精度 88.19%，为密度无关标准下的最高值。消融显示感知流单独会降低精度，但与认知流堆叠后符号反转，呈现协同效应；三个域外基准呈现可预测、可证伪的域条件性，协同效应局限于锚点的语义域，在图表和视错觉上失效。

papers.title: A Cloud-Edge System for Multimodal Clinical Screening in Resource-Constrained Rural Settings
papers.abstract_en: Medical AI has demonstrated specialist-level diagnostic accuracy, yet these capabilities remain largely inaccessible in resource-constrained rural settings where bandwidth is scarce, compute is limited, and clinical decision-making requires integrating heterogeneous modalities. We introduce a cloud--edge collaborative architecture that addresses these constraints: lightweight, domain-specific models on the edge transform raw medical data into compact structured outputs, while a cloud LLM synthesizes these outputs into clinical summaries. An LLM-based orchestrator dynamically selects diagnostic tools based on patient context, promoting comprehensive modality coverage without processing irrelevant inputs. We evaluate on 20 multimodal clinical cases spanning cardiac, obstetric, trauma, and screening scenarios under three simulated network profiles (500,kbps--5,Mbps). The hybrid system achieves 98--99% diagnostic tool recall with 92--96% precision, matches or exceeds cloud-only baselines on clinical accuracy, and maintains bandwidth-invariant latency (25--35,s) at 4--15x lower token cost. These results highlight the role of architectural design in enabling efficient multimodal integration and improving factual grounding compared to cloud-only approaches under deployment constraints.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 3 figures. In Proceedings of Machine Learning Research, Volume 340, 2026 (Machine Learning for Healthcare Conference)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向资源受限农村环境的云-边缘协同多模态临床筛查架构：边缘侧轻量级领域模型将原始医疗数据转换为紧凑的结构化输出，云端 LLM 再将其综合为临床摘要，并由基于 LLM 的编排器根据患者上下文动态选择诊断工具。在 20 个覆盖心脏、产科、创伤和筛查场景的多模态临床案例、三种模拟网络条件（500kbps–5Mbps）下，该系统达到 98–99% 的诊断工具召回率与 92–96% 的精确率，临床准确率不低于纯云端基线，延迟保持与带宽无关（25–35 秒），token 成本降低 4–15 倍。
Motivation: 医疗 AI 虽已具备专家级诊断能力，但在带宽稀缺、计算有限且需整合异质模态的农村医疗场景中难以落地，现有云端方案受部署约束明显。
Method: 提出云-边缘协同架构：边缘运行轻量级领域特定模型，将原始医疗数据转为紧凑结构化输出；云端 LLM 综合这些输出生成临床摘要；并引入基于 LLM 的编排器，依据患者上下文动态选择诊断工具，以避免处理无关输入。
Result: 在 20 个多模态临床病例和 500kbps–5Mbps 三种网络剖面下，混合系统实现 98–99% 诊断工具召回率、92–96% 精确率，临床准确率匹配或超过纯云端基线，延迟恒定在 25–35 秒，token 成本比云端方案降低 4–15 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调架构设计本身能在部署约束下实现高效的多模态集成，并与纯云端方法相比改善事实依据（factual grounding）。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Spatial Memory Agent: Experience-Grounded Procedure Memory for Spatial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Spatial intelligence is becoming a foundation for embodied agents, robotic planning, and multimodal assistants. To improve the spatial reasoning ability of VLM agents, existing work has mainly followed two lines. One line uses post-training methods, such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Another line adopts an agentic paradigm in which the model calls external spatial tools, such as depth estimation and 3D reconstruction tools, to gather intermediate spatial evidence. We study a complementary and underexplored route: Can a frozen VLM agent improve its spatial reasoning through \textbf{parameter-update-free self-evolution}, without depending on external expert spatial tools at inference time? We present \textbf{Spatial Memory Agent (SMA)}, an \textbf{experience-grounded runtime framework} that converts verified spatial experience into reusable transferable lessons. In a verifiable spatial environment, SMA queries the frozen VLM, obtains a predicted answer and reward, and uses \textbf{verifier-guided reflection} to distill compact transferable lessons from spatial experience. SMA further assigns each lesson a \textbf{Transfer Reliability Score (TRS)}, which is initialized uniformly and calibrated from later retrieval outcomes as visit evidence of future transfer reliability. During \textbf{read-only deployment}, SMA retrieves lessons by semantic filter and similarity-TRS combined ranking, allowing the retrieved memory to guide frozen model inference. Across five representative spatial benchmarks and four base VLMs, SMA achieves the highest macro average in every base-model block and the best accuracy among the evaluated methods in most of the 20 evaluations, establishing a practical parameter-update-free path for spatial self-evolution across the evaluated frozen model scales and environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Spatial Memory Agent (SMA)，一种基于经验的运行时框架 (experience-grounded runtime framework)，使冻结的 VLM 在推理时不更新参数、不依赖外部专家空间工具的情况下，通过可验证空间环境中的自我演化提升空间推理能力。SMA 利用验证器引导的反思 (verifier-guided reflection) 将经过验证的空间经验提炼为可迁移的紧凑经验教训，并为每条教训分配迁移可靠性分数 (TRS)。在五个空间基准和四个基础 VLM 上，SMA 在每个 base-model block 都取得最高宏平均准确率，并在 20 个评测中的大多数上取得最佳准确率。
Motivation: 现有提升 VLM 空间推理的路线主要有两条：后训练方法（如 SFT 和强化学习）以及在推理时调用外部空间工具（如深度估计、3D 重建）收集中间证据。作者研究一条互补且少被探索的路线：冻结 VLM 能否通过不更新参数的自我演化 (parameter-update-free self-evolution) 提升空间推理，且不依赖推理时的外部专家空间工具。
Method: SMA 在可验证空间环境中查询冻结 VLM，获得预测答案和奖励，并使用验证器引导的反思从空间经验中提炼紧凑的可迁移经验教训。每条教训被赋予初始均匀、随后由检索结果校准的 Transfer Reliability Score (TRS)；在只读部署阶段，SMA 通过语义过滤和相似度-TRS 联合排序检索教训，用检索到的记忆引导冻结模型推理。
Result: 在五个代表性空间基准和四个基础 VLM 上，SMA 在每个 base-model block 中取得最高的宏平均准确率，并在 20 个测评中的大多数上取得最佳准确率，验证了免参数更新空间自我演化路径的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，SMA 建立了一条实用的免参数更新路径，可在所评估的冻结模型尺度和环境中实现空间自我演化，而无需推理时依赖外部专家工具。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Dual-Manifold Geometry Guided Representation Learning: Adaptive Coupling between Kernel and Data Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Deep representation learning has primarily focused on how features evolve across network layers, while largely overlooking the structured geometry embedded in network parameters. We introduce a dual-manifold perspective in which each convolutional layer contains two coupled geometric spaces: a Kernel Manifold induced by convolutional filters and a Data Manifold characterized by intermediate feature representations. Because these manifolds share the same channel space, parameter geometry can provide complementary structural information to guide feature evolution. Based on this insight, we propose Kernel-Guided Feature Transform (KGFT), a lightweight module that derives a geometric guidance matrix from the kernel Gram matrix and uses it to transform the covariance structure of feature representations. Unlike conventional attention mechanisms that reweight feature responses, KGFT explicitly reshapes feature relationships by transferring geometric information from the kernel manifold to the data manifold. To accommodate network hierarchy, we further introduce Exploit and Explore modes with a depth-aware scheduling strategy and a learnable guidance strength that adaptively controls the contribution of geometric transformation. This design promotes geometric alignment in shallow layers while encouraging feature diversity in deeper layers, without imposing excessive constraints on representation learning. Theoretical analysis establishes the validity of the proposed transformation and characterizes its effect on feature covariance. Extensive experiments across CNN- and Transformer-based architectures, including ResNet, ViT, and LLaMA-7B, demonstrate consistent improvements on image classification and arithmetic reasoning tasks, validating the generality and effectiveness of kernel-guided dual-manifold representation learning. Code will be publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出从双流形视角看待卷积层：卷积核诱导的 Kernel Manifold 与中间特征构成的 Data Manifold 共享同一通道空间，参数几何可作为特征演化的结构约束。作者据此设计 Kernel-Guided Feature Transform (KGFT) 轻量模块，从核 Gram 矩阵导出几何引导矩阵，进而变换特征表示的协方差结构；并引入 Exploit/Explore 模式与深度感知调度、可学习引导强度，在浅层促进几何对齐、深层鼓励特征多样性。理论分析证明了变换的有效性及其对特征协方差的影响，在 ResNet、ViT、LLaMA-7B 等 CNN 与 Transformer 架构上的图像分类和算术推理任务中取得一致提升。
Motivation: 现有深度表示学习主要关注特征跨层演化，忽略了网络参数中嵌入的结构化几何信息；论文希望利用卷积核与中间特征共享通道空间这一事实，使参数几何为特征演化提供互补的引导信息。
Method: 提出 Kernel-Guided Feature Transform (KGFT) 模块：由卷积核 Gram 矩阵构建几何引导矩阵，用于变换特征表示的协方差结构，而非像常规注意力那样仅重加权特征响应；同时设计 Exploit 与 Explore 两种模式，配合深度感知调度和可学习引导强度，自适应控制几何变换的贡献。
Result: 理论分析验证了所提变换的合理性并刻画其对特征协方差的影响；实验在 ResNet、ViT、LLaMA-7B 等 CNN 与 Transformer 架构上，对图像分类和算术推理任务均取得一致改进，表明该方法具备通用性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调核引导的双流形表示学习能通过向数据流形传递参数几何信息来提升表示质量，且不会对表示学习施加过度约束；代码将公开。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 理论分析验证了所提变换的合理性并刻画其对特征协方差的影响；实验在 ResNet、ViT、LLaMA-7B 等 CNN 与 Transformer 架构上，对图像分类和算术推理任务均取得一致改进，表明该方法具备通用性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调核引导的双流形表示学习能通过向数据流形传递参数几何信息来提升表示质量，且不会对表示学习施加过度约束；代码将公开。

papers.title: A Generative Approach for Improving Multi-Label Defect Classification in Photovoltaic Modules
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the challenge of multi-label defect classification in electroluminescence (EL) images of photovoltaic (PV) cells. Training models on images where multiple defects co-occur creates learning ambiguity, making it difficult to disentangle visual features for specific defect types, a problem compounded by the scarcity of examples for individual classes. To tackle this, we introduce Generative Defect Isolation (GDI), utilizing the LaMa inpainting model with Fast Fourier Convolutions to remove selected defects and generate realistic, single-defect training samples. Extensive experiments on Vision Transformer (ViT-S, ViT-L) and EfficientNetV2-L architectures demonstrate that GDI significantly outperforms baselines. The performance gains are most pronounced in low-data scenarios; class-wise analysis shows substantial improvements, boosting the F1-Score for rare defect classes by up to 63.6%. Furthermore, GDI effectively resolves learning ambiguity from co-occurring defects, yielding a 26% reduction in such co-occurring classification errors. Our work establishes GDI as an effective method for maximizing the value of existing segmentation datasets and sets a new performance benchmark for multi-label classification in this domain.
papers.journal_ref: Solar Energy 317 (2026) 114943
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对光伏组件电致发光（EL）图像中的多标签缺陷分类问题，提出生成式缺陷隔离（Generative Defect Isolation, GDI）方法，利用基于快速傅里叶卷积（Fast Fourier Convolutions）的 LaMa 修复模型移除选定缺陷，从而生成逼真的单缺陷训练样本。在 ViT-S、ViT-L 和 EfficientNetV2-L 上的实验表明，GDI 显著优于基线，尤其在低数据场景下收益最大，罕见缺陷类别的 F1 分数最高提升 63.6%，并减少了 26% 的共现缺陷分类错误。
Motivation: 多缺陷共现的图像会造成学习歧义，使模型难以区分不同缺陷类型的视觉特征，同时单个类别的样本稀少，进一步加剧了多标签缺陷分类的难度。
Method: 提出 Generative Defect Isolation (GDI) 方法，使用带快速傅里叶卷积的 LaMa 修复模型去除选定缺陷，生成逼真的单缺陷训练样本，以缓解多缺陷共现带来的学习歧义并扩充稀有类别样本。
Result: 在 ViT-S、ViT-L 和 EfficientNetV2-L 架构上的大量实验显示 GDI 显著优于基线；低数据场景下增益最明显，稀有缺陷类别的 F1 分数最高提升 63.6%，同时共现缺陷分类错误降低 26%。
Conclusion: 作者认为 GDI 是一种有效利用现有分割数据集价值的方法，并为该领域的多标签分类设立了新的性能基准；摘要未提及方法在非 EL 图像或真实产线上的泛化限制。

papers.title: MAG: MAnifold Guided Semi-Supervised Multi-modal In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot in-context learning (ICL) with multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) enables task adaptation without parameter updates, but its performance is highly sensitive to the quality and coverage of the selected demonstrations. While unlabeled multi-modal data is abundant, it remains elusive how to exploit them for ICL. We propose MAG (MAnifold-Guided semi-supervised in-context demonstra- tion selection), an efficient framework that leverages unlabeled data to improve multi-modal ICL. MAG formulates demonstration selection as a semi-supervised propagation problem on a multi-modal graph and adopts a two-stage strategy: (i) relevance score propagation identifies a compact set of high-impact unlabeled samples for pseudo-labeling, reducing MLLM inference cost; (ii) multi-modal relevance is used to select the final demonstrations. We show that textual represen- tations are more effective for relevance propagation, while both visual and textual modalities are crucial for high-quality demonstration selection. Experiments on eight multi-modal benchmarks demonstrate that MAG consistently outperforms strong baselines in label-scarce regimes, achieving significant gains with a limited pseudo-labeling budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAG (MAnifold-Guided semi-supervised in-context demonstration selection)，一种利用无标注多模态数据改进多模态大语言模型少样本上下文学习 (in-context learning, ICL) 的框架。方法将示例选择建模为多模态图上的半监督传播问题，采用两阶段策略：先通过相关性分数传播选出少量高影响的未标注样本进行伪标注，再基于多模态相关性挑选最终演示示例。在八个多模态基准上，MAG 在标签稀缺场景下持续优于强基线。
Motivation: 少样本 ICL 的性能高度依赖所选演示示例的质量与覆盖度，而丰富的无标注多模态数据尚未被有效用于改进示例选择。
Method: 将演示选择建模为多模态图上的半监督传播问题，提出两阶段策略：(i) 通过相关性分数传播 (relevance score propagation) 从大量未标注样本中筛选出紧凑的高影响集合用于伪标签，以降低 MLLM 推理成本；(ii) 利用多模态相关性 (multi-modal relevance) 进行最终演示选择。摘要还指出文本表示对相关性传播更有效，而视觉与文本两种模态对高质量演示选择都不可缺少。
Result: 在八个多模态基准上的实验表明，MAG 在标签稀缺 (label-scarce) 场景下一致优于强基线，并在有限的伪标注预算下取得显著增益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用无标注数据并以半监督图传播方式组织演示选择可以提升多模态 ICL，且视觉与文本模态各自发挥关键作用；摘要未明确讨论方法局限。

papers.title: VOS-Agent: The 1st Place Solution for the 8th LSVOS Challenge (MOSEv2 Track)
papers.abstract_en: Complex video object segmentation requires robust target propagation under severe occlusion, disappearance and reappearance. Although SAM3 provides strong promptable mask propagation, a uniform inference path remains unreliable for tiny targets with insufficient visual evidence and semantic-dominated targets whose identities depend on explicit attributes. To this end, we present VOS-Agent, a collaborative framework that retains SAM3 as the shared dense segmentation module and conditionally activates specialized agents according to target characteristics. A Target Perception and Routing Agent assigns each sequence to a regular, tiny, or semantic-dominated route. Tiny targets are supported by a Visual Tracking Agent through confidence-aware box prompts, while semantic-dominated targets are handled by an MLLM-based Semantic Agent through description-guided localization and candidate verification. On the MOSEv2 test set, VOS-Agent achieves 69.82% on the official $\mathcal{J}\&\dot{\mathcal{F}}$ metric and ranks first in the MOSEv2 Track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge at ECCV 2026.
papers.comment: 1st Place Solution for the 8th LSVOS MOSEv2 Challenge (ECCV 2026 Workshop)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VOS-Agent，一种面向复杂视频目标分割的协作框架，以 SAM3 作为共享稠密分割模块，并根据目标特征条件化激活专用智能体。在 MOSEv2 测试集上达到 69.82% 的官方 J&F 指标，获得 ECCV 2026 第八届 LSVOS Challenge MOSEv2 Track 第一名。
Motivation: 复杂视频目标分割需要在严重遮挡、消失与重现情况下稳健传播目标，而统一推理路径对视觉证据不足的微小目标和依赖显式属性的语义主导目标并不可靠。
Method: 框架保留 SAM3 作为共享稠密分割模块，由 Target Perception and Routing Agent 将序列分配到常规、微小或语义主导路线；微小目标由 Visual Tracking Agent 通过置信度感知的 box prompt 处理，语义主导目标由基于 MLLM 的 Semantic Agent 通过描述引导定位和候选验证处理。
Result: 在 MOSEv2 测试集上，VOS-Agent 在官方 J&F 指标上达到 69.82%，排名该赛道第一。
Conclusion: 摘要表明按目标特征条件化选择推理路径可提升复杂视频目标分割的稳健性，并已在 LSVOS MOSEv2 Track 中验证。
