papers.title: ERSkill: Evolving for Skill-Guided Adaptive Memory Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on long-term memory for persistent interactions, the retrieval mechanisms governing this memory are rarely treated as evolvable components. This static approach limits performance on heterogeneous memory queries, which often demand diverse evidence construction strategies. To address this, we introduce \textbf{ERSkill}, a retrieval-centric framework for self-evolving, skill-guided memory access. ERSkill compiles interaction histories into a structured memory store and represents retrieval behaviors as executable skills composed of fundamental primitives. At inference time, a trained router dynamically matches each query to the optimal skill to construct tailored evidence for answer generation. To enable continuous improvement, ERSkill co-evolves the skill set and the router during training. It employs an experience trie to efficiently record explored retrieval paths, alongside a double-frontier mechanism that safely decouples the expansion of new skill capabilities from stable, router-facing deployment. Experiments across multiple agent memory benchmarks demonstrate that ERSkill substantially outperforms strong non-evolving and self-evolving baselines. Notably, it improves the overall average across F1, BLEU-1, and LLM-judge scores by 31.3\% with Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct and by 28.1\% with GPT-5.4-nano.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ERSkill，一个面向 LLM 智能体长期记忆的检索中心框架，将检索行为表示为由基本原语组成的可执行技能，并在推理时用训练好的路由器将查询匹配到最优技能以构造证据。训练阶段通过经验 trie 记录探索过的检索路径，并用双前沿机制解耦技能能力扩展与面向路由器的稳定部署，实现技能集与路由器的共同进化。实验显示该方法在多个智能体记忆基准上显著优于非进化和自进化基线。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体长期记忆的检索机制是静态的，很少被视为可进化组件，难以应对异构记忆查询所要求的多样化证据构建策略。
Method: ERSkill 将交互历史编译为结构化记忆库，把检索行为表示为由基础原语构成的可执行技能；推理时路由器动态匹配查询与最优技能；训练时使用经验 trie 高效记录已探索的检索路径，并利用双前沿机制安全解耦新技能能力扩展与面向路由器的稳定部署。
Result: 在多个智能体记忆基准上，ERSkill 大幅超过强非进化和自进化基线；使用 Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct 时 F1、BLEU-1 与 LLM-judge 分数的整体平均提升 31.3%，使用 GPT-5.4-nano 时提升 28.1%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调检索机制应作为可进化组件对待，并且技能集与路由器的共同进化能持续改善智能体的记忆访问与证据构造能力；摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Error-Aware Reverse Auction Mechanism for Large Language Model Routing
papers.abstract_en: Routing each query to a cost-effective large language model (LLM) is critical for balancing quality and cost, yet most routers rely on a centralized task center to predict model performance, creating an information-risk mismatch and a scalability bottleneck as the model pool grows. We propose a market-based routing paradigm that shifts ex-ante prediction to LLM providers via a reverse auction, where providers bid with self-predicted success probabilities and execution costs. To account for inherently noisy provider predictions and center evaluations, we introduce the \textit{\textbf{E}rror-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{R}everse \textbf{A}uction \textbf{M}echanism} (EA-RAM), which explicitly models this inherent Dual Error. We prove that EA-RAM is Bayesian incentive compatible and individually rational under the Dual Error, establish sufficient conditions for center rationality, and derive an explicit welfare-loss bound. We further identify robustness effects: opposite-signed errors can cancel, vanishing-tail link functions (e.g., logistic) stabilize clear-cut cases via saturation, and extra noise smooths belief maps, reducing the gains from marginal manipulation. Experiments on simulations and real-world benchmarks show that EA-RAM is robust to the Dual Error and achieves a better cost--performance Pareto frontier than centralized baselines, with additional gains when providers contribute local information, validating its practical effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于市场的 LLM 路由范式，将原本由中心化任务中心进行的模型性能预测，改为通过反向拍卖 (reverse auction) 交给 LLM 提供方，由提供方以自预测成功概率和执行成本进行投标。为应对提供方预测与中心评估中天然存在的噪声，作者提出 Error-Aware Reverse Auction Mechanism (EA-RAM)，显式建模这种 Dual Error，并在理论上证明其在 Dual Error 下满足贝叶斯激励相容与个体理性。实验表明 EA-RAM 对 Dual Error 具有鲁棒性，并在成本-性能 Pareto 前沿上优于中心化基线。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 路由器通常依赖中心化任务中心预测各模型性能，这导致信息-风险错配，并且随着模型池扩大成为可扩展性瓶颈；需要一种能分散预测责任、缓解噪声影响的路由机制。
Method: 提出市场化的路由机制 EA-RAM：通过反向拍卖让 LLM 提供方以自预测成功概率和执行成本投标，机制显式建模提供方预测与中心评估中的 Dual Error；理论部分证明其贝叶斯激励相容和个体理性，给出中心理性 (center rationality) 的充分条件并推导显式的 welfare-loss 界，同时分析错误符号相消、饱和型链接函数和额外噪声对信念图的影响。
Result: 理论分析识别出鲁棒性效应：相反符号的错误可以相互抵消，逻辑斯蒂等 vanishing-tail 链接函数通过饱和稳定清晰情形，额外噪声使信念图平滑并降低边际操纵收益；仿真与真实基准实验表明 EA-RAM 对 Dual Error 鲁棒，并比中心化基线取得更好的成本-性能 Pareto 前沿，提供方贡献局部信息时还能进一步获益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将 ex-ante 预测转移到提供方并显式建模 Dual Error 的市场化路由，能够在噪声环境下保持激励兼容并改善成本与质量权衡，且提供方本地信息可提升机制实际效果。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种基于市场的 LLM 路由范式，将原本由中心化任务中心进行的模型性能预测，改为通过反向拍卖 (reverse auction) 交给 LLM 提供方，由提供方以自预测成功概率和执行成本进行投标。为应对提供方预测与中心评估中天然存在的噪声，作者提出 Error-Aware Reverse Auction Mechanism (EA-RAM)，显式建模这种 Dual Error，并在理论上证明其在 Dual Error 下满足贝叶斯激励相容与个体理性。实验表明 EA-RAM 对 Dual Error 具有鲁棒性，并在成本-性能 Pareto 前沿上优于中心化基线。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有 LLM 路由器通常依赖中心化任务中心预测各模型性能，这导致信息-风险错配，并且随着模型池扩大成为可扩展性瓶颈；需要一种能分散预测责任、缓解噪声影响的路由机制。
summary_sections.method: 提出市场化的路由机制 EA-RAM：通过反向拍卖让 LLM 提供方以自预测成功概率和执行成本投标，机制显式建模提供方预测与中心评估中的 Dual Error；理论部分证明其贝叶斯激励相容和个体理性，给出中心理性 (center rationality) 的充分条件并推导显式的 welfare-loss 界，同时分析错误符号相消、饱和型链接函数和额外噪声对信念图的影响。
summary_sections.result: 理论分析识别出鲁棒性效应：相反符号的错误可以相互抵消，逻辑斯蒂等 vanishing-tail 链接函数通过饱和稳定清晰情形，额外噪声使信念图平滑并降低边际操纵收益；仿真与真实基准实验表明 EA-RAM 对 Dual Error 鲁棒，并比中心化基线取得更好的成本-性能 Pareto 前沿，提供方贡献局部信息时还能进一步获益。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调将 ex-ante 预测转移到提供方并显式建模 Dual Error 的市场化路由，能够在噪声环境下保持激励兼容并改善成本与质量权衡，且提供方本地信息可提升机制实际效果。

papers.title: Perturbation-based Regional Interpretability through Subtraction Mapping (PRISM): naming-error dissociations in language models and post-stroke aphasia
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability of large language models lacks spatially resolved, falsifiable tools for testing whether internal components are specialized for distinct cognitive operations. We adapt subtraction analysis, the standard framework of human neuroimaging, from biological brains to perturbed transformers, and apply the same logic to both substrates in parallel. Building on the Brain-LLM Unified Model (BLUM), which showed that layer-perturbed LLaVA-1.6-Vicuna-13B error profiles match the lesion patterns of aphasic patients, we develop PRISM (Perturbation-based Regional Interpretability through Subtraction Mapping). PRISM maps the seven clinical Philadelphia Naming Test categories, subtracts error classes pairwise, and treats each perturbation seed as a subject in a group analysis with threshold-free cluster enhancement along the layer axis. We run a structurally matched analysis on 213 chronic post-stroke aphasia patients using correlation-difference lesion-symptom mapping, and replicate both sides on held-out splits. The designs match in subject dimension (seeds, patients), spatial dimension (layers, atlas-parcellated cortex) and thresholding, but the contrast operator differs: a within-subject error-proportion difference for the LLM, a between-subject correlation difference for the cortex. Both substrates recover a robust phonemic-favoring dissociation, a deep layer cluster and a frontal-perisylvian cortical cluster, both replicating; the semantic-favoring direction is a consistently signed but non-significant trend on both. PRISM thus gives a falsifiable, spatially resolved test of functional-specialization claims in transformer language models. A confirmatory ROI-level intervention (PRISM Stage 3) licensing the strongest causal-mechanism claim is left to subsequent work.
papers.comment: 49 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Supplementary methods, 6 tables and 5 figures included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PRISM（Perturbation-based Regional Interpretability through Subtraction Mapping），将人类神经影像学中的减法分析（subtraction analysis）框架从生物大脑迁移到扰动后的 Transformer 上，并与脑损伤数据并行分析。PRISM 基于 Brain-LLM Unified Model (BLUM)，将 LLaVA-1.6-Vicuna-13B 的层扰动误差按费城命名测试（Philadelphia Naming Test）的七个临床类别进行两两相减，再把每个扰动种子视为一个被试做组分析，并沿层轴使用 Threshold-free Cluster Enhancement。作者在 213 名慢性卒中后失语症患者上运行结构匹配的相关差异病灶症状映射，并在留出划分上复现两侧结果。
Motivation: 大语言模型的机制可解释性缺乏空间可解析、可证伪的工具来检验内部组件是否特化于不同认知操作；现有方法难以将模型内部结构与人类认知功能的神经证据直接对照。
Method: PRISM 将七类命名错误两两相减，把每个扰动种子作为组分析中的被试，沿层轴进行阈值无关簇增强；对皮层侧采用被试间相关差异的病灶症状映射。两侧设计在被试维度（种子 vs 患者）、空间维度（层 vs 图谱划分皮层）和阈值化上匹配，但对比算子不同：LLM 用被试内错误比例差，皮层用被试间相关差。
Result: 两个基质都稳健地恢复了音位偏好（phonemic-favoring）的分离：LLM 的深层簇与皮层的额叶-外侧裂周簇均可复现；语义偏好方向在两侧均为符号一致但不显著的趋势。
Conclusion: PRISM 为 Transformer 语言模型的功能特化主张提供了可证伪、空间可解析的检验；摘要同时指出，支持最强因果机制主张的确认性 ROI 级干预（PRISM Stage 3）留待后续工作。

papers.title: HybridSB-MoE: Dual-Domain Schrödinger Bridges with Scene-Adaptive Expert Routing for Speech Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Generative speech enhancement faces three gaps: spectral models capture harmonic structure but often disrupt phase, waveform models preserve phase but miss harmonics, and Schrödinger Bridges (SB) shorten transport from noise to clean speech but leave inference cost only loosely tied to training. We propose HybridSB-MoE, a dual-domain framework that fills these gaps through three contributions unified by a single asymmetric design principle. (i) Asymmetric uncertainty fusion: The spectral path captures epistemic uncertainty via expert disagreement, while the waveform bridge models aleatoric variance through stochastic dynamics. We fuse them asymmetrically, allowing the mixing weight to adapt to distinct error regimes rather than average predictions. (ii) Heterogeneous MoE with top-k=2 routing across five distinct architectural archetypes, where architectural diversity makes the epistemic signal indicate which inductive bias fails rather than small perturbations among similar experts. (iii) Discretization bound (Theorem 1): path-consistency and trajectory regularizers together bound the K-step bridge sampling error in 2-Wasserstein distance at rate K-alpha, making small-K inference an objective-level guarantee rather than an empirical claim. On VoiceBank+DEMAND, HybridSB-MoE outperforms diffusion- and SB-based baselines at their step budgets while remaining competitive with consistency-distilled few-step methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HybridSB-MoE，一种双域生成式语音增强框架，将频谱路径与波形域 Schrödinger Bridge (SB) 结合，并以非对称方式融合两类不确定性。方法采用跨五个异构专家架构的 top-k=2 路由，并借助 path-consistency 与 trajectory 正则化，给出小步数桥采样的 2-Wasserstein 误差界。摘要报告在 VoiceBank+DEMAND 上优于 diffusion 与 SB 基线，并与 consistency-distilled 少步方法相当。
Motivation: 生成式语音增强存在三个缺口：频谱模型保留谐波结构但破坏相位，波形模型保留相位却容易丢失谐波；SB 方法虽然缩短了从噪声到干净语音的传输距离，但推理成本与训练之间的联系松散。作者针对这些缺口提出统一的不对称设计原则。
Method: 提出双域框架，包含三个贡献：非对称不确定性融合（频谱路径通过专家分歧建模 epistemic uncertainty，波形桥通过随机动力学建模 aleatoric variance）；跨五个不同架构原型的异构 MoE，采用 top-k=2 路由，利用架构多样性使 epistemic 信号指示哪种归纳偏置失败；以及利用 path-consistency 与 trajectory regularizer 证明 K 步桥采样误差在 2-Wasserstein 距离上以 K^{-alpha} 速率有界（Theorem 1）。
Result: 在 VoiceBank+DEMAND 上，HybridSB-MoE 在其各自的步数预算下优于 diffusion 与 SB 基线，并与 consistency-distilled 少步方法表现相当。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法使小 K 推理获得 objective-level 的保证，而不只是经验性结论；其适用场景是生成式语音增强。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Towards Sparsely Annotated Open-World Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Real-world object detection operates under ambiguous supervision, where unlabeled regions may correspond to missing annotations of known objects or genuinely unknown categories. These challenges have been addressed separately in Sparsely Annotated Object Detection (SAOD) and Open-World Object Detection (OWOD). In practice, their co-occurrence remains an open problem. To address this problem, we introduce Sparsely Annotated Open-World Object Detection (SA-OWOD), a new task that jointly considers sparse supervision and the presence of unseen categories. We propose Dual-Perspective Object Discovery (DPOD), a unified framework that jointly models unlabeled known and unknown instances via two complementary mechanisms. The Known Target Recovery Module (KTRM) recovers supervision for unlabeled known instances and explicitly regularizes the feature space to separate known and unknown representations. Complementarily, the Dual-Disagreement Target Generator (DDTG) identifies reliable unknown candidates through cross-view semantic inconsistency. By integrating these modules, DPOD resolves contradictory supervision signals caused by ambiguous unlabeled regions. As a result, it prevents misclassification between known and unknown objects and stabilizes the decision boundaries. Experimental results on sparsely annotated open-world benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms existing open-world detection methods, particularly in detecting unknown objects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出稀疏标注开放世界目标检测 (SA-OWOD) 任务，同时处理稀疏监督和未知类别存在的场景。作者提出 Dual-Perspective Object Discovery (DPOD) 统一框架，通过已知目标恢复模块 (KTRM) 和双分歧目标生成器 (DDTG) 分别恢复未标注已知实例的监督并识别未知候选。在稀疏标注开放世界基准上，DPOD 优于现有开放世界检测方法，尤其在未知目标检测上。
Motivation: 真实世界目标检测面临模糊监督，未标注区域可能对应已知目标缺失标注或真正未知类别；现有 SAOD 和 OWOD 分别解决这两类问题，但两者的共同出现仍是未解决的开放问题。
Method: 提出 DPOD 框架，包含两个互补机制：KTRM 恢复未标注已知实例的监督并显式正则化特征空间以分离已知与未知表示；DDTG 通过跨视图语义不一致性生成可靠的未知候选，从而解决模糊未标注区域引起的矛盾监督信号。
Result: 在稀疏标注开放世界基准上的实验表明，该方法优于现有开放世界检测方法，特别是在检测未知目标方面。
Conclusion: 摘要强调两个模块的整合能够防止已知与未知目标的误分类并稳定决策边界，从而解决 SA-OWOD 任务。

papers.title: Tracing Provenance and Detecting Tampering with Complementary LLM Watermarks
papers.abstract_en: Watermarking LLM-generated text is an important task for tracing its provenance. Existing LLM watermarks preserve provenance under editing, but this same robustness allows an adversary to alter critical content while retaining attribution, a vulnerability known as piggyback spoofing. We introduce an innovative watermark that jointly provides provenance and tamper evidence. It co-embeds a robust signal and a fragile signal into each generated token. The signals share the same mechanism but use independent keys and different seeding windows over normalized text, making one resilient to edits and the other sensitive to reader-visible changes. Multiple rounds of unbiased tournament reweighting preserve the expected generation distribution, while a periodic round-allocation pattern controls the trade-off between the two signals. At detection, their scores form a two-dimensional space supporting three decisions: Intact, Tampered, and No-Watermark. Across two large language models and two prompt datasets, our method demonstrates the highest tamper-detection rate among the evaluated methods while maintaining competitive attribution robustness and perplexity. Ablation studies show that reliable three-state detection requires a well-defined notion of intactness, co-embedding of the two signals, and complementary sensitivity to edits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种同时提供溯源与篡改证据的 LLM 水印方法，在每个生成 token 中联合嵌入鲁棒信号与脆弱信号。两种信号共享同一机制但使用独立密钥和不同播种窗口，使一个对编辑鲁棒、另一个对读者可见改动敏感；多轮无偏 tournament reweighting 保持期望生成分布，周期性轮次分配模式控制两种信号的权衡。检测时二维评分支持 Intact、Tampered、No-Watermark 三种判定。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 水印在编辑下保留溯源，但这种鲁棒性也让攻击者可以在保留归属的同时篡改关键内容，即 piggyback spoofing 漏洞。因此需要一种水印机制同时提供溯源证据与篡改证据。
Method: 提出在每个 token 中联合嵌入鲁棒信号与脆弱信号的水印，两者共享相同机制但使用独立密钥和不同 seeding windows（基于归一化文本），使一个对编辑有弹性、另一个对可见修改敏感。检测时采用多轮无偏 tournament reweighting 保持生成分布，并通过周期性轮次分配模式控制两信号间的权衡。
Result: 在两个大语言模型和两个 prompt 数据集上，该方法在评估方法中取得了最高的篡改检测率，同时保持有竞争力的归属鲁棒性（attribution robustness）和 perplexity。消融研究表明可靠的三态检测需要明确定义的完整度、两种信号的联合嵌入以及互补的编辑敏感性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调可靠的 Intact/Tampered/No-Watermark 三态检测依赖完整度定义、信号联合嵌入与对编辑的互补敏感性。摘要未报告明确的方法局限性。

papers.title: Federated Compositional Muon Optimizer for Matrix-Wise Models
papers.abstract_en: Muon, a more recently developed optimizer, is useful for matrix-wise models in AI areas. Although many works have studied Muon and its variants, these methods are still not particularly well-suited for hierarchical structured problems. To fill this gap, we propose an effective federated compositional Muon (FedCoMuon) optimizer to solve distributed matrix-wise compositional optimization problems. Specifically, our FedCoMuon optimizer builds on compositional gradient tracking and orthogonalized momentum. Moreover, we propose a variance reduced variant of FedCoMuon (FedCoMuon-VR) based on a momentum-based variance reduced technique. In theory, we analyze the convergence properties of our algorithms under the non-i.i.d. and non-convex settings. In particular, we prove that our FedCoMuon-VR obtains a lower sample complexity of $O(ε^{-3})$ for finding an $ε$-stationary solution than the existing FedMuon algorithms. Extensive numerical experiments on robust federated learning and task-distributed risk-sensitive meta learning show that our proposed methods are competitive with existing compositional baselines and achieve the best reported accuracy in several settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向矩阵型模型（matrix-wise models）的联邦复合优化器 FedCoMuon，用于求解分布式矩阵型复合优化问题。方法建立在复合梯度追踪（compositional gradient tracking）与正交化动量（orthogonalized momentum）之上，并进一步给出基于动量方差缩减的变体 FedCoMuon-VR。理论分析表明在非独立同分布（non-i.i.d.）与非凸设定下，FedCoMuon-VR 找到 ε-稳定点的样本复杂度为 O(ε^{-3})，低于现有 FedMuon 算法。实验在鲁棒联邦学习与任务分布式风险敏感元学习上验证了方法的竞争力。
Motivation: 现有 Muon 优化器及其变体对层次化结构问题（hierarchical structured problems）适配不佳，分布式场景下的矩阵型复合优化问题缺乏专门设计的有效优化器。
Method: 提出 FedCoMuon 优化器，结合复合梯度追踪与正交化动量；并基于动量方差缩减技术提出 FedCoMuon-VR 变体。
Result: 在非 i.i.d. 和非凸设定下证明 FedCoMuon-VR 具有 O(ε^{-3}) 的样本复杂度，优于现有 FedMuon 算法；数值实验显示其在鲁棒联邦学习和任务分布式风险敏感元学习上可与现有复合优化基线竞争，并在多个设定下取得最佳报告精度。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法填补了 Muon 类优化器难以处理层次化结构问题的空白，为分布式矩阵型复合优化提供了理论和实证支撑；摘要未提及明显局限。

papers.title: Efficient Hessian-Free Methods for Multi-Objective Bilevel Optimization with Nonconvex Lower Level
papers.abstract_en: Multi-objective bilevel optimization has wide applications in the AI area such as automated learning and multi-task meta-learning. Although recently some works have been begun to study the multi-objective bilevel optimization, the proposed methods rely on the (strongly) convex lower level problems. In fact, these multi-objective bilevel learning problems are generally nonconvex, and particularly their lower level problems are nonconvex. To fill this gap, we propose a class of Multi-Objective Moreau Envelope based Hessian-free Algorithms (MOMEHA) to solve the multi-objective bilevel learning problems with nonconvex lower level. Specifically, our method uses the Moreau envelope to convert the original problem into a multi-objective single-level optimization with an envelope constraint. In particular, our method retains computational advantages of being single-loop and Hessian-free in the multi-objective setting by incorporating a smooth weighted Tchebycheff scalarization. Furthermore, we propose a momentum-based variant of MOMEHA (i.e., MB-MOMEHA) method to solve the stochastic multi-objective bilevel learning problems. In theory, we provide the convergence properties of our algorithms under both deterministic and stochastic setting. Some experiments on few-shot meta-learning and neural architecture search demonstrate that our methods outperform the existing approaches in Pareto front, validating its effectiveness and robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多目标双层优化（multi-objective bilevel optimization）中下层问题非凸这一未被充分处理的场景，提出一类基于 Moreau Envelope 的无 Hessian 算法 MOMEHA。该方法将原问题转化为带 envelope 约束的多目标单层优化问题，并借助平滑加权 Tchebycheff 标量化（smooth weighted Tchebycheff scalarization）保持单循环（single-loop）和无 Hessian 计算优势；随机设定下进一步提出动量变体 MB-MOMEHA。理论部分给出确定性与随机两种设置下的收敛性保证，实验在 few-shot meta-learning 和 neural architecture search 上显示 Pareto front 优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有研究多目标双层优化的方法大多依赖（强）凸下层问题，而实际多目标双层学习问题的下层往往是非凸的，缺乏相应算法。
Method: 使用 Moreau envelope 将原多目标双层问题转化为带 envelope 约束的多目标单层优化，并结合平滑加权 Tchebycheff 标量化进行求解，从而在非凸下层下保留单循环与无 Hessian 计算特点；随机问题中引入基于动量的变体 MB-MOMEHA。
Result: 摘要报告算法在确定性和随机环境下都具有收敛性保证；few-shot meta-learning 与 neural architecture search 实验表明，方法在 Pareto front 上优于现有方法，验证了有效性和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该方法填补了非凸下层多目标双层优化中算法的空白，同时保留了计算上的单循环与无 Hessian 优势，并在实验中验证其表现。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Contract-Grade Verifier for LLM-Generated GPU Kernels, and a Native Blackwell Backward for the Gated-Linear-Recurrence Family
papers.abstract_en: Systems that generate GPU kernels with language models report high correctness rates. Those rates come from a single loose test: run the kernel on a few random inputs at one fixed shape and accept it if the output is close to a reference. A kernel can pass that test and still be silently wrong. It can return an ordinary number where the true answer is a NaN or an infinity, differ from run to run, break when the shape changes, or accumulate in fp16 where the reference keeps an fp32 total. We build the instrument that checks correctness properly: a contract-grade verifier of twelve adversarial gates, each a property a correct kernel must satisfy, several of them tolerance-free, so no choice of threshold can explain a failure away. Aimed outward, the verifier audits 2,638 machine-generated kernels that a public system's own harness had already accepted as correct. It finds 39.5% broken beyond any tolerance argument and 62.1% carrying at least one violation. The field's standard test accepts 1,487 kernels the verifier rejects, against only 14 the other way. We defend the finding four independent ways: a 7/7 positive control, a threshold-calibration sweep, 98.5% agreement with the reference benchmark's own correctness code, and a stratified hand-audit. Aimed inward, the verifier judges a kernel of our own: the first native Blackwell tcgen05 training backward for the gated-linear-recurrence (GDN) family, including the reverse-state stage the field still runs on a fallback. We establish its correctness independently, against a double-precision oracle, and train five family members through it. The correctness signal behind reported progress in kernel generation is far weaker than the numbers suggest, and a set of tolerance-free contracts would close most of the gap.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 3 figures. Also archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.21563213
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个面向大语言模型生成 GPU kernel 的合同级验证器 (contract-grade verifier)，包含 12 个对抗性检查门 (adversarial gates)，其中多条不依赖容差。作者用它审计了某公开系统已判定正确的 2,638 个机器生成 kernel，发现 39.5% 无法用容差解释地损坏、62.1% 至少违反一项性质。验证器还用于验证作者自研的 gated-linear-recurrence (GDN) 家族首个原生 Blackwell tcgen05 训练反向传播。
Motivation: 现有系统报告的高正确率来自单一松散测试：在固定形状的少量随机输入上运行 kernel 并与参考比较。这种测试可能漏掉返回 NaN/无穷、运行间结果不一致、形状变化时出错或 fp16 累积等静默错误，因此正确性信号被严重高估。
Method: 提出由 12 个正确 kernel 必须满足的性质组成的合同级验证器，其中若干性质完全无容差。对外用于审计他人已接受的机器生成 kernel，对内用于验证自研 GDN 家族原生 Blackwell tcgen05 训练反向（含仍依赖回退路径的 reverse-state 阶段），并以双精度 oracle 独立验证正确性。
Result: 审计结果显示 39.5% 的 kernel 无法通过任何容差论证、62.1% 至少有一项违规；标准测试接受 1,487 个被验证器拒绝的 kernel，反向仅 14 个。作者通过 7/7 阳性对照、阈值校准扫描、与参考基准正确性代码 98.5% 一致及分层人工审计四种方式支持该结论。
Conclusion: kernel 生成领域报告中正确性信号远弱于数字所示，一组无容差合同 (tolerance-free contracts) 可弥合大部分差距。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Class Geometry as Supervision for Sample-Efficient Open-World Detection
papers.abstract_en: Open-world object detection requires models to recognize known categories, reject unfamiliar objects, and incorporate new classes over time. This is especially challenging in scarce-data settings such as biomedical and scientific imaging, where rare categories may have only a few annotated examples and fine-grained classes differ by subtle morphology. Prototype-based detectors are natural for this regime, but they typically learn class prototypes as independent anchors, ignoring relational structure among classes. We propose class-geometry supervision (CGS), a general framework that constrains learned prototype or class-representation spaces to preserve visual or semantic class dissimilarities estimated from training data. CGS introduces a dissimilarity-preserving objective that aligns pairwise distances among learned class representations with a target class-geometry matrix while retaining the standard task loss. We instantiate the same objective across prototype recognition, few-shot biomedical object detection, open-set detection, novel-class insertion, and OWOD adaptation on COCO. Experiments show that CGS improves sample efficiency in recognition and ova detection, substantially strengthens novel-class insertion, and improves unknown recall on COCO while retaining much of the known-class detection performance. Ablations show that meaningful visual geometry provides the most reliable gains, while random geometry can help novel separation but is less consistent for few-shot detection. These results suggest that relational class geometry is an effective supervisory signal for building calibrated and extensible open-world detectors under limited supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出类几何监督 (Class-Geometry Supervision, CGS) 框架，通过约束原型或类表示空间，使其保留从训练数据估计出的视觉或语义类别差异，并将同一目标实例化到原型识别、few-shot 生物医学检测、开集检测、新类插入以及 COCO 上的开放世界检测 (OWOD) 适应中。摘要报告 CGS 能提升样本效率、显著增强新类插入能力，并在保持大部分已知类检测性能的同时提高 COCO 上的未知类召回。
Motivation: 开放世界目标检测在标注稀缺场景（如生物医学和科学成像）中困难重重：稀有类别只有少量标注样本，细粒度类间差异微妙。现有基于原型的检测器通常把类原型当作独立锚点学习，忽略类别之间已有的关系结构。
Method: 提出 CGS 通用框架，引入一个保持差异的目标函数，将学习到的类表示之间的成对距离与目标类几何矩阵对齐，同时保留标准任务损失；该目标可跨多种检测任务直接实例化。
Result: 实验表明 CGS 在识别和卵检测 (ova detection) 中提高样本效率，显著增强新类插入，在 COCO 上提升未知类召回并保留大部分已知类检测性能；消融显示有意义的视觉几何带来的增益最可靠，而随机几何虽有助于新类分离，但在 few-shot 检测上一致性较差。
Conclusion: 摘要认为关系类几何是构建校准且可扩展的开放世界检测器的有效监督信号，能够在有限监督下工作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Impact of Temporal Context Length and Encoding Strategies on Self-Supervised ECG Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised electrocardiogram (ECG) models are often trained on a few seconds of ECG signal and, increasingly, on discretized token sequences. It remains unclear whether these choices sacrifice information needed for rhythm inference and longitudinal consistency in real-world ambulatory recordings. We present a controlled study on the Icentia11k single-lead dataset that varies (i) the input horizon (16 seconds, 1 minute, 5 minutes, and 10 minutes) and (ii) the front-end representation (continuous convolutional patch embeddings vs. fixed vector-quantized tokens), while holding the Transformer backbone and training protocol constant. Representations are assessed by downstream abnormal rhythm detection and by patient-level retrieval that probes cross-session stability. Our results show that increasing temporal context beyond 16-second snapshots yields stronger transfer and higher retrieval accuracy, with the strongest performance achieved by the 5- and 10-minute models, indicating improved capture of slow-varying rhythm dynamics and individual-specific structure. Across all evaluated horizons, continuous patch embeddings outperform discretized tokens, suggesting that quantization can discard clinically relevant waveform detail. These findings motivate ECG foundation models that emphasize extended context and continuous encoders for clinical prediction and similarity-based applications. Our code and pretrained models are publicly available at https://github.com/muha-0/ecg-ssl-representation-learning.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 48th Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBC 2026). 6 pages, 2 figures, 1 table
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 Icentia11k 单导联 ECG 数据集上开展受控研究，考察输入时间范围（16 秒、1 分钟、5 分钟、10 分钟）和前端表示（连续卷积 patch 嵌入 vs 固定向量量化 token）对自监督 ECG 表示学习的影响，同时保持 Transformer backbone 与训练协议不变。结果显示超过 16 秒的更长上下文带来更强的迁移表现和更高的患者级检索准确率，其中 5 分钟与 10 分钟模型最优；在所有时间范围下，连续 patch 嵌入均优于离散化 token。作者据此建议 ECG 基础模型应强调扩展上下文和连续编码器。
Motivation: 自监督 ECG 模型通常只使用几秒信号，且越来越多地采用离散化 token 序列；尚不清楚这些选择是否牺牲了真实动态记录中心律推断与纵向一致性所需的信息。
Method: 在 Icentia11k 单导联数据集上设计受控实验，分别改变输入时间范围（16 秒、1 分钟、5 分钟、10 分钟）和前端表示（连续卷积 patch 嵌入 vs 固定向量量化 token），保持 Transformer backbone 与训练协议不变，并用下游异常心律检测和患者级检索（跨会话稳定性）评估表示质量。
Result: 增加时间上下文可提升迁移表现与检索准确率，5 分钟和 10 分钟模型表现最强，说明其更好地捕捉了慢变化心律动态和个体特定结构；在所有评估时间范围下，连续 patch 嵌入均优于离散化 token，提示量化可能丢弃临床相关的波形细节。
Conclusion: 该研究为 ECG foundation models 的设计提供证据，主张采用扩展上下文与连续编码器以支持临床预测和相似性应用；代码与预训练模型已公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Mr3D-VL: A generalist vision language foundation model for Multiparametric 3D Magnetic Resonance Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Multi-parametric magnetic resonance imaging (mpMRI) is a cornerstone for brain tumor diagnosis and treatment, yet current AI models face critical limitations: their lack of natural language interaction and interpretability impedes spatial information integration and cross-modal reasoning required clinically. Key challenges arise from significant physical meaning differences across modalities, spatial misalignment due to scan intervals, and the need for complex multi-feature interpretation in tasks like glioma grading. While visual-language models (VLMs) show promise in cross-modal understanding, existing methods focus mainly on 2D image modeling, neglecting direct perception of 3D volumetric space. Although 3D VLMs have been proposed for report generation and feature alignment in 3D CT imaging, mpMRI applications demand collaborative inference across multiple imaging modalities-a requirement unmet by current solutions. To address this, we introduce Mr3D-VL, a dedicated visual-language foundation model for multi-parametric 3D MRI. With 4 billion parameters, it employs an unsupervised pre-trained shared 3D encoder and 4D rotational positional embedding for dual modality-spatial integration. Its cross-modal projection layer uses a multi-resolution feature implantation strategy to enhance feature perception across resolutions. Experimental results show significant improvements over existing 4B/7B/30B domain-specific and general-purpose models in text generation tasks, achieving a BERTScore of 0.856 for report generation, with question-answering accuracy at 0.713 and multiple-choice accuracy at 0.912.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mr3D-VL，一个面向多参数三维 MRI（mpMRI）的视觉-语言基础模型，参数量为 40 亿。它采用无监督预训练的共享 3D 编码器和 4D 旋转位置嵌入（4D rotational positional embedding）来实现模态与空间的双重整合，并通过多分辨率特征植入（multi-resolution feature implantation）的跨模态投影层增强多尺度特征感知。摘要报告其在文本生成任务上优于现有 4B/7B/30B 领域专用与通用模型，报告生成的 BERTScore 达 0.856，问答准确率 0.713，多项选择准确率 0.912。
Motivation: 现有 AI 模型在脑肿瘤 mpMRI 分析中缺乏自然语言交互与可解释性，难以整合空间信息和进行跨模态推理；已有 VLM 主要停留在 2D 图像建模，而 3D 医学影像应用需要多模态协作推断，现有方案无法满足这一需求。
Method: 提出 Mr3D-VL 架构，包含无监督预训练的共享 3D 编码器、用于双模态-空间整合的 4D 旋转位置嵌入，以及采用多分辨率特征植入策略的跨模态投影层。
Result: 摘要报告该模型在文本生成任务上显著优于现有 4B/7B/30B 的领域专用模型和通用模型，报告生成 BERTScore 为 0.856，问答准确率为 0.713，多项选择准确率为 0.912。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Mr3D-VL 为多参数三维 MRI 的跨模态理解与自然语言交互提供了可行的视觉-语言基础模型方案；摘要未明确指出该方法的局限性或适用范围限制。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Finding the Needle in a Haystack: Test-Time Analog Circuit Representation Adaptation for Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimization (BO) is a sample-efficient framework for analog circuit topology search, where evaluating each candidate topology can require costly simulation. However, representation-based BO methods typically treat circuit embeddings as fixed after encoder training. This creates a mismatch between representation learning and optimization: embeddings learned to encode or reconstruct circuit structure are not necessarily organized according to the figure of merit (FoM) being optimized. This paper introduces Test-Time Analog Representation Adaptation for Bayesian Optimization (TTARO), an online deep-kernel BO framework that adapts circuit representations throughout the search process. Starting from pretrained circuit embeddings, TTARO jointly learns a nonlinear feature transformation and a Gaussian-process surrogate using the FoM labels of the circuits evaluated so far. Following each new evaluation, TTARO updates the representation and surrogate before selecting the next candidate. We compare TTARO with conventional Gaussian Process-based BO over fixed embeddings and with Deep Kernel Learning (DKL), which learns the representation only from the initial evaluated designs and keeps it fixed throughout the remainder of the search. By continually incorporating newly observed FoM labels into representation learning, TTARO aligns the search space with the optimization objective as BO progresses. In our experiments, TTARO reduces regret AUC by 15.2% on average relative to BO and by 20.7% relative to DKL across 40 encoder/kernel/acquisition settings, outperforming prior art in most settings with reductions as large as 46.7%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TTARO（Test-Time Analog Representation Adaptation for Bayesian Optimization），一种用于模拟电路拓扑搜索的在线深度核贝叶斯优化框架。与固定嵌入的 BO 方法不同，TTARO 在搜索过程中不断利用已评估电路的 FoM 标签更新表示和高斯过程代理。实验显示，在 40 种编码器/核/采集设置下，其平均 regret AUC 相比固定嵌入 BO 降低 15.2%，相比 DKL 降低 20.7%，多数设置下优于先前方法。
Motivation: 基于表示的 BO 方法通常在编码器训练后就将电路嵌入固定，导致嵌入空间并非按照被优化的品质因数（FoM）组织，表示学习与优化目标之间出现失配。
Method: TTARO 从预训练电路嵌入出发，联合学习非线性特征变换和高斯过程代理；每完成一次新评估，就用新观测到的 FoM 标签更新表示与代理，然后再选择下一个候选点，从而在搜索进程中持续对齐表示与优化目标。
Result: 在 40 种 encoder/kernel/acquisition 设置下，TTARO 相比常规固定嵌入 BO 平均降低 regret AUC 15.2%，相比只在初始设计上学习表示的 DKL 平均降低 20.7%，多数设置下优于先前方法，最大降幅达 46.7%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调持续将新观测的 FoM 标签纳入表示学习，可使搜索空间随 BO 进程与优化目标对齐。该工作面向模拟电路拓扑搜索，属于电路自动设计领域。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: High-resolution Calibrated Probabilistic Hourly Precipitation from a Deterministic Forecast
papers.abstract_en: An ``Attention Residual U-Net'' method is described for probabilistic quantitative precipitation forecasting (PQPF) that predicts the hourly probability of no precipitation plus the distribution of positive precipitation from a weighted mixture of two Gamma distributions. The neural network is trained on patches of numerical weather prediction (NWP) hourly precipitation from The Weather Company's convection-permitting GRAF (Global high-Resolution Atmospheric Forecasting) model along with terrain information and column-average relative humidity from the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration's (NOAA's) Global Forecast System (GFS). The target data are NOAA's Multi-Radar, Multi-Sensor (MRMS) gauge-corrected, quality controlled radar data sampled to the same grid as the GRAF data. The network outputs distributional parameters for each model grid point. Training uses negative log-likelihood as a proper scoring rule, with climatological initialization for stable convergence. Inference is performed as a single forward pass over the contiguous United States (CONUS) domain, with edge-replication padding to satisfy the network's spatial-divisibility requirement. The subsequent forecasts are spatially detailed, highly reliable, and skillful with respect to climatology and a simpler reference forecast method. The method is particularly useful for estimating probabilities in regions with large terrain variation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 Attention Residual U-Net 的概率定量降水预报 (PQPF) 方法，将确定性数值预报转换为逐小时的无降水概率与正降水量分布。模型以 The Weather Company 的 GRAF 模式逐小时降水为输入，结合地形与 GFS 的柱平均相对湿度，以 NOAA MRMS 雷达数据为训练目标，输出每个格点的分布参数。摘要报告该方法在 CONUS 域上得到空间细节丰富、可靠性高且优于气候态和简单参考方法的降水概率预报。
Motivation: 确定性降水预报无法直接给出概率信息，而在实际业务中用户需要校准过的逐小时降水概率，尤其是地形复杂区域。
Method: 采用 Attention Residual U-Net 网络，将正降水量建模为两个 Gamma 分布的加权混合，并额外输出无降水概率；训练使用负对数似然作为严格评分规则 (proper scoring rule)，并用气候态初始化保证稳定收敛；推理时对 CONUS 域做单次前向传播，通过边缘复制填充满足网络的空间可除性要求。
Result: 预报在空间上具有高分辨率细节，可靠性 (reliability) 高，且相对气候态和更简单的参考预报方法具有技巧；特别适用于地形起伏大的区域。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该方法是生成空间精细且可靠逐小时降水概率的有效途径，并强调其在地形变化较大地区的实用价值。
Relevance: 96

papers.title: FUSE: Active Functional Affordance Grounding through Adaptive Semantic-Geometric Evidence Acquisition
papers.abstract_en: Embodied agents must often identify and interact with objects based on their function rather than their identity, requiring them to actively acquire observations that reveal discriminative functional evidence. Existing affordance grounding methods operate from fixed viewpoints and lack mechanisms for deciding where to look when functional cues are occluded or incomplete. We introduce Active Functional Affordance Grounding, a new task in which an agent sequentially explores a scene to identify and spatially ground an object satisfying a functional query. To address this problem, we propose FUSE, an adaptive semantic-geometric evidence acquisition framework that combines explicit uncertainty-driven exploration with a learned amortized planner to efficiently select informative viewpoints. We further introduce a Habitat-based benchmark for evaluating active functional grounding. Experiments show that FUSE achieves the highest observed non-oracle grounding performance while reducing computation by 1.33x relative to fully explicit exploration, and remains effective across multiple affordance knowledge sources.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出主动功能可供性接地（Active Functional Affordance Grounding）任务，即智能体通过顺序探索场景来定位满足功能查询的对象。作者提出 FUSE 框架，结合显式不确定性驱动的探索与学习到的摊销规划器（amortized planner）以高效选择信息量大的视点，并引入基于 Habitat 的基准。实验表明 FUSE 取得最高的非 oracle 接地性能，同时相比完全显式探索将计算量降低 1.33 倍。
Motivation: 现有可供性接地方法通常从固定视点处理场景，缺少在功能线索被遮挡或不完整时决定下一步看哪里的机制，制约了具身智能体基于功能的物体识别与交互。
Method: 提出 FUSE，一个自适应语义-几何证据获取框架，将显式不确定性驱动的探索与学习到的摊销规划器相结合，用于顺序选择信息量最大的视点；同时构建了基于 Habitat 的基准来评估主动功能接地。
Result: 摘要报告 FUSE 在非 oracle 接地性能上达到最高观测值，相对完全显式探索减少 1.33 倍计算量，并在多个可供性知识源上保持有效性。
Conclusion: 作者将主动功能可供性接地视为新任务，并指出融合不确定性探索与学习式规划的 FUSE 能高效完成该任务；摘要未涉及方法在真实机器人上的泛化或失败案例等限制。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者将主动功能可供性接地视为新任务，并指出融合不确定性探索与学习式规划的 FUSE 能高效完成该任务；摘要未涉及方法在真实机器人上的泛化或失败案例等限制。

papers.title: Demand Transfer Estimation at Scale via Restricted Logit Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Item demand forecasting is an integral component of store assortment optimization. Existing literature focuses on learning a suitable customer choice model and using this model to determine the value of an objective function (i.e. expected demand) with respect to an assortment proposal. However, for large item universe with many categories, this approach can prove inefficient, needing a separate demand forecast for every possible item assortment. An alternate approach exists whereby we combine the efficiency of forecasting item demand independently, while at the same time applying adjustments to the independent forecasts that account for the relations between item demand and the availability of other similar items on the shelf. Central to this approach is the estimation of Demand Transfer (DT) coefficients. These DT coefficients represent the percent of a particular target item's (item that the customer walked in the store to buy) demand that is redirected to each other item in the universe should the target item be removed from the shelf. We introduce an approach that allows us to compute these DT coefficients on large item universes (assortments having 1 million+ items). Experiments on data as well as historical transaction data for multiple locations within categories demonstrate that when certain reasonable assumptions about substitution behavior are satisfied, our procedure is able to accurately estimate underlying DT coefficients and lead to improvements in demand forecasting.
papers.comment: 8 pages. Accepted in the Main Conference of IEEE ICMLA 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型商品宇宙（100 万件以上商品）中商品需求预测的低效问题，提出基于受限 Logit 建模（Restricted Logit Modeling）的需求转移（Demand Transfer, DT）系数估计方法。DT 系数刻画目标商品下架后需求重定向到其他商品的百分比。摘要称实验表明在合理的替代行为假设下，该方法能准确估计 DT 系数并改进需求预测。
Motivation: 现有顾客选择模型需要对每个可能的商品组合分别进行需求预测，在商品数量庞大且类别众多时效率低下。本文希望结合独立需求预测的效率与商品间替代关系的调整，而核心在于大规模估计需求转移系数。
Method: 提出一种受限 Logit 建模流程，在大型商品集合上计算 DT 系数，通过将独立商品需求预测与基于货架上其他相似商品可用性的调整相结合。
Result: 在历史交易数据以及多个地点的多品类数据上的实验表明，当关于替代行为的合理假设得到满足时，该流程能准确估计潜在 DT 系数，并带来需求预测的改进。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提方法可扩展到超过 100 万件商品的大型商品集合，并指出其有效性依赖于关于顾客替代行为的特定假设条件。

papers.title: Beyond the Best Guess: Improving LLM Solution Coverage with Evolution Strategies
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in discovery domains such as math and science. The usual approach is to present the problem to the model and use its answer as the proposed solution. However, beyond this best guess, discovery can be enhanced by increasing test-time compute. In a process called pass@k, the model is allowed to explore the solution space and generate diverse candidate solutions. Unfortunately, the standard approach to post-training LLMs through Reinforcement Learning (RL) may limit pass@k: the model's output distribution narrows around high-reward outputs, causing the solution coverage to collapse. The alternative is to use Evolution Strategies (ES), a population-based, gradient-free post-training method that optimizes directly in weight space through random perturbations. As this paper shows, ES achieves consistently higher pass@k than RL and produces a broader output distribution with greater solution coverage. This coverage in turn makes it possible to achieve better results in e.g. standard math benchmarks. Thus, ES provides a better foundation for post-training in discovery problems and other domains where diverse solution coverage is critical.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 在发现型任务（数学、科学等）中的后训练方式，指出标准强化学习（RL）后训练会使输出分布收窄、导致 pass@k 解覆盖度崩塌；相比之下，基于种群的免梯度进化策略（Evolution Strategies, ES）直接在权重空间通过随机扰动优化，能获得更高的 pass@k 和更广的解覆盖度，进而在标准数学基准上取得更好结果。
Motivation: 发现型任务中通常只取模型的最佳猜测，但通过增加测试时计算（test-time compute）可以提升解覆盖度；然而标准 RL 后训练会围绕高奖励输出收窄分布，限制了 pass@k 的多样性。
Method: 提出使用进化策略（ES）替代 RL 进行后训练：ES 是一种基于种群、免梯度的优化方法，通过在权重空间施加随机扰动直接优化目标，从而避免输出分布坍缩。
Result: 摘要报告 ES 相比 RL 在多个任务上一致取得更高的 pass@k，产生更宽的输出分布与更大的解覆盖度，并因此在标准数学基准上取得更优结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为在发现型问题以及解覆盖度至关重要的其他领域中，ES 提供了比 RL 更好的后训练基础。

papers.title: The Role of Natural Language Understanding in Multimodal Video-Based Dengue Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Detecting infection-related behavioral changes in mosquitoes from video data is challenging because mosquitoes are small, move rapidly and irregularly, and are affected by environmental factors such as background, lighting, and shadows, which can make reliable feature extraction difficult. In this study, a YOLO- and Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP)-based vision-language framework is proposed to classify mosquito flight frames of uninfected and Dengue virus serotype 2 (DENV2)-infected mosquitoes. First, YOLO is used to isolate mosquito regions from the background. Then, visual features extracted from video frames are aligned with biologically meaningful textual prompts in a shared embedding space. The multimodal model was fine-tuned using supervised bidirectional contrastive learning and evaluated through frame-level image-text similarity-based classification. The results show that the proposed method achieved 98.54% accuracy and 99.91% sensitivity at the frame level. After temporal aggregation of frame-level information, the model achieved complete video-level performance. The ablation results showed that fine-tuning and CLIP-based representations were essential for this domain, while the textual branch provided semantic image-text alignment rather than an accuracy advantage over the vision-only model. These findings suggest that vision-language models can provide a useful framework for analyzing infection-related biological behaviors from video data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于 YOLO 和 CLIP 的视觉-语言框架，用于从未感染与感染登革病毒 2 型（DENV2）的蚊子视频帧中分类飞行行为。YOLO 先将蚊子区域与背景分离，随后将帧级视觉特征与生物语义文本提示在共享嵌入空间中对齐；模型经有监督双向对比学习微调，并按帧级图像-文本相似度分类。结果显示帧级准确率 98.54%、灵敏度 99.91%，时间聚合后达到完整视频级性能；消融表明微调与 CLIP 表征对该领域至关重要，而文本分支只提供语义对齐，未比纯视觉模型带来准确率优势。
Motivation: 从视频数据检测蚊子感染相关行为变化具有挑战性：蚊子体型小、运动快速且不规则，并受背景、光照和阴影等环境因素干扰，导致可靠特征提取困难。
Method: 提出 YOLO-与 CLIP-based 的视觉-语言框架：先用 YOLO 从背景中分离蚊子区域，再将视频帧视觉特征与生物学上有意义的文本提示在共享嵌入空间中对齐；使用有监督双向对比学习对多模态模型进行微调，并基于帧级图像-文本相似度进行分类，随后对帧级信息做时间聚合。
Result: 帧级分类达到 98.54% 准确率和 99.91% 灵敏度；帧级信息时间聚合后模型获得完整视频级性能。消融结果显示微调和 CLIP 表征是关键，文本分支主要提供语义图像-文本对齐，而没有在准确率上超过纯视觉模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为视觉-语言模型可为从视频数据中分析感染相关生物行为提供有效框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving RAG by Concealing Sensitive Information from External LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is widely used to improve the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) in answering user queries. Existing privacy research on RAG has focused on preventing unauthorized users from accessing sensitive data. However, another important problem that is often overlooked in RAG privacy research is that external generators have access to the query and the retrieved documents, which may contain confidential information that could potentially be misused or accessed for unintended purposes. In this paper, we introduce the Sensitive Entity Alias Generator (SEAG), a privacy-preserving framework that empowers users to utilize powerful third-party generators without disclosing sensitive information. SEAG introduces a lightweight model that locates sensitive entities, generates corresponding aliases, and constructs an entity replacement table. The table is used to replace sensitive words in the user's query and in the retrieved documents before they are forwarded to an external generator. For this purpose, two datasets were constructed: one for fine-tuning SEAG models to generate entity replacement tables, and another for evaluating the entire SEAG framework. The experimental results demonstrate the success of the SEAG framework. As for the User metric, which measures the ability of the model to provide a correct response to the user while hiding sensitive information from the external generator, all SEAG models achieved over 80% accuracy. Additional analysis further evaluated the ability of SEAG models Qwen-3, LLaMA-3.2, and Phi-4 to hide all sensitive entities within given documents. The results show good performance with total accuracies of 77.83%, 76.73%, and 74.91%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Sensitive Entity Alias Generator (SEAG)，一个面向检索增强生成（RAG）的隐私保护框架，使外部第三方生成器无法看到查询和检索文档中的敏感信息。SEAG 用一个轻量模型定位敏感实体、生成别名并构造实体替换表，在把查询和文档转发给外部生成器前替换敏感词。作者构建了两个数据集分别用于微调和评估，实验表明所有 SEAG 模型在 User 指标上超过 80% 准确率，且 Qwen-3、LLaMA-3.2、Phi-4 隐藏文档中所有敏感实体的总准确率分别为 77.83%、76.73%、74.91%。
Motivation: 现有 RAG 隐私研究主要关注阻止未授权用户访问敏感数据，却忽略了外部生成器能访问查询和检索文档，其中可能包含会被误用或用于非预期目的的机密信息。
Method: 提出 SEAG 框架，包含一个轻量模型，负责定位敏感实体、生成对应别名并构造实体替换表；该表用于在将用户查询和检索文档转发给外部生成器之前替换其中的敏感词。作者还构建了两个数据集，一个用于微调 SEAG 模型以生成替换表，另一个用于评估整个框架。
Result: 摘要报告 SEAG 框架在 User 指标（衡量模型既能向用户提供正确回答又能对外部生成器隐藏敏感信息的能力）上所有模型均超过 80% 准确率。额外分析中，SEAG 模型 Qwen-3、LLaMA-3.2、Phi-4 隐藏给定文档内所有敏感实体的总准确率分别为 77.83%、76.73%、74.91%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 SEAG 能够在不向外部 LLM 泄露敏感信息的前提下利用强大的第三方生成器，实验验证了其在多种基础模型上的有效性。

papers.title: Lines and Ladders: A Context-Aware Multi-Agent Framework for Large-Scale Retail Price Taxonomy
papers.abstract_en: Maintaining price consistency and executing an Every Day Low Price strategy is critical for global retailers. However, with catalogs spanning millions of active items, manual governance of price relationships is infeasible. Inconsistent pricing across item variants distorts customer value perception and cannibalizes sales. To address this, we present a scalable, context-aware Multi-Agent Framework designed to automate the construction of "Lines and Ladders" pricing taxonomies. Our framework employs specialized LLM agents to construct these coherent pricing structures by identifying key attributes, extracting multi-modal values, and applying hierarchical grouping logic. Evaluated on real-world enterprise data and deployed in production, our 3-Agent system achieves an F1-score of 0.83 for Lines, outperforming single-agent baselines by mitigating cognitive overload. The system achieves >90% precision and >75% recall in Food & Consumables, and 80.2% assignment accuracy in the unstructured General Merchandise catalog.
papers.comment: 8 pages. Accepted in the Main Conference of IEEE ICMLA 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个上下文感知的多智能体框架，用于自动化构建大规模零售商品的 "Lines and Ladders" 定价分类体系。框架使用专门的 LLM 智能体识别关键属性、提取多模态值并应用分层分组逻辑。在真实企业数据上评估并部署到生产环境，3-Agent 系统在 Lines 任务上取得 F1 0.83，优于单智能体基线。
Motivation: 全球零售商目录包含数百万活跃商品，人工治理价格关系不可行；跨商品变体的定价不一致会扭曲客户价值感知并蚕食销售额，因此需要自动化的定价分类构建方法。
Method: 提出可扩展的多智能体框架，采用专门化的 LLM 智能体，通过识别关键属性、提取多模态值以及应用层级分组逻辑来自动构建定价分类体系；3-Agent 设计旨在缓解单智能体的认知过载 (cognitive overload)。
Result: 在真实企业数据上，3-Agent 系统在 Lines 上实现 F1 0.83，优于单智能体基线；在 Food & Consumables 上达到精度超过 90%、召回超过 75%；在非结构化的 General Merchandise 目录上达到 80.2% 的分配准确率。
Conclusion: 该系统已在实际生产环境中部署，表明上下文感知的多智能体框架能够在零售价格分类场景中替代人工治理；摘要未说明局限性。

summary_sections.motivation: 全球零售商目录包含数百万活跃商品，人工治理价格关系不可行；跨商品变体的定价不一致会扭曲客户价值感知并蚕食销售额，因此需要自动化的定价分类构建方法。
summary_sections.method: 提出可扩展的多智能体框架，采用专门化的 LLM 智能体，通过识别关键属性、提取多模态值以及应用层级分组逻辑来自动构建定价分类体系；3-Agent 设计旨在缓解单智能体的认知过载 (cognitive overload)。
summary_sections.result: 在真实企业数据上，3-Agent 系统在 Lines 上实现 F1 0.83，优于单智能体基线；在 Food & Consumables 上达到精度超过 90%、召回超过 75%；在非结构化的 General Merchandise 目录上达到 80.2% 的分配准确率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该系统已在实际生产环境中部署，表明上下文感知的多智能体框架能够在零售价格分类场景中替代人工治理；摘要未说明局限性。

papers.title: On the Expressive Power of Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Multi-layer transformers form the critical component of essentially all large language models (LLMs) in use today. Because of their ubiquity and computational capability, there is a rapidly growing body of work that aims to precisely calibrate the expressive power of transformers as language recognizers by comparing them against standard models of computation studied for decades by the theoretical computer science community. In this endeavor, circuit complexity has by and large emerged as the "correct" branch of computational complexity to analyze the expressive power of transformers; the reason is that parameterizing transformers by the various resources they use, such as attention and precision, leads to direct comparisons with different classes of circuits parameterized by resources such as type of gates, size, and depth. Here, we present an overview of selected results that delineate the expressive power of transformers using concepts and methods from circuit complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于用电路复杂性（circuit complexity）刻画 Transformer 表达能力的综述。作者将 Transformer 使用的资源（如注意力与精度）参数化，并与以门类型、规模、深度等参数化的电路类进行直接比较，概述了这一方向上的代表性结果。
Motivation: 多层 Transformer 是当今几乎所有大语言模型（LLM）的关键组件，因此需要精确校准其作为语言识别器的表达能力；作者认为电路复杂性是与标准计算模型比较时的合适分支。
Method: 以资源参数化视角组织综述：将 Transformer 所消耗的注意力和精度等资源，与不同种类电路所消耗的门类型、规模、深度等资源建立对应关系，并据此梳理刻画表达能力的若干结果。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值实验或定理结果，仅说明呈现了使用电路复杂性概念与方法界定 Transformer 表达能力的选择性结果概览。
Conclusion: 作者强调电路复杂性已成为分析 Transformer 表达能力的主流理论框架，本文旨在为这一路线提供概述性梳理。

papers.title: Designing AI Pipelines for Decision-Ready ITSM Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: IT service management (ITSM) systems accumulate large volumes of heterogeneous ticket data that are difficult for sales and executive stakeholders to convert into actionable intelligence. This paper presents a sociotechnical AI pipeline, designed and evaluated following design science research principles, that transforms raw ITSM exports into a multilevel decision-support artifact. The pipeline combines LLM-based schema normalization, HDBSCAN sub-topic clustering, and hierarchical agglomerative clustering to generate executive-facing Main-topics and granular Sub-topics. A stakeholder evaluation across six artifacts and five raters from Sales Engineering and customer success roles shows that all four decision-support metrics, interpretability, actionability, trust, and likelihood of use, on average exceed 4.0 out of 5.0, with trust as the most consistent signal. The findings position ITSM analytics as an Information Systems (IS) problem of transformation, abstraction, and human-centered design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向 IT 服务管理（ITSM）系统，提出一个社会技术性 AI 流水线，将异构的工单数据转换为面向销售与高管的决策支持工件。流水线结合 LLM 驱动的模式归一化、HDBSCAN 子主题聚类和层次凝聚聚类，生成执行层 Main-topics 与细粒度 Sub-topics。基于五名评分者对六个工件的评估，可解释性、可行动性、信任和使用可能性四项决策支持指标的平均分均超过 4.0/5.0，其中信任信号最为一致。
Motivation: ITSM 系统积累了大量异构工单数据，销售和行政等利益相关者难以将其转化为可执行的 actionable intelligence，这是本工作要填补的缺口。
Method: 遵循设计科学研究（design science research）原则，设计并评估一条社会技术性 AI 流水线：用 LLM 做模式归一化，用 HDBSCAN 做子主题聚类，再用层次凝聚聚类生成多层级主题结构。
Result: 在六个工件和来自 Sales Engineering 与客户成功角色的五名评分者评估中，可解释性、可行动性、信任和使用可能性四项指标的平均分均超过 4.0/5.0，其中信任是最一致的信号。
Conclusion: 作者将 ITSM 分析定位为信息系统的转型、抽象和以人为本设计问题，强调其价值在于把原始导出数据变成高管可用的决策支持工件。

papers.title: Long-Horizon AI Research for Grothendieck Constant: A Case Study in Human-AI Mathematical Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are increasingly used in mathematics research, but it is often unclear how to use them effectively. Towards this, we present an extensive case study of how AI was used to improve bounds on the Grothendieck constant $K_G$, which captures the hardness between combinatorial problems and their continuous relaxations. Specifically, while the precise value of $K_G$ is not known, we recently tightened the best known bounds to \[ \frac{6π}{11} \;\le\; K_G \;\le\; \fracπ{2\log(1+\sqrt2)} - 10^{-4}. \] Crucially, these improvements were achieved using an AI research system that could arrive at insights deemed novel by domain experts. We give a detailed discussion of our experience using AI for mathematics research, particularly touching upon its strengths and weaknesses, as well as our experience with creating ideal conditions for AI to arrive at breakthrough insights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一份关于利用 AI 研究系统改进 Grothendieck 常数 $K_G$ 上下界的人机数学协作案例研究。摘要报告将已知最佳界收紧为 $6\pi/11 \le K_G \le \pi/(2\log(1+\sqrt{2})) - 10^{-4}$，并称这些改进由能产生领域专家认为新颖洞见的 AI 研究系统实现。作者详细讨论了 AI 用于数学研究的经验、优缺点，以及为 AI 产生突破性洞见创造条件的心得。
Motivation: AI agent 越来越多地被用于数学研究，但如何有效使用它们尚不明确。本文以 Grothendieck 常数 $K_G$——刻画组合问题与其连续松弛之间难度差距的量——为对象，提供详细案例来说明 AI 如何帮助改进其已知界。
Method: 作者使用一个 AI 研究系统来探索 Grothendieck 常数的边界，该系统能够产生被领域专家判定为新颖的数学洞见。论文给出了使用 AI 进行数学研究的详细经验讨论，包括如何创建有利于 AI 产生突破性洞见的条件。
Result: 摘要报告将 $K_G$ 的最佳已知界收紧为 $6\pi/11 \le K_G \le \pi/(2\log(1+\sqrt{2})) - 10^{-4}$，并强调这些改进归功于 AI 系统产生的新颖洞见。
Conclusion: 作者总结 AI 在数学研究中既有优势也有局限，并强调为 AI 设置合适条件以促成突破性发现的重要性。该案例表明 AI 可以辅助推进纯数学中的开放问题，但论文本身是经验性案例研究，未给出通用方法的保证。

papers.title: Flex-$π$: A Multi-Stream World-Action Model with Compute Flexibility
papers.abstract_en: World-action models (WAMs) predict the future to act better, but nearly all of them predict only RGB latents, trained purely for pixel reconstruction, with no explicit signal for the 3D geometry or object semantics manipulation needs. We find a surprising free lunch: the same frozen video-generation VAE that encodes RGB also encodes 3D pointmaps almost losslessly, with no pointmap-specific training at all. This lets us supervise Flex-$π$, a 6B-parameter WAM, on 3D geometry and object-centric DINO semantics alongside RGB, at no cost in new sensors, new pre-training, or inference latency. Every visual signal is projected into this shared latent space and denoised jointly with actions inside a Mixture-of-Transformers backbone; per-stream dropout with cross-modality forcing then lets a single trained checkpoint run on any subset of these streams, from a fast action-only mode to full joint generation. The result is a policy that is exceptionally demonstration-efficient and generalizes well, beating the strongest baselines by up to 2-7$\times$ on dexterous, precise, real-world bimanual manipulation tasks both in and out of distribution, all while running faster than $π_{0.5}$. Our project website: https://flex-pi.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Flex-π，一个 6B 参数的 world-action model (WAM)，利用冻结的视频生成 VAE 在共享潜空间中同时编码 RGB、3D pointmaps 和 DINO 语义，并在 Mixture-of-Transformers 骨干中与动作联合去噪。通过逐流 dropout 与跨模态强制，单个检查点可在从仅动作模式到完整联合生成的任意流子集上运行。摘要报告该方法在灵巧、精确的真实世界双臂操作任务（分布内与分布外）上以最高 2-7 倍的优势超过最强基线，且运行速度快于 π0.5。
Motivation: 现有 WAM 几乎只预测 RGB 潜变量，仅以像素重建为目标训练，缺乏对操作任务所需的 3D 几何或物体语义的显式监督信号。
Method: 利用同一冻结视频生成 VAE 对 RGB 和 3D pointmaps 几乎无损编码的特性，引入 3D 几何与 object-centric DINO 语义监督；所有视觉信号被投影到共享潜空间，并在 Mixture-of-Transformers 骨干中与动作联合去噪，配合逐流 dropout 与跨模态强制实现任意流子集推理。
Result: 摘要报告 Flex-π 在真实世界双臂操作任务上以最高 2-7 倍性能优势击败最强基线，分布内与分布外均有效，且推理速度快于 π0.5，同时无需新增传感器、预训练或推理延迟代价。
Conclusion: 作者强调在共享潜空间中对 3D 几何和语义进行联合监督能带来训练效率与泛化收益，且单一检查点即可灵活切换不同计算模式。

papers.title: Fast and Memory-Efficient Wavelet Convolutions via I/O-Aware Reformulation
papers.abstract_en: Wavelet convolution (WTConv) has emerged as an increasingly popular drop-in replacement for standard convolutions, expanding a network's receptive field exponentially with the number of decomposition levels while keeping the parameter count linear. However, its reference implementation is severely memory-bound due to excessive data movement through high-bandwidth memory (HBM). We develop an I/O model of WTConv to characterize this bottleneck and use it to guide three algebraic reformulations: (1) recomputing the inexpensive Haar analysis butterfly on chip, (2) collapsing the multi-level synthesis cascade into a single closed-form pass indexed by output-coordinate bits, and (3) folding learned per-channel scales into the convolution weights. Together, these reformulations enable an I/O-aware fused implementation that substantially reduces HBM traffic. We evaluate the WTConvNeXt configuration across decomposition levels and a broad range of tensor shapes. Despite performing comparable arithmetic, the reference WTConv is substantially slower than the depthwise convolution it replaces. Our reformulation reduces modeled HBM traffic by approximately $2.55\times$, yielding up to a $4.35\times$ training speedup over the reference while roughly halving peak memory usage. Thus, our reformulation preserves the benefits of WTConv while substantially reducing its execution time and memory footprint, removing the systems overhead that previously limited its practical efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对小波卷积 (WTConv) 参考实现受高带宽内存 (HBM) 带宽限制的问题，建立 WTConv 的 I/O 模型并用其指导三种代数重构：在芯片上重算廉价的 Haar 分析蝴蝶变换、将多级合成级联折叠为按输出坐标位索引的单次闭式传递、将逐通道学习尺度折入卷积权重。据此实现 I/O 感知的融合实现，将建模的 HBM 流量降低约 2.55 倍，训练速度最高提升 4.35 倍，峰值内存大约减半。
Motivation: WTConv 作为标准卷积的即插即用替代方案，能以线性参数数量随分解层数指数扩展感受野，但其参考实现因高带宽内存中的过度数据移动而严重受内存限制，实际运行比其替换的深度可分离卷积慢得多。
Method: 作者先为 WTConv 建立 I/O 模型以刻画内存瓶颈，再据此提出三种代数重构：(1) 在芯片上重算廉价的 Haar 分析蝴蝶变换；(2) 将多级合成级联折叠为按输出坐标位索引的单次闭式传递；(3) 将学习到的逐通道尺度折入卷积权重。三者结合形成 I/O 感知的融合实现。
Result: 在保持相近算术量 (comparable arithmetic) 的前提下，该重构将建模的 HBM 流量减少约 2.55 倍，相对参考实现最高取得 4.35 倍训练加速，峰值内存大约减半；实验覆盖 WTConvNeXt 配置的多个分解级别和多种张量形状。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该重构在保留 WTConv 收益的同时显著降低其执行时间和内存占用，消除了此前限制其实用效率的系统开销。

summary_sections.method: 作者先为 WTConv 建立 I/O 模型以刻画内存瓶颈，再据此提出三种代数重构：(1) 在芯片上重算廉价的 Haar 分析蝴蝶变换；(2) 将多级合成级联折叠为按输出坐标位索引的单次闭式传递；(3) 将学习到的逐通道尺度折入卷积权重。三者结合形成 I/O 感知的融合实现。
summary_sections.result: 在保持相近算术量 (comparable arithmetic) 的前提下，该重构将建模的 HBM 流量减少约 2.55 倍，相对参考实现最高取得 4.35 倍训练加速，峰值内存大约减半；实验覆盖 WTConvNeXt 配置的多个分解级别和多种张量形状。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该重构在保留 WTConv 收益的同时显著降低其执行时间和内存占用，消除了此前限制其实用效率的系统开销。

papers.title: Rule of Thumb: Explaining Artificial Intelligence Systems using Partial Information
papers.abstract_en: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) seeks to explain how an Artificial Intelligence (AI) system arrived at a particular decision. We propose ''Rule of Thumb'' (RoT) explanations, a new approach to XAI based upon a novel formulation that identifies the most relevant features for predicting the behaviour of an AI system, for a particular datapoint. We show how RoT is well-suited to enable XAI in: (a) zero-shot classification using large language models (LLMs), (b) auditing of opaque AI systems without model access, and (c) the use of AI in scientific discovery. Additionally, RoT meets specific requirements from leading AI regulations, provides a familiar interface and visualisations for XAI practitioners, is model-agnostic, and is substantially faster than alternatives. Code available at: https://github.com/KaiRawal/Rule-of-Thumb-Explaining-Artificial-Intelligence-Systems-using-Partial-Information
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的 XAI 方法“Rule of Thumb (RoT) 解释”，其核心是为一特定数据点识别预测 AI 系统行为时最相关的特征。摘要称该方法适用于大语言模型 (LLM) 的零样本分类、无法访问模型的黑盒审计，以及 AI 辅助科学发现等场景，并声称满足主流 AI 监管要求、提供熟悉的界面与可视化、具备模型不可知性且比现有替代方法更快。
Motivation: XAI 的目标是解释 AI 系统如何得出某个决策，而现有方法在面对黑盒系统、零样本 LLM 分类或科学发现等高要求场景时难以直接使用；本文旨在提出一种基于部分信息、不依赖模型内部访问的新解释框架。
Method: 提出 RoT 解释方法，通过一种新的问题形式化，针对给定数据点找出预测 AI 系统行为最相关的特征；该方法被描述为模型不可知 (model-agnostic)，并提供与 XAI 实践者熟悉的接口和可视化。
Result: 摘要报告 RoT 在三个场景中适用：LLM 零样本分类、无模型访问的 AI 系统审计、以及 AI 科学发现；同时还满足领先 AI 监管的具体要求，并比替代方案显著更快。
Conclusion: 作者认为 RoT 是一种兼顾监管要求与实用性的新 XAI 解释形式，可服务于多种模型不可知的解释与审计需求；摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Grid-Preserving Knowledge Distillation: Transferring Convolutional Inductive Bias to Vision Transformers under Data Scarcity
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers demonstrate remarkable global modeling capacity but often underperform in data-scarce regimes. Distilling convolutional inductive biases from a CNN teacher provides an effective remedy while leaving the deployed model unchanged. However, general-purpose feature distillation transfers little in this setting. In CNN-to-CNN distillation, pooling, flattening, and logit-space projections remove the spatial grid that encodes locality and translation equivariance. Unlike a convolutional student, a ViT cannot readily reconstruct this structure on its own. In this paper, we propose iBKD, a distillation framework that preserves the spatial grid throughout the entire transfer process. Its core module, the Inductive Bias Attention Module, aggregates features from all student layers onto the teacher's grid using learned weights. It then enhances structural cues through channel and deformable spatial attention and injects them via convolutional cross-attention operating directly between spatial grids rather than token sets. The module is used only during training, leaving the deployed model as an unmodified ViT with no inference overhead. Across seven Transformer backbones and six data-scarce benchmarks, iBKD consistently outperforms both locality-guidance methods and general knowledge distillation baselines, with its advantage increasing as the amount of training data decreases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 iBKD，一个在 CNN 教师向 ViT 学生蒸馏时全程保留空间网格的蒸馏框架，用于缓解数据稀缺场景下 ViT 性能不足的问题。核心模块 Inductive Bias Attention Module 用学习权重把学生各层特征聚合到教师的网格上，再通过通道注意力和可变形空间注意力增强结构线索，并以卷积交叉注意力在空间网格之间（而非 token 集合之间）注入归纳偏置。该模块只在训练阶段使用，部署模型仍是未修改的 ViT，无推理开销。在七个 Transformer 骨干和六个数据稀缺基准上，iBKD 一致优于 locality-guidance 方法与通用知识蒸馏基线，且训练数据越少优势越明显。
Motivation: 通用特征蒸馏在 CNN 到 ViT 的迁移中效果有限，因为池化、展平和 logit 空间投影会移除编码局部性与平移等变性的空间网格；与卷积学生不同，ViT 难以自行重建这种结构。
Method: 提出 iBKD 蒸馏框架，其核心 Inductive Bias Attention Module 将学生所有层的特征以学习权重聚合到教师的空间网格上，通过通道注意力和可变形空间注意力增强结构线索，再用直接在空间网格间操作的卷积交叉注意力注入特征，替代通常的 token 集交互；模块仅在训练时启用。
Result: 在七个 Transformer 骨干和六个数据稀缺基准上，iBKD 一致优于 locality-guidance 方法及通用知识蒸馏基线，并且随着训练数据量减少，其相对优势进一步扩大。
Conclusion: 作者强调，在 CNN 到 ViT 的知识蒸馏中保留空间网格能够有效传递卷积归纳偏置，同时保持部署的 ViT 模型不变且无推理开销。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Critic-Free Pretraining for Efficient Online Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Offline-to-online (O2O) reinforcement learning aims to leverage policies pretrained on static datasets while improving them through online interaction. However, directly reusing an offline-trained critic can hinder online fine-tuning: as the policy and data distribution change rapidly, value estimates inherited from offline training may become misaligned with the online environment, leading to inaccurate policy improvement and inefficient exploration. To address this problem, we introduce Critic-Free Pretraining: an efficient paradigm that completely abandons the approach of offline critic training, allowing a freshly initialized critic to adapt without inheriting biased estimates. CFP is compatible with various mainstream O2O algorithms and consistently matches or improves upon conventional O2O algorithms across a diverse set of tasks, with particularly pronounced gains on several challenging tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对离线到在线 (O2O) 强化学习微调中复用离线 critic 导致价值估计偏差的问题，提出 Critic-Free Pretraining (CFP)：完全放弃离线 critic 训练，让在线阶段从零初始化的 critic 直接适应，从而避免继承偏差。摘要报告 CFP 与多种主流 O2O 算法兼容，并在多样化任务上一致匹配或优于传统 O2O 算法，在若干困难任务上增益尤其明显。
Motivation: O2O 强化学习直接复用离线训练的 critic 会在在线微调中产生问题：随策略和数据分布快速变化，离线价值估计与在线环境失准，导致策略改进不准确且探索低效。
Method: 提出一种名为 Critic-Free Pretraining 的新范式，核心是彻底放弃离线 critic 训练流程，使用全新初始化的 critic 在在线交互中自适应更新，不继承离线阶段可能存在的有偏估值。
Result: 摘要声称该方法与主流 O2O 算法兼容，并在多类任务上持续匹配或优于传统 O2O 算法，在多个具有挑战性的任务上取得特别显著的提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为丢弃离线 critic 而采用在线新鲜初始化的 critic 是一种高效且通用的改进方式，可避免离线价值偏差对在线微调的负面影响。

papers.title: From Recoverability to Functional Use: Certifying Temporal Reports in Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Temporal reports are increasingly emitted alongside numerical forecasts and are often interpreted as statements about the computation producing those forecasts. We formalize the resulting certification problem as three distinct stages: \emph{recoverability}, \emph{report correctness}, and \emph{functional use}. For point delays, an exact finite-sample recovery--substitutability identity ties structural discrimination and proxy prediction to the same realized shift geometry while placing them on different scales: structural evidence grows with $nη_n$, whereas the normalized predictive penalty is governed by $η_n$. A delay can therefore be statistically decisive while an alternative lag remains near-oracle. Guided by this regime, we evaluate TCN- and N-HiTS-based systems on the strict intersection of recoverable trajectories, correct reports, and near-oracle one-step predictions. Their dominant forecast dependence remains far from the reported delay under masking, finite perturbations, local Jacobians, and in-distribution conditional replacement, and the separation persists across a 100-fold forecast-loss sweep. A no-bypass factorization then provides an explicit access certificate for the final stage, while architecture-matched multi-seed, post-hoc, and gate-destruction controls identify report-coordinate access as the mechanism governing alignment. The resulting framework separates statistical evidence for \emph{what can be identified} from computational evidence for \emph{what the forecast uses}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个三阶段认证框架，用于检验与数值预测一同发布的时间性报告（temporal reports）是否真的被预测模型的计算过程所使用。作者针对点延迟建立了可恢复性（recoverability）与可替代性（substitutability）之间的有限样本恒等式，并在 TCN 与 N-HiTS 系统上以掩码、有限扰动、局部 Jacobian、条件替换等手段验证报告坐标的访问机制。核心结论是区分统计上‘能被识别’的证据与计算上‘预测实际使用’的证据。
Motivation: 时间性报告常被解读为关于产生该预测的计算过程的陈述，但缺少严格的认证手段；作者希望将认证问题从可恢复性逐层推进到功能使用，以检验报告与预测计算之间的真实关系。
Method: 将认证问题分解为可恢复性、报告正确性（report correctness）与功能使用（functional use）三个阶段；对点延迟推导 recovery-substitutability 恒等式，并采用掩码、有限扰动、局部 Jacobian、分布内条件替换、no-bypass 分解以及门控破坏（gate-destruction）对照等手段。
Result: 摘要指出结构证据随 nη_n 增长，而归一化预测惩罚由 η_n 控制，因此某个延迟可以在统计上显著而备选滞后仍接近最优；在 TCN 和 N-HiTS 系统上，所有探针以及 100 倍预测损失扫描下，主导预测依赖均远离所报告延迟。
Conclusion: 该框架将‘可识别性’的证据与‘预测实际使用’的证据分开，并为功能使用阶段提供显式访问证书（access certificate）；作者强调这种分离有助于更严格地认证时间序列预测中附带的时间性报告。

papers.title: On the Importance of Geometric Nonlinearity and Temperature-Dependent Properties in Multi-Material Thermo-Mechanical Topology Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Thermo-mechanical compliant devices are commonly designed with small-strain linear elasticity and temperature-independent material properties, even though they might operate hundreds of kelvin above ambient where both assumptions are questionable. In this work, we quantify the effect and cost of each assumption in multi-material topology optimization of thermally actuated compliant devices. To this end, we introduce a physics-informed, simultaneous analysis-and-design framework with (i) a finite-strain quadratic-Hencky (logarithmic-strain) constitutive model whose isotropic thermal eigenstrain admits an exact additive split in log-strain space, and (ii) temperature-dependent conductivity, thermal expansion, and elastic moduli for a titanium--copper--steel material system. We optimize a thermal actuator and a thermal gripper at three design temperatures under both a baseline model and the full physics, subject to mass and manufacturability constraints. Every converged design is re-evaluated by verified nonlinear finite element solvers in the full factorial of constitutive law and property model. The comparison between the two factors reveals that the constitutive law is the decisive modeling choice: These devices work as linkages where linear kinematics mistakes rotation for compressive strain; its error therefore grows with the design temperature and concentrates on the very layouts that exploit rotation best. Because a linear optimizer also steers away from the rotation-rich mechanisms that would expose this bias, the model can deceptively appear trustworthy when validated against its own designs. Designing with the full physics yields consistently stronger and more temperature-robust devices at a modest increase in design-time cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文量化多材料热-机械拓扑优化中两个常见假设——小应变线弹性本构和与温度无关的材料属性——对热驱动柔顺机构设计的影响与成本。作者提出一个物理信息驱动的分析与设计同步框架，采用有限应变二次 Hencky（对数应变）本构模型，其各向同性热特征应变在对数应变空间可精确加性分解，并纳入钛-铜-钢体系的随温度变化的电导率、热膨胀系数和弹性模量。在三种设计温度下分别用基线模型和完整物理模型优化热致动器和热夹持器，并用非线性有限元求解器对所有收敛设计进行全因子复评。
Motivation: 热-机械柔顺器件通常在高于环境数百开尔文的工况下工作，但现有设计普遍采用小应变线弹性与温度无关材料属性，这两个假设在该工况下是否成立缺乏量化评估。
Method: 建立物理信息驱动的同步分析与设计框架：本构采用有限应变二次 Hencky 对数应变模型，热特征应变在 log-strain 空间精确加性分解；材料属性（电导率、热膨胀、弹性模量）随温度变化；在质量和可制造性约束下，对热致动器和热夹持器在三种设计温度下分别用基线模型与完整物理模型优化，并用已验证的非线性有限元求解器对全部收敛设计做全因子复评。
Result: 本构模型是决定性因素：这类器件像连杆机构一样工作，线性运动学把旋转误判为压缩应变，因此误差随设计温度增大，并集中在最能利用旋转的布局上；同时线性优化器会避开富含旋转的机构，使其在自身设计的验证下显得可信。用完整物理模型设计出的器件一致更强、温度稳健性更好，而设计时间成本仅适度增加。
Conclusion: 作者强调几何非线性本构模型是热-机械拓扑优化中的关键建模选择，温度相关材料属性也需纳入；仅在线性假设下验证模型可能掩盖其系统性偏差。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Model Discovery Agent: LLM-assisted Bayesian experiment design for data-efficient discovery of mechanistic world models
papers.abstract_en: Predicting the answer to interventional ``what if'' questions --- the outcome of an action never taken --- requires a \emph{mechanistic}, causal model, not a curve fit; and learning such a model requires \emph{experiments}, because passive data leaves its mechanisms unidentified. Experiments are expensive, so the central problem is \emph{data efficiency}. We present the Model Discovery Agent (MDA), which couples a large language model (LLM), used as a \emph{proposer} of candidate structures, with standard Bayesian machinery --- sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) for parameter and structure posteriors, simulation-based inference (SBI) for intractable likelihoods, and value-of-information (VoI) for experiment design --- to discover latent mechanistic world models from few interventions. MDA operates in the M-open setting: when the truth lies outside the current hypothesis class, a predictive check flags the inadequacy and the proposer expands the hypothesis space with a new model whose parameters are then identified by designed experiments. We show that \emph{discovery and design reinforce}: the design step identifies the mechanism the discovery step proposes, and the identified mechanism improves predictions, enabling further discoveries from the remaining unexplained residuals. On three different benchmarks --- covering physics (\DPbench, \citep{wiemann2026discoverphysics}), chemistry (\CHEMbench, \citep{kabra2026autoscilab}) and biology (\HHbench, a new partially observed single-neuron electrophysiology benchmark we create) --- we show that MDA sets a new SOTA in terms of data-efficient model learning and reliable interventional prediction ability.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Model Discovery Agent (MDA)，将大语言模型 (LLM) 作为候选机制结构的提出者，与序列蒙特卡洛 (SMC)、基于模拟的推断 (SBI) 和信息价值 (VoI) 实验设计等贝叶斯工具耦合，以从少量干预实验中高效发现隐式的机制性世界模型。MDA 在 M-open 设定下运作：当真实模型落在当前假设类之外时，预测性检查会标记不足，并提出者随之扩展假设空间。作者在物理 (DPbench)、化学 (CHEMbench) 和新建的生物学 (HHbench) 三个基准上报告了新的最优结果。
Motivation: 回答干预性“如果……会怎样”的问题需要机制性因果模型而非曲线拟合；被动数据无法识别机制，因此必须开展实验，而实验昂贵，数据效率成为核心问题。
Method: MDA 用 LLM 充当结构提出者，用 SMC 处理参数与结构后验，用 SBI 处理不可处理的似然，用 VoI 指导实验设计；在 M-open 设定下，当预测性检查暴露当前假设类不足时，提出者会扩展假设空间以引入新模型，再通过设计的实验识别其参数。
Result: 在物理、化学和生物学三个基准上，MDA 在数据高效模型学习和可靠的干预预测能力方面达到新的 SOTA；摘要强调“发现与设计相互强化”，即设计步骤识别发现步骤提出的机制，已识别机制提升预测，进而从剩余残差中促成新发现。
Conclusion: 摘要主张发现与实验设计之间存在正向循环，这一耦合使得从少量干预中学习机制性世界模型成为可能，并在多个科学领域获得验证。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: LoRA-based Adaptation Alone Is Not Enough: Understanding the Limits of Foundation Models for Face Presentation Attack Detection
papers.abstract_en: Face presentation attack detection (PAD) aims to reliably detect a wide range of presentation attacks. While PAD methods achieve strong performance within individual datasets, their performance degrades under cross-dataset evaluation. Variations in sensors or lighting conditions can reduce the effectiveness of detectors from near-perfect to nearly random. Foundation models (FMs) have emerged as a promising alternative because typical PAD datasets, such as the MCIO benchmarks (MSU-MFSD, CASIA-FASD, Replay-Attack, and OULU-NPU), are small relative to the scale used for web-based pretraining. However, existing PAD systems primarily focus on CLIP-based foundation models, while overlooking other FMs with different architectures and training procedures. This study addresses this question by systematically evaluating 32 FMs. Zero-shot prompting achieves performance near chance across model families and scales. The vision encoders, when low-rankadapted (LoRA) with fewer than 1% trainable weights, achieve below 2% intra-dataset ACER in most cases, while cross-dataset ACER is substantially higher. LoRA primarily refines the decision boundary within a dataset, suggesting that pretrained representations and the adaptation dataset play a larger role in cross-dataset generalization than the evaluated lightweight adaptation strategy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估32个基础模型（foundation models, FMs）用于人脸呈现攻击检测（face presentation attack detection, PAD），重点考察低秩适配（LoRA）轻量微调在MCIO基准（MSU-MFSD、CASIA-FASD、Replay-Attack、OULU-NPU）上的表现。摘要报告零样本提示在各类模型族和规模下接近随机性能；视觉编码器经LoRA适配（可训练权重少于1%）后，多数情况下数据集内ACER低于2%，但跨数据集ACER明显更高。作者认为LoRA主要细化数据集内的决策边界，预训练表示与适配数据集对跨数据集泛化的影响大于该轻量适配策略。
Motivation: 人脸PAD方法在单个数据集上表现强，但跨数据集评估时性能严重下降，传感器或光照变化可使检测器从接近完美退化到接近随机。现有PAD系统主要关注CLIP类基础模型，忽视了其他架构与训练流程不同的基础模型，且典型PAD数据集规模远小于网络预训练规模，基础模型是否适合PAD尚无系统认识。
Method: 对32个不同架构与训练方式的基础模型进行系统评估，比较零样本提示与仅对视觉编码器做LoRA低秩适配（可训练参数少于1%）的两种使用方式，在MCIO基准的四个数据集上报告数据集内与跨数据集的ACER。
Result: 零样本提示在所有模型族和规模下性能接近随机；LoRA适配后在多数情况下数据集内ACER低于2%，但跨数据集ACER显著更高，表明轻量适配难以带来跨数据集泛化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调预训练表示和适配数据集比所评估的轻量适配策略对跨数据集泛化贡献更大，LoRA主要是在数据集内精化决策边界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TCS-BENCH: Benchmarking State-of-the-Art Generative AI Theoretical Computer Science Research Ability
papers.abstract_en: We introduce TCS-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) on research-level Theoretical Computer Science (TCS) proof generation. TCS-Bench consists of theorem-proving tasks from papers published at top theoretical computer science venues (STOC, FOCS, and SODA). Each task provides the necessary context to derive a self-contained proof for a target result. We evaluate state-of-the-art models on this benchmark. We verify the correctness of generated proofs via a verification agent, and further benchmark the verifier against human-expert proof judgements on a set of target statements and generated proofs pairs. Our reference verifier achieves over 90% accuracy on the expert labeled set.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TCS-Bench，一个用于评估大语言模型 (LLM) 在研究级理论计算机科学 (TCS) 证明生成能力的基准。基准包含来自 STOC、FOCS 和 SODA 等顶会论文的定理证明任务，每个任务提供必要上下文以推导自包含证明。作者用验证代理 (verification agent) 检查生成证明的正确性，并将验证器与人类专家判断进行对比，参考验证器在专家标注集上取得超过 90% 的准确率。
Motivation: 目前缺乏系统评估 LLM 在高级理论计算机科学研究级证明生成能力的基准，现有评估多集中在编程或数学竞赛级别，难以反映真实的 TCS 研究任务需求。
Method: 构建 TCS-Bench，从 STOC、FOCS、SODA 顶会论文中提取定理证明任务并配齐自包含上下文；使用验证代理对 LLM 生成证明做正确性判定，并在目标陈述与生成证明对上用人类专家标注来校准验证器性能。
Result: 参考验证器在专家标注集上达到超过 90% 的准确率，说明该自动验证方式能够以较高可靠度评估生成证明。
Conclusion: TCS-Bench 为衡量 LLM 在理论计算机科学领域的证明生成能力提供了新的评估手段，且其可信的验证器使得大规模自动评测成为可能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DreOPD: Degraded-Reference Extrapolative On-Policy Distillation for Flow-matching Models
papers.abstract_en: Flow-matching models are now a mainstream method to image generation, but its adaptation to diverse downstream scenarios typically relies on post-training, which may cause conflicts among task-specific optimization objectives. Reinforcement learning enables direct optimization of task-specific rewards beyond the original models, yet trajectory-level optimization may incur high-variance gradients and cross-task interference. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers dense and stable supervision on student rollouts, but conventional teacher matching remains imitation-based. We propose DreOPD, a Degraded-reference extrapolative OPD method for flow-matching models that bridges these two paradigms. Our DreOPD converts implicit reward extrapolation into closed-form velocity regression, enabling extrapolative post-training with the stability of OPD. It further uses a mildly degraded reference to strengthen the teacher-reference contrast, yielding a clearer extrapolation direction. Experiments on single- and multi-teacher settings show that DreOPD outperforms OPD and multi-task RL baselines in average performance, while surpassing specialized teachers on most metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DreOPD，一种面向 flow-matching 模型的退化参考外推在线策略蒸馏（degraded-reference extrapolative on-policy distillation）方法。它将隐式奖励外推转化为闭式速度回归，从而在保持 OPD 稳定性的同时实现外推式后训练，并利用轻微退化的参考图像增强教师-参考对比。实验在单教师和多教师设置下显示，DreOPD 的平均性能优于 OPD 与多任务 RL 基线，并在大多数指标上超过专用教师。
Motivation: Flow-matching 模型已成为图像生成的主流方法，但适配多样下游场景通常依赖后训练，而不同任务特定的优化目标可能相互冲突。现有的强化学习可直接优化任务奖励，但轨迹级优化存在高方差梯度和跨任务干扰；在线策略蒸馏（OPD）虽能提供稠密稳定的监督，传统教师匹配仍属于模仿式学习，缺乏奖励外推能力。
Method: DreOPD 将隐式奖励外推转换为闭式速度回归，使外推式后训练具备 OPD 的稳定性。它进一步使用轻微退化的参考（degraded reference）强化教师与参考之间的对比，从而提供更清晰的奖励外推方向。
Result: 在单教师和多教师设置中，DreOPD 在平均性能上优于 OPD 和多任务 RL 基线，并在大多数指标上超过专门的教师模型。
Conclusion: 作者将 DreOPD 定位为连接 OPD 稳定监督与任务奖励外推两种范式的桥梁，强调其能在不牺牲稳定性的前提下实现外推式后训练；实验证据限于图像生成的单教师与多教师设置。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 DreOPD，一种面向 flow-matching 模型的退化参考外推在线策略蒸馏（degraded-reference extrapolative on-policy distillation）方法。它将隐式奖励外推转化为闭式速度回归，从而在保持 OPD 稳定性的同时实现外推式后训练，并利用轻微退化的参考图像增强教师-参考对比。实验在单教师和多教师设置下显示，DreOPD 的平均性能优于 OPD 与多任务 RL 基线，并在大多数指标上超过专用教师。
summary_sections.motivation: Flow-matching 模型已成为图像生成的主流方法，但适配多样下游场景通常依赖后训练，而不同任务特定的优化目标可能相互冲突。现有的强化学习可直接优化任务奖励，但轨迹级优化存在高方差梯度和跨任务干扰；在线策略蒸馏（OPD）虽能提供稠密稳定的监督，传统教师匹配仍属于模仿式学习，缺乏奖励外推能力。

papers.title: NBA_Streaming: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Fine-Grained Basketball Commentary Generation in Continuous Streams
papers.abstract_en: Live basketball commentary generation requires determining when an event is sufficiently observable and describing it before subsequent events unfold. However, existing methods are primarily designed for pre-segmented clips or complete videos, making them unsuitable for continuous streams. Existing datasets also provide limited supervision for player identities, fine-grained actions, event attributes, and coherent event chains, restricting the factual richness of generated commentary. To address these limitations, we introduce NBA_Streaming, a large-scale benchmark for online fine-grained basketball commentary generation. It contains 307.5 hours of basketball broadcasts and approximately 35K temporally aligned events, with annotations of event boundaries, player identities, fine-grained actions, event chains, and natural-language commentary. By moving from isolated clips to continuous streams, NBA_Streaming enables unified evaluation of event localization, response reliability, factual grounding, and commentary quality under causal constraints. We further propose a causal two-stage framework that combines completion-first localization with ball-centric semantic grounding, enabling the system to identify complete events from observed streams and organize scene, event, identity, and action cues for commentary generation. Extensive experiments reveal the difficulty of NBA_Streaming, where existing baselines struggle with online timing, factual grounding, and fine-grained description. Our framework consistently improves over strong alternatives, while the remaining gap highlights NBA_Streaming as a valuable benchmark for streaming sports video understanding and generation. The code and data will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NBA_Streaming，一个面向连续直播流的细粒度篮球解说生成大规模基准，包含 307.5 小时转播视频、约 3.5 万个时间对齐事件，并标注了事件边界、球员身份、细粒度动作、事件链和自然语言解说。作者还提出一个因果两阶段框架，将先定位完整事件与以球为中心的语义锚定相结合，用于在线解说生成。实验显示现有基线在该基准上普遍存在在线时序、事实锚定和细粒度描述方面的困难，而所提框架一致优于强基线，但仍有明显差距。
Motivation: 现有解说生成方法主要面向预切片段或完整视频，不适用于连续直播流；现有数据集对球员身份、细粒度动作、事件属性和连贯事件链的监督不足，限制了生成解说的事实丰富性。
Method: 提出一个因果两阶段框架，先进行完成优先的定位（completion-first localization），再利用以球为中心（ball-centric）的语义锚定，从观测到的连续流中识别完整事件，并组织场景、事件、身份和动作线索来生成解说。
Result: 基准规模为 307.5 小时篮球转播与约 3.5 万个时间对齐事件；实验表明现有基线在在线时序、事实锚定和细粒度描述上表现困难，所提框架一致优于强基线，但剩余性能差距说明该基准仍具挑战性。
Conclusion: 作者将 NBA_Streaming 定位为流式体育视频理解与生成领域有价值的基准，并指出所提框架的相对优势以及尚未弥合的差距；代码和数据将在论文被接收后公开。
