papers.title: CIDER: A Dataset of Contextual Disclosure Boundaries for Privacy Preference Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human privacy preferences requires capturing individuals' disclosure boundaries beyond general privacy norms. However, a gap remains in eliciting such nuanced preferences to evaluate alignment in realistic settings. We introduce CIDER, a dataset of 14,850 human annotations from 169 users, forming 1,650 contextual disclosure boundary sets across 60 interpersonal communication scenarios involving information sharing that violates privacy norms. Each boundary represents a real user's disclosure decisions over 9 sharing variants in a scenario, for a given communication role and AI-mediated condition. We formulate a task in which models predict a user's disclosure decision from historical boundaries, with varying levels of contextual information. Across 12 open and proprietary models, in-context personalization improves prediction accuracy by up to 11.41 percentage points using only 6 historical examples. Larger models such as GPT-5.4 (with medium reasoning effort) and Claude Sonnet 4.6 are better at leveraging semantic context to understand user-specific, context-dependent disclosure preferences for more accurate predictions, while smaller models tend to rely on structured heuristics based on disclosure granularity and identifiability. Personalization generally improves prediction accuracy, but the improvement is often accompanied by imbalanced shifts in false-positive and false-negative rates across models, with only Claude Sonnet 4.6 achieving balanced improvements in both. Our findings reveal both the promise and limitations of inference-time personalization for privacy preference modeling and position CIDER as a resource for advancing personalized privacy alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CIDER 数据集，包含来自 169 位用户的 14,850 条人工标注，构成 60 个人际沟通场景下的 1,650 个情境化披露边界集合 (contextual disclosure boundary sets)，旨在评估大语言模型在真实场景中对人类隐私偏好的对齐。作者将任务定义为根据用户的历史披露边界预测其对 9 种共享变体 (sharing variants) 的披露决策，并在 12 个开源与专有模型上比较不同上下文信息量下的表现。
Motivation: 对齐 LLM 与人类隐私偏好需要捕捉个体化的披露边界，而不仅仅是通用隐私规范；现有工作在真实场景中获取这类细微偏好以评估对齐效果方面存在空白。
Method: 引入 CIDER 数据集，每个披露边界代表某一通信角色和 AI 中介条件下真实用户在一个场景中对 9 种共享变体的披露决策；形式化一个预测任务，要求模型依据历史边界预测用户披露决策，并变换上下文信息量进行测试。
Result: 仅使用 6 个历史样例，上下文个性化 (in-context personalization) 最多可将预测准确率提升 11.41 个百分点。更大模型（如 GPT-5.4 中等推理努力和 Claude Sonnet 4.6）更善于利用语义上下文理解用户特定、情境依赖的披露偏好；较小模型则更依赖基于披露粒度 (granularity) 和可识别性 (identifiability) 的结构化启发式。个性化总体上提升准确率，但常伴随假阳性率和假阴性率的失衡变化，仅 Claude Sonnet 4.6 实现了两者均衡的改进。
Conclusion: 结果揭示了推理时个性化 (inference-time personalization) 用于隐私偏好建模的潜力与局限，并将 CIDER 定位为推进个性化隐私对齐研究的数据资源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Model the Edit, Not the Image: Visual Autoregressive Editing from a Source-Centric Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Next-scale visual autoregressive models (VARs) have emerged as a powerful generative paradigm, producing high-quality images through efficient coarse-to-fine prediction. However, their potential for text-guided image editing remains largely underexplored. Existing training-free VAR editing approaches often formulate editing as target-conditioned regeneration guided or constrained by the source image, and may rely on inversion, test-time optimization, attention control, or user-provided masks. This generation-centric formulation does not fully exploit the multiscale source representations provided by VARs and may introduce additional computation or intervention. We instead take a source-centric perspective on VAR editing, in which the encoded source image tokens serve as the primary visual state and the editing process focuses on condition-induced changes. Based on this perspective, we propose \textbf{EditMod}, which compares source- and target-conditioned predictions under a shared autoregressive context, treats their difference as a scale-wise editing direction, and applies it as a residual update to source tokens at selected scales. Experiments show that EditMod achieves leading source-image fidelity while maintaining strong text alignment, and completes end-to-end editing of a 1K image in only 1.57 seconds on a single A100 GPU without per-image preparation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EditMod，一种从源图像中心视角进行文本引导图像编辑的方法，针对下一尺度视觉自回归模型 (next-scale VAR)。其核心是让源图像编码 token 作为主要视觉状态，比较在共享自回归上下文下源条件与目标条件的预测，将二者差异视为尺度级编辑方向，并作为残差更新应用到选定尺度的源 token 上。实验显示 EditMod 在保持较强文本对齐的同时取得领先的源图像保真度，在单张 A100 GPU 上无需逐图像准备即可在 1.57 秒内完成一张 1K 图像的端到端编辑。
Motivation: 现有免训练的 VAR 编辑方法通常采用生成中心视角，把编辑构造成由目标条件引导、受源图像约束或指导的再生成，常依赖反转 (inversion)、测试时优化、注意力控制或用户提供的掩码。这种公式没有充分利用 VAR 提供的多尺度源表示，并可能引入额外的计算或人工干预。
Method: EditMod 采用源中心视角，将编码后的源图像 token 作为主要视觉状态；在共享自回归上下文下同时得到源条件与目标条件的预测，把两者的差异当作尺度级编辑方向，并在选定的尺度上将其作为残差更新施加到源 token。
Result: 摘要报告 EditMod 取得领先的源图像保真度并保持较强的文本对齐；它能在单张 A100 GPU 上以 1.57 秒完成 1K 图像的端到端编辑，且无需针对每张图像的准备步骤。
Conclusion: 摘要强调源中心视角能更充分地利用 VAR 的多尺度源表示，避免生成中心方法中额外的计算或干预成本，为文本引导的图像编辑提供了一种高效替代方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AeroReformer2: Spoken-Query Referring Segmentation for Aerial Images
papers.abstract_en: Spoken language offers a natural, hands-free interface for specifying an arbitrary target in dense remote-sensing imagery, yet existing referring remote-sensing image segmentation benchmarks accept only written expressions. To bridge this gap, we introduce \dataset, a spoken-query benchmark derived from RISBench that adds accent- and voice-diverse speech while preserving the original image, mask, and data splits. Its hard evaluation sets combine rotor, wind, and mixed interference with three signal-to-noise levels. We also propose \model, an efficient bilateral network that combines a boundary-preserving visual path with token-preserving speech encoding, kernel linear cross-modal attention, and a resolution refinement head. The design conditions visual features at two scales without materializing a dense speech--visual affinity matrix, then restores fine boundaries using high-resolution visual features. On the clean test split, \model with Swin-Base achieves 62.09\% mean intersection over union (mIoU) and 68.22\% overall intersection over union (oIoU), outperforming the strongest audio-adapted remote-sensing baseline by 5.38 and 2.08 percentage points, respectively. It retains the best hard-set mIoU at 54.09\%. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first benchmark and model study of full-sentence spoken-query referring segmentation for remote-sensing imagery. The code will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向遥感影像的语音查询指代分割基准，基于 RISBench 构建并加入口音与嗓音多样的语音，同时设计了带转子、风和混合干扰以及三档信噪比的困难评测集。作者还提出一个高效双侧网络，结合保持边界的视觉路径、保留 token 的语音编码、核线性跨模态注意力与分辨率细化头。在干净测试集上，基于 Swin-Base 的模型达到 62.09% mIoU 和 68.22% oIoU，分别超过最强音频适配遥感基线 5.38 和 2.08 个百分点；困难集 mIoU 为 54.09%。作者称这是首个针对遥感影像全句语音查询指代分割的基准与模型研究。
Motivation: 现有多数指代遥感图像分割基准只接受书面文本表达，而语音是密集遥感影像中指定任意目标的自然免提交互方式，缺少语音查询基准与对应模型研究。
Method: 提出双侧网络，包含保持边界的视觉路径与保留 token 的语音编码；采用核线性跨模态注意力，在两个尺度上条件化视觉特征而不构造稠密的语音-视觉亲和矩阵，并用高分辨率视觉特征恢复精细边界，最后通过分辨率细化头输出分割结果。
Result: 在干净测试集上，基于 Swin-Base 的模型取得 62.09% mIoU 和 68.22% oIoU，比最强的音频适配遥感基线分别高 5.38 和 2.08 个百分点；在困难评测集上仍保持最佳 mIoU 54.09%。
Conclusion: 该工作是遥感影像全句语音查询指代分割的首个基准与模型研究，代码将公开；摘要未讨论跨域泛化或语音干扰鲁棒性的详细局限。

summary_sections.result: 在干净测试集上，基于 Swin-Base 的模型取得 62.09% mIoU 和 68.22% oIoU，比最强的音频适配遥感基线分别高 5.38 和 2.08 个百分点；在困难评测集上仍保持最佳 mIoU 54.09%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作是遥感影像全句语音查询指代分割的首个基准与模型研究，代码将公开；摘要未讨论跨域泛化或语音干扰鲁棒性的详细局限。

papers.title: Neural Message Passing on Structural Interaction Graphs for Fully-Inductive Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: A central obstacle in building graph foundation models is the input heterogeneity in terms of feature space dimensionality, semantics, and structure. Such heterogeneity limits the capability of graph neural networks to generalize to new graphs with unseen feature spaces. We address the transferability challenge with SIGIL, a framework that maps any attributed graph to a unified representation space of fixed dimension. Given a graph, SIGIL lifts it to a structural interaction graph, where nodes are the input feature dimensions and weighted, typed edges encode feature alignment across multiple orders of the graph's connectivity. A relational message-passing network embeds each feature dimension into a shared space, transforming the original node features, of arbitrary dimensionality, into representations transferable to any downstream graph. By construction, SIGIL is equivariant to permutations of nodes, feature dimensions, and labels. Additionally, when the input features are one-hot indicators of discrete relations, SIGIL recovers and strictly generalizes existing foundation models for knowledge graph reasoning. A single SIGIL model, pretrained on one graph, delivers strong fully-inductive link prediction. Also, SIGIL can be used to implement existing knowledge graph foundation models. As such, SIGIL unifies several existing regimes in graph foundation model design under a single framework
papers.comment: 7 pages, 1 figure in the main body. 12 pages, 5 figures in appendix. Submitted to AAAI 2027 (main track) and currently under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SIGIL，一个将任意属性图 (attributed graph) 映射到固定维度统一表示空间的框架，以解决图基础模型在图间泛化时面临的特征空间维度、语义和结构异质性问题。SIGIL 将图提升为结构交互图 (structural interaction graph)，其中节点是输入特征维度，带权的类型化边编码多个图连通阶数上的特征对齐关系，再用关系消息传递网络 (relational message-passing network) 将每个特征维度嵌入共享空间。单个 SIGIL 模型在图预训练后即可用于完全归纳式 (fully-inductive) 链接预测，并能统一并严格推广现有的知识图谱推理基础模型。
Motivation: 图基础模型的主要障碍是输入异质性，即不同图在特征空间维度、语义和结构上不一致，这限制了图神经网络泛化到具有未见特征空间的新图。
Method: SIGIL 将任意属性图提升为以输入特征维度为节点的结构交互图，并在多个图连通阶数上构建带权类型化边以编码特征对齐；随后通过关系消息传递网络将各特征维度嵌入到共享空间，从而把任意维度的原始节点特征转换为可迁移的表示。
Result: 摘要报告单个 SIGIL 模型在单个图上预训练后即可获得强壮的完全归纳式链接预测性能；当输入特征为离散关系的一热 (one-hot) 指示时，SIGIL 能恢复并严格推广现有知识图谱推理基础模型。
Conclusion: SIGIL 在设计上对节点、特征维度和标签的置换具有等变性 (equivariance)，并将多种现有的图基础模型设计范式统一到单一框架下。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Private Etymology: Designing Relational Reuse of Shared Symbols in Long-Term Human-AI Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Previous studies have shown that people can develop shared symbols, partner-specific expressions, personal idioms, inside jokes, and other parts of a relational microculture. Recent work has also examined how humans and conversational AI negotiate and revise symbolic meanings. However, long-term human-AI systems still lack a clear design model for recording how a dyad-specific expression gains meaning, checking whether both sides still accept that meaning, and safely reusing the expression in later sessions. This concept-and-prototype paper introduces Private Etymology, a machine-representable relational provenance that records how a dyad-specific symbolic expression is proposed, interpreted, negotiated, repaired, reused, revised, stabilized, contested, forgotten, or retired over time. I also propose relational reuse: reactivating a dyad-specific expression in a later session without fully explaining its meaning again. The contribution is not the invention of shared symbols or relational microcultures. Instead, this paper integrates prior ideas into persistent, revisable, and evidence-grounded symbolic units for human-AI relationships. I present a lifecycle model, an illustrative machine-readable schema, a working Apple Watch prototype, and a longitudinal research agenda. In the prototype, a language model classifies discrete conversational evidence, while deterministic local code decides whether a Shared Symbol can be updated. This prevents a free-form model confidence score or an AI proposal by itself from directly updating the persisted symbol. Private Etymology is proposed as infrastructure for conversational agents to participate in changing relational microcultures without inventing their origins or treating relational meaning as a fixed memory value.
papers.comment: Added a link to the Apple Watch prototype "MikasaWatch" demonstration video on 10 page
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Private Etymology，一种机器可表示的关系性溯源，用于记录双人特定符号表达在长期人机交互中如何被提出、解释、协商、修复、复用、修订、稳定、争议、遗忘或退役。作者还提出关系性复用（relational reuse），即在后续会话中无需完整解释即可重新激活双人特定表达。论文给出生命周期模型、示意性机器可读 schema、可工作的 Apple Watch 原型和纵向研究议程。
Motivation: 长期人机对话系统缺少清晰的设计模型，来记录双人特定表达如何获得意义、检查双方是否仍接受该意义，以及如何在后续会话中安全地复用该表达。
Method: 将已有共享符号与关系性微观文化的研究整合为持久、可修订、有证据支撑的符号单元；原型中语言模型对离散会话证据进行分类，但由确定性本地代码决定 Shared Symbol 是否可以更新，从而防止自由形式的模型置信度分数或 AI 提议直接改写持久化符号。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验结果；贡献以概念与原型为主，包括生命周期模型、示意性 schema、Apple Watch 原型以及纵向研究议程。
Conclusion: Private Etymology 被定位为基础设施，使对话智能体能够参与不断变化的关系性微观文化，而不虚构其起源或将关系意义视为固定记忆值；论文自身声明是概念与原型层面的工作。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: When Does Trace-Driven Evaluation Mislead MoE Expert Caching? Replay Semantics, Workload Contamination, and Operating Regimes
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have outgrown accelerator memory, and offloading expert weights to host memory is now standard. This makes expert cache management an attractive lever: a policy that raised the hit rate would cut expert traffic per token. Evaluating that is a measurement problem, and we find the measurement fragile. With a trace-driven, event-atomic simulator over three MoE models (40, 64, 128 experts), we isolate three evaluation axes that change conclusions, not just numbers. Replay semantics: under a fused-event traffic contract, an inconsistent per-access replay inflates recency-based policies by 27-29% while leaving frequency-based and static ones within 4%, inverting the policy ranking. Workload contamination: probe sets using one instruction template per category produce verbatim-identical generation prefixes; a matched-pair rendering intervention moves the measured early-window effect by 19.4-31.9 points and reverses which workloads look most cache-friendly. Operating regimes: normalized miss fractions do not transfer across models, so the per-step expert union relative to per-layer capacity must be reported -- yet permuting only the temporal order of an identical event stream moves the offline-optimal gap from 44.9% to 30.8%, so it is not sufficient. Corrected, a stable gap to the offline optimum remains (44.2-45.9% over 13 frozen workload compositions). A forced-admission oracle attributes 84.3-96.6% of it to knowing which resident expert is used furthest in the future. A causal next-use predictor, used as an eviction rule, recovers -11.4% of the gap; it picks an optimal victim 3.4% of the time, against 2.4% for a random resident block and 20.6-22.1% for LRU and LFRU. Our position is narrow: in our evaluated settings a large offline-optimal gap substantially overstates the gains recovered by representative lightweight causal mechanisms.
papers.comment: 38 pages, 4 figures, 21 tables. Measurement and scoped negative-results study. Artifacts, frozen manifests and SHA-256 records archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21788821
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一项面向 MoE 专家缓存 (expert caching) 评估的测量与限定性负面结果研究。作者用 trace 驱动、事件原子 (event-atomic) 的模拟器，在 40/64/128 专家三个 MoE 模型上分离出三个会改变结论而非仅改变数字的评估轴：重放语义 (replay semantics)、负载污染 (workload contamination) 和运行区间 (operating regimes)。摘要报告，不一致的 per-access 重放会把基于近期性 (recency) 的策略抬高 27-29% 并反转策略排序；修正后的离线最优 (offline-optimal) 差距稳定在 44.2-45.9%，且其中 84.3-96.6% 可归因于知道未来最远被使用的驻留专家；因果性 next-use 预测器作为驱逐规则只能回收 -11.4% 的差距。
Motivation: MoE 模型已超出加速器内存上限，将专家权重卸载到主机内存成为标配，使专家缓存管理成为降低每 token 专家流量的诱人杠杆。问题在于评估本身是脆弱的测量问题：不同的 trace 重放语义、探测负载的构造方式和运行区间会颠倒策略结论，从而误导缓存策略设计。
Method: 作者构建了 trace 驱动、事件原子的模拟器，在三个 MoE 模型上系统隔离三个评估轴：融合事件流量契约下不一致的 per-access 重放；每类仅用一个指令模板导致逐字相同生成前缀的探测集，并施加匹配对 (matched-pair) 渲染干预；以及不跨模型迁移的归一化缺失率，报告每步专家并集相对每层容量的指标，并额外扰动事件流的时间顺序。此外引入强制准入 oracle 和因果 next-use 预测器作为驱逐规则进行归因。
Result: 不一致的 per-access 重放将 recency 类策略抬高 27-29%，而对 frequency 类和静态策略影响在 4% 以内，从而反转策略排名；匹配对渲染干预使早期窗口效应移动 19.4-31.9 点并颠倒哪些负载最缓存友好。仅打乱相同事件流的时间顺序就把离线最优差距从 44.9% 变为 30.8%，修正后 13 个冻结负载组合上的稳定差距为 44.2-45.9%；强制准入 oracle 将其中的 84.3-96.6% 归因于预知未来最远的驻留专家使用。因果 next-use 驱逐规则回收 -11.4% 的差距，3.4% 的时间选出最优受害者，而随机驻留块为 2.4%，LRU 与 LFRU 为 20.6-22.1%。
Conclusion: 作者的立场是狭窄且明确的：在其评估设置下，大的离线最优差距显著高估了代表性轻量级因果机制能实际回收的收益；同时，仅报告每步专家并集相对层容量等运行区间指标并不充分，因为事件流的时间顺序本身也会改变结论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Aftab: A Comprehensive Benchmark of CNN Encoders and Advanced Value Functions in Parallelized Q-Networks
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in deep reinforcement learning have increasingly favored simplified, highly parallelized paradigms. Notably, the Parallelized Q-Network (PQN) algorithm enables off-policy value learning without relying on experience replay buffers or target networks. However, the representational capacity and computational efficiency of visual encoders operating in these buffer-free settings remain comparatively underexplored. In this work, we systematically investigate the architectural design space of Convolutional Neural Networks within PQN. We evaluate eight distinct CNN topologies while explicitly characterizing their parameter and computational requirements. We further study the effect of multiplicative representation learning and advanced value estimation by integrating the Hadamax encoding paradigm with categorical, ensemble, and dueling value heads. Extensive experiments on Atari-57 show that our final composite architecture, Aftab, achieves an Interquartile Mean (IQM) Human-Normalized Score of 6.592, compared with 2.715 for the standard PQN baseline, together with a 0.86 Probability of Improvement over PQN. We additionally evaluate Aftab on Procgen-Hard to assess performance under procedurally varying visual environments. Aftab achieves a normalized learning-curve Area Under the Curve (nAUC) of 0.541 compared with 0.216 for PQN. Overall, the results demonstrate that carefully designed encoder topology, multiplicative feature interactions, and advanced value-estimation heads can substantially improve performance within a parallelized, replay-free Q-learning framework while preserving its memory-efficient training paradigm. The complete Aftab framework, including model definitions, training configurations, reproducibility settings, and raw experimental logs, is open-sourced at https://github.com/tahashieenavaz/aftab
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了无需经验回放缓冲区或目标网络的并行化 Q-Network（PQN）框架中，视觉编码器的架构设计空间。作者评估了八种不同的 CNN 拓扑，并引入 Hadamax 编码范式结合 categorical、ensemble 与 dueling 价值头，最终组合出复合架构 Aftab。在 Atari-57 上，Aftab 的 IQM Human-Normalized Score 达到 6.592，而标准 PQN 基线为 2.715，且对 PQN 的 Improvement Probability 为 0.86；在 Procgen-Hard 上，Aftab 的 nAUC 为 0.541，对比 PQN 的 0.216。
Motivation: 深度强化学习中并行化、无回放缓冲区的范式日益流行，但此类设置下视觉编码器的表征能力与计算效率尚未被充分探索。
Method: 在 PQN 内系统比较八种 CNN 拓扑并刻画其参数量与计算需求；通过 Hadamax 编码实现乘法表示学习，并将其与 categorical、ensemble 和 dueling 价值估计头结合，构建复合架构 Aftab。
Result: 在 Atari-57 上，Aftab 取得 6.592 的 IQM Human-Normalized Score，显著高于 PQN 基线的 2.715，并实现 0.86 的 Improvement Probability；在 Procgen-Hard 上，Aftab 的 nAUC 为 0.541，远高于 PQN 的 0.216。
Conclusion: 结果表明，精心设计的编码器拓扑、乘法特征交互与先进价值估计头能在保留并行化、无经验回放 Q-learning 框架内存高效训练特性的前提下大幅提升性能。完整框架已开源。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: 本文系统研究了无需经验回放缓冲区或目标网络的并行化 Q-Network（PQN）框架中，视觉编码器的架构设计空间。作者评估了八种不同的 CNN 拓扑，并引入 Hadamax 编码范式结合 categorical、ensemble 与 dueling 价值头，最终组合出复合架构 Aftab。在 Atari-57 上，Aftab 的 IQM Human-Normalized Score 达到 6.592，而标准 PQN 基线为 2.715，且对 PQN 的 Improvement Probability 为 0.86；在 Procgen-Hard 上，Aftab 的 nAUC 为 0.541，对比 PQN 的 0.216。
summary_sections.motivation: 深度强化学习中并行化、无回放缓冲区的范式日益流行，但此类设置下视觉编码器的表征能力与计算效率尚未被充分探索。
summary_sections.method: 在 PQN 内系统比较八种 CNN 拓扑并刻画其参数量与计算需求；通过 Hadamax 编码实现乘法表示学习，并将其与 categorical、ensemble 和 dueling 价值估计头结合，构建复合架构 Aftab。

papers.title: Coordinated incentives in AI-generated misinformation governance
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid diffusion of AI-generated content, AI-driven misinformation is becoming increasingly pervasive and difficult to govern, undermining information credibility and social trust. This study models the strategic interdependence among a government regulator, an AI enterprise, and users through a three-party evolutionary game that incorporates heterogeneous rewards and punishments. From the resulting replicator equations, we characterize the evolutionary stability of competing governance and production strategies. The analysis indicates that neither unilateral regulation nor market incentives alone can effectively curb misinformation. Instead, an evolutionarily stable regime of real-information production arises only when regulatory rewards and punishment intensity, enterprise reputation loss, and user adoption incentives collectively surpass critical thresholds. The findings highlight the need for coordinated and adaptive policy mixes that align regulatory instruments with enterprise behavior and user uptake while managing governance costs.
papers.journal_ref: Humanities and Social Sciences Communications (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文用三方演化博弈（政府监管者、AI企业、用户）建模AI生成内容虚假信息治理中的策略相互依赖，纳入异质奖惩机制。通过复制者方程分析，作者刻画了治理与生产策略的演化稳定性，并指出只有当监管奖惩强度、企业声誉损失和用户采纳激励共同超过临界阈值时，真实信息生产才会成为演化稳定状态。
Motivation: AI生成内容快速扩散使得AI驱动虚假信息日益普遍且难以治理，削弱信息可信度与社会信任，单向监管或纯市场激励均不足以遏制虚假信息。
Method: 构建包含政府监管者、AI企业和用户的三方演化博弈模型，引入异质奖励与惩罚，利用复制者方程（replicator equations）分析各策略组合的演化稳定性。
Result: 分析表明，仅靠单边监管或市场激励都无法有效遏制虚假信息；只有当监管奖惩强度、企业声誉损失与用户采纳激励共同超过临界阈值时，真实信息生产才能形成演化稳定状态。
Conclusion: 研究强调需要协调且自适应的政策组合，将监管工具与企业行为、用户采纳相配套，同时控制治理成本。

papers.title: Which Decisions Low-Bit Quantization Breaks, and How to Predict Them
papers.abstract_en: Quantization is known to hurt below four bits, but nobody can say which of a model's decisions will change at a given bit-width. This matters most where a model acts rather than answers: a compressed agent stops calling its tools and, one bit lower, loses roughly half its safety refusals, while benchmark scores barely move. Prior work assumes the added noise has a roughly fixed size, which would make confident decisions safe. We measure the decision instead: the margin, the picked option's score minus its best alternative's, tracked before and after quantization across 16 models from 8 families under round-to-nearest, seven under AWQ, two under GPTQ and one under GGUF, at 8 down to 2 bits. The damage is proportional, not fixed in size: the margin is multiplied by a factor that collapses with bit-width (median 0.86 at 4 bits, 0.33 at 3, 0.00 at 2), which we call margin shrinkage. Contraction removes the protection a large margin affords; the model's own biases pick the direction: at 3 bits the decision to call a tool collapses toward inaction while the choice of which tool is untouched. No additive account, including one whose noise grows with the margin, wins a single damaged whether-to-call or safety cell (378 of 378). Given a condition's own constants the relation predicts held-out flip rates to a median 1.7 points, calibrated per decision (error 0.004 over 161,744 predictions), no flip used in the fit. Borrowed constants are wrong by 18-33 points at 3 bits, so the paired margin set has to be measured per model and bit-width: it locates breaking decisions without replacing measurement. At 4 bits the measurement is anchored to behaviour (the most likely token over the whole vocabulary is one of the item's two options in 85% of tool items); we treat the 2-bit floor as where the instrument stops measuring. No label-free repair we tested recovers more than one more bit does.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究低比特量化（8 比特到 2 比特）会破坏模型哪些决策，提出“margin shrinkage”概念：决策边界（所选选项得分与次优选项得分之差）在量化后近似被乘以一个随比特宽度坍缩的因子（4 比特中位数 0.86，3 比特 0.33，2 比特 0.00），而非被加上固定大小的噪声。作者在 8 个模型家族的 16 个模型上，用 round-to-nearest、AWQ、GPTQ、GGUF 等量化方式测量该效应，发现 3 比特时工具调用决策倾向于坍缩为不行动，而具体选哪个工具不受影响，安全拒绝也会大量丢失。
Motivation: 量化在低于 4 比特时已知会损害性能，但现有方法无法预测特定比特宽度下模型的哪些决策会改变；在智能体这类“行动”场景中，压缩后的模型会停止调用工具且丢失近一半安全拒绝，而 benchmark 分数几乎不变。此前工作假设附加噪声大小大致固定，从而认为高置信度决策是安全的，这一假设与实测不符。
Method: 作者直接测量决策 margin（选中选项分数减去最强替代选项分数）在量化前后的变化，在 8 到 2 比特下覆盖 16 个模型、8 个家族，并比较 round-to-nearest、AWQ、GPTQ 与 GGUF。他们提出 margin 被乘以一个随比特宽度缩小的因子（margin shrinkage），并用每个模型和比特宽度对应的 paired margin 集合，通过一个带条件常数的关系式预测翻转率，同时做逐决策校准。
Result: 摘要报告损伤是比例性的而非固定幅度：margin 的乘性因子在 4、3、2 比特时中位数分别为 0.86、0.33、0.00。没有任何加性噪声模型（包括噪声随 margin 增长的变体）能在 378 个受损的“是否调用工具”或安全细胞中胜出；给定条件自身的常数，关系式对留出集翻转率的预测中位误差为 1.7 个点，161,744 个预测上校准误差 0.004，且拟合未使用任何翻转样本。借用其他模型/比特宽度的常数在 3 比特时误差达 18–33 个点，因此 paired margin 集合必须按模型和比特宽度实测。
Conclusion: 作者强调 margin shrinkage 能够定位“会出问题的决策”，但不会取代测量本身：每个模型和比特宽度都需要实测 paired margin 集合。他们提到 4 比特时测量锚定到行为（工具项中 85% 的全词表最可能 token 是该项的两个选项之一），并把 2 比特视为测量工具失效的下限；测试过的无标签修复方法最多只能挽回 1 个比特的损失。

papers.title: iARCS: Iterative Agentic RL for Controllable 3D Scene Generation
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic 3D scene generation is increasingly used as a data source for computer vision and embodied AI, but existing generators often optimize perceptual realism without reliably satisfying task-critical functional constraints. This mismatch limits the usefulness of synthetic data for downstream training, where accessibility, traversability, and spatial rule compliance are often essential. We present iARCS, an iterative agentic reinforcement learning framework that adapts a pretrained scene generator to natural-language task requirements. iARCS uses a two-stage strategy: universal-reward pretraining to improve physical plausibility and layout quality, followed by task-specific fine-tuning with LLM-generated reward programs that are iteratively refined from training feedback. Experiments show improved constraint fidelity on walkability, reachability, and clearance-focused tasks, effective task-specific constraint optimization, and competitive scene diversity. We further show that data generated by iARCS improves a base generator, supporting its value as a practical synthetic data generation tool rather than only a controllable scene editing method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 iARCS，一种基于迭代智能体强化学习（agentic RL）的框架，用于将预训练的 3D 场景生成器适配到自然语言任务需求。方法采用两阶段策略：先以通用奖励（universal reward）预训练提升物理合理性和布局质量，再用由 LLM 生成并经训练反馈迭代细化的奖励程序进行任务特定微调。实验表明，该方法在可步行性（walkability）、可达性（reachability）和净空（clearance）等约束任务上提升约束保真度，同时保持有竞争力的场景多样性，且生成的数据能进一步改进基础生成器。
Motivation: 现有合成 3D 场景生成器主要优化感知真实感，常无法满足可访问性、可穿越性和空间规则等任务关键功能约束，导致合成数据对下游视觉与具身 AI 训练的价值受限。
Method: iARCS 采用两阶段自适应流程：通用奖励预训练用于改善物理合理性与布局质量；任务特定微调阶段使用 LLM 生成的奖励程序，并根据训练反馈迭代修正这些奖励程序。
Result: 实验在 walkability、reachability 和 clearance 相关任务上显示约束保真度提升，任务特定约束优化有效，场景多样性具有竞争力；此外，iARCS 生成的数据可改进基础生成器。
Conclusion: 作者将 iARCS 定位为实用的合成数据生成工具，而不仅是可控场景编辑方法；摘要未讨论明显局限。

papers.title: Short-term load forecasting under EU-AI Act Requirements in Safety-Critical Environments: Results from a 41-day live challenge on the aggregated German transmission-grid load
papers.abstract_en: Short-term load forecasting (STLF) plays a vital role in the electric power industry. It is relevant for critical infrastructure. STLF is no longer purely a performance and accuracy problem, because determinism, fail-safe handling, minimal-attack surface, and no dead code are software-engineering requirements rather than optional extras. This report describes results from a 41-day live challenge that evaluated an STLF pipeline for the aggregated German transmission-grid load. The STLF pipeline predicts the 24 hourly load values of a target day from European Network of Transmission System Operators for Electricity (ENTSO-E) data. It is based on the open-source Python library spotforecast2-safe, which tries to implement the EU-AI Act Requirements in Safety-Critical Environments by design. The STLF pipeline includes gap- and anomaly-aware data preprocessing, calendar and weather covariates, and a forecasting algorithm. Forecast quality is compared to the official ENTSO-E day-ahead forecast. The spotforecast2-safe pipeline beats the ENTSO-E baseline. In-context models show competitive performance. Transparent, deterministic, low-cost, and auditable local models (referred to as macl2l in this report) are competitive with more than 100-million-parameter large, energy-intensive pre-trained foundation models such as chronos-2. The challenge implementation, the submission history of all teams, and the archived leaderboard are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了一个为期 41 天的实时挑战赛结果，用于评估针对德国输电网聚合负荷的短期负荷预测 (STLF) 流水线。该流水线基于开源 Python 库 spotforecast2-safe，从 ENTSO-E 数据预测目标日 24 个小时负荷值；结果显示其优于官方 ENTSO-E 日前预测，且透明、确定性、低成本的本地模型 (macl2l) 与参数量超过 1 亿的预训练基础模型 chronos-2 具有竞争力。挑战实现、各团队提交历史和最终排行榜均公开。
Motivation: 短期负荷预测对关键基础设施至关重要，且不再只是精度问题；在安全关键环境下，确定性、故障安全处理、最小攻击面和无死代码等软件工程需求是欧盟 AI 法案 (EU-AI Act) 要求的一部分。
Method: 提出并公开基于 spotforecast2-safe 库的 STLF 流水线，按设计尝试满足 EU-AI Act 对安全关键环境的要求；流水线包含缺口与异常感知的数据预处理、日历和天气协变量以及预测算法，并通过 41 天实时挑战赛进行评估。
Result: 摘要报告该流水线在德国输电网聚合负荷预测上击败官方 ENTSO-E 日前预测基线；in-context 模型表现具有竞争力，本地可审计模型 macl2l 也能与超过 1 亿参数的预训练基础模型 chronos-2 媲美。
Conclusion: 作者强调透明、确定性、低成本和可审计的本地模型可以在该任务上与大型预训练基础模型竞争，并提供公开的挑战实现和排行榜以供复现。

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告该流水线在德国输电网聚合负荷预测上击败官方 ENTSO-E 日前预测基线；in-context 模型表现具有竞争力，本地可审计模型 macl2l 也能与超过 1 亿参数的预训练基础模型 chronos-2 媲美。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调透明、确定性、低成本和可审计的本地模型可以在该任务上与大型预训练基础模型竞争，并提供公开的挑战实现和排行榜以供复现。

papers.title: A GitOps-Driven Annotation Catalog for Fully Automatic Railway Operations
papers.abstract_en: Automatic train operation (ATO) at grade of automation 3 and above (GoA3-GoA4) requires robust AI-based perception systems capable of reliably detecting obstacles and railway-specific objects under real-world conditions. The effectiveness of these modern artificial intelligence approaches depends heavily on large-scale, high-quality, and highly dynamic annotated datasets. However, managing metadata, maintaining provenance, and tracking the iterative evolution of these annotations impose significant infrastructural and regulatory requirements. Existing monolithic data catalogs often suffer from massive operational overhead, poor integration into developer workflows, and severe documentation drift. This paper introduces an innovative, lightweight GitOps-based architecture for metadata management. By leveraging Data-as-Code principles, Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, and Static Site Generation (SSG), the proposed approach establishes a seamless, developer-centric workflow. This ensures an traceability, enforces strict regulatory compliance, and automatically generates a highly performant dataset overview.
papers.journal_ref: 16th International Conference on Advanced Computer Information Technologies in Zlín, Czech Republic, 2026
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: From Multi-Resolution Cells to Gigapixel Whole Slide Images Foundation Model for Computational Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) and their hierarchical variants have achieved strong performance in Computational Pathology (CPath). However, most are pre-trained on single-resolution Whole Slide Images (WSIs), limiting their generalization across arbitrary resolutions. Gigapixel WSIs inherently contain diagnostic patterns at multiple scales, including cellular morphologies, tissue architectures, and global context, mirroring how expert pathologists examine WSIs. We introduce Multi-Resolution Pyramid Transformer (MRPT), a model that hierarchically aggregates multi-resolution information from cellular to tissue and WSI levels. MRPT employs a biologically meaningful Consecutive Cross-Resolution Attention (CCRA) mechanism to capture scale-independent interactions and enforces multi-resolution semantic consistency by aligning embeddings across resolutions, yielding robust and generalizable WSI representations. Pre-trained in a multi-resolution self-supervised manner on 624M patches, 2.4M regions, and 36K WSIs, MRPT learns rich coarse-to-fine histopathology features. Extensive experiments on 34 diverse datasets show that MRPT surpasses recent foundation models and Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in cancer subtype classification, tissue phenotyping, and Visual Question Answering (VQA) for WSI understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多分辨率金字塔 Transformer（MRPT），用于计算病理学中的千兆像素全切片图像（WSI）表示学习。MRPT 在细胞、组织和 WSI 三个层级上层次化聚合多分辨率信息，并采用连续跨分辨率注意力（CCRA）与跨分辨率语义一致性对齐。模型以多分辨率自监督方式在 624M patches、2.4M regions 和 36K WSIs 上预训练，在 34 个数据集上超过近期基础模型和多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）。
Motivation: 现有 Vision Transformer 及其层级变体大多在单一分辨率的 WSI 上预训练，限制了模型在任意分辨率下的泛化能力；而千兆像素 WSI 的诊断模式天然存在于细胞形态、组织结构和全局上下文等多个尺度。
Method: 提出 Multi-Resolution Pyramid Transformer (MRPT)，通过层次化结构从细胞到组织再到 WSI 聚合多分辨率信息；使用生物学上有意义的 Consecutive Cross-Resolution Attention (CCRA) 捕获尺度无关的交互，并对齐各分辨率嵌入以强化多分辨率语义一致性，最后以多分辨率自监督方式进行预训练。
Result: 在 34 个多样化数据集上的大量实验表明，MRPT 在癌症亚型分类、组织表型分析和 WSI 视觉问答（VQA）任务上均超过近期基础模型和多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）。
Conclusion: 作者认为，多分辨率自监督预训练与跨分辨率一致性约束能够学习到鲁棒且可泛化的 WSI 表示，从而支持多种下游病理分析任务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Surrogate Substitution Preserves PHI Detectability: A Multi-Detector Equivalence Study
papers.abstract_en: Structure-preserving de-identification replaces protected health information (PHI) with realistic same-type surrogates -- "Anna S." becomes "Maria S.", not [NAME] -- so that clinical text stays fluent and downstream tools keep working. But this only helps if the substitution does not itself corrupt the signal those tools rely on. We ask a narrow, testable question: on the spans a de-identifier actually masks, can downstream PHI detectors still find the surrogate? We introduce a paired, multi-detector evaluation protocol that (i) scores utility only on masked spans, decoupling coverage from utility; (ii) uses equivalence testing (TOST) rather than null-hypothesis significance testing, which is uninformative at our sample size (57k paired spans); and (iii) builds a surrogate-failure typology separating fixable generator defects from intrinsic detector limits. Across 11 detectors, 7 benchmarks, and 7 languages (1,750 documents), recall on masked spans moves from 76.1% to 74.9% -- a change our equivalence test shows is statistically equivalent to zero within a +/-2-point margin (p ~ 3e-9), with detector ranking preserved. The residual loss does not reflect detectors getting worse at PHI: it concentrates in malformed and out-of-distribution surrogates (truncation Chicago -> Illino, salience loss Cedars-Sinai -> Vidant). A redaction floor and an open-source surrogate baseline indicate the effect is a property of well-formed substitution, not of one tool. We release the evaluation subsets, scoring code, and an interactive dashboard at https://custodianai.pages.dev so the protocol can audit any structure-preserving transform.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 10 tables. Code, data, and interactive dashboard: https://custodianai.pages.dev ; repository: https://github.com/Custodian-Labs/guardian-layer-phi-benchmark

papers.title: DiffImaginE: Imagine to Verify Entity Types with Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal named entity recognition (MNER) determines whether each candidate span and entity-type hypothesis is supported by joint textual and visual evidence. Existing imagine-and-compare verifiers map each (span, type) pair to one predicted visual feature, compressing diverse visual realisations into a single prototype and providing a compatibility score without explicit probabilistic semantics. We introduce DiffImaginE, which formulates MNER type verification as conditional latent diffusion inference. Given span-localised visual evidence, a type-conditioned denoiser predicts noise injected into its standardised latent. The resulting denoising error provides an ELBO-consistent surrogate for type-conditional negative log-likelihood, allowing competing type hypotheses to be ranked by how well they explain the observation. DiffImaginE retains a standard multimodal encoder stack and replaces the deterministic verifier with a classifier-free-guided diffusion scorer trained using Min-SNR weighting. We directly supervise per-type diffusion scores as classification logits, learn aggregation across noise levels, and use antithetic sampling to reduce Monte Carlo comparison variance. Our analysis shows that classifier-free guidance sharpens the induced type posterior and characterises when antithetic pairing reduces variance at equal denoiser cost. Experiments on Twitter-2015 and Twitter-2017 show consistent gains over a matched deterministic ImaginE control under the same encoder, auxiliary objectives, and evaluation protocol, supported by ablations and paired significance tests.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiffImaginE，将多模态命名实体识别（MNER）中的类型验证建模为条件潜在扩散推理。给定 span 局部视觉证据，类型条件去噪器预测注入标准潜在空间的噪声，去噪误差作为类型条件负对数似然的 ELBO 一致代理，从而对候选类型假设排序。在 Twitter-2015 和 Twitter-2017 上的实验显示，相比匹配的确定性 ImaginE 控制，该方法在相同编码器、辅助目标和评估协议下取得持续提升。
Motivation: 现有 imagine-and-compare 验证器将每个 (span, type) 对映射到单一的预测视觉特征，把多样的视觉实现压缩成单一原型，只提供兼容性分数而不具备显式的概率语义。
Method: 用一个类型条件去噪器预测注入标准潜在空间的噪声，将去噪误差作为类型条件负对数似然的代理；训练采用 classifier-free guidance 与 Min-SNR 加权，直接监督每类扩散分数作为分类 logits，学习跨噪声水平的聚合，并用 antithetic sampling 降低蒙特卡洛比较方差。
Result: 在 Twitter-2015 和 Twitter-2017 上，DiffImaginE 相对匹配的确定性 ImaginE 控制有一致提升，并附有消融实验和配对显著性检验支持。
Conclusion: 分析表明 classifier-free guidance 能使诱导的类型后验更尖锐，并刻画了 antithetic pairing 在相同去噪器成本下何时能降低方差。摘要强调该概率化扩散评分器可在保留标准多模态编码器结构的同时替代确定性验证器。

papers.title: Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0: A Unified Multimodal Model for Scalable 3D Generation, Understanding, and Editing
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in image generation have demonstrated the potential of unified multimodal models that integrate understanding, generation, and editing. However, unified 3D modeling remains constrained by scarce multimodal data, particularly the lack of large-scale and geometrically consistent editing data. To address this limitation, we propose Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0, a unified framework supporting 3D understanding, text-to-3D generation, instruction-guided 3D editing, and text-grounded part generation within a single architecture. To enable scalable training, we construct an 87M-scale 3D multimodal corpus, comprising 25M understanding samples, 50M text-to-3D pairs, and 12M editing pairs generated using Nano3D-v2. Architecturally, the framework combines Hunyuan3D-VLM for semantic, structural, and spatial understanding with Hunyuan3D DiT for high-fidelity 3D synthesis. The VLM provides multimodal semantic conditions for generation, while editing and part generation additionally condition the diffusion process on the source object representation to preserve its overall structure and unedited regions. Extensive experiments show that Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0 achieves state-of-the-art or leading performance on text-to-3D generation and 3D editing benchmarks, while exhibiting strong understanding and part-generation capabilities. Our analysis further shows that both generation and understanding improve editing, demonstrating the effectiveness of unified 3D multimodal training. Project Page: https://tencent-hunyuan.github.io/Hunyuan3D-Buffalo1.0/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0，一个统一的多模态 3D 框架，在单一架构中支持 3D 理解、文生 3D、指令引导的 3D 编辑以及文本引导的部件生成。为支撑可扩展训练，作者构建了 87M 规模的 3D 多模态语料库，包含 25M 理解样本、50M 文生 3D 对和 12M 编辑对（由 Nano3D-v2 生成）。架构结合 Hunyuan3D-VLM 提供语义、结构和空间理解，以及 Hunyuan3D DiT 进行高保真 3D 合成。实验表明该方法在文生 3D 和 3D 编辑基准上达到领先性能，并展现出较强的理解与部件生成能力。
Motivation: 统一的 3D 多模态建模受限于稀缺的多模态数据，尤其缺少大规模且几何一致的编辑数据，这限制了将理解、生成和编辑整合到单一模型中的可行性。
Method: 提出统一框架 Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0，由 Hunyuan3D-VLM 提供多模态语义条件，Hunyuan3D DiT 负责 3D 合成；编辑和部件生成额外以源对象表示作为扩散条件，以保留整体结构和未编辑区域。训练数据通过构建 87M 规模语料库实现可扩展训练。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在文生 3D 与 3D 编辑基准上取得 state-of-the-art 或领先性能，并具备较强的理解与部件生成能力；分析还表明生成和理解相互促进编辑，验证了统一 3D 多模态训练的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统一 3D 多模态训练能够同时提升理解、生成与编辑，且大规模几何一致的编辑数据是释放该能力的关键。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告该方法在文生 3D 与 3D 编辑基准上取得 state-of-the-art 或领先性能，并具备较强的理解与部件生成能力；分析还表明生成和理解相互促进编辑，验证了统一 3D 多模态训练的有效性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调统一 3D 多模态训练能够同时提升理解、生成与编辑，且大规模几何一致的编辑数据是释放该能力的关键。

papers.title: Pseudorandom Streams within Diffusion Models Act as Learnable Inputs That Affect Generation Quality
papers.abstract_en: Digital learning systems consume concrete pseudorandom values rather than abstract random variables. These values enter the realized loss and its gradient during training. If a pseudorandom stream contains structure that is accessible to the model, this structure can therefore become part of what the learning system learns. We show that this effect can be strong enough to change generation quality in diffusion models. For diffusion noise prediction, there are two related routes by which the loss can be reduced. The model can learn regularities of the clean data and use them to infer the added noise. It can also exploit regularities of the noise source itself to recover the realized noise from the noisy input. Random-role ablation shows that the dominant source-dependent effect in our experiments is associated with the diffusion-noise roles. A diffusion probe that removes reusable real-image structure still shows clear source-dependent noise-prediction learning, and its source ordering closely matches that of real-data diffusion training. Different pseudorandom sources also produce large differences in generation quality on MNIST and CIFAR-10. Further experiments show that the same source structure can also be learned in an independent next-value prediction task, although this is not the learning mechanism used by the diffusion model. Changing the probe clean reference preserves much of the source ordering while changing the numerical response, producing clean-reference-dependent power-law relations. Overall, the results show that a pseudorandom stream is not only a source of stochastic variation: its concrete structure can act as a learnable input whose effect depends on the learning system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究扩散模型训练中伪随机流（pseudorandom stream）的具体结构是否会被模型当作可学习输入。作者表明，若伪随机源含有模型可访问的结构，该结构会进入损失与梯度，进而可能改变生成质量。通过随机角色消融与扩散探针实验，他们发现源相关的噪声预测学习与真实数据扩散训练中的源排序接近，且不同伪随机源在 MNIST 和 CIFAR-10 上造成明显的生成质量差异。整体结论是伪随机流不仅是随机变异来源，其具体结构可依据学习系统而被学习。
Motivation: 数字学习系统实际消费的是具体伪随机值，而非抽象随机变量，但这些值通常被当作纯粹的随机性来源。作者想检验伪随机流中可被模型访问的结构是否会成为学习内容的一部分，并评估这种效应是否足以影响扩散模型的生成质量。
Method: 在扩散模型噪声预测设置下，采用随机角色消融区分模型利用的是干净数据规律还是噪声源本身的规律；使用扩散探针去除可复用的真实图像结构以验证源相关学习的稳健性；并在独立的下一值预测任务中检验同一源结构是否可单独学习；同时变换探针的干净参考以观察排序与数值响应的变化。
Result: 随机角色消融表明，实验中占主导的源相关效应来自扩散噪声角色；去除真实图像结构后，源相关的噪声预测学习依然清晰，且源排序与真实数据扩散训练接近；不同伪随机源在 MNIST 与 CIFAR-10 上带来大的生成质量差异；更换干净参考会保留大量源排序但改变数值响应，并产生依赖干净参考的幂律关系。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，伪随机流的具体结构可以作为可学习输入影响扩散模型的生成质量，其效果依赖于具体的学习系统；伪随机源的选取本身可能构成影响训练结果的一个实际因素。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DAPD: Dual-Anchored Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy (self) distillation (OPSD) is increasingly adopted for language-model post-training. It strengthens the teacher with privileged information but can induce a privilege illusion: the student learns privilege-dependent behavior it cannot reproduce from its inference-time context, yet behaves as if the training-time privileged information remained available, ultimately degrading performance. In this paper, we identify information asymmetry between the privileged teacher and the student at inference as the root cause of this failure in OPSD. To resolve this asymmetry, we propose Dual-Anchored Policy Distillation (DAPD), a unified framework with two levels of anchoring. Dual-Path Anchoring (DPA) introduces a self-conditioned bridge and aligns reference and rollout behavior along two matched-information paths, preventing privilege-dependent behavior from being transferred to the inference-time student. Dual-Source Anchoring (DSA) applies these paths in both reference-to-rollout and rollout-to-reference directions, reducing reliance on privileged reference guidance while preserving correctness supervision. Extensive experiments show that DAPD significantly alleviates privilege illusion, outperforming OPSD on Qwen3-4B by +2.00 points on average across tasks. Notably, its gains persist across scales, reaching +2.69 at 4B and +2.78 at 32B.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语言模型后训练中 on-policy (self) distillation (OPSD) 出现的“特权幻觉”(privilege illusion) 问题，提出 Dual-Anchored Policy Distillation (DAPD) 统一框架。作者将教师特权信息与学生推理时信息不对称视为失败根源，并通过 Dual-Path Anchoring (DPA) 和 Dual-Source Anchoring (DSA) 两级锚定来阻断特权依赖行为的迁移。实验显示 DAPD 在 Qwen3-4B 上平均提升 +2.00 点，且在 4B 和 32B 规模上分别达到 +2.69 和 +2.78。
Motivation: OPSD 中教师利用训练时特权信息强化学生，但学生会学到依赖特权信息的行为，而推理时这些信息不可用，从而产生特权幻觉并导致性能下降。作者指出根本原因是特权教师与学生推理时的信息不对称。
Method: 提出 DAPD 框架，包含两级锚定：Dual-Path Anchoring (DPA) 引入自条件化桥接 (self-conditioned bridge)，并沿两条信息匹配路径对齐参考 (reference) 与 rollout 行为，避免特权依赖行为传给推理时的学生；Dual-Source Anchoring (DSA) 在 reference-to-rollout 与 rollout-to-reference 两个方向上应用这些路径，降低对特权参考指导的依赖，同时保留正确性监督。
Result: 摘要报告 DAPD 显著缓解特权幻觉，在 Qwen3-4B 上平均超过 OPSD +2.00 点；收益跨规模保持，4B 时为 +2.69，32B 时为 +2.78。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过双路径与双源锚定消除信息不对称，可以有效缓解 OPSD 中的特权幻觉，并指出该收益在更大模型规模上依然存在。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beckmann Transport Models: From Autonomous Flows to One-Step Maps
papers.abstract_en: We propose an instantiation of flow matching that relies on a time-independent velocity field (an \emph{autonomous flow}) to exactly map between two distributions, so long as the target is singular, i.e.\ supported on a lower-dimensional data manifold. We also show that the one-step generative map associated with this flow is the unique solution of a simple conservation equation, which can be used to learn the map directly from samples. These autonomous flows and maps give a dynamical meaning to the flux constraint of Beckmann's transportation problem. Their construction provides a unifying framework that recovers, for instance, the closed-form Poisson-flow generative model and equilibrium matching with a quadratic flow-matching regression loss. We illustrate how this theory corrects inconsistencies in existing methods and demonstrate the effectiveness of the autonomous flow and the one-step map on ImageNet 256x256.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于时间无关速度场（自主流）的 flow matching 实例，用于在目标分布为奇异、即支持在低维数据流形上时，精确地将一个分布映射到另一个分布。作者进一步证明该流对应的一步生成映射是某个简单守恒方程的唯一解，因此可直接从样本学习该映射。该框架为 Beckmann 输运问题中的通量约束赋予动力学意义，并统一了 Poisson-flow 生成模型与使用二次 flow-matching 回归损失的 equilibrium matching，最后在 ImageNet 256x256 上验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有 flow matching 方法通常依赖时间相关速度场，且涉及奇异目标分布（低维流形上的数据）的生成模型在构造上存在不一致之处。作者希望给出一个统一框架来修正这些不一致，并阐明自主流与经典输运问题之间的联系。
Method: 构造时间无关速度场驱动的自主流（autonomous flow），使其与 Beckmann 输运问题中的通量约束建立动力学对应；一步生成映射被刻画为一个简单守恒方程的唯一解，并利用该方程直接从样本学习映射。
Result: 摘要报告该方法能恢复 Poisson-flow 生成模型和带二次 flow-matching 回归损失的 equilibrium matching 等现有方法的闭式形式，纠正了现有方法中的不一致，并在 ImageNet 256x256 上展示了自主流与一步映射的有效性。
Conclusion: 该理论为奇异分布之间的生成映射提供了统一框架，并强调其对现有方法不一致性的修正意义；摘要本身未涉及降水、临近预报或天气数据等应用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Generative Brownian Bridge Diffusion In Motion Space For Enhanced Myocardial Strain Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Myocardial strain analysis of cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) images provides an important tool for evaluating cardiac function. However, current techniques require either human-adjusted post-processing with suboptimal regional accuracy, or specialized acquisitions with limited availability. In this paper, we propose to leverage the power of generative models to synthesize high-quality motion-derived strain values from routinely acquired CMR sequences. Specifically, we develop a novel Brownian bridge diffusion model in motion space to learn the probabilistic mapping between standard CMR motion estimated from widely adopted registration methods and highly accurate motion provided by advanced strain imaging techniques. To promote the fidelity of anatomical structure in the generation process, our model is conditioned on the corresponding CMR images. We validate our method on large-scale multi-center CMR datasets including subjects of paired standard cine CMR and advanced strain imaging acquisitions. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework significantly improves the accuracy of motion prediction and strain analysis from standard CMRs compared to existing learning-based approaches. Our research represents a new paradigm for potentially developing cost-effective, clinically deployable AI tools for cardiac function assessment with enhanced strain accuracy in busy clinical workflows. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Rishov-MIA/Brownian-Bridge-strain-analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种生成式布朗桥扩散模型 (Brownian bridge diffusion model)，在运动空间 (motion space) 中学习从常规 CMR 序列经标准配准方法得到的运动估计到先进应变成像技术提供的高精度运动之间的概率映射，并以对应 CMR 图像为条件约束解剖结构保真度。方法在大规模多中心 CMR 数据集上验证，摘要报告相比已有学习方法显著提升了标准 CMR 的运动预测与应变分析精度。
Motivation: 现有心肌应变分析要么依赖人工调整的后处理且区域精度欠佳，要么需要可用性受限的特殊采集序列；作者希望利用生成模型从常规采集的 CMR 序列合成高质量应变值，以降低临床部署门槛。
Method: 在运动空间构建布朗桥扩散模型，学习常规配准运动与先进应变成像高精度运动之间的概率映射，并将对应 CMR 图像作为条件输入以保持解剖结构真实性；使用配对的标准 cine CMR 与先进应变成像数据训练。
Result: 在大规模多中心 CMR 数据集（含配对标准 cine CMR 与先进应变成像采集）上的实验表明，该框架相比现有学习方法显著提高了标准 CMR 的运动预测与应变分析精度。
Conclusion: 作者认为这项工作为在繁忙临床流程中开发经济、可部署的心脏功能 AI 评估工具提供了新范式，并公开了代码。

papers.title: Thermalizing Stochastic Programs
papers.abstract_en: We present a set of tools for mapping general stochastic programs to thermodynamic hardware designed for energy-efficient stochastic sampling. Given a target stochastic program expressed as a Directed Factor Graph (DFG) of stochastic channels, or equivalently as a Parametrized Stochastic Circuit (PSC), we first introduce a method to approximately compile each factor in the DFG to an Energy-Based Model (EBM) that is native to the hardware. We then analyze how the error of the compiled DFG accumulates from the per-factor errors, and introduce two training refinements, context matching and trajectory-level REINFORCE post-training, which can reduce the residual error left by training each factor in isolation. The \texttt{thermalizers} framework takes a stochastic program expressed in the \texttt{torx} library and replaces its factors with thermodynamic kernels implemented and sampled using the \texttt{thrml} library. We demonstrate it on several example applications, including a market simulator that learns the joint day-to-day dynamics of a panel of financial time series from recorded market history alone, a probabilistic model from mathematical ecology, Gibbs sampling of an EBM the hardware cannot natively express, and a sequential Bayesian design loop over a Gaussian stochastic circuit.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 随机采样在硬件上通常能耗高，目标是如何将通用随机程序高效映射到专门为节能随机采样设计的热力学硬件。逐因子独立训练会留下残余误差，需要对其累积效应进行控制。
Method: 先引入一种方法将 DFG/PSC 中的每个因子近似编译为硬件原生 EBM；然后分析编译后 DFG 的误差如何从逐因子误差累积；再提出两种训练细化，即上下文匹配（context matching）和轨迹级 REINFORCE 后训练（trajectory-level REINFORCE post-training），以降低逐因子孤立训练留下的残差。整个流程通过 thermalizers 框架实现，把 torx 表达的程序转为 thrml 的热力学核。

papers.title: Round-Trip Consistency: Bidirectional Diffusion Models Can Predict Their Own Rollout Errors
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive models accumulate error over long rollouts, yet at deployment there is no ground truth to measure it against. We train a single conditional latent diffusion model that steps a dynamical system forward or backward in time via a direction flag, and show that this bidirectionality supplies a measurement-free test-time error signal: rolling forward $i$ steps and then backward $i$ steps must return the model to its start, so the round-trip discrepancy $\mathcal{C}_i$ is a self-supervised proxy for the unobservable rollout error: no ensembles, no held-out data, no governing equations, for one extra rollout. We validate on compressible magnetohydrodynamics (MHD), an astrophysical turbulent radiative mixing layer, and natural face videos (CelebV-HQ). On held-out MHD trajectories, $\mathcal{C}_i$ ranks rollout error (Spearman $0.91$-$0.98$ at fixed depth; $0.69 \pm 0.16$ within trajectories), and a simple calibrator fit on training rollouts predicts its magnitude to within $1.14\times$ ($68\%$) and $1.29\times$ ($95\%$) with near-nominal coverage - one nat beyond a depth-only predictor, transferring to all six decoded physical fields. The same signal flags the out-of-distribution Orszag-Tang vortex (AUROC $0.98$; $1.0$ by depth $10$) exactly where sampling-dispersion baselines invert, and it cuts incurred error by $15\%$ at $80\%$ coverage - three times the depth-only baseline. Bidirectional training comes at negative cost, beating direction specialists in both directions, and the backward direction doubles as a fast inverse solver. On LE-PDE-UQ's turbulent Navier-Stokes benchmark, a single bidirectional model reaches accuracy within $1.3\times$ of their ten-model ensemble at a tenth of the training cost, with the best training-free pixel-level calibration. Round-trip consistency turns reversibility into a practical trust signal for generative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用单个条件潜在扩散模型，通过方向标志（direction flag）同时学习正向和反向时间演化，并利用往返一致性（round-trip consistency）作为免测量的测试时误差信号：前向 i 步再反向 i 步的差异 C_i 可作为不可观测 rollout 误差的自监督代理。作者在可压缩磁流体力学（MHD）、湍流辐射混合层和自然人脸视频（CelebV-HQ）上验证，并在 LE-PDE-UQ 的湍流 Navier-Stokes 基准上展示单个双向模型以十分之一训练成本达到十模型集成约 1.3 倍内的精度。
Motivation: 自回归类模型在长 rollout 中会累积误差，但部署时没有 ground truth 可用来衡量误差大小。作者希望在不使用集成、不依赖留出数据或控制方程的情况下，获得一个可操作的测试时置信信号。
Method: 训练一个带方向条件的单一潜在扩散模型，使其既能前向又能反向演化动力学系统；测试时通过计算往返差异 C_i 作为 rollout 误差的代理，并额外训练一个基于训练 rollout 的简单校准器来预测误差量级。
Result: 在留出 MHD 轨迹上，C_i 对 rollout 误差排序的 Spearman 相关系数为固定深度 0.91–0.98、轨迹内 0.69±0.16；校准器预测幅度在 68% 和 95% 覆盖率下分别达到 1.14 倍和 1.29 倍误差以内。该信号在 Orszag-Tang 涡旋这类分布外数据上取得 AUROC 0.98，并在 80% 覆盖率下将实际误差削减 15%，是三倍于仅用深度的基线。
Conclusion: 作者提出往返一致性能把动力学系统的可逆性转化为生成模型的实用信任信号，且双向训练的额外成本为负（在正反两个方向上都优于仅单向训练的模型）。摘要未讨论该方法在不可逆系统或更长 rollout 上的局限。

papers.title: LOCUS-DT: Localization via Observation-Conditioned Uncertainty Scoring with Digital Twins
papers.abstract_en: Accurate indoor localization is essential for emerging applications in robotic navigation and search and rescue. While classical methods typically focus on single-point estimates, complex indoor environments with heavy blockage and multipath propagation often lead to multimodal likelihood surfaces where a single estimate is insufficient. This paper proposes LOCUS-DT (Localization via Observation-Conditioned Uncertainty Scoring with Digital Twins), a framework that treats snapshot localization as posterior inference over the transmitter location. By leveraging a ray-tracing-based digital twin (DT) of the known environment, LOCUS-DT generates synthetic multipath profiles for candidate locations and compares them against the measured channel profile. Central to our approach is a novel learned scoring function designed to compare a fixed number of dominant specular paths, providing robustness against errors in both the DT environment model and the physical channel estimation. Importantly, LOCUS-DT is trained over an ensemble of environments to ensure generalization to unseen layouts. We evaluate the system using a Sionna-based ray-tracing backend, demonstrating that LOCUS-DT captures the sharp, multimodal posterior structures inherent in indoor settings more accurately than standard Gaussian or Gaussian-mixture benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LOCUS-DT，一种利用数字孪生 (digital twin) 和射线追踪 (ray-tracing) 进行室内快照定位的框架，将定位建模为对发射机位置的后验推断。通过学习的评分函数比较固定数量的主镜面路径，LOCUS-DT 对数字孪生环境模型误差和信道估计误差具有鲁棒性，并在多个环境上训练以泛化到未见布局。基于 Sionna 射线追踪后端的评估表明，该方法比标准高斯或高斯混合基准更能捕捉室内场景中尖锐的多模态后验结构。
Motivation: 室内定位面临遮挡和多径传播，似然面常呈多模态，单点估计不足以刻画不确定性，现有经典方法主要提供单点估计。
Method: 利用已知环境的射线追踪数字孪生为候选位置生成合成多径轮廓，与实测信道轮廓比较；核心是一种学习的评分函数，用于比较固定数量的主导镜面路径，并对环境模型和信道估计误差具有鲁棒性；模型在环境集成上训练以保证对未见布局的泛化。
Result: 基于 Sionna 射线追踪后端评估，LOCUS-DT 比标准高斯或高斯混合基准更准确地捕捉室内定位固有的尖锐多模态后验结构。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架通过后验推断和多环境训练能有效处理室内多径环境的不确定性，但未报告具体数值指标或局限性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Commit Locally, Exit Globally: Coordinating Adaptive Sampling and Early Exit in Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models expose a provisional prediction at every denoising step, and on many tasks the candidate answer inside it stabilizes before the step schedule is exhausted. This creates two acceleration opportunities, leaving a block early and stopping the sequence early, but the two require different criteria because block acceleration is local whereas sequence termination is global and freezes the graded answer. Existing methods usually optimize only one axis, and existing exit gates rely on fixed-region confidence or schedule-dependent rules rather than the candidate answer itself. We present $\textbf{C}^4$, which coordinates the two axes by giving each decision its own gate. $\textbf{C}$onfidence-Verified Early Exit (CVEE) decides when the sequence may stop, requiring confidence and sustained argmax stability over a candidate span re-extracted at every step. $\textbf{C}$ommit-$\textbf{C}$ore-Then-$\textbf{C}$onfirm (CCTC) decides which token positions a step may commit by borrowing an autoregressive freezing order inside each block: it commits a boundary-anchored core and confirms deferred positions one step later, so the answer block can be accelerated without allowing local commits inside the answer span to determine sequence-level termination. On 12 zero-shot tasks with LLaDA and Dream, one frozen configuration removes 64--95% of decoding steps and delivers measured end-to-end speedups of 2.6 to 8.6 over full decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/ming053l/C4-dLLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 C^4，在扩散语言模型 (diffusion language model) 中同时协调两种解码加速：提前离开去噪块 (early exiting) 与提前终止序列 (early stopping)。作者为两种决策分别设计门控：CVEE 基于置信度和 argmax 持续稳定性决定序列何时停止，CCTC 在块内借用自回归冻结顺序决定哪些 token 位置可以先提交。在 LLaDA 与 Dream 上的 12 个零样本任务中，单一冻结配置可去除 64–95% 的解码步，并带来 2.6–8.6 倍的端到端加速。
Motivation: 现有扩散语言模型加速方法通常只优化块的提前退出或序列的提前终止之一，且已有出口门控依赖固定区域置信度或依赖调度规则的启发式，而不是直接利用每一步重新提取出的候选答案本身。由于块的加速是局部的、而序列终止是全局的且会冻结最终答案，两条轴需要不同的判据，现有方法未能统一处理。
Method: 提出 C^4 框架，为每条加速轴设置独立门控：CVEE (Confidence-Verified Early Exit) 在每一步重新提取候选答案区间，要求置信度与 argmax 的持续稳定性后才允许序列停止；CCTC (Commit-Core-Then-Confirm) 在块内按边界锚定的核心区间先行提交、延迟位置延后一步确认，从而在不让局部提交决定全局终止的前提下加速回答块。
Result: 在 LLaDA 和 Dream 上的 12 个零样本任务中，一个固定的配置可去除 64–95% 的解码步骤，实测端到端加速为完整解码的 2.6–8.6 倍。
Conclusion: 作者强调，将局部块加速与全局序列终止分开、并让两者使用各自基于候选答案的门控判据，可以同时获得显著的去步效果与端到端加速；具体局限性在摘要中未提及。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Noise Premium in Adversarial Training for Kernel Regression
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial training can improve the robustness of predictive models to bounded perturbations, often at the cost of statistical efficiency. We study this trade-off in kernel regression over a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). It is shown that, under squared loss, adversarial training in RKHS introduces a term involving the product of the function norm with the mean absolute value of the response noise, which we call the \textit{noise premium}. Our analysis shows that the noise premium makes the prediction error of adversarial training converge strictly more slowly than the nonparametric minimax benchmark even after balancing approximation and estimation errors. Moreover, for a fixed perturbation budget, once the budget exceeds a certain threshold, the solution to adversarial training collapses to the zero function. To mitigate these effects of the noise premium, we propose noise-debiased adversarial training. The resulting noise-debiased estimator can attain the minimax optimal rate up to a logarithmic factor for the prediction error, raises the collapse threshold, and admits an explicit bound on the increase in adversarial loss. Numerical experiments on synthetic and real data support the theoretical findings and validate the effectiveness of the proposed noise-debiased method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究核回归（kernel regression over RKHS）中对抗训练（adversarial training）在鲁棒性与统计效率之间的权衡。作者证明在平方损失下，对抗训练会引入一个由函数范数与响应噪声均值绝对值乘积构成的“噪声溢价”（noise premium），使预测误差收敛速度严格慢于非参数极小极大（minimax）基准；并提出噪声去偏对抗训练（noise-debiased adversarial training）来缓解该问题。数值实验在合成与真实数据上支持理论结果。
Motivation: 对抗训练能提升模型对有限扰动的鲁棒性，但常牺牲统计效率；本文聚焦核回归场景，希望从理论层面刻画响应噪声对对抗训练泛化误差的影响，并给出可修复的估计方法。
Method: 在 RKHS 上对平方损失下的对抗训练做理论分析，识别出噪声溢价项；随后提出噪声去偏对抗训练估计器，以消除该溢价带来的收敛速度损失，并提升对抗训练解崩溃（collapse）的扰动预算阈值。
Result: 理论结果表明对抗训练的预测误差收敛严格慢于非参数极小极大基准；对固定扰动预算，一旦预算超过某阈值，解会退化为零函数。去偏后的估计器可将预测误差恢复到至多相差对数因子的极小极大最优速率，提高崩溃阈值，并给出对抗损失增加的显式界；合成与真实数据的数值实验验证了这些结论。
Conclusion: 作者认为噪声溢价是对抗训练在核回归中统计效率下降的关键机制，所提出的噪声去偏对抗训练可以在保持鲁棒性的同时恢复近乎最优的收敛速率。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Subtract, Transport, or Replay? Auditable Deletion from Language-Model Memory
papers.abstract_en: Exact deletion from persistent language-model memory depends on whether a record's effect remains addressable after later computation. Native Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) gives a negative result for the tested receipt interface: the corpus-pooled raw recurrent contribution changes by 12-49% with the suffix and remains 8-49% after a decay-ledger correction. Native omission also changes later transition and write terms and other active caches. Frozen-input transport succeeds on its fixed-input control; the changed terms place native omission outside the tested receipt classes. Checkpoint replay supplies the evaluated recomputation path; zero residual on final logits and all 80 audited KDA arrays verifies restoration across the declared checkpoint surface. The complementary result is constructive. We retrofit support-vector memory into frozen Gemma 3 without attention transfer, low-rank recovery, distillation, adapters, or language-model parameter updates. Prefix-mass preservation and one box per prefix solve give base-matched admission at 4B with 1.85% perplexity overhead. At 1B and 4B, verified deletion agrees with its conditional retained-key refit within 1.3e-10 maximum next-token KL; behavioral attacks at 4B reach never-stored or chance baselines. Across 1B, 4B, and 12B, the 4B checkpoint uniquely combines base-matched admission with low overhead. The paper's two contributions are a negative result for native KDA's tested receipt classes and a positive training-free construction for addressable pretrained memory.
papers.comment: 26 pages (9-page main text), 11 figures. v2: major revision. Replaces the trained-conversion pipeline with a training-free retrofit of the support-vector gate into frozen Gemma 3; adds the native Kimi Linear (KDA) receipt/forcing study and checkpoint-replay deletion audits on MIMIC. Earlier trained-conversion results are retained as legacy appendix diagnostics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型持久记忆中的可审计删除 (auditable deletion)。作者报告原生 Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) 在测试的收据 (receipt) 接口上给出负面结果，并验证冻结输入传输与检查点重放 (checkpoint replay) 的恢复效果。随后提出免训练改造，将支持向量记忆 (support-vector memory) 接入冻结的 Gemma 3，在不更新语言模型参数的情况下实现可寻址的预训练记忆删除。
Motivation: 精确删除的可行性取决于一条记录在后续计算后是否仍可被寻址 (addressable)。作者指出原生 KDA 的逐词元递推贡献会随后缀变化而不再稳定，因此需要审计哪些删除路径真正满足可验证的删除保证。
Method: 方法分两部分：一是对原生 KDA 删除收据类别的审计，包括原生省略 (native omission)、冻结输入传输 (frozen-input transport) 和检查点重放 (checkpoint replay)；二是免训练构造，将支持向量门 (support-vector gate) 改造进冻结的 Gemma 3，配以前缀质量保持 (prefix-mass preservation) 和每前缀一盒 (one box per prefix) 的求解，并用条件保留键重拟合来交叉验证删除一致性。
Result: 原生 KDA 的语料池化原始循环贡献随后缀变化 12-49%，经衰减账本校正后仍为 8-49%；检查点重放使最终 logits 与全部 80 个被审计 KDA 数组的残差为零。免训练构造在 4B 规模达到与基线匹配的接纳，困惑度开销 1.85%；1B 和 4B 下验证删除与条件保留键重拟合的最大下一 token KL 差在 1.3e-10 以内，4B 的行为攻击达到从未存储或随机基线水平。
Conclusion: 论文给出两个互补结论：原生 KDA 在测试的收据类别上不支持可靠删除，而免训练的地址化预训练记忆构造是可行的。跨 1B、4B 和 12B 规模，4B 检查点同时满足基线匹配接纳与低开销。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AgenticCANN: Automated Ascend C Operator Generation via Knowledge-Augmented Agentic Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Ascend C operator optimization is critical for NPU (Neural Processing Unit) inference performance but requires deep hardware expertise. While large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in automated CUDA kernel generation, the fundamentally different programming model of Ascend C introduces unique challenges that remain unexplored. In this paper, we propose AgenticCANN, a knowledge-augmented agentic evolution framework specifically tailored for automated Ascend C operator synthesis in low-corpus NPU environments. To overcome the severe platform knowledge deficit on unfamiliar hardware, AgenticCANN incorporates a knowledge-orchestrated generation system that delivers structured, multi-level domain insights across the development lifecycle to resolve the upstream feasibility bottleneck. Building on this foundation, it features a stage-adaptive agentic evolution strategy that dynamically aligns LLM interaction modes with specific generation and evolution phases, balancing high-exploration candidate discovery with high-convergence performance tuning. Extensive experiments on Huawei Ascend 910B across six operators spanning five pattern categories demonstrate that our method achieves 90 to 100 percent feasibility on elementwise and normalization operators, 56% on fusion operators, and up to 6.65$\times$ speedup on 1B Pangu model inference kernels. Further analysis reveals that knowledge injection monotonically improves feasibility from 57% to 86% on elementwise operators, demonstrating its general rather than operator-specific benefit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgenticCANN，一个面向低语料 NPU 环境下 Ascend C 算子自动生成的知识增强型智能体演化框架。它通过知识编排生成系统提供结构化、多层次的领域知识以缓解平台知识匮乏，并采用阶段自适应智能体演化策略动态调整 LLM 交互模式。在华为 Ascend 910B 上对覆盖五类模式的六个算子进行实验，elementwise 和 normalization 算子的可行性达 90% 至 100%，fusion 算子为 56%，并在 1B Pangu 模型推理 kernel 上取得最高 6.65 倍加速。
Motivation: Ascend C 算子优化对 NPU 推理性能至关重要但依赖深厚的硬件专业知识；LLM 已在自动化 CUDA kernel 生成上展现潜力，但 Ascend C 编程模型根本不同且平台知识极度缺乏，导致上游可行性成为瓶颈，这一问题此前未被探索。
Method: 提出 AgenticCANN 框架：包含知识编排生成系统，在开发生命周期内提供结构化、多层次领域知识以解决可行性瓶颈；以及阶段自适应智能体演化策略，将 LLM 交互模式与特定生成和演化阶段对齐，在高探索的候选发现与高收敛的性能调优之间取得平衡。
Result: 在华为 Ascend 910B 上，六个算子覆盖五类模式，elementwise 与 normalization 算子可行性为 90% 至 100%，fusion 算子为 56%；在 1B Pangu 模型推理 kernel 上实现最高 6.65 倍加速。进一步分析显示知识注入使 elementwise 算子可行性从 57% 单调提升至 86%，说明收益是普适的而非算子特异的。
Conclusion: 作者强调知识注入具有一般性好处，能够有效克服低语料 NPU 环境下的平台知识短缺问题，为自动化 Ascend C 算子合成提供了可行路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Distributional Robustness Margin For Pathology Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Pathology foundation models encode non-biological variation introduced by tissue preparation, staining and scanning, enabling shortcut learning that undermines generalisation across institutions. The Robustness Index (RI} was proposed to assess whether local representation geometry is dominated by biological or non-biological variation. However, its construction suffers from structural limitations that make cross-model comparison unreliable and call for a more principled metric. We introduce the Cross-confounder Robustness Margin (CRoMa), which measures, for each sample, whether biologically matched samples differing in the confounder lie closer in representation space than confounder-matched samples differing in biology. By design, CRoMa recasts robustness as a cohort-wide distribution of sample-level margins. We evaluated frozen representations from 20 tile-level encoders across three benchmarks and 4 slide-level encoders on a fourth. Median CRoMa rankings were broadly consistent across cohorts, yet all encoders contained confounder-dominated subsets whose prevalence and severity varied substantially across models and cohorts. Higher CRoMa margins were associated with smaller shortcut-induced performance drops after supervised adaptation, indicating that CRoMa can be a valuable tool for assessing model robustness on downstream tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对病理学基础模型 (pathology foundation models) 中由组织制备、染色和扫描引入的非生物学变异所导致的捷径学习 (shortcut learning) 问题，提出 Cross-confounder Robustness Margin (CRoMa)。CRoMa 对每个样本度量生物学匹配但混淆因子不同的样本是否比混淆因子匹配但生物学不同的样本在表征空间中更近，从而把鲁棒性重述为样本级边际的队列分布。在 20 个 tile-level 编码器、三个基准以及 4 个 slide-level 编码器上的评估显示，中位 CRoMa 排名跨队列大体一致，但所有编码器都包含混淆因子主导的子集，且其普遍性与严重程度随模型和队列显著变化。
Motivation: 病理基础模型会编码染色、扫描等非生物学变异，导致跨机构泛化下降。已有 Robustness Index (RI) 用于判断局部表征几何由生物学还是非生物学变异主导，但其构造存在结构性局限，使跨模型比较不可靠，需要更严谨的指标。
Method: 提出 CRoMa 指标：对每个样本考察生物学匹配但混淆因子不同的样本对，以及混淆因子匹配但生物学不同的样本对，比较它们在表征空间中的相对距离，并以样本级边际的分布形式刻画整个队列的鲁棒性。
Result: 基于 20 个 tile-level 编码器（三个基准）和 4 个 slide-level 编码器（第四个基准）的评估显示，中位 CRoMa 排名跨队列大体一致；所有编码器都存在混淆因子主导的数据子集，其规模与严重程度因模型和队列而异。更高的 CRoMa 边际与监督适应后捷径导致的性能下降更小相关。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 CRoMa 可以作为评估病理基础模型下游任务鲁棒性的有效工具，尤其能揭示总体指标可能遗漏的混淆因子主导子集。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Moral Hazard in Multi-Agent Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Cooperation can fail when socially valuable effort is costly, hard to observe, and benefits mainly someone else. Building on Holmström's model of moral hazard in teams, we introduce the Dialogue Moral Hazard Game, a theory-grounded controlled experimental paradigm that instantiates this hidden-action structure as a textual environment for language agents. In each episode, an agent chooses between keeping an immediate local reward and paying a query cost to reveal a hidden safety fact that primarily helps another agent's downstream decision. We evaluate eleven open-weight language models and three frontier API models, decomposing behavior into query rate, realized information transfer, local-reward preservation, unsafe choice, format validity, and team success. The frontier policies differ sharply: Fable 5 moves from querying toward local reward as cost rises and back toward querying as team reward rises, yet remains query-saturated under controlled private-share isolation; Muse Spark 1.1 responds to query cost, team reward, and private team share; and GPT-5.6 Sol reaches ceiling behavior in the primary setting. In a 3,015-decision incentive-isolation experiment, Sol tracks the Holmström-derived private-share boundary across nine query costs with a mean absolute error of 0.013. We then apply supervised fine-tuning, RLOO, sequential SFT+RLOO, and GEPA prompt optimization as diagnostic update mechanisms wherever model access permits. Their effects are heterogeneous: SmolLM3-3B and OLMo-7B show the clearest mechanism-consistent, weight-level gains, whereas GEPA sometimes raises team success while reducing or eliminating costly queries. Optimization can therefore lift aggregate reward without restoring the designated cooperative mechanism, motivating evaluations that report mechanism-level behavior rather than team success alone.
papers.comment: This revision substantially expands the empirical evaluation to eleven open-weight and three frontier models, adding matched query-cost, team-reward, group-size, and private-share incentive analyses. It also extends the weight-level and GEPA results, frozen-prompt information-structure interventions, statistical uncertainty analyses, and qualitative prompt/reasoning-trace studies

papers.title: Do LLMs Know Their Vulnerable Scenarios?
papers.abstract_en: Safety-aligned large language models are trained to refuse harmful requests, yet embedding the same requests in particular scenarios can bypass their safeguards. Existing red-teaming methods empirically identify effective scenarios through observed attack outcomes, but why particular scenarios weaken refusal remains mechanistically unclear. Meanwhile, mechanistic interpretability studies have characterized both refusal directions and jailbreak-associated features, without explaining the relationship between the two representations. In this work, we show that scenario-wrapped prompts activate internal scenario directions whose causal steering consistently reduces refusal scores. Building on this finding, we propose \textsc{Concept2Scenario}, a concept-based attribution framework for vulnerable scenario discovery. It instantiates a broad concept space with a sparse autoencoder, attributes refusal suppression to individual concepts, translates the identified concepts into interpretable natural-language scenarios, and identifies synergistic scenario combinations through interaction attribution. Across three open-source models, two safety benchmarks, and six black-box jailbreak methods, the discovered scenarios serve as reusable priors that improve average attack success rates by up to $18.2$ percentage points. They also transfer to GPT-5, Claude-Haiku-4.5, and Gemini-3-Flash, suggesting that some scenario-level refusal vulnerabilities are shared across model families. Moreover, the identified combinations outperform their individual constituents and enable iterative attacks to succeed in fewer turns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究安全对齐的大语言模型为何在特定场景中包装同一有害请求时会绕过安全机制。作者发现场景包装提示词会激活内部场景方向，因果干预可稳定降低拒绝分数；据此提出 Concept2Scenario，一种基于概念归因的脆弱场景发现框架，用稀疏自编码器实例化概念空间、将拒绝抑制归因到单个概念、翻译为可解释自然语言场景，并用交互归因识别协同场景组合。在三个开源模型、两个安全基准和六种黑盒越狱方法上，发现的场景作为可复用先验使平均攻击成功率提升最多 18.2 个百分点，并迁移到 GPT-5、Claude-Haiku-4.5 和 Gemini-3-Flash。
Motivation: 现有红队方法通过观察攻击结果来经验性地识别有效场景，但为何特定场景会削弱拒绝机制在机理上仍不清楚；机制可解释性研究分别刻画了拒绝方向和越狱相关特征，却没有解释这两类表示之间的关系。
Method: 提出 Concept2Scenario 概念归因框架：用稀疏自编码器 (sparse autoencoder) 实例化广泛的概念空间，将拒绝抑制归因到单个概念，把识别的概念翻译成可解释的自然语言场景，并通过交互归因识别协同的场景组合。核心发现是场景包装的提示词会激活内部场景方向，且对该方向的因果干预会一致地降低拒绝分数。
Result: 在三个开源模型、两个安全基准和六种黑盒越狱方法上，发现的场景作为可复用先验使平均攻击成功率 (attack success rate) 提升最多 18.2 个百分点；这些场景可迁移到 GPT-5、Claude-Haiku-4.5 和 Gemini-3-Flash，说明部分场景级拒绝脆弱性在不同模型家族间共享；识别出的组合优于单独成分，并使迭代攻击在更少轮次内成功。
Conclusion: 摘要强调场景级拒绝脆弱性是可归因、可解释且部分跨模型共享的，Concept2Scenario 为脆弱场景发现提供了概念归因的新视角；该工作为预印本 (Under Review)，摘要未报告具体局限性。

papers.title: Wrong Design Intent Is Worse Than Never Conditioning: A Derangement-Control Diagnosis of Header Conditioning in CAD Program Completion
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuned code LLMs are routinely conditioned on a design-intent specification, but the correctness axis of such a signal -- a wrong intent rather than an absent one -- has not been tested, and the benefit of conditioning is usually scored with the same detector that defines the signal. We study CADCON, a five-feature design-intent header prepended to CadQuery-style programs during LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B, scoring adherence with executable geometric assertions that share no code with the header-defining extractor. On a pre-registered sample of 400 deduplicated held-out programs stratified over eleven intent profiles, at 40% prefix and three seeds, a semantically wrong header degrades adherence below the never-header-trained baseline on 3/3 seeds under both tokenizations at the program level, and on 3/3 token and 2/3 text seeds at the 298 distinct model inputs they present. Wrong-header executability is not depressed relative to that baseline. A derangement control, retrained so every program receives another program's header -- holding the header marginal fixed while destroying its correlation with the program -- saw the same programs, indices and wrong headers. Its correct-to-wrong change is -0.006/+0.016/-0.003 against 0.124/0.241/0.230 for the standard model, and the interaction is significant on 3/3 seeds (p <= 5.9e-7), so the model's sensitivity to whether the header is right or wrong requires the learned mapping. The control sits below the baseline by the same margin under a correct as under a wrong header, so we claim that sensitivity and not the below-baseline level. On features the true intent lacks, the standard model realizes a feature far more often when the wrong header names it; the control does not. Ground truth itself scores only 0.567 here, the scale on which arm levels should be read. Wrong design intent is not inert: it actively misdirects generation.
papers.comment: 47 pages, 4 figures. v5: one change in Sec. 6. The repaired-extractor re-run, previously listed as the first follow-up, has now been run under an independent pre-registration: the deficit reproduces on the repaired scoring surface under both tokenizations, bounded by the repair changing only 11.2% of scored rows. Anchor, verdict, per-row scores on both surfaces and run log are public

papers.title: Vibe to Code: Elucidating Strategic Oscillation of Tacit Knowledge in Generative AI Design Workflows -- An Exploratory Qualitative Study
papers.abstract_en: The rapid adoption of generative AI tools has created new literacy demands for designers who must verbalize tacit knowledge through natural language prompts. Yet the micro-level cognitive processes by which designers externalize implicit intentions during iterative AI dialogue remain underexplored. This exploratory qualitative study examined five expert designers (11-20 years UI/UX experience, M = 15.4 years) using think-aloud protocols. We identified "Strategic Oscillation" -- experts' intentional return to vague language (Vibe) after progressing toward operational specifications (Code), leveraging AI's probabilistic nature for creative exploration. We observed shifts from "instruction" to "consultation" mode, deep reflection triggered by semantic collisions, and one participant's disengagement revealing conceptual alignment as a tentative boundary condition. We propose the ECRT cycle (Expectation-Collision-Reflection-Transformation) operationalizing the SECI model's "externalization" phase for human-AI collaboration. These findings yield three design patterns for metacognitive support and position AI as a "probabilistic mirror" catalyzing tacit knowledge externalization.
papers.comment: Author's original version (as submitted, February 2026). This article has been accepted for publication in International Journal of Human-Computer Interaction, published by Taylor & Francis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一项探索性定性研究，通过 think-aloud 协议观察 5 名资深 UI/UX 设计师（经验 11-20 年，均值 15.4 年）与生成式 AI 的迭代对话，考察隐性知识外化的微观认知过程。研究发现专家会刻意在模糊语言（Vibe）与操作性规格（Code）之间来回摆动，即“Strategic Oscillation”，并提出 ECRT 循环（Expectation-Collision-Reflection-Transformation）来操作化 SECI 模型中的“外化”阶段，最终给出三种元认知支持设计模式。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 的快速普及要求设计师通过自然语言提示将隐性知识显性化，但设计师在与 AI 迭代对话过程中如何外化隐含意图的微观认知机制仍缺乏研究。该研究旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 采用探索性定性研究设计，对 5 名资深 UI/UX 设计师进行 think-aloud 协议研究，基于观察识别出 Strategic Oscillation 现象，并构建 ECRT 循环作为 SECI 模型外部化阶段的操作化框架。
Result: 摘要报告识别出专家的 Strategic Oscillation，即从操作性规格有意退回模糊语言以利用 AI 的概率性进行创意探索；观察到从“指令”到“咨询”模式的转变、语义碰撞引发的深度反思，以及一名参与者因概念对齐问题而脱离，提示概念对齐是尝试性边界条件。
Conclusion: 作者将 AI 定位为“概率性镜子”，催化隐性知识外化，并据此提出三种元认知支持设计模式；但作为小样本探索性研究，结论的边界条件仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: AIFS-TC: A simple correction competitive with the operational frontier for tropical cyclone intensity forecasting
papers.abstract_en: AI weather models are in the process of revolutionising weather forecasting. While these models have been shown to achieve superior performance to physics-based NWP in forecasting tropical cyclone (TC) tracks, they tend to dramatically underestimate intensity. Here we present AIFS-TC, a simple correction to the AIFS-Single model that is competitive with the operational state-of-the-art for forecasting maximum wind speed and minimum central pressure at lead times of 12 h to seven days. This performance also holds for rapid intensification events. Notably, the entire system was autonomously designed and built by a large language model (Claude Fable 5) in a few hours, directed through a small number of natural-language prompts by a single domain scientist. That the operational frontier can be reached with an open-source AI forecast model (AIFS-Single) and relatively simple, cheap post-processing is significant for TC science, and points to agentic coding as a route to rapid exploration and progress in life-saving early-warning systems in other domains.
