papers.title: Where Should Optimizer State Live? Tiered State Allocation for Memory-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Training
papers.abstract_en: Optimizer state is the largest single line item in the memory budget of mixture-of-experts (MoE) training. On a 6.78B-parameter MoE language model AdamW keeps 50.6 GB of first and second moments to update 12.6 GB of bfloat16 weights. We study SkewAdam, an optimizer built on the observation that the three parameter populations of an MoE differ enough in size and gradient statistics that they should not receive the same state. Those populations are the dense backbone, the experts and the router. SkewAdam keeps float32 momentum plus a factored second moment for the backbone (5% of parameters), a factored second moment alone for the experts (95%) and an exact second moment for the router (<0.01%). The resulting state occupies 1.29 GB or 2.6% of AdamW's and peak training memory falls from 81.4 GB to 31.3 GB, within the budget of a 40 GB accelerator. In a controlled comparison from identical initializations over 82M tokens, SkewAdam reaches validation perplexity 108.4, ahead of AdamW (126.8), Muon (120.2) and Lion (393.7), and settles router load balance to within 1% of its uniform floor. The allocation is not what earns that perplexity. A tier ablation reaches the same value while carrying twenty times the state, so the tiers buy memory rather than accuracy. Same-platform runs separate what does earn it. Removing momentum costs 31 perplexity points (tuned Adafactor, 139.7) and replacing the factored second moment and its update clipping with a full second moment costs 10 (tuned AdamW, 118.5), so neither tuned baseline reaches the untuned tiered policy. Where optimizer state lives, these results suggest, matters at least as much as how much of it there is.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. v2: adds Adam-mini discussion, learning-rate sweeps with repeated seeds for the AdamW and Adafactor baselines, and a tier ablation; corrects the attribution of the perplexity advantage between momentum and the factored estimator. Code and per-run training logs: https://github.com/nuemaan/skewadam
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 MoE 训练中优化器状态的内存开销，提出 SkewAdam：根据 MoE 的三类参数群体（dense backbone、experts、router）在规模和梯度统计上的差异，分配不同的优化器状态。在 6.78B MoE 语言模型上，状态内存从 AdamW 的 50.6 GB 降至 1.29 GB（约为 AdamW 的 2.6%），峰值训练内存从 81.4 GB 降至 31.3 GB，可在 40 GB 加速器上训练，并在 82M tokens 的受控对比中取得优于 AdamW、Muon 和 Lion 的验证困惑度。
Motivation: 优化器状态是 MoE 训练内存预算中最大的单项开销；例如在 6.78B 参数 MoE 模型上，AdamW 需要 50.6 GB 的一阶和二阶矩来更新 12.6 GB 的 bfloat16 权重。作者观察到 MoE 的三类参数群体大小和梯度统计差异足够大，不应使用相同的状态分配。
Method: SkewAdam 采用分层状态分配：dense backbone（占 5% 参数）保留 float32 momentum 加 factored second moment，专家（占 95% 参数）只保留 factored second moment，router（占不到 0.01% 参数）保留 exact second moment。作者通过 tier ablation 和相同平台上的对比运行，分离内存节省与困惑度收益的各自来源。
Result: 状态占用从 50.6 GB 降到 1.29 GB（AdamW 的 2.6%），峰值训练内存从 81.4 GB 降到 31.3 GB，适配 40 GB 加速器。在相同初始化、82M tokens 的受控对比中，SkewAdam 达到验证困惑度 108.4，优于 AdamW（126.8）、Muon（120.2）和 Lion（393.7），并将 router 负载均衡收敛到均匀下限的 1% 以内。Tier ablation 显示去掉分层后仍能达到相同困惑度但携带二十倍状态，说明分层买来的是内存而非精度；去掉 momentum 损失 31 个困惑度点，用 full second moment 替换 factored second moment 及其更新裁剪则损失 10 个点。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是：优化器状态放在哪里（where optimizer state lives）至少与状态总量同等重要；分层分配可以在不损失困惑度的情况下大幅削减内存占用，而困惑度优势主要来自 momentum 和 factored second moment 设计，而非状态分配本身。

papers.title: Similarity All The Way Up: Multilingual Generalization in LLMs Relies on Language-Level Similarity Structures
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) grow more capable across diverse tasks, their (in)ability to generalize remains difficult to quantify and poorly understood beyond limited domains. In particular, LLMs are known to struggle generalizing multilingually, to languages outside of English, and that are poorly attested in their training data. To understand why this may be, and what enables some models to perform better than others, we turn to a long history of work across the cognitive sciences, arguing that successful generalization derives from appropriate representations in similarity space. We look at how well LLMs' representations capture the hierarchical similarity structure between distinct languages. Strikingly, we show LLMs' latent representations largely recover the hierarchical structure of the Indo-European language family tree -- grouping languages that are members of the same subfamily closely together in representation space. Furthermore, we show that the degree to which models reflect the similarity structure of languages correlates with their performance on XNLI, a multilingual natural language inference benchmark. This extends classic work on similarity-driven generalization at scale, showing how models that represent similar languages similarly generalize better from one language to another.
papers.comment: Accepted for oral presentation at CogSci 2026 (48th Annual Meeting of the Cognitive Science Society), Rio de Janeiro. 8 pages, 3 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型 (LLM) 在多语言泛化中的表现，借用认知科学中相似性驱动泛化的观点，考察模型的潜在表征是否捕获语言之间的层次相似性结构。作者发现 LLM 的潜在表征能大致还原印欧语系的语言树，并且模型反映语言相似性结构的程度与其在 XNLI 多语言自然语言推理基准上的表现相关。该工作将经典的相似性驱动泛化研究扩展到大规模语言模型场景。
Motivation: LLM 在英语之外、训练数据中资源匮乏的语言上泛化能力不足，且这种多语言泛化能力难以量化、机制尚不明确。作者希望从认知科学的相似性表征角度解释为何某些模型在多语言上表现更好。
Method: 作者测量 LLM 潜在表征中不同语言之间的距离结构，检验其是否反映语言间的层次相似性（如印欧语系谱系树），并将该结构一致性与模型在 XNLI 基准上的多语言性能进行相关性分析。
Result: 实验显示 LLM 的潜在表征在很大程度上恢复了印欧语系家族树的层次结构，同一子语系的语言在表征空间中彼此接近；模型表征对语言相似性结构的反映程度与其 XNLI 性能呈正相关。
Conclusion: 文章认为，能更相似地表征相似语言的模型，能更好地实现跨语言迁移；这一发现将认知科学中相似性驱动泛化的经典理论延伸到了大规模 LLM 上。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scaling Time Series Classification via XAI-Driven Data Reduction
papers.abstract_en: Explainable AI (XAI) for time series has seen significant algorithmic growth, but its utility in providing measurable performance gains for downstream tasks remains under-explored. This paper bridges this gap by introducing drXAI, a novel methodology that repurposes XAI attribution methods for effective data reduction in Time Series Classification (TSC). The core challenge in modern TSC is scalability; state-of-the-art models, such as Transformers, exhibit quadratic complexity relative to sequence length and linear complexity relative to the number of channels. This renders them computationally prohibitive for massive datasets. drXAI addresses this by using a fast, GPU-accelerated classifier (Hydra) to generate local attributions. We aggregate these into global feature importance scores and employ an automated elbow-cut heuristic to select the most salient features without requiring manual thresholds. We evaluate our approach on both synthetic and real-world univariate and multivariate datasets. On synthetic benchmarks, drXAI successfully recovers ground-truth features where traditional baselines fail. On real-world data, drXAI achieves between 80% and 90% data reduction while maintaining classification accuracy comparable to models trained on the full dataset. Most importantly, we show that drXAI allows resource-intensive models like ConvTran to scale to datasets that were previously inaccessible due to memory constraints. Our results show the benefits of using XAI not just for interpretability, but as a robust tool for feature selection and scalability in time series analysis. All our code and data are openly available.
papers.comment: Accepted for AALTD workshop at ECML-PKDD 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 drXAI，一种将 XAI 归因方法重新用于时间序列分类 (TSC) 数据缩减的方法。它用 GPU 加速的 Hydra 分类器生成局部归因，聚合为全局特征重要性，并通过自动肘部截断启发式选择最显著特征。在合成与真实数据集上，drXAI 实现 80%-90% 的数据缩减并保持与全数据训练相当的分类精度，使 ConvTran 等资源密集型模型能扩展到此前因内存限制无法处理的数据集。
Motivation: 现代 TSC 模型如 Transformer 在序列长度上呈二次复杂度、在通道数上呈线性复杂度，导致大规模数据集上计算开销过大；同时 XAI 在下游任务中能否带来可量化的性能提升仍未被充分探索。
Method: drXAI 使用快速的 GPU 加速分类器 Hydra 生成局部归因，将局部归因聚合成全局特征重要性分数，并采用自动肘部截断启发式选取最显著特征，避免手动设定阈值。
Result: 在合成数据上，drXAI 能恢复传统基线无法恢复的地面真值特征；在真实数据上，它实现 80%-90% 的数据缩减并保持与全数据训练相当的分类精度，且使 ConvTran 能够扩展到此前内存受限而不可用的数据集。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 XAI 不仅可用于可解释性，还可作为时间序列分析中稳健的特征选择与可扩展性工具；所有代码和数据已公开。

papers.title: Hough-SIFT: Robust Image Registration for Linear Structures via Hough Space
papers.abstract_en: Image registration is essential in applications such as electronic image stabilization. Scale-Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT), a widely used local keypoint detector and descriptor, typically provides accurate registration; however, it often fails in scenes with strong linear structures (e.g., shutters), where local features become ambiguous. We propose Hough-SIFT, a robust registration method that performs SIFT descriptor matching in Hough space. In this domain, linear structures form distinctive peaks that restore descriptor discriminability. Experiments demonstrate that Hough-SIFT is robust in linear scenes where SIFT frequently fails, while maintaining accuracy comparable to SIFT in normal scenes.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 6 figures. Supplementary video is available as an ancillary file. Acknowledgment updated in v2. Accepted for oral presentation at the 29th Meeting on Image Recognition and Understanding (MIRU2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hough-SIFT，一种用于线性结构场景的鲁棒图像配准方法。作者指出标准 SIFT 在强线性结构（如快门）场景中常因局部特征模糊而失效，因此将 SIFT 描述子匹配迁移到 Hough 空间中执行，使线性结构形成显著峰值并恢复描述子判别力。实验表明该方法在线性场景中比 SIFT 更鲁棒，同时在常规场景中保持与 SIFT 相当的精度。
Motivation: 图像配准在电子稳像等应用中至关重要，SIFT 虽通常能提供准确配准，但在强线性结构场景中局部特征变得模糊，导致注册失败。
Method: 提出 Hough-SIFT，在 Hough 空间中进行 SIFT 描述子匹配，利用线性结构在该空间中形成显著峰值的特性来恢复描述子的可区分性。
Result: 实验显示 Hough-SIFT 在 SIFT 频繁失败的线性场景中表现鲁棒，且在常规场景中维持与 SIFT 相当的配准精度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Hough 空间表示能有效处理线性结构下的特征歧义问题，论文篇幅为 5 页并附补充视频，被 MIRU2026 接收为口头报告。

summary_sections.method: 提出 Hough-SIFT，在 Hough 空间中进行 SIFT 描述子匹配，利用线性结构在该空间中形成显著峰值的特性来恢复描述子的可区分性。

papers.title: Alipay-PIBench: A Realistic Payment Integration Benchmark for Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Payment integration is a demanding repository-level software task: agents must select a suitable product, implement coordinated client-server flows, verify payment outcomes, and preserve consistency between transaction and business states. We introduce Alipay-PIBench, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on realistic Alipay payment integration. It contains nine product-specific projects and 18 task instances, each organized into Basic functional-completion and Advanced risk-aware hardening scenarios. Scenario-specific rubrics support deterministic static, unit, integration, and end-to-end checks, supplemented by LLM-assisted assessment for semantic requirements. We evaluate six coding-agent models and report rubric pass rate (RPR). Under the with-skill condition, mean RPR ranges from 68.58% to 91.37%. Access to the alipay-payment-integration skill improves mean RPR by 10.31 percentage points on average relative to the without-skill condition, with gains varying across models, products, and scenarios. Method-level results distinguish source-level completion, executable payment behavior, and payment-domain requirements. Alipay-PIBench provides a controlled setting for diagnosing model capability and evaluating structured guidance in payment integration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Alipay-PIBench，一个用于评测代码智能体在真实支付宝支付集成任务上表现的基准。该基准包含 9 个产品项目和 18 个任务实例，分为 Basic 功能补全与 Advanced 风险加固两类场景。作者评估了六种编码智能体模型，并以 rubric pass rate (RPR) 为主要指标；在 with-skill 条件下平均 RPR 介于 68.58% 至 91.37% 之间，使用 alipay-payment-integration skill 相比 without-skill 平均提升 10.31 个百分点。
Motivation: 支付集成是要求较高的仓库级软件任务，智能体需要选择合适产品、实现协调的客户端-服务端流程、验证支付结果并保持交易状态与业务状态的一致性，但缺少针对这一真实场景的受控评测基准。
Method: 构建 Alipay-PIBench，包含 9 个产品项目和 18 个任务实例，任务组织为 Basic 功能补全和 Advanced 风险加固两类场景；场景特定的评分标准支持确定性静态、单元、集成和端到端检查，并辅以 LLM 辅助评估来覆盖语义需求。
Result: 对六种编码智能体模型进行评测并报告 RPR，with-skill 条件下平均 RPR 为 68.58% 到 91.37%；相比 without-skill 条件，使用 alipay-payment-integration skill 平均提升 10.31 个百分点，且提升幅度因模型、产品和场景而异。
Conclusion: Alipay-PIBench 为诊断模型能力以及评估支付集成中结构化指导的效果提供了受控测试环境。

papers.title: CRC-HGD: A Histopathological Image Dataset for Grading Colorectal Cancer
papers.abstract_en: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is the third most common cancer worldwide and the second leading cause of cancer-related deaths globally, with approximately 1,926,425 new cases and 904,019 deaths reported in 2022. Accurate histologic grading plays a critical role in prognosis and treatment planning for colorectal adenocarcinoma. In recent years, artificial intelligence and its subcategories, including machine learning and deep learning, have been increasingly employed for automated cancer detection and classification. An appropriate and well-organized dataset is the essential first step to achieve this goal. This paper introduces CRC-HGD, a histopathological microscopy image dataset of 1,914 images obtained from 214 colorectal adenocarcinoma patients (Grade I: 106, Grade II: 75, Grade III: 33). The specimens are H&E-stained colorectal tissue sections acquired at the Poursina Hakim Research Center of Isfahan University of Medical Sciences, Iran, diagnosed between 2014 and 2019, and graded according to the World Health Organization (WHO) criteria into three grades: well-differentiated (Grade I), moderately differentiated (Grade II), and poorly differentiated (Grade III). For each specimen, four magnification levels are provided: 4x, 10x, 20x, and 40x. The dataset is accessible via Mendeley Data (https://doi.org/10.17632/yfp5sfj47m.4) and at http://databiox.com, where the latest version is also available. The distinctive feature of this dataset is the provision of labeled specimens across all three differentiation grades at multiple magnification levels, enabling comprehensive computational analysis of colorectal cancer grading.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 CRC-HGD，一个用于结直肠癌组织学分级（grading）的病理显微镜图像数据集。数据集包含来自 214 例结直肠腺癌患者的 1,914 张 H&E 染色切片图像，按 WHO 标准划分为高分化（Grade I，106 例）、中分化（Grade II，75 例）和低分化（Grade III，33 例）三个等级，并为每个标本提供 4x、10x、20x、40x 四种放大倍率。作者指出，同时覆盖三个分化等级和多个放大倍率是该数据集区别于现有资源的主要特征。
Motivation: 结直肠癌是全球第三大常见癌症，准确的病理分级对预后和治疗计划至关重要；基于 AI 的自动化检测与分类需要组织良好且合适的数据集作为基础。
Method: 作者从伊朗伊斯法罕医科大学 Poursina Hakim 研究中心收集 2014 至 2019 年间确诊的结肠直肠腺癌标本，制作 H&E 染色组织切片，并依据 WHO 标准分为三个分化等级；每个标本提供 4x、10x、20x 和 40x 四种放大倍率图像。数据集通过 Mendeley Data 和 databiox.com 公开获取。
Result: 数据集共含 1,914 张图像，来自 214 位患者，其中 Grade I 106 例、Grade II 75 例、Grade III 33 例；每个标本覆盖四个放大倍率。
Conclusion: 该数据集的独特之处在于同时提供三个分化等级的标注标本以及多种放大倍率，可用于结直肠癌分级的综合计算分析。

papers.title: Infrared Organization and Critical Cognitive Field Formation in Transformer Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Large language models exhibit remarkable emergent behaviors, yet the physical mechanism governing their collective dynamics remains poorly understood. Cognitive Field Theory predicts that learning reorganizes the collective relaxation spectrum, thereby modifying memory self-energy, long-memory dynamics, and collective susceptibility through the infrared organization of slow relaxation modes. Here we test this framework directly in Transformer dynamics. Using publicly available Pythia language models, we extract relaxation spectra from layer Jacobians throughout training, prompt ensembles, network depth, and model scale, allowing the collective observables of Cognitive Field Theory to be measured quantitatively. The measurements reveal pronounced infrared reorganization of the relaxation spectrum. Learning substantially redistributes spectral weight while preserving a nearly flat but weakly infrared-enhanced time-scale density of states, \( ρ(λ)\simλ^β, \qquad β\simeq-0.1, \) with a corresponding memory kernel exhibiting robust long-memory scaling close to \( K(t)\sim\frac{1}{t}. \) The collective observables further reveal a critical formation process: the memory self-energy reaches a transient maximum during early training before relaxing toward a metastable near-critical regime. Prompt-resolved and token-subspace measurements show that distinct local Jacobians recover a common macroscopic TDOS with shared infrared scaling, consistent with infrared fixed-point organization under coarse graining. The reproducibility of this infrared organization across training, prompt ensembles, network depth, and Transformer model scales supports infrared slow-mode organization as a robust collective principle of Transformer dynamics, providing a quantitative experimental realization of the collective observables predicted by Cognitive Field Theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文用公开的 Pythia 语言模型，从层 Jacobian 提取弛豫谱，直接检验 Cognitive Field Theory 对 Transformer 集体动力学的预测。测量显示学习引起弛豫谱的显著红外重组：谱权重重新分布，但时间尺度态密度保持近平坦且弱红外增强，ρ(λ)~λ^β，β≈-0.1，相应记忆核接近 K(t)~1/t 的长记忆标度。记忆自能在训练早期达到瞬态最大值，随后弛豫到亚稳态近临界区；不同 prompt 与 token 子空间的局部 Jacobian 恢复共同的宏观 TDOS 和共享红外标度。
Motivation: 大语言模型表现出显著的涌现行为，但对其集体动力学的物理机制认知不足；Cognitive Field Theory 预测学习会重组集体弛豫谱，本文旨在 Transformer 动力学中定量检验这一框架。
Method: 使用公开的 Pythia 语言模型，从训练过程、prompt 集成、网络深度和模型规模下的层 Jacobian 中提取弛豫谱，从而定量测量 Cognitive Field Theory 的记忆自能、长记忆动力学与集体磁化率等可观测量。
Result: 测量揭示了弛豫谱的显著红外重组：学习大幅重新分配谱权重，同时保持几乎平坦但弱红外增强的时间尺度态密度（β≈-0.1），记忆核呈现接近 1/t 的稳健长记忆标度；记忆自能在早期训练达到瞬态最大值后弛豫至亚稳态近临界区；局部 Jacobian 可恢复共同的宏观 TDOS 与共享红外标度。
Conclusion: 摘要认为红外慢模组织在训练、prompt 集成、网络深度和模型尺度上均稳健复现，是 Transformer 动力学的集体原则，并为 Cognitive Field Theory 的集体可观测量提供了定量实验实现。

papers.title: Vanilla SGD with Momentum Survives Heavy-Tailed Noise: Convergence Analysis without Gradient Clipping or Normalization
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is a cornerstone of modern optimization. While its performance under heavy-tailed noise is often addressed through specialized modifications such as gradient clipping or normalization, we investigate a more fundamental question: how does vanilla SGD, particularly with momentum, perform in the presence of heavy-tailed noise? In this paper, we refine existing convergence results for vanilla SGD and, more importantly, provide the first comprehensive convergence analysis of vanilla SGD with momentum for strongly convex, convex, and nonconvex objectives, without employing any gradient control mechanisms. Our results demonstrate that the obtained convergence rates are inferior to the optimal rates achieved by clipped or normalized variants of SGD, thereby revealing inherent limitations of vanilla methods under heavy-tailed noise. The theoretical findings are supported by experiments on synthetic functions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在重尾噪声下 vanilla SGD（包括带动量版本）的收敛性，不采用梯度裁剪或归一化等梯度控制机制。作者改进了 vanilla SGD 的现有收敛结果，并首次对强凸、凸和非凸目标给出带动量 vanilla SGD 的全面收敛分析。结果表明其收敛速度劣于裁剪或归一化 SGD 变体的最优速度，并用合成函数实验支持理论发现。
Motivation: 重尾噪声下 SGD 通常需要专门修改如梯度裁剪或归一化，但 vanilla SGD 尤其带动量时的收敛行为尚缺乏系统理解；论文针对这一理论缺口展开分析。
Method: 对 vanilla SGD 及带动量版本在强凸、凸和非凸目标函数下进行收敛性分析，不引入任何梯度控制机制，并在合成函数上通过实验验证理论结果。
Result: 摘要报告得到 vanilla SGD 与带动量版本在多种目标下的收敛速度，但这些速度劣于裁剪或归一化 SGD 变体的最优速度，从而揭示 vanilla 方法的固有限制。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在重尾噪声下 vanilla 方法存在固有的收敛性限制，裁剪或归一化机制仍属必要。

papers.title: LLM-Based Test Oracles: Source-of-Authority Taxonomy -- A Systematic Literature Review
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly decide whether software behaves correctly, either by writing a test oracle or by acting as one. Yet two oracles can look identical and rest on different ground: one assertion encodes a written specification, another only what the model learned in training. Prior secondary studies sort oracles by form or by technique, rarely by the property that governs how far a verdict can be trusted: where its authority comes from. This systematic literature review, reported under the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020 guidelines, screens 2,436 records to 54 included studies, extended by citation searching (snowballing) to 83 in total. We read the corpus along three axes: the source of an oracle's authority, the form it takes, and the mechanism that adjudicates it. Just over half of the corpus reaches a verdict with no specification at all. That is what lets these oracles work on code with no specification to consult, and what leaves a challenged verdict with less to fall back on. Source and mechanism cross-cut rather than coincide, so a label such as LLM-as-a-judge names how a verdict is produced, not why it should be trusted. Oracle quality is most often judged by resemblance to a known oracle rather than by whether injected faults are caught. The first question to ask of any LLM oracle is therefore what one would point to in defending its verdict. The protocol, search query, and per-study coding sheet are released.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 10 figures, 11 tables. Systematic literature review of 83 studies, reported under PRISMA 2020. Submitted to IEEE Access. Replication package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21194940
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇系统文献综述，针对基于大语言模型（LLM）的测试预言（test oracle）提出按权威来源（source of authority）分类的分类法。作者在 PRISMA 2020 指南下筛选 2,436 条记录至 54 项纳入研究，并通过引用雪球（snowballing）扩展至 83 项，从权威来源、预言形式和裁决机制三个轴分析语料。综述发现过半研究在没有任何规范（specification）的情况下做出裁决，且预言质量最常通过与已知预言的相似性来评判，而非通过注入故障是否被捕获。
Motivation: 现有二次研究按形式或技术对测试预言分类，很少考虑裁决可信度受什么支配——即其权威来自何处。两个表面相同的预言可能建立在不同基础上：一个断言编码了书面规范，另一个只反映了模型在训练中学到的内容，因此需要一种按权威来源组织的分类视角。
Method: 采用 PRISMA 2020 报告指南开展系统文献综述：筛选 2,436 条记录，纳入 54 项研究，再经引用雪球扩展到 83 项。作者沿三个轴阅读语料：预言的权威来源、形式、以及对其裁决进行仲裁的机制，并发布了协议、检索式以及逐研究编码表。
Result: 摘要报告，略过半数的语料在完全无规范的情况下得出裁决；权威来源与裁决机制相互交叉而非重合，因此诸如 LLM-as-a-judge 的标签只说明裁决如何产生，并不说明为何值得信任。预言质量的评判最常参照与已知预言的相似性，而不是是否捕获注入的故障。
Conclusion: 作者强调，面对任何 LLM 预言首先要问的问题是：为其裁决辩护时可以指出什么依据。综述公开了协议、检索式、逐研究编码表以及复现包，以支持后续研究。

papers.title: SAF3R: Dynamic Sparse Attention for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction (F3R) transformers have recently achieved remarkable success. However, scaling them to long image sequences remains challenging, as the quadratic complexity of cross-view global attention quickly becomes the dominant computational bottleneck. While recent efforts attempt to improve efficiency through compressed or sparse attention, they fail to fully exploit the inherent sparsity and dynamic behavior of global attention. In this work, we present a comprehensive analysis of global attention across multiple F3R transformers and reveal that attention patterns are highly heterogeneous, dynamic, and extremely sparse across layers and attention heads. Motivated by these findings, we propose SAF3R, a training-free dynamic sparse attention framework tailored to F3R transformers. SAF3R integrates tailored sparse attention mechanisms with offline head profiling and an efficient online adaptation strategy to match input-dependent attention behaviors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SAF3R achieves high sparsity ratios while preserving camera pose estimation and 3D reconstruction quality, translating into substantial end-to-end speedup on F3R transformers compared to existing methods. Code is available at https://github.com/jndeng/SAF3R
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文先对多个前馈3D重建（F3R）transformer中的全局注意力进行系统分析，发现注意力模式在层与注意力头之间高度异质、动态且极稀疏。基于此提出SAF3R，一个无需训练的动态稀疏注意力框架，通过离线头部分析与在线适应策略匹配输入相关的注意力行为。实验表明SAF3R在保持相机位姿估计与3D重建质量的同时实现高稀疏率，并带来显著的端到端加速。
Motivation: F3R transformer在长图像序列上受限于交叉视图全局注意力的二次复杂度，成为主要计算瓶颈；已有的压缩或稀疏注意力方法没有充分利用全局注意力本身固有的稀疏性和动态行为。
Method: 提出SAF3R，一种针对F3R transformer的免训练动态稀疏注意力框架，集成定制稀疏注意力机制、离线注意力头部分析（head profiling）以及高效的在线适应策略，以匹配与输入相关的注意力模式。
Result: 大量实验表明SAF3R能达到高稀疏率，同时保持相机位姿估计和3D重建的质量，相比现有方法在F3R transformer上获得显著端到端加速。
Conclusion: 作者的注意力分析揭示了全局注意力跨层和跨头的异质性与稀疏性，SAF3R据此以训练自由的方式实现高效的动态稀疏推理。

papers.title: HandsOnWorld: Unconstrained Egocentric Video Generation with Camera-Disentangled Hand Control
papers.abstract_en: We present HandsOnWorld, a framework for hand-controlled egocentric video generation that learns directly from unconstrained monocular video. Prior generators depend on 3D hand annotations from multi-view or marker-based motion capture, confining them to narrow, instrumented scene distributions. To bridge this gap, we introduce a protagonist-centered annotation pipeline that filters monocular 3D reconstructions at the action-semantic, image-quality, and 3D-geometric levels, yielding EgoVid-Pro, a dataset of clean, protagonist-only hand trajectories spanning 103K clips and roughly 12M frames across diverse everyday scenes. These unconstrained scenes exhibit substantial camera ego-motion that is largely absent from tabletop captures, exposing the entanglement of camera and hand motion in existing camera-space control signals. We therefore propose the Plücker Hand Map, which extends Plücker rays from camera geometry to the hand surface, representing hand motion in the same world frame as the camera and disentangling the two motion sources at the representation level. Experiments show that HandsOnWorld outperforms prior methods in visual fidelity and control accuracy and generalizes beyond laboratory settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HandsOnWorld，一个面向手部控制的 egocentric 视频生成框架，直接从无约束的单目视频学习，无需多视角或基于标记的动作捕捉 3D 手部标注。作者构建了 protagonist-centered 标注流水线，过滤单目 3D 重建结果，得到包含 103K 片段、约 1200 万帧的 EgoVid-Pro 数据集，并提出 Plücker Hand Map 将手部运动表示在与相机相同的世界坐标系中，从而在表示层面解耦相机与手部运动。实验表明该方法在视觉保真度和控制精度上优于先前方法，并能泛化到实验室之外的场景。
Motivation: 现有手部控制 egocentric 视频生成依赖多视角或基于标记的动作捕捉带来的 3D 手部标注，局限于狭窄、仪器化的场景分布；真实无约束场景中相机自身运动显著，使现有相机空间控制信号中相机与手部运动相互纠缠。
Method: 提出 protagonist-centered 标注流水线，从动作语义、图像质量和 3D 几何三个层面过滤单目 3D 重建，生成干净的 EgoVid-Pro 数据集；并提出 Plücker Hand Map，将 Plücker rays 从相机几何扩展到手部表面，使手部运动与相机在同一世界坐标系中表示，从而在表示层面解耦两类运动。
Result: 实验显示 HandsOnWorld 在视觉保真度和控制精度上优于先前方法，并能泛化到实验室以外的场景；数据集包含 103K 片段和约 12M 帧，覆盖多样日常场景。
Conclusion: 作者认为在表示层面将手部运动与相机运动解耦，并配以大规模无约束单目数据，是突破实验室场景限制、实现手部可控 egocentric 视频生成的关键。

papers.title: Early Warning Signals for OpenVLA Failure under Visual Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Visual shifts can cause a vision-language-action policy to fail after initially plausible behavior. We ask whether OpenVLA's internal activations contain signals associated with the steps before failure. We freeze the policy, record one MLP activation per LIBERO-10 step, and fit two linear monitors. Occlusion reduces task success from $57\%$ to $17\%$. Within failed matched-reset trajectories, a layer-16 logistic probe attains AUROC $0.972$ and AUPRC $0.352$, whereas action disagreement attains AUROC $0.496$. Without refitting, the occlusion-trained probe reaches AUROC $0.689$ on failed camera-jitter episodes. In a calibration check, however, the same layer-16 monitor averages 3.32 warning onsets per clean episode. This contrast shows that strong retrospective discrimination does not imply operationally quiet warning behavior. Because fitting and evaluation share tasks, resets, and seed, these results establish retrospective separability rather than prediction on independent episodes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉分布偏移下 OpenVLA 策略在失败前的内部激活是否包含早期预警信号。作者冻结策略，在 LIBERO-10 每步记录一个 MLP 激活并训练两个线性监测器，发现遮挡将任务成功率从 57% 降至 17%，层 16 的逻辑回归探针在失败轨迹上取得 AUROC 0.972，但同一监测器在干净情节中平均每集触发 3.32 次警告，且评估与训练共享任务、重置和随机种子，证明的是回顾性可分性而非独立情节上的预测。
Motivation: 视觉分布偏移可能让视觉-语言-动作策略在最初看似正常的行为之后才失败，现有方法缺乏对失败前内部状态的监测信号，作者希望判断 OpenVLA 的内部激活是否携带失败前兆信息。
Method: 冻结 OpenVLA 策略，在每个 LIBERO-10 步骤记录一个 MLP 激活，拟合两个线性监测器（逻辑回归探针与动作不一致度量），并在遮挡与相机抖动两类视觉偏移下评估；同时进行校准检查，统计干净情节中的误报。
Result: 遮挡使任务成功率从 57% 下降到 17%；在失败的匹配重置轨迹中，层 16 逻辑探针 AUROC 为 0.972、AUPRC 为 0.352，而动作不一致仅为 0.496；遮挡训练的探针无需重拟合即可在失败的相机抖动情节上达到 AUROC 0.689；但同一层 16 监测器在干净情节中平均每集有 3.32 次警告。
Conclusion: 结果显示强回顾性区分能力并不等同于操作上安静的预警行为；由于拟合与评估共享任务、重置和随机种子，这些结果建立的是回顾性可分性，而非对独立情节的预测能力。

papers.title: NaLA: A 3D Native LLM Layout Agent for High-quality 3D Scene Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as promising layout agents for 3D scene generation. Existing layout agents still suffer from implausible layout generation because most of them convert 3D assets and 3D layouts into textual descriptions as inputs and outputs, which involves severe information loss due to the modality gap between texts and 3D assets and 3D layouts. We propose NaLA, a native 3D LLM layout Agent for high-quality 3D scene generation by placing 3D assets in the scene. For the inputs, NaLA encodes 3D scene boundaries and 3D assets directly into the LLM, preserving fine-grained geometry and enabling explicit reasoning over relationships like collisions, surface supporting, and containment. To accurately output the positions and orientations of assets, NaLA adopts a coarse-to-fine prediction mechanism that first predicts discrete poses in an autoregressive manner and then refines the discrete poses with a continuous regression. Trained on diverse layout datasets, NaLA attains strong geometric perception and layout coherence. Experiments demonstrate that NaLA outperforms prior layout agents in both generation quality and inference efficiency, with comprehensive ablation studies to verify each component's effectiveness.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://adamcwan.github.io/NaLA/. Code: https://github.com/adamcwan/NaLA-code
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NaALLA 3D 原生 LLM 布局代理，用于高质量 3D 场景生成。与先前将 3D 资产和布局转换为文本描述的代理不同，NaLA 直接将 3D 场景边界和 3D 资产编码进 LLM，避免模态转换带来的信息损失，并采用粗到细的预测机制先自回归预测离散姿态、再以连续回归细化。实验表明其在生成质量和推理效率上优于先前布局代理。
Motivation: 现有 3D 场景布局代理大多把 3D 资产和布局转成文本描述作为输入输出，文本与 3D 之间的模态差距会造成严重信息损失，导致布局生成不合理。
Method: NaLA 将 3D 场景边界和 3D 资产直接编码进 LLM，保留细粒度几何信息，并能对碰撞、表面支撑和包含等关系进行显式推理；输出端采用粗到细预测，先自回归生成离散姿态，再用连续回归细化位置和朝向。
Result: 实验显示 NaLA 在生成质量和推理效率两方面均优于先前布局代理，并通过全面消融研究验证了各组件的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为原生 3D 编码与粗到细姿态预测使 NaLA 获得较强的几何感知和布局一致性，优于基于文本描述的布局代理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Liquidity-Based Audit of Algorithmic Trading Strategies
papers.abstract_en: We show that net demand for liquidity by algo strategies is identifiable from its trade and price history alone, with no knowledge of its signal or optimization problem. An exact multi-period regret decomposition implies that the sign of this statistic classifies a linear strategy as a net liquidity consumer or provider, recovering the Kyle (1985) informed-trader/market-maker dichotomy from observables alone. Under an AR(1) cost process, the same statistic equals the product of strategy size and the squared Roll (1984) implied spread, making the correction a direct proxy for prevailing illiquidity. Extending to endogenous price impact and aggregating across N correlated strategies yields a liquidity-balance condition whose violation produces welfare loss scaling as N squared, a closed-form fire-sale externality. We calibrate to CRSP equity data (2016-2025), tracking implied spreads through the COVID-19 and 2022 rate-shock episodes, with an estimator computable in O(Tnd) time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于可观测交易与价格历史来审计算法交易策略流动性角色的方法：通过精确的多期遗憾分解 (regret decomposition) 构造净流动性需求统计量，其符号即可将线性策略分类为净流动性提供者或消费者，从而从数据中恢复 Kyle (1985) 的信息交易者/做市商二分法。在 AR(1) 成本过程下，该统计量等于策略规模乘以 Roll (1984) 隐含价差的平方，并进一步扩展到内生价格冲击和 N 个相关策略的聚合情形，得到流动性平衡条件及其对应的福利损失。作者用 CRSP 股票数据（2016–2025）进行校准，估计器时间复杂度为 O(Tnd)。
Motivation: 实际中算法交易者的信号、目标函数和私有信息往往不可观测，难以直接判断其是在提供还是消耗流动性；本文试图仅从交易量和价格历史这类可观测信息中识别这一净流动性角色，以满足市场监管和微观结构分析的需求。
Method: 核心是推导一个精确的多期遗憾分解，据此构造可由交易与价格历史计算的净流动性需求统计量；在 AR(1) 成本过程下该统计量等于策略规模与 Roll (1984) 隐含价差平方的乘积；方法还扩展到内生价格冲击，并通过对 N 个相关策略加总得到流动性平衡条件，估计器可在 O(Tnd) 时间内计算。
Result: 摘要报告将该方法校准到 2016–2025 年的 CRSP 股票数据，用于追踪 COVID-19 与 2022 年利率冲击期间的隐含价差变化；同时表明流动性平衡条件的违反会产生随 N 平方增长的福利损失，即闭合形式的抛售外部性 (fire-sale externality)。
Conclusion: 作者强调，算法策略的净流动性需求可以从交易与价格历史中直接识别，无需知道其信号或优化问题，从而由可观测数据恢复 Kyle (1985) 分类；该统计量还可作为当前市场非流动性 (illiquidity) 的直接代理。

papers.title: Learning to Recover Task Experts from a Multi-Task Merged Model
papers.abstract_en: Multi-task model merging aims to consolidate several task-specific experts into a unified model, yet static merging consistently suffers from parameter interference. While dynamic merging models aim to bridge this gap, many works rely on the costly storage and loading of redundant expert components at inference. In this work, from the perspective of task expert, we view parameter interference as parameter perturbation introduced to each expert during merging process. We show that such parameter perturbations can be modeled as affine transformation, which can be approximated as additive offsets. Motivated by these, we propose Recover Task eXpert (ReTeX), a framework that predicts those offsets, in order to undo parameter interference and recover task-expert performance from a single merged checkpoint. To recover the appropriate expert when task identity is unknown, we introduce a router-free task identifier based on SVD subspace signatures computed offline before inference. At inference, the identifier selects the task whose subspace yields the smallest projection residual for a given input. As a result, ReTeX recovers over 95% of individual-expert performance in both vision and NLP domains, while significantly improving generalization to unseen tasks. Crucially, we also show that the parameter offset prediction leads to emergent adaptive interpolation of expert knowledge for out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks. ReTeX adaptively interpolates seen expert knowledge to handle unseen tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/BAIKLAB/ReTeX
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReTeX（Recover Task eXpert），将多任务模型合并中的参数干扰建模为对每个专家施加的仿射变换，并近似为加性偏移，通过学习预测这些偏移，从单个合并检查点恢复任务专家性能。针对任务身份未知的情形，作者提出基于 SVD 子空间签名的免路由任务标识器，推理时选择投影残差最小的任务。摘要报告该方法在视觉与 NLP 领域恢复超过 95% 的个体专家性能，并显著提升对未见任务与 OOD 任务的泛化。
Motivation: 静态多任务模型合并在参数共享时持续受到参数干扰的影响；动态合并虽能缓解该问题，但许多方法需要在推理时存储和加载冗余的专家组件，成本较高。作者从任务专家视角将干扰视为合并过程中引入的参数扰动，希望只依赖单个合并检查点低成本地恢复专家性能。
Method: ReTeX 将合并过程中每个专家受到的参数扰动建模为仿射变换，并将其近似为加性偏移，训练模型预测这些偏移以抵消参数干扰。当任务身份未知时，引入一个免路由的任务标识器：离线计算 SVD 子空间签名，在线推理时选择子空间投影残差最小的任务。对未见任务，该方法通过自适应插值已见专家知识来处理 OOD 输入。
Result: 摘要报告 ReTeX 在视觉和 NLP 领域恢复了超过 95% 的个体专家性能，并显著改善了对未见任务的泛化；同时，参数偏移预测使模型对 OOD 任务表现出自适应插值专家知识的能力。
Conclusion: 作者强调参数偏移预测可以撤销合并带来的参数干扰，从单一合并检查点恢复任务专家性能，并产生面向未见任务的 emergent 自适应插值行为；代码已公开。摘要未明确讨论该方法在参数量、推理开销或失败场景上的局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gradient-Free Warm-Start Library Recovery: an Amortized-Regret Separation
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning that is gradient-free, local, online, and append-only is attractive for edge and streaming deployment, but its value is usually argued informally. We give a provable account on recurring-regime streams. Given segmentation, a warm-start library learner attains amortized recovery cost $O\!\big(KD/\varepsilon^2+(R-K)\logK/Δ^2\big)$ versus a memoryless re-estimator's $Θ(RD/\varepsilon^2)$, an advantage $(R-K)\,Θ(D/\varepsilon^2)$ growing with dimension $D$ and recurrence density. The mechanism is a decoupling: recognizing which of $K$ seen regimes is active costs $O(\log K/Δ^2)$, independent of $D$, whereas estimating a regime costs $Θ(D/\varepsilon^2)$. We prove this is tight: matching lower bounds give recognition $Θ(\log K/Δ^2)$ and a memoryless-class bound $Ω(RD/\varepsilon^2)$, so each term is individually minimax-tight (the joint statement is conditional). The separation is born-immune (a memoryless learner's advantage is identically zero) and paradigm-level: it matches, and does not beat, a fair spawn-capable Bayesian baseline; the contribution is attaining this cost structure without end-to-end backprop and with zero forgetting by construction. A count-calibrated variant ties the baseline's leading constant up to a bounded, never-negative per-recurrence overshoot, hyperparameter-free and with no per-step transcendentals. We bound the scope: recognizable regimes are capped by simplex packing (walls $e^{Θ(D)}$); autonomous segmentation is impossible at the packing wall (no detector escapes the false-alarm/delay frontier as regimes overlap); the advantage vanishes under overlap. The dimension-dependent separation is corroborated on synthetic streams and real $k$-mer genome distributions (memoryless cost $\propto D^{1.04}$, recognition $D$-independent); the one real sequential stream sits in the $D{=}1$ near-null corner.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上刻画了无梯度、局部、在线且仅追加的持续学习(continual learning)在周期性流(streams)上的价值。给定分段(segmentation)，warm-start 库学习器(library learner)的摊销恢复代价为 O(KD/ε^2+(R-K)logK/Δ^2)，而 memoryless re-estimator 为 Θ(RD/ε^2)，优势随维度 D 和复发密度增长。作者证明该分离在逐项 minimax 意义下 tight，并给出可识别 regime 数量、自主分割可行性以及重叠情形下的边界。合成流与真实 k-mer 基因组分布实验支持维度相关的分离结论。
Motivation: 无梯度、局部、在线、追加式的持续学习对边缘和流式部署很有吸引力，但其价值通常只被非正式地论证，缺少可证明的理论账目。作者希望在复发型流(recurring-regime streams)上给出严格的性能保证。
Method: 核心机制是解耦(decoupling)：识别当前激活的是 K 个已见 regime 中的哪一个，代价为 O(logK/Δ²) 且与维度 D 无关；而估计一个 regime 的代价为 Θ(D/ε²)。作者由此构造 warm-start library learner，并以匹配下界证明识别项和 memoryless 类下界分别 tight；此外还给出 count-calibrated 变体，无需超参数且无逐步超越函数。
Result: 学习器的摊销恢复代价为 O(KD/ε²+(R-K)logK/Δ²)，对比 memoryless re-estimator 的 Θ(RD/ε²)，优势为 (R-K)Θ(D/ε²)。匹配下界给出识别 Θ(logK/Δ²) 与 memoryless 类 Ω(RD/ε²)。实验显示 memoryless 代价 ∝D^1.04，识别代价与 D 无关；真实序列流处于 D=1 的近零角落。
Conclusion: 作者明确界定范围：可识别 regime 数量受 simplex packing 限制（墙为 e^{Θ(D)}），在 packing wall 上自主分割不可能（重叠时无检测器能逃离 false-alarm/delay 前沿），且重叠会使优势消失。该分离是 paradigm-level 的：与公平的 spawn-capable Bayesian baseline 匹配而非超越，贡献在于无需端到端反向传播且构造上零遗忘地达到该代价结构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Communication Heterogeneity and Collective Consensus in Neural Cellular Automata
papers.abstract_en: Reaching global agreement from purely local interactions is a defining problem of collective intelligence, and most models of it assume that all agents share a single communication protocol. We ask what happens when they do not. Using a Neural Cellular Automaton in which a population of cells must solve the density classification task, agreeing on a global majority that no individual can observe, we introduce ``languages'' as sub-populations that read one another's messages through a translation with a tunable ``linguistic distance''. We find that linguistic distance slows consensus, that it produces mild divergence between groups rather than full fragmentation, and that a collective whose shared rule was trained under diverse protocols is robust to mismatch; a homogeneously trained one is not. The findings hold on both a ring and a two-dimensional grid, and admit a natural reading as Ising relaxation, in which a foreign-language region acts as a boundary defect that leaves the system in a higher-energy, partially ordered state. These patterns are qualitatively consistent with effects reported in human group studies, suggesting that distance between communication protocols is a minimal mechanism sufficient to produce them, without anything language-specific.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文用神经细胞自动机（Neural Cellular Automaton）在环和二维网格上研究通信异质性对群体共识的影响。细胞群需通过局部交互完成密度分类任务（density classification task），作者引入“语言”子群体，通过可调“语言距离”的翻译机制互相读取消息。结果显示语言距离会减慢共识、造成组间温和分歧而非完全碎片化，且多样性训练使规则对失配鲁棒，同质训练则不然；结果可类比 Ising 弛豫。
Motivation: 群体智能模型多假设所有智能体共享单一通信协议，但现实中交互可能经由不同协议（语言），论文探讨当通信协议不同质时局部交互能否达成全局一致，以及异质性如何影响集体共识。
Method: 在 Neural Cellular Automaton 中让细胞群体解决密度分类任务，以“语言”作为子群体并定义可调的“语言距离”——子群体通过翻译读取彼此消息，考察这类通信异质性下的共识动力学，并在环和二维网格两种拓扑上验证。
Result: 发现语言距离会减慢共识，产生组间温和分歧而非完全碎片化；共享规则在多样协议下训练时对失配鲁棒，而同质训练下则脆弱；结果与 Ising 弛豫类比一致，外来语言区域相当于边界缺陷，使系统停留在较高能量、部分有序状态，并与人类群体研究中的效应定性一致。
Conclusion: 作者认为通信协议之间的距离是足以产生这类群体效应的最小机制，无需依赖语言特异性；研究同时在环和二维网格上成立，指向的是一种普遍动力学而非语言特有现象。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文用神经细胞自动机（Neural Cellular Automaton）在环和二维网格上研究通信异质性对群体共识的影响。细胞群需通过局部交互完成密度分类任务（density classification task），作者引入“语言”子群体，通过可调“语言距离”的翻译机制互相读取消息。结果显示语言距离会减慢共识、造成组间温和分歧而非完全碎片化，且多样性训练使规则对失配鲁棒，同质训练则不然；结果可类比 Ising 弛豫。

summary_sections.method: 在 Neural Cellular Automaton 中让细胞群体解决密度分类任务，以“语言”作为子群体并定义可调的“语言距离”——子群体通过翻译读取彼此消息，考察这类通信异质性下的共识动力学，并在环和二维网格两种拓扑上验证。
summary_sections.result: 发现语言距离会减慢共识，产生组间温和分歧而非完全碎片化；共享规则在多样协议下训练时对失配鲁棒，而同质训练下则脆弱；结果与 Ising 弛豫类比一致，外来语言区域相当于边界缺陷，使系统停留在较高能量、部分有序状态，并与人类群体研究中的效应定性一致。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为通信协议之间的距离是足以产生这类群体效应的最小机制，无需依赖语言特异性；研究同时在环和二维网格上成立，指向的是一种普遍动力学而非语言特有现象。

papers.title: The Hidden Evolution of Disguised Visual Context inside the VLM
papers.abstract_en: Visual tokens enter Large Language Models (LLMs) as raw, foreign signals. How they are transformed into meaningful representations and interact with the language space depends entirely on the integration architecture. Whether by treating visual tokens as in-context prompts within the input sequence or injecting them directly into the LLM's intermediate layers. A controlled comparison and understanding of how these architectural choices affect visual information and its internal transformation to integrate with the LLM remains underexplored. We provide a fair comparison by evaluating in-context and layer-wise injection VLM integration paradigms under identical training conditions across single image, multi-image, and video benchmarks. In doing so, we uncover a hidden evolution where visual tokens enter the LLM as disguised visual context, raw representations lacking linguistic structure, but are progressively reshaped depending on the integration paradigm, each capturing fundamentally different frequency characteristics of the visual signal. We show that this evolution inside the LLM determines what visual features the VLM can utilize effectively, how visual representations align with the language space, and ultimately how each paradigm performs across different tasks. We further demonstrate that attention allocation alone is insufficient, and that performance is driven by the quality of visual representations at each layer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在相同训练条件下，对两种VLM集成范式——将视觉令牌作为上下文提示（in-context prompts）与将其逐层注入LLM中间层（layer-wise injection）——进行公平比较，覆盖单图、多图和视频基准。作者发现视觉令牌进入LLM时是缺乏语言结构的"伪装视觉上下文"（disguised visual context），随后随集成范式被逐步重塑，不同范式捕获视觉信号的不同频率特征。研究认为这种LLM内部演化决定VLM可用的视觉特征、视觉表示与语言空间的对齐方式，并指出仅凭注意力分配不足以解释性能，各层视觉表示质量才是驱动因素。
Motivation: 视觉令牌如何被LLM转化为有意义表示并与语言空间交互完全取决于集成架构，但现有工作缺少对in-context提示与逐层注入这两种范式在受控条件下的对比和理解。
Method: 在相同训练条件下评估in-context提示和逐层注入两种VLM集成范式，使用单图、多图和视频基准，并通过分析视觉令牌在LLM内部的逐层频率特征变化来揭示其隐藏演化过程。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值；主要发现是两种集成范式分别捕获视觉信号的不同频率特征，LLM内部的演化决定VLM能有效利用的视觉特征及与语言空间的对齐程度，且注意力分配单独不足以解释任务表现。
Conclusion: 作者强调集成架构对视觉令牌内部演化起决定性作用，并提出高质量的各层视觉表示比注意力分配更能决定VLM性能。

papers.title: SDS-LoRA: Overcoming Anisotropic Gradient Scaling in Low-Rank Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient adaptation of large pretrained models to downstream tasks by parameterizing weight updates with low-rank matrices. In this paper, we investigate the limitations of the LoRA parameterization from a geometric perspective. Specifically, we show that when a full fine-tuning gradient is backpropagated to the low-rank matrices, it undergoes anisotropic scaling driven by their singular values. We argue that this phenomenon is undesirable because it distorts the full fine-tuning gradient by skewing it toward dominant singular directions while suppressing others. Our analyses demonstrate that anisotropic gradient scaling reduces the effective rank of the low-rank matrices' gradients and fails to provide the best possible alignment between the full fine-tuning gradient and its low-rank approximation in LoRA for arbitrary gradients, thereby exacerbating the gap to full fine-tuning. To address these limitations, we propose a new low-rank parameterization, SDS-LoRA, which Structurally Decouples Singular values from the backward pass. Our method ensures that the full fine-tuning gradient backpropagates only through the orthonormal bases of the low-rank matrices' subspaces, independent of their scales. Convergence analysis demonstrates that while LoRA's convergence rate degrades with the condition number of the low-rank matrices, that of SDS-LoRA remains independent of it. Experimental results across natural language and vision benchmarks show that SDS-LoRA improves loss convergence and reduces the gap to full fine-tuning, significantly enhancing adaptation performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从几何视角分析 LoRA 参数化的局限，指出全量微调梯度反传到低秩矩阵时会经历由奇异值驱动的各向异性缩放 (anisotropic scaling)，使梯度偏向主导奇异方向并抑制其他方向。作者提出 SDS-LoRA，将奇异值从反向传播中结构解耦，使梯度只通过低秩矩阵子空间的正交基回传。收敛性分析显示其收敛率与低秩矩阵条件数无关，在自然语言和视觉基准上改善了损失收敛并缩小与全量微调的差距。
Motivation: LoRA 通过低秩矩阵参数化权重更新来高效适配大模型，但其参数化存在几何层面的缺陷：全量微调梯度在反传到低秩矩阵时被奇异值各向异性缩放，扭曲梯度方向并降低低秩梯度的有效秩，从而放大与全量微调的差距。
Method: 提出新的低秩参数化 SDS-LoRA，结构性解耦奇异值与反向传播过程，使全量微调梯度仅通过低秩矩阵子空间的正交基回传，不受其尺度影响；并配套提供收敛性分析。
Result: 理论分析表明 LoRA 的收敛率随低秩矩阵条件数退化，而 SDS-LoRA 的收敛率与之无关。摘要报告在自然语言和视觉基准上，SDS-LoRA 改善损失收敛、缩小与全量微调的差距并显著提升适配性能。
Conclusion: 摘要认为各向异性梯度缩放是 LoRA 偏离全量微调的重要因素，将奇异值与梯度回传解耦能够提升低秩适配的性能与收敛性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Identifiability and Estimation for Unlabeled Finite Mixtures under Marginal Independence
papers.abstract_en: We study component recovery and mixing-matrix estimation from unlabeled finite mixtures whose observable distributions share the same latent components but have unknown mixing weights. The main identifying signal is marginal independence: each component is assumed to be independent on at least one coordinate pair, but no labels, clean component samples, or mixing weights are observed. We first prove a structural result for product components: under a subset-rank condition on the spans of the univariate marginals, any independent affine combination of the components must coincide with a single component. We then extend this principle to observable mixtures and show that, under the corresponding subset-rank, full-rank, and no-cancellation conditions, marginally independent affine combinations recover the corresponding latent components. When every component is independent on some coordinate pair, all components are identifiable, and the mixing matrix is recoverable under the stated completion conditions. Finally, we propose a Product-Marginal Maximum Mean Discrepancy (PM-MMD) estimator over affine combinations of the observable mixtures and prove uniform convergence and stability under approximate marginal independence. This framework also separates the empirical roles of the assumptions: irreducibility is, in general, not directly testable from the unlabeled mixtures alone, whereas marginal independence yields a candidate-level diagnostic through held-out PM-MMD. Controlled and flow-cytometry experiments show when marginal independence provides a useful recovery signal. In the reported multi-component comparisons, condition-aware representative selection stabilizes PM-MMD and improves recovery relative to clustering, factorization, and pairwise mixture-proportion baselines using the same unlabeled mixtures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究无标签有限混合模型（unlabeled finite mixtures）的组分恢复与混合矩阵估计问题：可观测分布共享相同的潜在组分但混合权重未知，主要识别信号来自边际独立性（marginal independence）。作者证明了在子集秩条件下，独立仿射组合必须与单一组分重合，并据此给出组分可识别与混合矩阵可恢复的条件；随后提出基于仿射组合的乘积边际最大均值差异（PM-MMD）估计器，并证明其在近似边际独立性下的一致收敛与稳定性。受控实验和流式细胞术实验展示了边际独立性作为恢复信号的有效性，且条件感知的代表性选择相比聚类、分解和成对混合比例基线能改善恢复效果。
Motivation: 无标签混合模型缺乏组分标签和干净样本，一般难以同时识别组分与混合权重；现有可识别性结果对稀疏边际独立性这类弱信号缺少结构性刻画。
Method: 先证明乘积组分的一个结构定理：在单变量边际张成空间的子集秩条件下，任何独立的仿射组合必须等于某个单一组分；再将该原理推广到可观测混合，给出子集秩、满秩与无相消（no-cancellation）条件下的可识别性。估计方面提出 PM-MMD 估计器，对可观测混合的仿射组合做拟合，并证明其在大样本下一致收敛且对近似边际独立性稳定。
Result: 当每个组分在至少一个坐标对（coordinate pair）上独立时，所有组分可识别，且在所述完成条件下混合矩阵可恢复。实验表明边际独立性能提供有用的恢复信号；在多组分对比中，条件感知的代表性选择稳定了 PM-MMD，并优于使用相同无标签混合的聚类、分解和成对混合比例基线。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架区分了各假设的经验角色：不可约性（irreducibility）一般无法仅从无标签混合中直接检验，而边际独立性可通过留出 PM-MMD 提供候选级诊断。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Certifiable Semantic Agreement Among LLM Agents: What the Admissibility Instrument Decides
papers.abstract_en: Can a committee of LLM agents reach agreement that is certifiable at the level of meaning, not only at the level of a label? We build a protocol to find out. H-CSC emits one of three typed outcomes per round -- semantic commit, verdict commit, or typed abort -- under a common 2f+1 distinct-signer certificate, and we use it to measure what such agreement costs and buys. The answer is conditional, and the condition is not the protocol. We prove a containment lemma: whenever the semantic core is large enough to make the committed verdict deterministically valid, the verdict margin already exceeds f, so at matched deterministic guarantees no coverage separation from certificate-wrapped majority is possible. Measurement agrees: the two rules commit the identical task set. What matters instead is the admissibility instrument. Against adversaries that preserve the verdict and corrupt only the reasoning, a 442 MB fine-tuned encoder reaches AUROC 0.621-0.744 at 0-8% TPR (5% honest FPR), while a training-free lexical predicate reaches 0.865-0.982 at 38-80% (50 tasks, 200 attacks, 400 honest) and is exactly deterministic, discharging an assumption the digest proofs rely on. Honest agents disperse further than attacks displace (90th-percentile honest angular distance 0.992 rad against a 0.65 radius), so on free-text rationales no embedding filter is viable -- a property of the output schema, which when tightened collapses dispersion twenty-fold. The committed digest is not inert: under non-disclosure a similarity-preserving sketch separates faithful from substituted derived statements at AUROC 0.741 (n=350), where a cryptographic hash and a verdict-only digest score exactly 0.500. We also report a tie-break capture vulnerability found in our own protocol, and its four-line fix. We claim no safety or coverage advantage over verdict-only certification; the lemma explains why there is none to claim.
papers.comment: 43 pages, 5 figures, 20 tables, 1 algorithm. Substantial revision: new title, new framing, new downstream-audit experiment; supersedes v1
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 智能体委员会能否在语义层面而非仅仅标签层面达成可认证的一致，并为此构建了 H-CSC 协议：每轮在共同的 2f+1 不同签名者证书下输出三种类型化结果（semantic commit、verdict commit、typed abort）。作者证明了一个包含引理：当语义核心足够大以至于承诺的裁决确定性有效时，裁决余量已超过 f，因此在匹配的确定性保证下，该协议与证书包装的多数投票之间不存在覆盖率分离；实验测量也确认两者承诺相同的任务集。论文转而指出真正起决定作用的是 admissibility instrument（可采纳性工具），并报告了面向不同推理攻击场景下的检测性能（微调编码器 AUROC 0.621-0.744，免训练词汇谓词 AUROC 0.865-0.982），以及对诚实合理性和摘要摘要（digest）审计的实验结果。
Motivation: 核心问题是：一组 LLM 智能体达成的共识能否在意义（meaning）层面得到可认证的保证，而不只是停留在标签层面；以及这种语义认证究竟需要付出什么代价、能买到什么保证。作者发现答案取决于条件，而该条件并非协议本身，这促使他们系统考察协议设计之外的决定因素。
Method: 提出 H-CSC 协议，每轮在 2f+1 不同签名者证书下输出 semantic commit、verdict commit 或 typed abort 三类结果；通过包含引理从理论上刻画语义核心与裁决余量之间的关系，并结合测量实验比较该协议与证书包装多数投票。论文还设计了 downstream-audit 实验，使用相似性保持的摘要（similarity-preserving sketch）在非披露条件下区分忠实的派生陈述与替换后的派生陈述。
Result: 摘要报告：在保持裁决正确、仅破坏推理过程的对抗设定下，442 MB 微调编码器在 0-8% TPR（5% 诚实 FPR）下达到 AUROC 0.621-0.744，而免训练的词汇谓词在 38-80% 下达到 AUROC 0.865-0.982（50 个任务、200 次攻击、400 个诚实样本）且完全确定性；诚实的智能体分散程度大于攻击造成的位移（诚实第 90 百分位角距离 0.992 rad，攻击半径 0.65），因此在自由文本理由上嵌入过滤器不可行，收紧输出模式后分散度降低约二十倍；在非披露条件下，相似性保持摘要区分忠实与替换派生陈述的 AUROC 为 0.741（n=350），而密码学哈希和仅裁决摘要恰好为 0.500。论文还报告了在其自身协议中发现的决胜捕获漏洞及其四行修复。
Conclusion: 作者明确声称该协议相对于仅裁决认证（verdict-only certification）不提供额外的安全性或覆盖率优势，包含引理解释了为何没有这种优势；真正起决定作用的因素是 admissibility instrument 以及输出模式（output schema）的设计。摘要同时指出协议中的摘要并非惰性，相似性保持摘要可在特定条件下提供可审计的检测能力。

papers.title: Residual Modeling for High-Fidelity Learned Compression of Scientific Data
papers.abstract_en: Lossy compression is essential for massive spatiotemporal data from scientific simulations. Learned compressors can achieve high compression ratios at moderate accuracy targets, but their aggregate reconstruction losses do not guarantee accuracy for each block. Existing Guaranteed Autoencoder (GAE) methods add a per-block residual correction by retaining SVD/PCA-style coefficients until the target is met. This works at moderate tolerances, but in the high-fidelity regime with block-level NRMSE from 10^-6 to 10^-4, the number of retained coefficients grows quickly and the correction stream dominates the total rate. We propose a residual-centric view: the learned residual is structurally different from the original scientific field and should be coded with a representation designed for that residual. We introduce two residual coders. LBRC is a deterministic, training-free pipeline that adaptively quantizes the learned residual to the target NRMSE and losslessly encodes the resulting integer residual using 3D Lorenzo differencing, zigzag mapping, bit-plane coding, and entropy coding. NGLR adds a causal neural predictor that outputs a normalized bias for an integer-rounded Lorenzo prediction in the same deterministic integer pipeline, reducing the entropy of the remaining residual code while preserving deterministic decoding. The predictor weights are serialized and counted in the bitstream. Across E3SM, JHTDB, and ERA5 at block-level NRMSE targets from 10^-6 to 10^-4, LBRC improves compression ratio over GAE by 30-60% and is broadly competitive with SZ. NGLR adds a further 10-40% over LBRC and outperforms SZ in the evaluated high-fidelity regime. These results show that residual representations tailored to learned-compressor residuals can preserve the advantage of learned compression when global residual correction becomes rate-dominant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对科学模拟产生的大规模时空数据，提出以残差为中心的极致保真有损压缩思路。作者指出已有的 Guaranteed Autoencoder (GAE) 在块级 NRMSE 10^-6 到 10^-4 的高保真区间内，保留的 SVD/PCA 风格校正系数过多，校正码流主导总码率；为此提出两种残差编码器 LBRC 与 NGLR，在 E3SM、JHTDB 和 ERA5 上相对 GAE 获得 30-60% 的压缩比提升，NGLR 进一步超越 SZ。
Motivation: 现有学习型压缩器在中等精度目标下压缩比高，但聚合重建损失无法保证逐块的精度；GAE 通过逐块保留残差校正系数来满足目标，然而在高保真区间校正码流迅速膨胀，成为总码率的主导，削弱了学习压缩的优势。
Method: 提出残差视角：学习压缩器的残差在结构上不同于原始科学场，应用专门为其设计的表示编码。LBRC 是无训练的确定性流水线，将学习残差自适应量化到目标 NRMSE，并用 3D Lorenzo 差分、zigzag 映射、位平面编码和熵编码无损编码整数残差；NGLR 在此确定性整数流水线上加入因果神经预测器，对整数化的 Lorenzo 预测输出归一化偏差以降低剩余残差码的熵，预测器权重序列化后计入码流。
Result: 在 E3SM、JHTDB、ERA5 上、块级 NRMSE 目标 10^-6 到 10^-4 下，LBRC 相对 GAE 压缩比提升 30-60%，并与 SZ 大体相当；NGLR 在 LBRC 基础上再提升 10-40%，在所评估的高保真区间内优于 SZ。
Conclusion: 结果表明，针对学习型压缩器残差量身定制的表示，能够在全局残差校正成为码率主导时保留学习压缩的优势。
Relevance: 40

papers.title: Constitutional On-Policy Safe Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has emerged as an efficient post-training paradigm by using a teacher conditioned on privileged information to provide dense token-level supervision. Prior work has shown that OPSD can collapse in verifiable reasoning tasks, while safety alignment differs in that it is guided by high-level constitutions rather than explicit target answers. However, pilot studies reveals that safety OPSD nonetheless suffers from severe collapse, where constitutional conditioning contracts the teacher distribution toward short and overly conservative responses and Reverse KL further amplifies this contraction into reduced expressiveness. We formalize this effect as geometric leakage under safety boundaries in a non-orthogonal semantic space, where safety pressure transfers into the expressiveness dimension. Based on this analysis, we propose Constitutional On-Policy Safety Distillation (COPSD), which first calibrates the teacher through a Cross-SFT cold-start and then performs constitution-conditioned on-policy distillation. Experiments across 3 multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on 12 safety and general benchmarks show that COPSD improves both safety and helpfulness over baselines while reducing the safety tax on general reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究安全对齐中的 on-policy 自蒸馏（OPSD）崩溃问题。作者发现安全 OPSD 同样会出现严重塌缩：宪法条件（constitutional conditioning）使教师分布收缩为简短且过度保守的回复，Reverse KL 进一步放大这种收缩并降低表达能力。作者将这一效应形式化为非正交语义空间中安全边界下的几何泄漏（geometric leakage），并提出 Constitutional On-Policy Safety Distillation（COPSD），先用 Cross-SFT 冷启动校准教师，再进行宪法条件下的 on-policy 蒸馏。实验在 3 个多模态大语言模型（MLLM）上的 12 个安全与通用基准中显示，COPSD 相比基线同时提升安全性与有用性，并降低通用推理上的安全税（safety tax）。
Motivation: 安全对齐与可验证推理任务不同，缺少显式目标答案，而是由高层宪法引导；但初步实验表明安全 OPSD 仍会遭遇严重塌缩，表现为回复变短、过于保守以及表达能力下降。现有分析未解释这一安全蒸馏特有的崩溃机制，需要形式化描述并设计缓解方法。
Method: 作者将安全压力向表达能力维度迁移的现象形式化为非正交语义空间中的几何泄漏，并提出 COPSD：首先通过 Cross-SFT 冷启动校准教师分布，然后执行宪法条件（constitution-conditioned）的 on-policy 蒸馏，以缓解分布收缩。
Result: 在 3 个多模态大语言模型和 12 个安全与通用基准上，COPSD 同时改善安全性和 helpfulness，并降低对通用推理能力的安全税。
Conclusion: 摘要强调安全蒸馏中宪法条件会收缩教师分布并由 Reverse KL 放大，COPSD 通过冷启动校准和条件化 on-policy 蒸馏缓解该问题；其验证范围集中在多模态大语言模型的安全对齐上。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CEON: Circular Economy Ontology Network
papers.abstract_en: Increasing the circularity of resource use in our society has been recognized as a path to sustainability, i.e., transitioning into a more circular economy. There are many different circular strategies to do so, such as reusing products and components, refurbishing and remanufacturing used products, or recycling left-over or used materials. To enable these strategies, it is necessary to share information at the infrastructure level and to communicate between industry sectors along the product life cycle. Enabling semantic interoperability in this information sharing and communication is therefore a key to increasing circularity. However, knowledge representation for the circular economy (CE) domain, which involves many relevant industry sectors related to product life cycles, remains challenging. To bridge this gap, we developed the Circular Economy Ontology Network (CEON) within the Onto-DESIDE project. This ontology network aims to fill gaps in CE by defining cross-sectorial concepts and to enable semantics-aware data documentation. We demonstrate CEON through cross-industry data documentation scenarios spanning construction, electronics, and textile sectors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Circular Economy Ontology Network (CEON)，一个在 Onto-DESIDE 项目框架内开发的循环经济本体网络，旨在通过定义跨行业概念和支持语义感知的数据文档化 (semantics-aware data documentation) 来填补循环经济领域的知识表示空白。作者在建筑、电子和纺织三个行业的跨行业数据文档场景中演示了 CEON 的可用性。
Motivation: 提高资源循环利用率需要跨行业在产品生命周期内共享信息并进行通信，语义互操作性 (semantic interoperability) 是实现循环经济策略的关键；然而循环经济领域涉及多个行业部门，知识表示仍然具有挑战性。
Method: 开发了 CEON 本体网络，定义跨行业概念，并用于实现语义感知的数据文档化，以支持循环经济中的跨行业信息共享。
Result: 通过在建筑、电子和纺织三个行业的跨行业数据文档场景中的演示，展示了 CEON 在循环经济中的应用。
Conclusion: CEON 旨在填补循环经济中的知识表示空白，并促进跨行业语义互操作性；摘要未提及具体局限性。

papers.title: Train, Test, Re-evaluate: Schedule-Sensitive Evaluation of Generative Data for Hand Detection
papers.abstract_en: Generated (or synthetic) image data is increasingly used to augment or replace real training datasets when target imagery is scarce, expensive, or biased. For hand detection, particularly in occupational safety settings, public datasets mostly contain bare hands. This under-represents the variation in hand appearance introduced by gloves, tattoos, jewelry, and other personal protective equipment, creating a distribution shift that safety-critical applications encounter at deployment. We test whether generative inpainting, editing only the hand region of a real photograph to introduce accessories, can close this shift gap and improve detection of real hands at deployment. On a paired dataset of real images and their synthetic counterparts, we evaluate YOLOv8n hand detectors across six experiments (A-F), four of which involve training (A, C, D, E) under three random seeds each, evaluate them on a real test set and on a real-gloves-only test split, and report the mean average precision (mAP) at two overlap thresholds (mAP@0.5 and mAP@0.5:0.95) along with paired statistical tests. A two-stage experiment: train on real U synthetic data, then fine-tune the resulting weights on real-only at a lower learning rate, directionally improves mAP@0.5 compared to the real-only baseline model on the standard real test set, and narrows the real-gloves out-of-distribution gap. Another three-stage experiment preserves box-tightness best, achieving the highest mAP@0.5:0.95 among experiments in the study. The synthetic-data utility for safety-critical hand detection depends on the training procedure, and simple multi-stage experiments extract substantial real-deployment benefit from inpainted accessory data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究生成式修复（generative inpainting）仅编辑真实照片的手部区域以加入手套等配件，能否缩小安全关键手部检测中的分布偏移并提升部署表现。作者在成对真实/合成数据上用 YOLOv8n 设计了六个实验（A-F），其中四个含训练且各用三个随机种子，在真实测试集和真实手套专用测试子集上报告 mAP@0.5 与 mAP@0.5:0.95，并做配对统计检验。结果显示两阶段训练（先真实+合成训练，再低学习率在真实数据上微调）方向性提升标准测试集的 mAP@0.5 并缩小手套越界差距，三阶段实验则取得最高的 mAP@0.5:0.95。
Motivation: 公共手部检测数据集大多只含裸手，无法覆盖手套、纹身、首饰等个人防护装备带来的手部外观变化，导致安全关键应用部署时出现分布偏移。论文想检验生成式修复是否通过只修改真实照片的手部区域来补充这些外观变化，从而改善其实部署检测。
Method: 采用生成式修复方法仅对真实照片的手部区域进行编辑以引入配件，构建成对真实-合成数据集；随后在六个实验（A-F）中用 YOLOv8n 训练和评估手部检测器，四个训练实验各使用三个随机种子，并在标准真实测试集及真实手套专用子集上比较 mAP 和进行配对统计检验。
Result: 两阶段实验（先在真实+合成数据上训练，再在仅真实数据上用较低学习率微调）相比仅真实基线在标准真实测试集上方向性提升 mAP@0.5，并缩小真实手套越界（out-of-distribution）差距；三阶段实验在研究中取得最高 mAP@0.5:0.95，最保持框紧密度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调合成数据对安全关键手部检测是否有效取决于训练流程，简单的多阶段训练流程即可从修复配件数据中获得实质性的真实部署收益。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Pairwise Preferences in Long-Term Decision Problems
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with scalar rewards is widely used for aligning machine-learning systems with user preferences. But, pairwise preferences are often more natural for users to specify than scalar rewards, and they express certain goals that scalar rewards cannot. Methods for reinforcement learning with pairwise preferences have thus received growing interest. Unfortunately, these methods are inefficient in problems with long time horizons, and they lack guarantees on the performance of Markov policies relative to history-dependent policies, which bridge the theory and practice of reinforcement learning. We address these limitations in a new problem setting for reinforcement learning with pairwise preferences called the \textit{Markov decision contest}. In this setting, we prove that stationary Markov policies perform just as well as history-dependent policies; that the problem of recovering an optimal policy exactly is in P; and that a simple iterative algorithm converges to an optimal policy at a sublinear rate. Lastly, we implement a deep-learning variant of our iterative algorithm and demonstrate its efficiency in long-term decision problems that require function approximation.
papers.comment: Accepted for ICML 2026. v2 has an updated abstract and introduction. Results and conclusions are unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个新的成对偏好强化学习问题设定——马尔可夫决策竞赛 (Markov decision contest)。作者证明在该设定下，平稳马尔可夫策略 (stationary Markov policy) 的表现与历史依赖策略 (history-dependent policy) 一样好，精确恢复最优策略的问题属于复杂度类 P，并给出一个以次线性速率收敛的简单迭代算法。文中还实现了该算法的深度学习变体，并在需要函数逼近的长时域决策问题中展示了其效率。
Motivation: 标量奖励被广泛用于对齐系统与用户偏好，但用户往往更自然地给出成对偏好，且成对偏好能表达某些标量奖励无法表达的目标。现有成对偏好强化学习方法在长时域问题中效率较低，也缺乏关于马尔可夫策略相对历史依赖策略性能的保证，这阻碍了理论与实践之间的衔接。
Method: 定义新的问题设定 Markov decision contest，在此框架下研究成对偏好强化学习；证明平稳马尔可夫策略与历史依赖策略等价，证明精确恢复最优策略的可解性属于 P，并设计一个保证次线性收敛的迭代算法，同时给出其深度学习变体。
Result: 摘要报告了三个理论结果：平稳马尔可夫策略与历史依赖策略性能相同；精确恢复最优策略问题属于 P；简单迭代算法以次线性速率收敛到最优策略。深度学习变体在需要函数逼近的长时域决策问题中表现出效率。
Conclusion: 该设定为长时域成对偏好强化学习提供了理论保证和高效算法，摘要强调其有助于弥合强化学习理论与实践的差距。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Annealed Softmax Greedy in Many-Armed Bayesian Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and group-based policy optimization methods such as GRPO update a stochastic policy by sampling multiple completions per prompt and increasing the policy's probability on those with higher reward, regularized by a KL penalty toward a reference policy. These updates do not include explicit mechanisms that track epistemic uncertainty. This paper studies a stylized explanation for why such uncertainty-agnostic updates can nevertheless be effective. We analyze an annealed softmax (Boltzmann) policy that selects actions according to a softmax of empirical mean rewards in a many-armed Bayesian Bernoulli bandit. Under a linear upper-tail condition on the prior (the $β=1$ case of $β$-regularity), which implies an abundance of near-optimal arms, we prove that annealed softmax greedy achieves Bayes regret $\tilde{O}(m + T/m)$, and in particular $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ when the number of arms scales as $m = Θ(\sqrt{T})$. This is the near-optimal Bayes regret rate in this regime, attained also by empirical-mean greedy. Under $β$-regularity, many arms maintain empirical means close to the optimum throughout learning, so when softmax samples an arm other than the empirically best, that arm tends to be another near-optimal one rather than a clearly inferior one. By contrast, with a small number of arms, the same kind of softmax policy can suffer linear regret. The result also provides a structural analogy to RLVR, where a base policy with a non-negligible probability of producing a correct completion plays the role of $β$-regularity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多臂贝叶斯 Bernoulli bandit 中的退火 softmax (annealed softmax / Boltzmann) 贪心策略，试图解释 RLVR 与 GRPO 这类不显式追踪认知不确定性的策略更新为何仍然有效。作者证明在满足线性上尾条件（β-regularity 的 β=1 情形）的先验下，annealed softmax greedy 达到 Bayes regret O~(m + T/m)，当臂数 m=Θ(√T) 时为 O~(√T)，该率与 empirical-mean greedy 同阶且接近最优；而臂数较少时同类 softmax 策略可能遭受线性 regret。
Motivation: RLVR 和基于组的策略优化（如 GRPO）在更新策略时只依赖采样完成结果与 KL 惩罚，缺少显式的 epistemic uncertainty 追踪机制，但实践中效果良好；作者希望用多臂 bandit 的退火 softmax 策略给出一个风格化解释。
Method: 采用理论分析方法：在 many-armed Bayesian Bernoulli bandit 中考察按经验均值 reward 的 softmax 选择策略，并假设先验满足 β-regularity 的 β=1 情形（线性上尾条件，意味着大量近最优臂），据此推导 Bayes regret 上界并与 greedy 策略对比。
Result: 摘要证明 annealed softmax greedy 的 Bayes regret 为 O~(m + T/m)，特别在 m=Θ(√T) 时达到 O~(√T)，是该机制下的近最优率；在 β-regularity 下许多臂的经验均值始终接近最优，因此 softmax 采样到非最优臂时往往仍是近最优臂。相反，臂数很少时同类策略可能产生线性 regret。
Conclusion: 摘要给出的核心结论是：不确定性无感知的 softmax 型更新在臂数充足的近最优臂环境下依然高效，并将该结构与 RLVR 类比——基策略以不可忽略概率产出正确 completion 相当于 β-regularity 的作用；本文属于风格化理论解释，不涉及实际 RLVR 实验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DualEraser: Joint Video Object and Effect Removal via Balanced Text-Mask Guidance and Decoupled Locator-Preserver
papers.abstract_en: Video object removal frequently struggles to eliminate target objects and their associated complex physical effects (e.g., smoke and light) in real-world scenes. We attribute this challenge to a fundamental semantic--pixel conflict, which manifests at two aspects: condition-level modality dissonance and optimization-level objective entanglement. In terms of conditioning, modality dissonance emerges from single-modality information incompleteness and cross-modal dominance imbalance. During optimization, two conflicting objectives---high-level semantic erasure and pixel-level background preservation---are inextricably entangled within a single model. To address these conflicts, we propose DualEraser, a novel framework for joint video object and effect removal. First, a Bipartite Text prompt and a Multi-Conditional Capability Elicitation (MCCE) mechanism explicitly inject effect semantics and further leverage multimodal priors to address the limitations of individual modalities. Second, a Learnable Deep CFG Fusion (LD-CFG) module adaptively balances the relative dominance between the text and mask conditions. Finally, we introduce a decoupled expert architecture comprising a Locator for semantic erasure and a Preserver for background pixel alignment to break the objective entanglement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DualEraser achieves state-of-the-art quantitative performance on standard benchmarks (e.g., gains of 2.16 dB and 1.44 dB on ROSE and VOR-Eval, respectively), while enabling robust removal of complex effects in open-world videos. https://cyqii.github.io/DualEraser.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DualEraser，面向视频中目标物体及其关联复杂物理效果（如烟雾、光照）的联合移除框架。作者将任务难点归因于语义-像素冲突，具体表现为条件层面的模态失谐（modality dissonance）与优化层面的目标纠缠（objective entanglement），并据此设计文本-掩码双条件引导与解耦的 Locator-Preserver 架构。摘要报告该方法在 ROSE 和 VOR-Eval 基准上分别取得 2.16 dB 和 1.44 dB 的提升，且能稳健移除开放世界视频中的复杂效果。
Motivation: 现有视频物体移除方法难以同时消除目标物体及其关联的复杂物理效果。作者认为其根源是单一模态信息不完整与跨模态支配不平衡导致的条件级模态失谐，以及高层语义擦除与像素级背景保持在单一模型内相互纠缠所造成的优化级目标纠缠。
Method: 提出 DualEraser 框架：通过双部文本提示（Bipartite Text prompt）与多条件能力激发（MCCE）机制显式注入效果语义并利用多模态先验；引入可学习深度 CFG 融合（LD-CFG）模块自适应平衡文本与掩码条件的相对主导地位；并采用解耦专家架构，由 Locator 负责语义擦除、Preserver 负责背景像素对齐。
Result: 摘要报告 DualEraser 在标准基准上达到当前最优定量性能，在 ROSE 和 VOR-Eval 上分别获得 2.16 dB 与 1.44 dB 的提升，并在开放世界视频上实现复杂效果的稳健移除。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过显式效果语义注入、条件间自适应平衡以及解耦的定位-保留架构，可以有效打破语义擦除与背景保持之间的目标纠缠，从而改进视频物体与效果联合移除的效果。摘要未明确讨论方法局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RIG-RoPE: Relation-Stratified Multimodal Attention with Instance-Local Rotary Geometry and Representation-Aware Traversal Coordinates
papers.abstract_en: Rotary positional encoding (RoPE) is a core component of modern language models and has been extended to multimodal LLMs through multidimensional variants such as multimodal RoPE (M-RoPE), which split positional channels into temporal, height, and width subspaces. This report identifies two limitations of static multidimensional position assignment in interleaved multimodal contexts. First, height/width rotations may be applied to token pairs whose spatial displacement is not a well-defined geometric object, producing cross-modal and inter-instance spatial interference. Second, temporal coordinates are often treated as equal-step counters, so a text token, an image block, and a video segment can advance the temporal phase by comparable amounts despite different information density. We propose RIG-RoPE, a relation- and instance-gated RoPE mechanism with duration-aware temporal coordinates. RIG-RoPE augments each token with a modality indicator, a visual instance identifier, and a scalar information-duration coordinate. It enables H/W rotations only for query-key pairs from the same visual instance; otherwise the unknown spatial displacement is marginalized rather than set to zero. Temporal rotations use interpolated cumulative block durations: text tokens consume unit duration, images use a dimension-aware logarithmic spatial scale, and videos further apply a logarithmic temporal extension over effective frames. We provide a gauge-invariance argument for avoiding ordinary cross-instance spatial rotation, an impossibility result for static IDs under shared H/W subspaces, and a duration-consistency argument against equal-step multimodal time. RIG-RoPE adds no learned parameters and can be implemented inside tiled attention kernels with constant additional metadata per token. This preliminary report establishes the formulation and validation path without claiming empirical superiority.

TL;DR: 本文提出 RIG-RoPE，一种面向交错多模态上下文的 relation- 与 instance-gated 旋转位置编码（RoPE），用于解决多维静态位置分配的两个问题：跨模态/跨实例空间干扰，以及把时间坐标当作等步长计数器而忽略不同模态信息密度。该方法为每个 token 增加模态指示符、视觉实例标识和标量信息时长坐标，并仅在同一视觉实例内启用 H/W 旋转，时间旋转采用插值累积块时长。这是初步技术报告，未声称实证优势，实验验证留待未来工作。
Motivation: 多模态 LLM 中常用的 M-RoPE 将位置通道拆成时间、高、宽子空间，但在交错多模态文本/图像/视频中，部分 token 对的空间位移不是良定几何对象，强行施加 H/W 旋转会带来跨模态与跨实例干扰；同时时间坐标若按等步长计数，无法反映文本、图像块、视频段的信息密度差异。
Method: RIG-RoPE 为每个 token 附加模态指示符、视觉实例标识符和标量信息时长坐标：仅对同一视觉实例的 query-key 对启用 H/W 旋转，其余情形将未知空间位移边际化而不是置零；时间旋转使用插值的累积块时长，文本消耗单位时长，图像使用维度感知的对数空间尺度，视频在对数帧数上做对数时间扩展。论文还给出 gauge-invariance 论证、静态 ID 在共享 H/W 子空间下的不可能性结果，以及反对等步长多模态时间的时长一致性论证；方法不增加可学习参数，可在 tiled attention kernel 内以常量额外元数据实现。
Result: 摘要未报告实验数据；本文定位为 preliminary report，仅建立公式化表述和验证路径，明确不声称经验优越性，实证验证留给未来工作。
Conclusion: 主要结论是：通过 relation-/instance-gated 旋转和 duration-aware 时间坐标，可以在不引入可学习参数的情况下避免跨实例空间旋转与等步长时间计数带来的问题；但论文本身强调这是初步技术报告，其有效性需后续实验验证。

papers.title: INSHAPE: Instance-Level Shapelets for Interpretable Time-Series Classification
papers.abstract_en: Discovering shapelets -- i.e., discriminative temporal patterns within time series -- has been widely studied to address the inherent complexity of time-series classification (TSC) and to make model decision-making processes more transparent. However, existing methods primarily focus on population-level shapelets optimized across the entire dataset, which leads to two fundamental limitations: (i) population-level patterns often misalign with instance-specific features, resulting in suboptimal performance and potentially misleading interpretations, and (ii) most methods treat shapelets as independent entities, overlooking important temporal dependencies and interactions among multiple patterns. To address these limitations, we propose INSHAPE, an interpretable TSC framework that discovers variable-length, discriminative temporal patterns specific to each time series. INSHAPE identifies these patterns as non-overlapping segments and models their temporal dependencies, thereby providing clear instance-level interpretations while achieving strong predictive performance. Furthermore, INSHAPE bridges local and global interpretability through a bottom-up approach, aggregating instance-level shapelets into prototypical (population-level) shapelets. Extensive experiments on 128 UCR and 30 UEA benchmark datasets show that INSHAPE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art shapelet-based methods while providing more intuitive and interpretable insights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 INSHAPE，一个面向可解释时间序列分类（TSC）的框架，为每条时间序列发现可变长度的判别性时序模式（shapelet），并将其建模为互不重叠的片段以刻画时序依赖关系。作者通过自底向上的方式将实例级 shapelet 聚合成原型（population-level）shapelet，从而桥接局部与全局可解释性。在 128 个 UCR 与 30 个 UEA 基准数据集上的实验表明，INSHAPE 持续优于最先进的基于 shapelet 的方法。
Motivation: 现有 shapelet 方法主要优化数据集层面的群体级模式，容易与实例特定特征错位，导致分类性能次优且解释可能产生误导；同时多数方法将 shapelet 视为独立实体，忽略了多个模式之间的时间依赖与交互。
Method: INSHAPE 为每条时间序列学习可变长度的判别性时序模式，将其识别为非重叠片段并显式建模片段间的时序依赖；随后采用自底向上的聚合策略，把实例级 shapelet 归纳为原型（population-level）shapelet，以同时支持局部与全局解释。
Result: 在 128 个 UCR 和 30 个 UEA 基准数据集上的大量实验中，INSHAPE 一致优于最先进的基于 shapelet 的方法，同时提供更直观且可解释的洞察。
Conclusion: 作者强调实例级 shapelet 及其时序依赖建模既能提升预测性能，又能提供清晰的实例级解释，并通过原型聚合实现了局部与全局可解释性的统一。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TabH2O: A Unified Foundation Model for Tabular Prediction
papers.abstract_en: We present TabH2O, a foundation model for tabular data that performs classification and regression in a single forward pass via in-context learning. TabH2O builds on the TabICL architecture with several key modifications: (1) unified training, a single model handles both classification and regression via a dual-head architecture, eliminating the need for separate models and reducing total pretraining cost; (2) single-stage pretraining, training stability improvements (bounded scalable softmax, inter-stage normalization, learnable residual scaling, logit soft-capping) eliminate the need for multi-stage curriculum learning, enabling training with full-length sequences from the start; and (3) noise-aware pretraining, synthetic datasets include explicit noise dimensions to teach the model robustness to irrelevant features. We evaluate TabH2O v1.1 (29.2M parameters) on the TALENT benchmark (300 datasets), where it achieves an average rank of 2.54 out of 6 evaluated methods, outperforming tuned CatBoost (4.00), H2O AutoML (4.28), LightGBM (4.98), and TabPFN v2.6 (2.80), and competitive compared to TabICL v2 (2.13), while placing in the top-3 on 80% of the testing datasets across classification and regression tasks. We also achieve state-of-the-art results on TabArena. Moreover, our single model is well-suited to tabular datasets up to roughly 500,000 rows and 100 features.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TabH2O，一个基于 TabICL 架构的表格数据基础模型，通过双头架构统一分类与回归，并采用单阶段预训练与噪声感知预训练。模型参数 29.2M，在 TALENT 基准的 300 个数据集上平均排名 2.54/6，优于调参后的 CatBoost、H2O AutoML、LightGBM 及 TabPFN v2.6，与 TabICL v2（2.13）相当，且在 TabArena 上达到 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有表格基础模型常需要多阶段课程学习来保障训练稳定性，且分类与回归需要分开训练；同时模型对无关特征缺乏鲁棒性。TabH2O 旨在通过统一训练和单阶段预训练降低预训练成本并提升稳定性。
Method: 在 TabICL 架构上做三点关键修改：一是采用双头架构让单一模型同时处理分类和回归；二是通过有界可扩展 softmax、阶段间归一化、可学习残差缩放和 logit soft-capping 等改进消除多阶段课程学习，直接从完整长度序列开始训练；三是在合成数据中加入显式噪声维度，进行噪声感知预训练以增强对无关特征的鲁棒性。
Result: 在 TALENT 基准（300 个数据集）上，TabH2O v1.1 取得 2.54 的平均排名，优于 CatBoost（4.00）、H2O AutoML（4.28）、LightGBM（4.98）和 TabPFN v2.6（2.80），仅次于 TabICL v2（2.13），并在 80% 的测试数据集上进入前三名，同时在 TabArena 上取得 SOTA 结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调单一模型即可适用于约 50 万行、100 特征的表格数据集，表明统一训练与噪声感知预训练能在保持竞争力的同时降低预训练成本。摘要未讨论具体局限性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: SAFE-SVD: Sensitivity-Aware Fidelity-Enforcing SVD for Physics Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose a new method for compressing physics foundation models (PFMs) which is a new trend in AI for Science. While model compression is essential for reducing memory use and accelerating inference in large foundation models, it remains under-explored for PFMs, where preserving physical fidelity is crucial. The challenge lies in the functional nature of physics data, where partial derivatives encode spatiotemporal dynamics and exhibit high sensitivity to compression. Conventional compression methods ignore this structure, often causing severe performance degradation or failure. To address this, we introduce a sensitivity-aware fidelity-enforcing compression framework that explicitly models loss-aware layer sensitivity in the output function space during compression. This provides a new route to compressing scientific foundation models while preserving accuracy and physical fidelity. Experiments show substantial gains over existing methods across multiple models and datasets, achieving significantly higher compression ratios while maintaining accuracy, in some cases by orders of magnitude. More broadly, the work potentially leads to a new subfield of efficient, deployable, and sustainable scientific foundation models in AI for Science.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAFE-SVD，一种面向物理基础模型（PFM）的压缩方法，核心是在输出函数空间中显式建模损失敏感的逐层灵敏度，从而在压缩时保持物理保真度。摘要报告在多个模型和数据集上相比现有方法获得显著更高的压缩比，同时保持精度。
Motivation: 物理基础模型在 AI for Science 中日益重要，但模型压缩在 PFM 上研究不足。物理数据的函数性质使偏导数编码时空动态，对压缩高度敏感，传统压缩方法忽略该结构，常导致性能严重下降。
Method: 提出灵敏度感知的保真性强制压缩框架，在压缩过程中显式建模输出函数空间中的逐层损失灵敏度（loss-aware layer sensitivity），用于指导 SVD 类压缩。
Result: 实验显示相比现有方法在多个模型和数据集上获得显著提升，实现更高压缩比同时保持精度，某些情况下压缩比提升达数量级。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作可能为高效、可部署、可持续的科学基础模型开辟新的子方向，但摘要未讨论具体局限。

papers.title: Robust Checkpoint Selection for Multimodal LLMs via Agentic Evaluation and Stability-Aware Ranking
papers.abstract_en: Selecting a final checkpoint for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is challenging when late-stage candidates are closely matched and downstream evaluation signals are noisy. Small observed differences can be comparable to variability introduced by finite evaluation samples, LLM-based judges, and ambiguous multimodal evidence, while validation loss may not identify the checkpoint preferred by downstream evaluation. We formulate late-stage checkpoint selection as a stability-aware decision problem under evaluation uncertainty and propose a progressive framework combining pointwise filtering, listwise ranking, and pairwise refinement. Repeated evaluation-set subsampling is used to characterize ranking stability, while percentile-based aggregation accounts for lower- and upper-tail behavior. Experiments show that multimodal data evaluability is critical: quality-aware curation of OCR-heavy inputs reduces ranking flip rate from 32.5\% to 11.2\% and increases inter-run agreement from 0.61 to 0.84. We further observe divergence between validation-loss progression and downstream checkpoint preference in two independent MLLM settings. An additional public Qwen2.5-VL-7B reproduction across 11 checkpoints shows tightly clustered pointwise scores and frequently tie-dominated final pairwise comparisons, while repeated evaluation most often selects an intermediate rather than the final checkpoint. These results suggest that reliable MLLM checkpoint selection should quantify and reserve evaluation uncertainty rather than force decisions from small differences in a single metric.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在后期阶段 checkpoint 选择中的不确定性问题，提出一种稳定性感知的渐进式选择框架，结合逐点过滤（pointwise filtering）、列表排序（listwise ranking）和成对精炼（pairwise refinement）。摘要报告称，对 OCR 密集输入进行质量感知筛选可将排序翻转率从 32.5% 降至 11.2%，并将多次运行间一致性从 0.61 提升到 0.84；同时观察到验证损失走势与下游偏好存在分歧。
Motivation: 当后期候选 checkpoint 表现接近且下游评估信号含噪时，小幅度观测差异可能与有限评估样本、LLM 评判者和模糊多模态证据引入的波动相当，而验证损失不一定能选出下游评估偏好的 checkpoint。
Method: 将后期 checkpoint 选择形式化为评估不确定性下的稳定性感知决策问题，提出渐进式框架：先逐点过滤，再列表排序，最后成对精炼；通过重复评估子采样刻画排序稳定性，并用基于百分位的聚合来反映下尾和上尾行为。
Result: 实验表明，对 OCR 密集输入进行质量感知筛选使排序翻转率从 32.5% 降至 11.2%，多次运行间一致性从 0.61 升至 0.84；在两个独立 MLLM 设置中观察到验证损失走势与下游偏好背离。Qwen2.5-VL-7B 在 11 个 checkpoint 上的复现显示逐点评分高度聚集、成对比较常被平局主导，重复评估更常选中中间 checkpoint 而非最后一个。
Conclusion: 可靠的 MLLM checkpoint 选择应当量化并保留评估不确定性，而不是从一个单一指标的小差异中强行做出决策。
