papers.title: A Hierarchical Energy-Based Model for Multimodal Cognition
papers.abstract_en: We propose IM-LEPP (Integrated Multimodal Latent Energy-based Predictive Processing), a hierarchical, energy-based model of multimodal cognition that extends a previously proposed single-modality model (LEPP) to integrate vision and language. Following the view that generative neural networks are effective theories of cognitive dynamics, analogous to how statistical mechanics relates to thermodynamics, IM-LEPP models cognition as latent states flowing through learned energy landscapes rather than as an account of neural circuitry. The architecture is a hub-and-spoke hierarchy, grounded in the controlled semantic cognition framework of Lambon Ralph et al., in which predictive-coding pipelines for visual objects, scenes, and linguistic units converge on a shared amodal hub modeled on the anterior temporal lobe. Each pipeline's own prediction is conditioned by, rather than overwritten by, the current hub state, preserving pipeline-specific identity while letting every prediction reflect the full multimodal context. We show this architecture gives a mechanistic account of attentional phenomena such as inattentional blindness and Necker-cube bistability, and that its structure recovers or motivates independently established findings in psycholinguistics, including surprisal theory, the N400/P600 ERP components, and garden-path reanalysis, alongside a falsifiable contrast with transformer language models on trajectory-sensitivity in next-word prediction. We also discuss data-efficient language acquisition relative to LLMs, outline a semantic/episodic memory subsystem, situate the model against predictive coding, the free-energy principle, JEPA, and Hierarchical Temporal Memory, and propose concrete experimental predictions to test its central claims Key Words: predictive processing; predictive coding; energy-based models; diffusion models; effective theory; computational neuroscience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IM-LEPP（Integrated Multimodal Latent Energy-based Predictive Processing），一个将先前单模态模型 LEPP 扩展至视觉与语言整合的层级能量模型。该模型把认知刻画为潜状态在习得的能量景观中流动，采用基于 Lambon Ralph 等人 controlled semantic cognition 框架的 hub-and-spoke 层级：视觉对象、场景和语言单元的预测编码管道汇聚到一个模拟前颞叶的共享无模态枢纽。作者称这一架构能机制性地解释不注意盲视与 Necker 立方体双稳态等注意现象，并恢复或推导出心理语言学中已确立的发现，如惊异理论、N400/P600 ERP 成分和花园路径重分析。
Motivation: 现有把生成神经网络视为认知动力学有效理论的工作多局限于单模态，缺乏一个能同时整合视觉与语言、并统一解释注意现象与心理语言学数据的层级能量模型。
Method: 提出 IM-LEPP，采用 hub-and-spoke 层级结构，其中各模态的预测编码管道（视觉对象、场景、语言单元）汇聚到共享的无模态枢纽；每个管道的预测被当前枢纽状态条件化而非覆盖，从而既保留管道特异性又让预测反映完整多模态上下文。
Result: 摘要报告该架构对不注意盲视和 Necker 立方体双稳态给出机制性解释，并恢复或推导出心理语言学中的既有发现，包括惊异理论、N400/P600 ERP 成分和花园路径重分析；此外提出与 Transformer 语言模型在下一词预测轨迹敏感性上的可证伪对比。
Conclusion: 论文还讨论相对 LLM 更数据高效的语言习得、提出语义/情景记忆子系统，并将模型与预测编码、自由能原理、JEPA 和层级时序记忆等框架对照，给出具体实验预测以检验核心主张；作者强调该模型是认知动力学的有效理论，而非对神经回路的详细刻画。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Research Assistant: AstraZeneca's Agentic System for R&D
papers.abstract_en: We describe Research Assistant, an internal LLM-based system developed at AstraZeneca to help scientists and clinicians explore biomedical questions across a broad range of data sources. The system provides a chat-style interface that brings together evidence from scientific literature, knowledge graphs, chemistry, clinical trials, safety resources, expression data, and internal experimental systems. It supports both a fast mode for direct question answering and a multi-step mode for more complex research tasks. Responses are grounded in retrieved evidence and linked back to the original sources, allowing users to review and further explore the underlying data. In this technical note, we outline the system architecture, the main design choices behind the product, and lessons learned from deploying it at scale to support day-to-day R&D workflows across AstraZeneca.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 AstraZeneca 内部开发的基于 LLM 的 Research Assistant 系统，帮助科学家和临床医生在多种生物医学数据源中探索问题。系统提供聊天式界面，整合科学文献、知识图谱、化学、临床试验、安全资源、表达数据和内部实验系统等数据，并支持快速直接问答模式与面向复杂研究任务的多步模式。回答基于检索证据并链接回原始来源，便于用户审查和深入探索。该技术报告概述系统架构、产品设计选择以及大规模部署支持日常 R&D 工作流的经验教训。
Motivation: 科学家和临床医生需要在大量分散的生物医学数据源中查找和整合证据，现有工具难以高效支持多样化的研究问题，因此需要一个统一的问答系统来降低检索和推理成本。
Method: 构建基于 LLM 的聊天式问答系统，集成多类异构数据源；提供 fast mode 用于直接问答，multi-step mode 用于复杂研究任务；响应通过检索证据进行 grounding，并链接原始来源以便追溯。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验指标，主要呈现系统架构、设计选择以及在大规模部署中支持 AstraZeneca 日常研发工作流的实践经验。
Conclusion: 作者将该工作定位为技术报告，强调从大规模实际部署中总结的经验教训，表明系统已融入日常 R&D 流程；未讨论具体性能评估或局限性。

papers.title: Unified Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Complex Graph Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Graph reasoning provides a promising testbed for evaluating the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs), as graph instances can be programmatically generated, structurally controlled, and naturally scaled to long-input settings. However, existing graph reasoning benchmarks have limited coverage of data complexity, rely heavily on manual construction, and lack unified evaluation across text-based and code-based reasoning modes. To address these limitations, we propose {\dataset}, a five-stage \textit{semi-automatic} framework for constructing complex graph reasoning benchmarks. It expands benchmark coverage along five dimensions: \textit{Graph Size}, \textit{Task Complexity}, \textit{Task Description}, \textit{Graph Loading}, and \textit{Task Source}. The framework uses an LLM-based data generator to automatically produce task descriptions, graph data, reference solutions, graph-loading scripts, question forms, and evaluation scripts, while retaining human validation at key quality-control stages. Based on it, we construct a benchmark with $202$ tasks and evaluate LLMs under text-based, code-based, and augmented reasoning settings. Experiments show that the complexity dimensions reveal model limitations that are less visible in existing benchmarks; existing fine-tuned models struggle to generalize to GraphGym, whereas retrieval-augmented methods show scenario-dependent adaptability, improving textual reasoning but not consistently improving coding reasoning. These findings suggest that ours serves as a challenging and diagnostic benchmark for graph reasoning and provides empirical guidance for future enhancement methods. Code and dataset will be published soon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GraphGym，一个基于五阶段半自动流程构建的复杂图推理基准，沿图规模、任务复杂度、任务描述、图加载和任务来源五个维度扩展覆盖，包含 202 个任务。作者在文本、代码和增强推理三种设置下评估 LLM，发现现有微调模型难以泛化到该基准，检索增强方法仅在文本推理上稳定获益。摘要认为该基准可作为有挑战性和诊断性的图推理测试床，并为未来增强方法提供经验指导。
Motivation: 现有图推理基准对数据复杂性的覆盖有限，严重依赖人工构建，且缺乏对文本推理与代码推理两种模式的统一评估。
Method: 提出五阶段半自动框架，使用基于 LLM 的数据生成器自动产出任务描述、图数据、参考解、图加载脚本、问题形式和评测脚本，并在关键质量控制阶段保留人工验证，同时沿五个维度系统扩展任务覆盖。
Result: 构建了含 202 个任务的基准并评估多种 LLM，实验显示这些复杂度维度能暴露现有基准不易发现的模型局限：微调模型难以泛化到 GraphGym，而检索增强方法表现出场景依赖性，可提升文本推理但未一致提升代码推理。
Conclusion: GraphGym 被定位为有挑战性的诊断性图推理基准，其发现可为未来模型增强方法提供经验指导；论文目前处于审稿阶段，代码与数据将公开发布。

papers.title: Learning to Adapt Cross-Domain Preferences via Meta-LoRA for LLM Personalization
papers.abstract_en: Cross-domain zero- or few-shot personalization aims to generate user-preferred responses in unseen conversational domains from only a handful of target-domain interactions. Existing adaptation methods struggle to calibrate update magnitude under sparse evidence and thus overfit, whereas history-transfer methods often entangle user preferences with source-domain artifacts, yielding unreliable personalization priors and negative transfer. To calibrate adaptation to evidence quality, we propose PAC-Bayes-regularized Meta-LoRA, which uses a meta-learned LoRA initialization as both the adaptation start and prior center, while adjusting update strength according to support-set size and predictive uncertainty. This limits overfitting under sparse or ambiguous evidence while permitting stronger personalization as evidence grows. Controlled adaptation alone does not determine which preferences should transfer across domains or how they should be expressed. We therefore functionally decompose personalization priors into user and domain components, using a human-readable prompt for stable preferences and topology-preserving soft tokens for domain-specific hidden-space conditioning. Experiments across multiple benchmarks and personalization tasks show consistent gains over strong baselines. On HiCUPID, our method reduces cross-domain win-rate degradation by 47.9% relative to the best competing baseline and improves win rate by 110.2% under unseen-user cold start.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PAC-Bayes 正则化的 Meta-LoRA，用于跨域零样本/少样本 LLM 个性化（personalization），目标是在仅见少量目标域交互时生成符合用户偏好的回复。方法以元学习的 LoRA 初始化作为起点和先验中心，根据支持集规模与预测不确定性调节更新强度，并将个性化先验分解为用户与域两个组件。实验在多个基准上报告一致改进，其中在 HiCUPID 上相对最强基线将跨域胜率退化降低 47.9%，并在未见用户冷启动下将胜率提升 110.2%。
Motivation: 现有跨域个性化方法在证据稀疏时难以校准更新幅度而容易过拟合，历史迁移方法则常把用户偏好与源域伪影纠缠在一起，导致不可靠的个性化先验和负迁移。
Method: 提出 PAC-Bayes 正则化的 Meta-LoRA，使用元学习的 LoRA 初始化同时作为适配起点与先验中心，并按支持集大小和预测不确定性调整更新强度；同时将个性化先验功能性地分解为用户组件（人类可读提示词）和域组件（保持拓扑的软 token 隐空间条件）。
Result: 在多个基准与个性化任务上相对强基线有一致提升；在 HiCUPID 上相对最佳对比基线将跨域胜率退化降低 47.9%，未见用户冷启动下胜率提高 110.2%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，依据证据质量校准 LoRA 更新强度并解耦用户与域先验，可以缓解稀疏证据下的过拟合并改善跨域个性化迁移。

summary_sections.result: 在多个基准与个性化任务上相对强基线有一致提升；在 HiCUPID 上相对最佳对比基线将跨域胜率退化降低 47.9%，未见用户冷启动下胜率提高 110.2%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，依据证据质量校准 LoRA 更新强度并解耦用户与域先验，可以缓解稀疏证据下的过拟合并改善跨域个性化迁移。

papers.title: A Bayes-Markov Neuromorphic Model of Cortical Orientation Selectivity: A Computational Re-implementation and Quantitative Simulation Study
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of orientation selectivity in the primary visual cortex (V1) remains a central question in computational neuroscience. Shirazi's Bayes-Markov model proposed a probabilistic explanation for how orientation-selective inhibition can arise from non-oriented lateral geniculate nucleus (LGN) inputs through local inference. In that formulation, the activity pattern of striate cortical inhibitory (SCI) cells is estimated from the LGN activity pattern by a maximum a posteriori (MAP) criterion over a two-layer hierarchical Markov random field, and the resulting inference is implemented through a local parallel relaxation algorithm. We provide a computationally explicit re-implementation and quantitative simulation study of this framework. We reconstruct the mathematical model, describe its fully LGN-driven update rule, and implement a vectorized simulation framework that preserves the original local clique operations while making systematic parameter sweeps feasible. We evaluate the model using orientation tuning curves, an orientation selectivity index (OSI), controlled LGN noise perturbations, contrast tests, and model-variant comparisons. We further add a spiking SCI-layer realization using leaky integrate-and-fire and Hodgkin-Huxley neurons to examine whether the rate-coded SCI field can be expressed through temporally explicit neural activity. The simulations support the central qualitative behavior of the Bayes-Markov framework: sharp orientation selectivity, robustness to moderate LGN noise, and a biologically interpretable proof-of-concept spiking realization of the inferred inhibitory field.
papers.comment: 24 pages. Computational neuroscience; orientation selectivity; neuromorphic modeling
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 Shirazi 提出的 Bayes-Markov 皮层方位选择性模型做了计算上明确的再实现与定量仿真研究。作者重建了该数学模型，给出完全由 LGN 驱动的更新规则，并实现保持原始局部 clique 操作的向量化仿真框架，使系统化参数扫描变得可行。仿真使用方位调谐曲线、方位选择性指数 (OSI)、受控 LGN 噪声扰动、对比度测试和模型变体比较进行评估，并额外加入基于 leaky integrate-and-fire 和 Hodgkin-Huxley 神经元的放电型 SCI 层实现。结果表明该框架能产生尖锐的方位选择性、对中等 LGN 噪声具有稳健性，并提供了推断抑制场的放电实现概念验证。
Motivation: 初级视觉皮层 (V1) 方位选择性的涌现仍是计算神经科学的核心问题，Shirazi 的 Bayes-Markov 模型试图从非选择性 LGN 输入出发，通过局部推断解释方位选择性抑制的产生。该工作针对这一理论框架缺乏计算上明确、可定量验证的实现而展开。
Method: 作者重建了两层层次马尔可夫随机场上的 MAP 推断模型，描述完全由 LGN 驱动的局部并行松弛更新规则，并设计保持局部 clique 操作的向量化仿真框架以支持系统参数扫描。仿真中进一步用 leaky integrate-and-fire 与 Hodgkin-Huxley 神经元实现放电型 SCI 层，考察速率编码的 SCI 场能否由时间显式的神经活动表达。
Result: 仿真支持 Bayes-Markov 框架的核心定性行为：从非选择性 LGN 输入中涌现尖锐的方位选择性，对中等 LGN 噪声保持稳健，并能给出推断抑制场的具有生物学可解释性的放电实现概念验证。摘要未报告定量数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为该再实现与仿真确证了 Bayes-Markov 框架能够在局部推断机制下由非方位选择性输入产生方位选择性抑制场，放电型神经元实现也表明速率编码的推断场可被时间显式活动表达。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Query Timing Produces Opposite Positional Biases Between LLMs and Humans
papers.abstract_en: Positional biases such as recency and primacy effects have been documented in large language models (LLMs), yet the underlying mechanism by which these models make their evaluations remains poorly understood. Both primacy and recency biases have been observed in human judgments in response to evidence, but recent work suggest that \emph{when} the listener updates their beliefs -- during the presentation of evidence or only at the end -- influences the presence of such effects. We investigate whether a similar phenomenon holds for LLMs, finding divergence from human behavior. These biases are more exacerbated in newer models compared to their predecessors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究查询时机（query timing）如何影响大语言模型（LLM）中的位置偏差（positional biases），即首因效应和近因效应。作者借鉴人类判断中的相关发现——信念更新发生在证据呈现期间还是只在结束时会影响这些偏差的出现——考察 LLM 是否呈现类似现象。结果表明 LLM 与人类行为存在分歧，且较新模型中的位置偏差比其前代模型更为加剧。
Motivation: LLM 中已记录到近因和首因等位置偏差，但其评估机制仍不清楚；人类判断中证据呈现期间的信念更新时机会影响此类效应。作者想要探究 LLM 是否也遵循这一规律。
Method: 论文通过对比 LLM 与人类在证据呈现过程中或仅在呈现结束时更新信念的行为，检验位置偏差是否受查询时机影响。
Result: 摘要报告 LLM 与人类行为存在分歧；此外，这些位置偏差在较新模型中比前代模型更加严重。
Conclusion: 作者认为查询时机对位置偏差的影响在 LLM 与人类之间有所不同，且新一代模型中的偏差被进一步放大。

papers.title: Dual-Flow Transformers: Decoupling the Primary Prefill Path from Additional Decode Computation
papers.abstract_en: As large language models serve more requests, cumulative inference cost is becoming increasingly important relative to one-time training cost. The two inference phases stress hardware differently: prompt prefill is parallel and typically compute-bound, whereas autoregressive decode is sequential and often memory-bandwidth-bound. Conventional width or depth scaling increases both costs together because every added layer is evaluated in both phases. We ask whether additional learned computation can instead be allocated to continuation prediction while preserving the prompt-wide primary computation and a single persistent key-value (KV) cache. We introduce the Dual-Flow Transformer. Its primary flow is a complete causal language model that processes the prompt and writes the KV cache. The auxiliary flow is omitted during prompt processing and activated only from the final prompt position onward, adding continuation-prediction computation without writing persistent state or influencing the primary flow. The two flows share major attention, MLP, and output matrices, while using separate token embeddings and lightweight coupling. Sharing weights and the primary cache also creates opportunities to reuse loaded weights and cached keys and values during grouped execution. Across matched-token comparisons, Dual-Flow achieves lower validation loss across architectures and data configurations. In MoE models, the separation makes primary and auxiliary expert fan-outs independent controls over prompt cost, continuation cost, and predictive quality. We study two regimes: increasing decode computation at fixed prefill expert computation, and reallocating a fixed decode expert budget between the two flows. These experiments expose a prefill-decode-quality trade-off and demonstrate the potential of phase-specific expert allocation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dual-Flow Transformer，将 LLM 推理中的主路径预填充 (prefill) 与额外的自回归解码计算解耦。主流程 (primary flow) 是一个完整的因果语言模型，负责处理完整 prompt 并写入持久化的键值缓存 (KV cache)；辅助流程 (auxiliary flow) 在 prompt 处理阶段被省略，仅从最后一个 prompt 位置开始激活，用于增强续写预测，不写入持久状态也不影响主流程。两个流程共享注意力、MLP 与输出矩阵，但使用独立的 token embedding 和轻量耦合。摘要报告在匹配 token 数的对比中，Dual-Flow 在多种架构和数据配置下取得更低的验证损失。
Motivation: 大模型累计推理成本正变得比一次性训练成本更重要，而 prefill 阶段并行且通常受计算限制，decode 阶段串行且常受内存带宽限制。传统宽度或深度扩展会同时增加两阶段成本，因为每一层都在两阶段被计算；作者希望把额外学习到的计算只分配给续写预测，同时保留对 prompt 的主计算和单一持久 KV 缓存。
Method: 引入 Dual-Flow Transformer：主流程是完整因果 LM，处理 prompt 并写 KV 缓存；辅助流程在 prompt 处理中省略、只在末尾位置起激活，增加续写预测计算而不写持久状态或影响主流程。两个流程共享主要注意力、MLP 与输出矩阵，但使用分离的 token embedding 与轻量耦合；权重共享和主缓存共享还带来了分组执行时复用已加载权重与缓存键值的可能性。
Result: 在匹配 token 数的比较中，Dual-Flow 在多种架构与数据配置上取得更低验证损失。在 MoE 模型中，作者研究了两个 regime：固定 prefill 专家计算而增加 decode 计算，以及在两个流程间重新分配固定 decode 专家预算；实验暴露了 prefill-decode-质量之间的权衡，并展示了分阶段专家分配 (phase-specific expert allocation) 的潜力。
Conclusion: 作者强调主/辅助专家扇出 (expert fan-out) 的分离使 prompt 成本、续写成本与预测质量成为可独立控制的变量，并展示了分阶段专家分配的潜在价值。摘要还指出共享权重与主缓存可在分组执行时复用已加载权重和缓存键值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Observation to Intervention: Memory in Brains and Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Brains and large language models (LLMs) are fundamentally different memory systems, but they can be compared through shared functional questions: where memory-related information is represented, how partial cues recover broader associations, how new information is written or updated, and how memory-related states can be perturbed. In biological systems, these questions span synapses, neuronal ensembles, hippocampal-cortical interactions, and plasticity; in LLMs, they span weights, activations, context windows, retrieval systems, and external stores. The comparison is therefore functional and experimental rather than anatomical. Human studies reveal sparse concept responses, temporal binding, rapid association formation, episode-specific coding, and recall-related reactivation, but selective intervention remains limited. Rodent studies provide more selective causal access to learning-related ensembles, whereas human and macaque interventions usually affect broader circuits. LLMs lack lived episodic memory, yet they permit unusually direct and repeatable manipulation of internal states and stored information. We argue that this asymmetry creates a new opportunity. LLMs are not ahead in memory itself, but in experimental access. Their tools may help turn broad questions about retrieval, updating, persistence, reversibility, and unintended effects into sharper biological hypotheses. The productive bridge is to transfer experimental logic, not anatomical parts.
papers.comment: Perspective article, 11 pages, 3 figures, 1 table, and 1 key terms box. Submitted for consideration to Nature Machine Intelligence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇观点文章 (perspective article)，从功能而非解剖层面比较大脑与大型语言模型 (LLM) 作为记忆系统的异同，围绕表征位置、部分线索恢复、信息写入/更新与状态扰动等共同问题展开。作者认为 LLM 在记忆本身并不领先，但在实验可及性上具备独特优势，因此应把实验逻辑从 LLM 迁移到生物记忆研究。文章未报告实证实验结果。
Motivation: 大脑和 LLM 是本质不同的记忆系统，但可通过共同的功能性问题进行比较；人类研究的因果干预手段有限，而啮齿类与灵长类干预又往往影响较大脑区，缺乏对记忆相关内部状态的直接可重复操控。
Method: 采用功能比较框架，将突触、神经元集群、海马-皮层交互与可塑性等生物层面，对照 LLM 的权重、激活、上下文窗口、检索系统与外部存储；主张迁移实验逻辑而非解剖部件，把 LLM 当作研究检索、更新、持久性、可逆性与意外效应的工具。
Result: 作为观点文章，本文没有报告实验数据；核心论断是 LLM 的优势不在于记忆能力本身，而在于对内部状态和存储信息的直接、可重复操控，即“实验可及性”的不对称。
Conclusion: 作者建议利用 LLM 提供的直接干预手段，将关于记忆检索、更新、持久性、可逆性及无意效应等宽泛问题转化为更清晰的生物学假设，并强调这一桥梁是功能与实验逻辑层面的迁移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Are you Talking Logic to Me? Assessing Language Models Syllogistic Reasoning Capabilities
papers.abstract_en: Language models (LMs) struggle with logical tasks like reasoning on syllogisms. It has been shown that Knowledge Representation (KR) plays a crucial role in expressing input information to help models solve tasks. This observation motivates our study of the impact of different formal KR notations on syllogistic reasoning by extending the FOLIO and P-FOLIO datasets. Our experiments on Small Language Models (SLMs) in Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Zero-Shot (ZS) settings show that the choice of input notation can yield performances competitive with natural language while enabling faster inference. We also propose a syllogistic categorization method (SEF) and use it to enrich ZS prompts with logical definitions, which boost reasoning in small models. We open-source our framework, Common Logic Grammar Construction (CLGC), as the first Python library for automatically generating syllogisms in KR notations and defining their SEF categories.

TL;DR: 本文研究不同知识表示 (Knowledge Representation, KR) 形式对语言模型三段论推理 (syllogistic reasoning) 能力的影响。作者扩展了 FOLIO 和 P-FOLIO 数据集，在小语言模型 (SLMs) 的监督微调 (SFT) 与零样本 (ZS) 设置下对比自然语言与多种 KR 记号的输入效果。摘要报告部分 KR 记号在保持与自然语言相当的性能时推理更快，并提出 SEF 分类方法来增强 ZS 提示，同时开源了自动生成三段论 KR 记号的 Python 库 CLGC。
Motivation: 语言模型在逻辑任务如三段论推理上表现困难，已有研究表明知识表示 (KR) 对输入信息的表达方式至关重要，但不同正式 KR 记号对三段论推理的具体影响尚未被系统评估。
Method: 扩展 FOLIO 与 P-FOLIO 数据集，在 SLMs 上比较多种正式 KR 记号与自然语言在三段论推理中的效果，分别采用 SFT 和 ZS 两种设置；提出三段论分类方法 SEF，并用逻辑定义丰富 ZS 提示；开源 Common Logic Grammar Construction (CLGC) 框架，作为首个自动生成 KR 记号三段论及其 SEF 类别的 Python 库。
Result: 摘要表明，选择合适的输入记号可以在获得与自然语言相当性能的同时加快推理；将 SEF 逻辑定义加入 ZS 提示能够提升小模型的推理表现。
Conclusion: 作者认为 KR 记号的选取对小型语言模型的三段论推理有实际影响，SEF 增强提示有助于零样本推理，并强调 CLGC 是首个支持自动生成 KR 记号三段论的开源 Python 库。

papers.title: Don't Want Your LLM to Recommend Nuclear Strike? Try Asking It in Japanese
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used in strategic and advisory contexts, yet their safety alignment is typically evaluated in English only. We test nine models from six providers and ask whether the language of a prompt can change a model's decision in a high-stakes scenario. We use single-turn game-theoretic vignettes in which a model advises a nuclear-armed nation on whether to strike a defenseless opponent. The prompt is intentionally amoral and strategically identical across languages. We find that Japanese prompts reduce launch rates in the Claude model family: Claude Sonnet 4.6 drops from 40% to 0% in scenarios where the strike is unnecessary and from 93% to 17% in contested scenarios, with minimal effect when the strike is strategically rational. The effect extends to Gemini Pro 3.1 (53% to 13%). A cross-language experiment isolates the mechanism: when instructed to reason in Japanese in an English prompt, launch rates drop from 93% to 37%. It is the language the model is asked to reason in, not the language of the input, that drives the effect. When reasoning in Japanese, models spontaneously generate moral vocabulary (''moral cost'', ''millions of lives'') that is entirely absent from the prompt. Five other models show no language effect, but they launch in nearly every condition regardless of language. The effect requires a model that already hesitates in English. These results show that LLM safety behavior is language-dependent, and that evaluating in English alone can miss both risks and safeguards encoded in other languages.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 6th Workshop on Trustworthy NLP (TrustNLP 2026), Jul 2026, San Diego, United States. pp.489-502
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文考察大语言模型在高风险战略决策中的安全性是否随提示语言变化。作者使用单轮博弈论情景（模型建议一个核武国家是否打击无防御对手），在策略上完全一致的九种模型、六家提供方上测试了日文与英文提示的效果。结果发现日文提示显著降低 Claude 系列与 Gemini Pro 3.1 的发射率，且跨语言实验表明起作用的是模型被要求使用的推理语言而非输入语言；用日文推理时模型自发产生道德词汇。论文据此认为 LLM 的安全行为具有语言依赖性，仅用英文评估会遗漏其他语言中编码的风险与防护。
Motivation: LLM 安全对齐通常在英文上评估，但模型越来越多用于战略与咨询场景；作者想检验提示语言本身能否改变模型在高风险场景中的决策，从而揭示单语言评估的盲区。
Method: 使用单轮博弈论小剧场（vignettes），提示词刻意去道德化且在语言间策略上一致；测试九家模型后，进一步设计跨语言实验，在英文提示中要求模型用日文推理，以区分输入语言与推理语言的作用。
Result: 日文提示使 Claude Sonnet 4.6 在不必要打击场景下发射率从 40% 降到 0%，在有争议场景从 93% 降到 17%，战略理性场景几乎不变；Gemini Pro 3.1 从 53% 降到 13%。当要求用日文推理时，英文提示下的发射率从 93% 降到 37%。其他五个模型无论语言如何几乎都发射。
Conclusion: LLM 的安全行为依赖语言，且该效应只出现在英文下已会犹豫的模型上；作者强调仅用英文评估会同时遗漏风险与防护机制。

papers.title: Position: We Need Practical AI Alignment Methods to Mirror Human Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: AI systems are increasingly employed as decision aids, decision delegates, or autonomous decision-makers. This position paper argues that in many settings, particularly high-stakes decision-making, we need accurate cognitively-aligned AI systems that reason similarly to their users, and faithfully communicate their reasoning. We review evidence that cognitive alignment improves understandability and trustworthiness, and provide new survey data showing that many users find cognitive alignment "essential" when an AI's rationale for a judgment or action is important to them. We outline the gaps between existing alignment methods and what is needed to achieve cognitive alignment, and present a research agenda to address these gaps. We argue that cognitive misalignment represents a likely impediment to AI adoption in many envisioned applications, and that addressing it is important for creating AI systems on which users are both willing and justified to rely.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文（position paper），主张在许多场景尤其是高风险决策中，需要认知对齐（cognitive alignment）的 AI 系统：既能像用户一样推理，又能忠实传达其推理过程。作者综述了认知对齐提升可理解性与可信度的证据，并报告了新的调查数据，指出现有对齐方法与实现认知对齐之间的差距，最后提出相应的研究议程。
Motivation: AI 系统越来越多地被用作决策辅助、决策委托方或自主决策者；论文认为在需要可靠推理的高风险决策场景中，仅仅对齐行为并不够，还需要推理方式与用户相似。作者将认知错位视为阻碍 AI 在许多设想应用中落地的重要因素。
Method: 作为立场论文，本文通过综述认知对齐提升可理解性和可信度的证据、呈现新的用户调查数据、梳理现有对齐方法的不足，并规划一套研究议程来推进认知对齐。
Result: 作者提供的调查数据显示，当用户在意 AI 对判断或行动的 rationale 时，许多用户认为认知对齐是“essential”的；综述证据也表明认知对齐有助于提高可理解性与信任度。
Conclusion: 论文认为认知错位很可能成为 AI 应用落地的一大障碍，解决该问题对构建用户既愿意依赖、也有理由依赖的 AI 系统很重要；本文属于观点性研究，未提出具体技术方案或实验系统。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Scheduling with LLM-Assisted Contract Net Negotiation for Stream Processing in Mobile Edge Computing
papers.abstract_en: Stream-processing systems increasingly operate across heterogeneous mobile edge--cloud infrastructures, where workload volatility, resource contention, and stringent quality-of-service (QoS) requirements complicate decentralized scheduling. This paper proposes \emph{MAS-DecStream}, whose main contribution is \emph{LLM-MR-CNP}: an extension of the classical Contract Net Protocol with semantic CFP formulation, progressive context disclosure, multi-round proposal revision, negotiation memory, and deterministic validation. Edge-cluster agents refine natural-language offloading proposals from local observations, predicted resource states, and qualitative runtime context, while hard resource and QoS constraints remain deterministic. Experiments derived from the Alibaba ASI Trace evaluate the extension at three levels: single- versus multi-round CNP, rule-based versus LLM-assisted refinement, and fixed-model single- versus multi-round negotiation. Under the evaluated configurations, MAS-DecStream reduces latency violations to 3\%, eliminates resource overcommitment, reaches a conflict-resolution rate of 0.91 with 20 agents, and improves utility by up to 22\% over the multi-round rule-based baseline. A separate 25-case evaluation shows model- and prompt-dependent accuracy--cost trade-offs. The results provide initial evidence that multi-round CNP refinement is the principal protocol-level gain, with LLM assistance adding value for qualitative and uncertain runtime context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAS-DecStream，一个用于移动边缘-云异构基础设施中流处理任务的多智能体调度框架，核心贡献是 LLM-MR-CNP，即对经典 Contract Net Protocol 的扩展，加入语义化 CFP 表述、渐进式上下文披露、多轮提案修订、协商记忆和确定性验证。基于 Alibaba ASI Trace 的实验表明，在评估配置下延迟违规降至 3%，资源过度承诺被消除，20 个智能体时冲突解决率达 0.91，效用相比多轮基于规则的基线最高提升 22%。
Motivation: 流处理系统在异构移动边缘-云基础设施上运行时面临工作负载波动、资源争用和严格 QoS 要求，去中心化调度复杂，经典协商协议难以处理非结构化定性运行上下文。
Method: 提出 MAS-DecStream，其中 LLM-MR-CNP 扩展了 Contract Net Protocol，包括语义 CFP 表述、渐进式上下文披露、多轮提案修订、协商记忆，以及对硬资源与 QoS 约束的确定性验证；边缘集群智能体基于本地观测、预测资源状态和定性运行上下文生成自然语言卸载提案。
Result: 基于 Alibaba ASI Trace 的实验从三个层面评估：单轮与多轮 CNP、规则与 LLM 辅助精炼、固定模型下单轮与多轮协商。结果显示延迟违规降至 3%、消除资源过度承诺、20 个智能体时冲突解决率达 0.91，效用相比多轮规则基线最高提升 22%；另有 25 个案例评估显示模型与提示相关的精度-成本权衡。
Conclusion: 结果表明多轮 CNP 精炼是协议层面的主要收益来源，LLM 辅助对于定性和不确定的运行上下文具有价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agreement Is Not Alignment: Divergent Moral Grounds in Human and LLM Ethical Judgments
papers.abstract_en: Agreement with human judgments is a common proxy for evaluating the alignment of large language models (LLMs). Yet agreement in final labels does not show that human annotators and models rely on the same moral grounds. Two agents may reach the same judgment while appealing to different principles, contextual assumptions, or interpretations of the situation. We test this distinction using a curated 500-item ETHICS-derived benchmark spanning five domains of moral judgment, with new human annotator and LLM annotations of both final labels and supporting rationales. Across frontier and open model families, agreement with human annotator majority labels is often high. However, rationale-level analysis reveals systematic divergence in the moral grounds expressed by human annotators and models. In particular, models redistribute attention across categories such as harm, respect, promise-keeping, justice, desert, and excuse relevance, even when their final labels match the human annotator majority. Our results show that agreement should not be treated as equivalent to alignment. Label-based evaluation can therefore be misleadingly reassuring unless complemented by analysis of the reasons, principles, and moral priorities expressed in model judgments.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted and presented at the AI Transparency Conference (AITC 2026), Nuremberg, Germany, June 5-6, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对“用与人类判断的一致性来评价大语言模型对齐性”这一常见做法提出质疑，认为最终标签一致并不能说明模型与人类依赖相同的道德依据。作者基于一个由 ETHICS 派生、涵盖五个道德判断领域的 500 条精选基准，收集人类标注者与多种 LLM 对最终标签和支持理由 (rationales) 的标注。结果显示模型与人类多数标签的一致性往往很高，但理由层面的分析暴露出二者在道德依据上的系统性分歧。
Motivation: 现有对齐评估常以最终标签与人类判断一致作为代理指标，但相同判断可能来自不同原则、情境假设或解释，导致标签层面的评估产生误导性的乐观结论。
Method: 构建包含五个道德判断领域的 500 条 ETHICS 派生基准，并新增人类与 LLM 对最终标签及支持理由的双层标注；通过理由层面分析比较人类与模型在不同道德范畴上的关注分布。
Result: 在前沿与开源模型族中，模型与人类多数标签的一致性通常较高；但理由层面分析显示，即使最终标签匹配，模型在 harm、respect、promise-keeping、justice、desert、excuse relevance 等范畴上的道德依据分布仍与人类存在系统性分歧。
Conclusion: 作者强调一致性不应等同于对齐性，仅靠标签评估可能造成误导性的安心，必须辅以对模型判断中所表达理由、原则和道德优先级的分析。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对“用与人类判断的一致性来评价大语言模型对齐性”这一常见做法提出质疑，认为最终标签一致并不能说明模型与人类依赖相同的道德依据。作者基于一个由 ETHICS 派生、涵盖五个道德判断领域的 500 条精选基准，收集人类标注者与多种 LLM 对最终标签和支持理由 (rationales) 的标注。结果显示模型与人类多数标签的一致性往往很高，但理由层面的分析暴露出二者在道德依据上的系统性分歧。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调一致性不应等同于对齐性，仅靠标签评估可能造成误导性的安心，必须辅以对模型判断中所表达理由、原则和道德优先级的分析。

papers.title: FluctlightDB: A Memory Model of Data for AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: For fifty years, data systems have answered two questions. The relational model asked which records match a predicate; the vector model asked which vectors lie nearest a query. Neither was built for cue-driven, provenance-weighted recall across long sessions. We propose treating long-term agent memory as a distinct data model -- with its own write semantics (encoding, separation, consolidation, provenance) and read semantics (cue-driven activation across a linked memory graph) -- and present FluctlightDB, an embedded engine that implements this contract via experience() and activate(). We make that case carefully, not categorically: we do not claim novelty over Mem0, Zep, or HippoRAG-style memory layers, only an embedded engine contract beneath them. On LoCoMo (official evidence-recall metric; 10 conversations, 1,982 gold spans), CHORUS recalls 99.0% on an internally reproduced July 2026 run. On LongMemEval-S (500 questions, official session_recall@8), our retrieval harness scores 97.6% (488/500); end-to-end QA with our reader/judge stack scores 97.4% (487/500) -- these layers use different protocols than vendor leaderboard figures we cite for context only. On BEIR SciFact (shared MiniLM embeddings, same harness, Recall Fabric on), CHORUS/PRISM edges Chroma on nDCG@10 (0.646 vs. 0.645) and Recall@10 (0.792 vs. 0.783). We also report a small author-designed regression suite (FAMB; paraphrase n=10, other sub-tests n=1) at 100% macro -- internal validation, not peer benchmark. Strangers can verify the engine in under a minute via pip install "fluctlightdb[native]" and a minimal connect() -> experience() -> activate() script (compiled wheel, not source-only). Harnesses and frozen JSON are MIT-licensed. We claim no new neuroscience and no new transformer; we propose a missing layer of the data stack and release an engine others can reproduce and contest.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 6 tables, 4 figures, appendix. Code and frozen benchmark artifacts: https://github.com/voxmastery/FluctlightDB. Preprint DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20949890

papers.title: EU-ETS under attack? The impact of carbon price suppression on the decarbonization of the power sector
papers.abstract_en: European countries are debating policies to mitigate the increased energy costs caused by renewed geopolitical tensions, while pursuing decarbonization and electrification. A notable example is Italy's 2026 Decreto Bollette package, which proposes to remove the carbon price equivalent from the bids of certain gas-driven power plants to wholesale electricity markets, among other provisions. We use this as a case study to assess the long-term implications of suppressing the carbon price signal in the electricity market for investment, emissions, and consumer costs. We employ a stylized Italian power system using MARLEY, a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework focused on long-term electricity market assessments. In this framework, we test this policy across configurations with varying levels of support for green investment, resource adequacy, and flexibility. Results show that partial suppression of the carbon price signal yields short-term cost reductions but only a minor long-term effect on total system costs, as the deferred emissions are ultimately repaid by consumers. CO$_2$ emissions rise across most configurations since suppressing the price signal erodes incentives for renewable and storage investment. Only the most ambitious configurations for supporting green investment avoid this outcome, but they do so by marginalizing the wholesale price signal itself, thereby requiring a commitment to a hybrid market paradigm that is in contradiction with the rationale of the proposed price intervention.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以意大利2026年Decreto Bollette法案为例，研究在电力批发市场中抑制碳价信号对长期投资、排放和消费者成本的影响。作者使用MARLEY多智能体强化学习框架构建风格化的意大利电力系统，并在不同绿色投资支持、资源充裕度和灵活性配置下评估该政策。结果显示，部分抑制碳价仅带来短期成本下降，长期系统成本影响较小，但大多数配置下CO2排放上升，因为抑制价格信号削弱了可再生能源和储能投资激励；只有最激进的绿色投资支持配置能避免排放上升，但代价是边缘化批发价格信号，需要转向与政策初衷矛盾的混合市场范式。
Motivation: 欧洲国家在因地缘政治紧张导致能源成本上升的同时仍追求脱碳与电气化，意大利2026年Decreto Bollette提出从部分燃气电厂报价中移除碳价等值成分。作者以此为案例，评估抑制电力市场碳价信号对投资、排放和消费者成本的长期影响，以回答此类价格干预是否与脱碳目标相容。
Method: 采用MARLEY多智能体强化学习框架，构建一个风格化的意大利电力系统，用于长期电力市场评估。作者在不同绿色投资支持水平、资源充裕度和灵活性配置下，模拟部分抑制碳价信号的政策情景。
Result: 摘要报告：该政策在短期降低消费者成本，但长期对系统总成本影响较小，延迟的排放最终由消费者偿还；在大多数配置下CO2排放上升，因为碳价信号被抑制削弱了可再生能源和储能投资激励。只有最激进的绿色投资支持配置能避免排放上升，但需边缘化批发价格信号并转向混合市场范式。
Conclusion: 作者强调，抑制碳价信号与脱碳目标的兼容性取决于配套的绿色投资支持力度；最激进的配置虽然避免排放上升，但要求放弃以价格信号为主导的市场范式，这与该价格干预本身的理由相矛盾。

papers.title: Regulatory Approval Is Not Enough: Gaps in Trustworthy AI Reporting in FDA-Cleared Medical Devices
papers.abstract_en: Background: AI/ML-enabled medical devices are increasingly deployed in healthcare under evolving regulatory frameworks. As these systems become more integrated into clinical decision-making, there is growing expectation that they demonstrate key dimensions of trustworthy AI to support clinician, patient, and public trust. Whether publicly available regulatory documentation provides sufficient evidence to independently assess the trustworthiness of cleared AI systems remains unclear. Methods: We analysed FDA AI/ML-enabled medical device summary reports published between 2021 and 2025. Reports underwent automated keyword screening followed by multi-stage manual consensus review to identify documented evidence for the six FUTURE-AI principles: Fairness, Universality, Traceability, Usability, Robustness, and Explainability. Descriptive, temporal, and clinical-domain analyses were performed. Multivariable logistic regression assessed whether year of clearance or clinical domain predicted higher reporting transparency, defined as evidence reported for three or more principles. Results: Of 1,105 FDA summary reports screened, 519 were included. Trustworthy AI reporting was limited and uneven. Nearly one quarter (24.7%) provided no evidence for any principle, and none documented evidence across all six. Robustness was most frequently reported (57.6%), while Traceability (8.3%) and Explainability (3.5%) were the most pronounced gaps. Neither year of clearance (OR 1.02, 95% CI 0.88-1.19) nor clinical domain (OR 0.73, 95% CI 0.46-1.15) predicted higher reporting transparency. Interpretation: Substantial, persistent trustworthy AI reporting gaps exist in FDA documentation. Regulatory approval alone should not be considered a proxy for trustworthiness. Standardised, audit-ready reporting across the AI lifecycle is needed to support independent assessment and responsible adoption of healthcare AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析2021至2025年间FDA发布的AI/ML医疗器械摘要报告，评估其中是否记录了FUTURE-AI六项可信赖AI原则（公平性、普适性、可追溯性、可用性、鲁棒性、可解释性）的证据。研究筛选了1,105份报告、纳入519份，发现可信赖AI报告覆盖有限且不均衡：24.7%的报告未记录任何原则的证据，没有一份覆盖全部六项原则。鲁棒性最常被报告（57.6%），而可追溯性（8.3%）和可解释性（3.5%）是最显著缺口。
Motivation: 随着AI/ML医疗设备越来越多地融入临床决策，监管机构和社会期望这些系统展示可信赖AI的关键维度，但不清楚公开的监管文件是否能提供足够证据来独立评估已获批AI系统的可信度。
Method: 对2021至2025年FDA AI/ML医疗器械摘要报告进行自动化关键词筛查，随后进行多阶段人工共识评审以识别六项FUTURE-AI原则的证据；开展描述性、时间趋势和临床领域分析，并用多变量逻辑回归检验获批年份或临床领域是否预测更高的报告透明度（定义为记录三项及以上原则的证据）。
Result: 在纳入的519份报告中，约四分之一（24.7%）未提供任何原则的证据，且没有报告覆盖全部六项原则；鲁棒性报告率最高（57.6%），可追溯性（8.3%）和可解释性（3.5%）缺口最大。获批年份（OR 1.02, 95% CI 0.88-1.19）和临床领域（OR 0.73, 95% CI 0.46-1.15）均不能预测更高的报告透明度。
Conclusion: FDA文档中存在实质且持续存在的可信赖AI报告缺口，监管批准本身不应被视为可信度的替代指标；需要跨AI生命周期的标准化、可审计报告来支持独立评估和负责任的医疗AI采用。

papers.title: Interaction Readiness: A Framework for Building and Evaluating AI Agents in Human Roles
papers.abstract_en: Product and engineering teams building role-bearing AI agents face an evaluation gap: an agent can produce accurate, safe, and fluent content while still failing the behavioral requirements of its assigned role. This paper introduces Interaction Readiness as a framework for specifying and evaluating that missing layer of performance. The framework separates content specifications, which govern what an agent knows and says, from interaction specifications, which define how an agent should conduct itself in a role-governed exchange. Interaction specifications require teams to define role purpose, authority boundaries, recurring situations, boundary cases, repair behaviors, and audit criteria before deployment. We operationalize interaction readiness through four agent operations: understanding purpose, calibrating authority, managing tone, and repairing breakdowns. Using StudyChat, a public dataset of student interactions with an AI tutoring agent, we show that content accuracy and interaction quality are independent dimensions: an agent may be factually correct while failing as a tutor, or interactionally sound while technically wrong. The most persistent failure is authority miscalibration: the agent often knows how to answer, but not whether, when, or how the tutor role permits it to answer. The paper translates these findings into a specification template and audit procedures that product and engineering teams can apply before and after deployment
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Interaction Readiness 框架，用于指定和评估承担人类角色的 AI agent 在角色交互中的行为表现。框架将内容规范（agent 知道和说什么）与交互规范（agent 在角色约束下如何行事）分离，并通过理解目的、校准权威、管理语气和修复崩溃四个操作来操作化。基于 StudyChat 学生与 AI 辅导 agent 的互动数据集，作者显示内容准确性与交互质量是独立维度，最常见的失败是权威失准（authority miscalibration）。
Motivation: 产品与工程团队在构建承担角色的 AI agent 时面临评估空白：agent 可以生成准确、安全且流畅的内容，却仍不能满足其被指派角色的行为要求。本文旨在为这一缺失的性能层提供指定的评估框架。
Method: 框架要求团队在部署前定义角色目的、权限边界、重复情境、边界案例、修复行为和审计标准；通过四种 agent 操作（理解目的、校准权威、管理语气、修复崩溃）将交互就绪操作化，并转化为规范模板与部署前后的审计程序。
Result: 在 StudyChat 数据集中，作者展示内容准确性与交互质量相互独立：agent 可能在事实上正确但作为导师失败，或交互上得体但在技术上错误；最持久的失败模式是权威失准，即 agent 知道如何回答，却不清楚导师角色是否允许、何时以及如何回答。

papers.title: Measuring Curriculum-Labor Market Alignment at the Scale of a Program Portfolio
papers.abstract_en: A college offering several overlapping computing degrees implicitly assumes that its programs are differentiated in line with how the labor market segments computing work and that, together, they prepare graduates for that market. Testing this is difficult, because the instruments available to curriculum committees, namely advisory boards, tracer studies, and employer surveys, are slow, narrow, and hard to reproduce. We apply one uniform, taxonomy-anchored alignment analysis across all five undergraduate programs of a College of Information Technology, comparing 1,922 course learning outcomes against 103,349 competencies extracted from a unified corpus of 5,186 deduplicated job openings from four boards. Every competency is obtained by a grounded single-language-model procedure that copies it verbatim from the source and verifies it against the source, then assigns it to one of eleven ESCO-aligned domains and a Bloom cognitive level; the curricular supply is read not as a catalog but on a realized-attainment basis that respects the credit-hour and elective constraints under which a student completes a degree. The extraction is validated blind by two independent faculty raters (domain kappa 0.91, Bloom level kappa 0.86) and the ESCO matching against a human-adjudicated gold set (kappa 0.72). Four findings emerge. The content gaps are systemic rather than program-specific, concentrated in systems, software engineering, security, and web development; the shared college core satisfies only about a third of the demanded competencies; the programs are well differentiated in disciplinary content yet homogeneous in where they fall short; and the curriculum is pitched roughly a full Bloom level below the market across the portfolio, most acutely in systems. We discuss the implications for program design, curriculum governance, and the practice of curriculum analytics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对一所信息技术学院的五个本科计算类项目进行统一的、基于分类法锚定的课程与劳动力市场对齐分析，比较了1,922个课程学习成果与从5,186个去重职位公告中提取的103,349项能力。能力通过grounded单语言模型流程逐字提取并验证，再分配到11个ESCO对齐领域和Bloom认知层级；课程供应按实际达成口径而非目录口径读取，并尊重学分与选修约束。摘要报告了四个发现：内容缺口是系统性而非项目特定的，集中在系统、软件工程、安全和Web开发；学院共享核心仅满足约三分之一的需求能力；各项目在学科内容上区分良好但在不足之处高度同质；课程整体比市场需求低约一个完整Bloom层级，系统领域最严重。
Motivation: 高校提供多个重叠的计算类学位时，隐含假设其项目差异与劳动力市场对计算工作的细分一致，且共同为学生进入该市场做好准备。但现有的课程评估工具（咨询委员会、追踪研究、雇主调查）缓慢、覆盖窄且难以复现，因此需要一种统一、可复现的大规模对齐分析方法。
Method: 该方法对所有五个本科项目统一采用一个taxonomy-anchored对齐分析，将1,922个课程学习成果与来自4个招聘板、经过去重的5,186条职位公告中提取的103,349项能力进行比较。每个能力经由grounded单语言模型流程获得，该流程从源文本逐字复制并对照源验证，再分配到11个ESCO对齐域和Bloom认知层级；课程供应按学生实际达成（realized-attainment）的口径读取，而非仅依据目录，并遵守学分和选修约束。提取结果由两位独立教师盲评验证（域kappa 0.91，Bloom层级kappa 0.86），ESCO匹配以人工裁决的gold set验证（kappa 0.72）。
Result: 四个主要发现：内容缺口是系统性的而非特定于某项目，集中在系统、软件工程、安全和Web开发；共享学院核心仅满足约三分之一的需求能力；项目在学科内容上分化良好，但在短板分布上同质；整个项目组合的课程层级比市场需求低约一个完整Bloom级别，系统领域最突出。
Conclusion: 作者基于这些发现讨论了项目设计、课程治理以及课程分析实践的含义，表明该对齐分析可作为传统课程评估工具的可扩展补充。

papers.title: Humans are Missing from AI Coding Agent Research
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in AI coding agent research has led to rapid improvements in agents' ability to autonomously perform complex software engineering tasks, from editing large codebases to executing long-horizon development workflows. As these systems make strides, however, the primary bottleneck to practical usefulness increasingly shifts away from pure task-solving capability, and toward challenges in how users communicate with, supervise, and trust agents. In this position paper, we argue for a reorientation from autonomous to human-centered coding agents: systems designed not only to complete tasks, but to collaborate effectively with people. We identify four core interaction-level dimensions that characterize the human-agent task-solving loop: task alignment, verifiability, steerability, and adaptability. Finally, we outline concrete research directions to advance these dimensions, including user-involved coding environments, comprehensive verification mechanisms, and principled measures of human-agent interaction quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文 (position paper)，主张 AI 编程智能体研究应从追求自主任务完成转向以人为本的协作式智能体。作者提出四个核心交互维度——任务对齐 (task alignment)、可验证性 (verifiability)、可操控性 (steerability) 和适应性 (adaptability)——并据此勾勒具体研究方向。
Motivation: 当前 AI 编程智能体在复杂软件工程任务上进展迅速，但实际应用的主要瓶颈已从任务求解能力转向用户如何与智能体沟通、监督和建立信任。
Method: 通过分析人机协作的任务求解循环，识别四个核心交互维度，并针对每个维度提出研究议程，包括用户参与的编码环境、综合验证机制以及人机交互质量的度量方法。
Result: 摘要未报告实验数据或基准结果，属于概念性立场论证，核心产出是交互维度的分类框架与研究路线图。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁将编程智能体研究重新定位为以人为中心，强调协作能力而非仅仅自主完成任务。

papers.title: Why AI Governance Frameworks Are Hard to Adopt: A Role-Based Stress Test of the NIST AI RMF
papers.abstract_en: AI governance frameworks can be known, used, and implemented in form without becoming governance in practice. This paper examines that problem through a role-based stress test of the NIST Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF) in consumer lending. We treat framework adoption as a governance translation problem: whether RMF language can become role-usable, cross-level, authority-connected governance over the AI system-in-use, rather than producing governance-looking artifacts. The study uses LLM-based role simulation as a structured analytic probe. We apply a 4 $\times$ 2 $\times$ 3 design across four organizational roles, two AI deployments, and three governance hard cases, producing 120 scored responses. Results show that local translation was not the main problem. Simulated actors generally understood their assigned roles and translated the RMF into local activity. The harder problem was whether that activity became governance value. Actor role was strongly associated with Cross-Level Governance Value, Authority Connection, Governance Translatability, and governance value. Deployment was strongly associated with Structural Fit: the RMF fit a bounded ML underwriting model more cleanly than a workflow-embedded LLM underwriting copilot. Risk reduction was harder still. It appeared only when governance value was present and Structural Fit was full, but neither condition was sufficient by itself. The paper contributes a diagnostic account of framework-based AI governance. Frameworks create value when they help organizations see, interpret, escalate, authorize, and correct risk in the AI system-in-use. They also create value when they reveal limits of governability under existing evidence paths, authority structures, and system boundaries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 AI 治理框架为何难以在实践中落地，以美国 NIST AI 风险管理框架 (AI RMF) 在消费信贷场景中的应用为例，进行基于角色的压力测试。作者将框架采用视为治理翻译问题，使用基于 LLM 的角色模拟作为结构化分析探针，设计 4×2×3 的试验（4 种组织角色 × 2 种 AI 部署 × 3 个治理难题），共得到 120 条评分响应。结果显示局部翻译不是主要障碍，模拟角色普遍能理解职责并将 RMF 转化为局部活动，但更难的是这些活动能否产生治理价值；风险降低只有在治理价值存在且结构适配完整时才会出现，但两个条件单独都不充分。
Motivation: 现有的 AI 治理框架可能被知晓、使用并以形式落地，却未真正成为实践中的治理。论文针对这一落差，研究框架语言能否转化为角色可用、跨层级、与权威相连的治理，而不是仅仅产生貌似治理的产物。
Method: 采用基于 LLM 的角色模拟作为结构化分析探针，应用 4×2×3 设计，覆盖四种组织角色、两种 AI 部署和三个治理难题，产出 120 条评分响应，对 NIST AI RMF 在消费信贷中的采用进行压力测试。
Result: 结果表明，角色与跨层级治理价值、权威连接、治理可翻译性和治理价值强关联；部署与结构适配强关联，RMF 对有界 ML 承保模型的适配明显优于嵌入工作流的 LLM 承保副驾驶。风险降低只有在治理价值存在且结构适配完全时出现，但两者单独都不充分。
Conclusion: 论文贡献了一个基于诊断的框架型 AI 治理说明：框架在帮助组织识别、解释、升级、授权和纠正 AI 系统风险时创造价值，也在揭示现有证据路径、权威结构和系统边界下可治理性的局限时创造价值。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Assessment Design in the GenAI Era: The X1-X2-X3 Assessment Pattern for Testing Students' AI Literacy, Learning Outcomes, and Reflection
authors: Thomas Roelleke (1) ((1) School of Electronic Engineering and Computer Science
papers.abstract_en: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) has challenged the validity of unsupervised online assessment, especially in technical subjects where plausible answers can be produced with little effort. This paper reports lessons from designing and implementing an AI-aware, AI-testing assessment in a large second-year undergraduate database systems module. The design combined two linked elements: (1) a structured three-part response format (X1-X2-X3) in which students documented a sourced answer, produced their own answer, and evaluated the sourced output; and (2) an AI-aware question-design process in which draft tasks were stress-tested against contemporary GenAI tools and revised when generic prompting produced superficially adequate answers. The account draws on archived assessment materials, rubrics, planning records, design-time GenAI trials, practice-response data, attainment records, and external review comments. Its main contribution is a reusable assessment-design method rather than a claim of measured learning gains. We show how the pattern developed across iterations and how it can support authentic assessment, visible AI literacy, student judgement, and more transparent marking. The paper offers practical guidance for lecturers adapting assessment to routine GenAI use, focusing on testing AI literacy rather than penalising students for misconduct.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 1 figure, 11 tables. Submitted to the following journal: Assessment & Evaluation in Higher Education (Taylor & Francis)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告在大型二年级本科数据库系统课程中设计并实施一种 AI-aware、AI-testing 评估方案的经验。其核心是 X1-X2-X3 三段式回答格式与 AI-aware 试题设计流程的结合，作者明确表示主要贡献是可复用的评估设计方法，而非实测的学习收益。
Motivation: 生成式 AI（GenAI）使得无需监督的在线评估有效性受到质疑，尤其在技术类科目中，学生可以轻易生成看似合理的答案，因此需要新的评估设计来测试 AI 素养而非仅仅惩罚学术不端。
Method: 提出两个关联要素：(1) 结构化的 X1-X2-X3 三段式作答格式，要求学生记录带来源的答案、给出自己的答案、并评价来源输出；(2) AI-aware 试题设计流程，在草拟任务时用当代 GenAI 工具进行压力测试，若通用提示能产生表面充分的答案则进行修订。分析基于存档的评估材料、评分标准、规划记录、设计期 GenAI 试验、练习作答数据、成绩记录及外部评审意见。
Result: 摘要未报告量化测评指标，而是展示该模式如何在多次迭代中发展，并说明其能够支持真实评估（authentic assessment）、可见的 AI 素养、学生判断力和更透明的评分。
Conclusion: 论文为讲师在常规 GenAI 使用背景下调整评估提供实用指导，重点是测试 AI 素养而不是惩罚学生；其贡献定位为可复用的评估设计方法，而非声称可测量的学习提升。

papers.title: From Caveman to Expert Analyst: Energy Consumption of Variable LLM Tasks
papers.abstract_en: The energy demand growth and environmental impacts of artificial intelligence (AI) have generated substantial interest in supplying sufficient low-cost electricity for AI-driven data center development. Research on the ability of demand-side management to address these challenges has been more limited. Shifting the amount or timing of demand from retail, corporate, and other organizational behaviors is a plausible option but only if changes in demand-related behavior have important effects on the envi- ronmental and electricity effects of AI. This article tests four retail (i.e., consumer) user behaviors with high behavioral plasticity to assess their technical abatement potential. The research concludes that non- reasoning models provide sufficient quality while consuming close to one-twentieth of energy compared to reasoning models, saving an amount equal to the annual electricity requirement of at least 141,000 US households under daily usage assumptions. Simple prompt modifications can yield additional reduc- tions in energy consumption by up to 65% using non-reasoning models. Specifically, the practice that maintains the highest degree of similarity with the baseline reduces electricity demand in the range of 4 to 35%, an amount equal to the annual electricity requirement of up to 7,200 US households. Although AI advancements make precise estimates of environmental and electricity impacts difficult to assess, the results confirm that certain minimally intrusive best practices aimed at the majority of users can reduce the energy and environmental burdens imposed by AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI驱动的数据中心电力需求增长与环境影响问题，从需求侧管理角度测试四种高行为可塑性（behavioral plasticity）的零售用户行为，评估其技术减排潜力。研究发现非推理模型（non-reasoning models）在提供足够质量的同时，能耗约为推理模型（reasoning models）的二十分之一；简单提示修改可带来最多65%的额外能耗削减，而保持与基线最高相似度的做法可减少4%至35%的电力需求。
Motivation: AI电力需求增长受到广泛关注，但针对需求侧管理（demand-side management）能否缓解环境与电力压力的研究有限。作者希望检验改变零售、企业等组织行为是否真的能对AI的环境和电力影响产生实质作用。
Method: 文章测试四种高行为可塑性的零售用户行为，对比推理模型与非推理模型在不同任务上的能耗，并评估简单提示修改（prompt modification）对能耗的额外削减效果。
Result: 非推理模型能耗约为推理模型的二十分之一，在日常使用假设下节省的电量相当于至少141,000户美国家庭的年用电量；简单提示修改可在非推理模型基础上进一步节省最多65%能耗；与基线相似度最高的实践可减少4%至35%的电力需求，相当于最多7,200户家庭的年用电量。
Conclusion: 针对大多数用户的低干扰最佳实践能够显著降低AI带来的能源与环境负担，但AI技术的快速发展使得精确评估其环境与电力影响仍然困难。

papers.title: StreamReason-Bench: Can Large Language Models Reason about Event-Time Stream-Processing Semantics?
papers.abstract_en: Streaming systems increasingly hand work to large language models (LLMs) -- writing pipelines, triaging alerts, reading logs -- and all of it assumes the model knows how event-time stream processing behaves. We test that assumption head-on. StreamReason-Bench asks a model to stand in for an event-time stream processor: given a windowed query and a stream of out-of-order events, it has to report which windows fire (with their aggregates) and which events are dropped as late. The answer key comes from a small reference implementation of Dataflow-model semantics, so we can grade exactly, and with a partial-credit row-F1, without running an engine. On 600 generated items covering tumbling, hopping, session, and processing-time windows, the models do poorly on event time. Told to answer directly, no model that actually follows the instruction clears 34% exact match; chain-of-thought (CoT) roughly doubles that for several of them (GPT-4o goes from 0.34 to 0.48), and only one frontier model that reasons by default comes near solving the set (0.85). A processing-time control, with no watermarks and nothing late, is almost solved by every capable model. That gap points to event-time and late-data handling, not windowing or arithmetic, as the hard part. Sorting errors by window type tells the same story: late-data mistakes dominate the event-time windows and vanish on the control, and session windows mostly fail on where the session boundaries fall.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StreamReason-Bench，一个评估大语言模型对事件时间流处理语义理解能力的基准。基准让模型扮演事件时间流处理器，给定带窗口查询和乱序事件流，报告哪些窗口触发及其聚合值、哪些事件因迟到被丢弃；答案由 Dataflow 模型语义的小型参考实现生成，可精确评分并支持部分正确的 row-F1。在 600 个覆盖滚动、跳跃、会话和处理时间窗口的生成样本上，直接遵循指令回答的模型精确匹配不超过 34%，思维链（chain-of-thought）使部分模型指标翻倍（GPT-4o 从 0.34 到 0.48），仅一个默认推理的前沿模型接近解决（0.85）；处理时间对照组几乎所有模型都能解决，说明难点在事件时间与迟到数据处理。
Motivation: 流式系统越来越多地把工作交给 LLM（如编写管道、分诊告警、读取日志），但这些工作都隐含假设模型理解事件时间流处理的行为方式；论文直接检验这一假设是否成立。
Method: 构建 StreamReason-Bench，让模型代替事件时间流处理器运行：给定带窗口的查询和乱序事件流，模型需报告哪些窗口触发（连同聚合值）以及哪些事件作为迟到被丢弃。答案键来自 Dataflow 模型语义的参考实现，可精确评分并支持部分正确的 row-F1，无需实际运行流引擎。
Result: 在 600 个生成样本（滚动、跳跃、会话、处理时间窗口）上，直接按指令回答的模型精确匹配均不高于 34%；若干模型用思维链后成绩约翻倍，唯一默认推理的前沿模型达到 0.85。处理时间对照组上几乎所有有能力的模型都接近解决；按窗口类型分类的错误显示，迟到数据错误主导事件时间窗口并在对照组中消失，会话窗口的失败主要来自会话边界划分。
Conclusion: 摘要定位事件时间与迟到数据处理为 LLM 推理的难点，而非窗口机制或算术计算；该基准可用于诊断和评估模型对事件时间流处理语义的理解水平。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Position: The Alignment Community is Unintentionally Building a Censor's Toolkit
papers.abstract_en: This position paper argues that modern AI alignment methods - originally designed to prevent harmful output - are dual-use technologies that may easily be misused by malicious actors for censorship and manipulation. By mapping current alignment techniques to the possibility and actual cases of misuse, we show that the quest for a "perfectly aligned" model inadvertently also provides malicious actors with an ever-improving tool for informational dominance. We need to discuss this dual-use potential now, as its risk is exacerbated by rapid user adoption of AI as information provider, economic power asymmetries, and a political landscape that increasingly shifts towards authoritarianism. We conclude by urging the community to consider the intentional misuse of AI alignment mechanisms and propose mitigation strategies to safeguard against this dual-use potential.
papers.comment: Accepted as oral paper at ICML 2026
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea. PMLR 306, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇立场论文 (position paper) 主张现代 AI 对齐 (alignment) 方法原本用于防止有害输出，但本质上是双重用途 (dual-use) 技术，容易被恶意行为者滥用于审查与操纵。作者通过将当前对齐技术映射到可能的及实际发生的滥用案例，论证追求“完全对齐”模型的过程客观上为恶意方提供了日益改进的信息支配工具。论文呼吁现在就要讨论这一双重用途风险，并提出缓解策略。
Motivation: 对齐技术的滥用潜力尚未被社区系统性讨论，而用户快速将 AI 作为信息来源、经济权力不对称以及政治环境日益转向威权主义，都放大了这种风险。
Method: 将现有 AI 对齐技术逐一映射到可能的和实际发生的滥用场景，以此论证对齐机制可被恶意用于审查和操纵。
Result: 论文没有给出实验数据，核心论点是：对“完美对齐”模型的追求会间接为恶意行为者提供用于信息支配 (informational dominance) 的不断改进工具。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁社区正视对齐机制的故意滥用 (intentional misuse) 可能，并提出缓解策略以防范这种双重用途潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diagnostic Foundation for Evaluating LLMs' Research Integrity as Co-Scientists
papers.abstract_en: Language models are increasingly deployed as co-scientists, yet their ability to uphold research integrity under institutional pressure remains unmeasured. We introduce IntegrityBench, a benchmark evaluating misconduct classification, ethical action reasoning and artifact-grounded decision making across 36 paired tasks under a 5-level implicit-explicit pressure protocol spanning 3 domains and 4 research stages. Evaluating 18 frontier model variants, we find that under peak pressure, models fail roughly 1 in 3 integrity-critical decisions, and neither scale nor reasoning ability reliably mitigates this. Explicit pressures induce compliance with misconduct, while implicit contextual reframing more often causes over-refusal of legitimate research tasks. Interestingly, models failing to classify research requests accurately perform equally or better on artifact-grounded decision making (85.7 vs. 79.4), suggesting the three facets are structurally dissociated and correct ethical action does not require accurate classification. Frontier models can thus appear helpful while harbouring integrity failures that create two distinct deployment risks: facilitating research misconduct and eroding trust in AI-assisted research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IntegrityBench，一个评估大语言模型作为共同科学家时维护研究诚信能力的基准。基准包含 36 个配对任务，覆盖 3 个领域和 4 个研究阶段，并采用 5 级隐式-显式压力协议来评测失范分类、伦理行动推理和基于工件（artifact）的决策。作者评估了 18 个前沿模型变体，发现高峰压力下模型在约三分之一的诚信关键决策上出错，且模型规模与推理能力无法可靠缓解这一缺陷。
Motivation: 语言模型越来越多地被部署为共同科学家，但它们在制度压力下维护研究诚信的能力尚未被系统度量，现有基准缺乏对压力情境和不同诚信维度的刻画。
Method: 构建 IntegrityBench 基准，包含跨 3 个领域和 4 个研究阶段的 36 个配对任务，并用 5 级隐式-显式压力协议评测模型的失范分类、伦理行动推理和基于工件的决策能力，对 18 个前沿模型变体进行系统评估。
Result: 在峰值压力下，模型约三分之一的诚信关键决策失败，规模和推理能力都不能可靠缓解；显式压力诱发对失范行为的顺从，而隐式上下文重构更多导致对合法研究任务的过度拒绝。值得注意的是，失范分类表现较差的模型在基于工件的决策上表现相当或更好（85.7 vs. 79.4），表明三个方面的能力结构上相互分离。
Conclusion: 作者认为正确的伦理行动并不依赖于准确的失范分类，三个诚信维度在结构上相互解离；前沿模型可能表面上有帮助但隐藏诚信失败，从而产生两类部署风险：助长研究失范和侵蚀对 AI 辅助研究的信任。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在峰值压力下，模型约三分之一的诚信关键决策失败，规模和推理能力都不能可靠缓解；显式压力诱发对失范行为的顺从，而隐式上下文重构更多导致对合法研究任务的过度拒绝。值得注意的是，失范分类表现较差的模型在基于工件的决策上表现相当或更好（85.7 vs. 79.4），表明三个方面的能力结构上相互分离。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为正确的伦理行动并不依赖于准确的失范分类，三个诚信维度在结构上相互解离；前沿模型可能表面上有帮助但隐藏诚信失败，从而产生两类部署风险：助长研究失范和侵蚀对 AI 辅助研究的信任。

papers.title: Are Large Language Models Reliable Reviewers? A Benchmark for Error Detection in Financial Documents
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring the accuracy of financial documents is critical for economic analysis, regulatory compliance, and corporate decision-making. Several studies have shown that Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well in many financial tasks, such as stock price movements and financial analytics. However, a critical task remains unexplored: the ability of LLMs to identify errors in financial documents. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{FinED-Bench}, the first publicly \textbf{Bench}mark for \textbf{Fin}ancial \textbf{E}rror \textbf{D}etection across three levels of cognitive complexity. FinED-Bench covers nine real-world financial scenarios, and includes over 900 documents reported in 2025 that are unseen by existing language models. We detail the benchmark construction process and evaluate several advanced LLMs (e.g., GPT-4o, Qwen3-14B) on this tasks, which requires both financial domain knowledge and reasoning capabilities. Experimental results show that current LLMs still struggle with this task, especially in high-complexity cases. Besides, supervised fine-tuning can significantly improve the performance of weaker LLMs on this task. Our data and code are available at https://github.com/hedyHe/FinED-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FinED-Bench，据称是首个面向金融文档错误检测的公开基准，覆盖三种认知复杂度层级、九个真实金融场景，并包含 900 余篇 2025 年报告、未被现有语言模型见过的文档。作者评估了 GPT-4o、Qwen3-14B 等 LLM，发现当前模型在该任务上表现不佳，尤其是在高复杂度案例中；监督微调 (supervised fine-tuning) 能显著提升较弱 LLM 的性能。数据与代码已公开。
Motivation: 金融文档的准确性对经济分析、监管合规和企业决策至关重要，已有工作表明 LLM 在股价预测与金融分析等任务上表现良好，但 LLM 能否识别金融文档中的错误这一关键任务尚未被系统研究。
Method: 构建 FinED-Bench：按三种认知复杂度层级设计任务，覆盖九个真实金融场景，收集 2025 年发布的 900 余篇文档以确保模型未见；随后在 GPT-4o、Qwen3-14B 等模型上评估，并对较弱模型进行监督微调。
Result: 实验显示当前 LLM 在金融错误检测上仍存在困难，高复杂度案例尤其明显；监督微调可以显著提高较弱 LLM 在该基准上的表现。
Conclusion: 作者强调金融错误检测需要金融领域知识与推理能力，FinED-Bench 作为首个公开基准揭示了现有 LLM 的不足，并指出微调是一种有效的改进路径。

papers.title: Mimicry without understanding: the origins of decision bias in large language models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language models (LLMs) were found to be susceptible to a host of social, affective, and cognitive biases. We examined two mechanisms through which such biases can be generated even when human preferences (in the training data) are not biased or when they are correctly categorized as being biased. The first is faulty mimicry of preferences based on human behavior: this involves LLMs inferring human preferences even when behaviors are logically unrelated to preferences. The second is mimicry of explicitly biased human behaviors. In four studies focusing on economic biases, we find that ChatGPT-4o and Qwen exhibited social proof biases even when prompted with reports of human behaviors that were clearly non-indicative of individuals' actual preferences. LLMs also displayed loss aversion when it was explicitly described as a bias. Indeed, when prompted with detailed scientific reports, the extent of the bias (i.e., loss aversion) in the scientific report predicted LLMs' own subsequent bias. Scientific papers of biases can thus become self-fulfilling prophecies, at least when it comes to LLMs' responses. The current study goes beyond fleshing out LLM biases and sheds light on the underlying component processes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文考察大型语言模型（LLMs）产生社会、情感和认知偏见的两种生成机制：一是对人类行为的错误模仿，即从与偏好逻辑无关的行为中推断偏好（faulty mimicry of preferences）；二是对明确有偏的人类行为的模仿。作者在四项聚焦经济偏见的研究中发现，ChatGPT-4o 和 Qwen 即使在收到显然不反映个体真实偏好的行为报告时仍表现出社会认同偏见（social proof bias），并且当损失厌恶（loss aversion）被明确描述为偏见时也会表现出来；科学报告中损失厌恶的程度还能预测模型随后的偏见强度。研究认为关于偏见的科学论文对 LLM 的反应而言可能成为自证预言（self-fulfilling prophecy）。
Motivation: 现有工作已发现 LLM 容易受到各类偏见影响，但对其底层成分过程或产生机制缺乏理解；本文针对即使训练数据中的人类偏好无偏或已正确归类为有偏时偏见仍会出现这一现象，试图厘清其来源。
Method: 提出并检验两种机制：基于人类行为的错误偏好模仿，以及对已明确为有偏行为的模仿。通过四项经济偏见研究，对 ChatGPT-4o 和 Qwen 施以包含非指示性行为报告、明确偏见描述以及详细科学报告的不同提示，考察其后续判断。
Result: 两种模型在面对显然不指示个体真实偏好的行为报告时仍出现社会认同偏见；在损失厌恶被明确描述为偏见时模型也表现出该偏见，且相关科学报告中的损失厌恶程度可预测模型自身随后表现出的偏见程度。
Conclusion: 研究超越了简单列举 LLM 偏见，揭示了其背后的成分过程；摘要强调，关于偏见的科学论文可以在 LLM 反应中成为自证预言，提示偏好模仿机制在偏见产生中的关键作用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: StorySpark: Module-wise Evolutionary Search for Story Premise Generation
papers.abstract_en: A story premise is the creative spark from which a full narrative can grow. Yet LLM-based story generation has mostly emphasized later-stage planning, controllability, coherence, and prose expansion, while premise-level ideation remains comparatively underexplored. We introduce StorySpark, a module-wise evolutionary search framework for story premise generation. StorySpark operates over interpretable narrative modules such as background, persona, event, ending, and twist, treating each active module not as a static field to fill once, but as a local search space conditioned on the partial premise built so far. For each module, it generates alternatives, evaluates them in context, refines them through feedback-driven mutation and recombination, preserves complementary strengths with Pareto-guided selection, and reallocates frontier capacity to balance branch coverage with promising directions. Multi-view automatic and human evaluations show that StorySpark produces stronger final premises than competitive baselines, with especially consistent gains in originality; when expanded with the same story writer, its premises also lead to higher-quality downstream stories while maintaining completeness, fascination, and diverse usable narrative directions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StorySpark 是一个面向故事前提生成的模块化进化搜索框架。它将故事前提分解为背景、人物、事件、结尾、反转等可解释叙事模块，每个模块作为在已构建前提条件下的局部搜索空间，通过生成候选、上下文评估、反馈驱动的变异与重组、Pareto 引导选择以及前沿容量重分配来迭代优化。多视角自动与人工评估显示，StorySpark 生成的最终前提强于竞争基线，尤其在原创性上增益一致；用同一故事作者扩写时，其前提也能带来更高质量的下游故事，同时保持完整性、吸引力和多样可用的叙事方向。
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的故事生成大多强调后期阶段的规划、可控性、连贯性和散文扩写，而前提层面的构思 (premise-level ideation) 相对未被充分探索。
Method: 提出模块化进化搜索框架，将每个活跃叙事模块视为局部搜索空间，并在已构建的部分前提条件下生成备选、进行上下文评估，通过反馈驱动的变异与重组改进，使用 Pareto 引导选择保留互补优势，并对前沿容量进行重分配以平衡分支覆盖与有前景的方向。
Result: 多视角自动与人工评估表明，StorySpark 比竞争基线生成更强的最终前提，尤其在原创性方面提升一致；在相同故事作者扩写下，其前提可带来更高质量的下游故事，同时保持完整性、吸引力与多样可用的叙事方向。
Conclusion: 摘要认为模块化进化搜索能够改进故事前提生成质量，并进一步惠及后续故事生成。

papers.title: Steering the Language Axis: From Linear Decodability to Causal Control
papers.abstract_en: Despite the impressive multilingual capabilities of Large Language Models, the latent dynamics dictating language selection remain poorly understood. In this work, we ask whether language identity is merely linearly decodable from hidden states, or if it can be causally controlled by a compact activation direction. We conduct an exhaustive causal intervention analysis across multiple model families, including Qwen 3.5-2B and Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct, isolating PCA-derived "language axes" to perform steering and ablation experiments across 1.26 million generations on the FLORES-200 dataset. Steering along these geometric directions reliably forces language switching in both cross-script (English to Chinese) and same-script (English to Spanish) settings, whereas equal-magnitude random perturbations yield virtually no effect. Our layerwise analysis reveals that language commitment is highly localized and explicitly language-pair-dependent. While English to Chinese switching resists early intervention and steers easily in the later layers, the English-Spanish transition shifts earlier, displaying a distinct, bimodal sensitivity. Furthermore, targeted ablation uncovers a fundamental reversion to English: once the language signal is removed, the model falls back to English regardless of the input prompt. Ultimately, these findings demonstrate that language decision boundaries function during inference as causally active features that are direction-dependent and layer-specific.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多语言大模型中的语言身份是否不仅可线性解码，还能通过紧凑的激活方向被因果控制。作者在 Qwen 3.5-2B 与 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 等多个模型上，基于 PCA 提取的“语言轴”进行干预，在 FLORES-200 上开展 126 万次生成的结构化 steering 与消融实验。结果表明，沿这些几何方向进行 steering 能在跨文字（英语到中文）和同文字（英语到西班牙语）场景下可靠地触发语言切换，而等幅随机扰动几乎无效；分层分析显示语言承诺高度局部化且依赖具体语言对，定向消融则会使模型回退到英语。
Motivation: 大模型虽有多语言能力，但其语言选择的潜在动态仍不清楚；作者想判断语言身份是仅仅可以从隐藏状态线性解码，还是能被一个紧凑的激活方向因果控制，这对可解释性与受控生成有直接意义。
Method: 采用跨模型族的因果干预分析：先通过 PCA 隔离“语言轴”，再在 FLORES-200 上进行 steering 与 ablation 实验，并设置等幅随机扰动作为对照；同时开展逐层分析，对比英语到中文（跨文字）与英语到西班牙语（同文字）两类语言对。
Result: 摘要报告 steering 可靠地诱发语言切换，而随机扰动几乎无效应；语言承诺表现出强局部性与语言对依赖性。英语到中文切换在早期层难以干预、在后期层容易 steering，英语到西班牙语切换则更早发生并呈现双峰敏感性；定向消融语言信号后，模型无论输入提示如何都会回退到英语。
Conclusion: 作者将语言决策边界解释为推理期间因果活跃的特征，具有方向依赖与层特异性；该结论限定于所测模型族与 FLORES-200 设置，论文目前处于审稿阶段（22 页，14 图）。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Vision-Language Models are Fragile Multilingual Associators
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models must associate visual entities with textual attributes. Whether these associations or concept bindings remain stable when the language of the input changes is unexplored. We introduce M$^2$BIND, a benchmark varying the language of the context and query across multiple languages. We evaluate binding both extrinsically through task performance metrics and intrinsically through causal interventions. We find that binding is not language-invariant: cross-family and cross-script settings trigger significant binding collapse, with the model's internal binding computation shifting to later layers and losing causal strength. Closely related languages preserve associations comparatively better. In a broader sense, our findings indicate how VLMs deployed globally in multilingual settings cannot be assumed to maintain the same association quality observed in monolingual evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多语言概念绑定基准 M²BIND，用于检验视觉语言模型（VLM）在不同语言上下文与查询下，视觉实体与文本属性之间的关联（concept binding）是否保持稳定。作者通过任务性能（外在评估）和因果干预（内在评估）发现绑定并不具备语言不变性：跨语系与跨文字体系会引发显著的绑定崩溃，模型内部绑定计算会转移到更深层且因果强度下降；而相近语言能相对更好地保持关联。
Motivation: 现有工作未探索当输入语言变化时，VLM 中视觉-文本概念绑定是否稳定；若绑定在多语言场景下退化，则全球多语言部署的 VLM 不能假设其关联质量与单语评估一致。
Method: 引入基准 M²BIND，在多种语言下改变上下文与查询的语言，分别通过任务性能指标进行外在评估，并通过因果干预（causal interventions）对模型内部绑定计算进行内在评估。
Result: 绑定并非语言不变：跨语系（cross-family）和跨文字体系（cross-script）设置会引发显著绑定崩溃，内部绑定计算转移到更深的层并失去因果强度；关系较近的语言能相对更好地保留关联。
Conclusion: 作者指出，在多语言环境中部署的 VLM 不能假定其关联质量等同于单语评估中的表现，语言变化会实质性地影响概念绑定的稳健性。

papers.title: Can Spectral-Clipping Enable Better Learning While Forgetting Less for Low-Rank Adaptation?
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as a significant paradigm that freezes pre-trained weights and introduces small, learnable adapters instead of fine-tuning the full set of parameters. In this work, we uncover several key insights regarding the singular components of network parameters based on Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). Firstly, the principal singular components with large singular values in pre-trained network parameters can be effectively reused during fine-tuning, whereas the minor components with smaller singular values are more task-specific and require substantial adaptation. Secondly, we first establish the theoretical connection that the uncontrolled growth of singular values in LoRA adapters leads to the forgetting of pre-trained knowledge -- a well-known issue referred to as catastrophic forgetting. Building on these observations, we propose SCLoRA, which injects parameterized singular components with spectral clipping into the pre-trained model in a way that is aware of the spectral distribution of the pre-trained model. SCLoRA effectively adapts to new tasks by focusing updates on components that require adaptation, while simultaneously alleviating catastrophic forgetting. We conduct extensive experiments and demonstrate that SCLoRA not only improves downstream performance but also effectively retains pre-trained knowledge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究低秩适应（LoRA）中的奇异值分解（SVD）性质，发现预训练参数中奇异值较大的主成分可以在微调时被有效复用，而奇异值较小的成分更具任务特异性、需要较多调整。作者进一步建立理论联系，指出 LoRA 适配器中奇异值的无控制增长会导致预训练知识遗忘（灾难性遗忘），并据此提出 SCLoRA，通过注入参数化奇异成分并施加谱裁剪（spectral clipping）来兼顾下游任务适配与知识保留。
Motivation: LoRA 通过冻结预训练权重并引入少量可学习适配器来避免全参数微调，但适配器更新可能导致预训练知识遗忘；现有方法缺乏从谱分布（spectral distribution）角度理解哪些奇异成分需要更新以及如何抑制遗忘的理论分析。
Method: SCLoRA 在注入参数化奇异成分时考虑预训练模型的谱分布，并施加谱裁剪限制奇异值增长，使模型集中更新需要适应的成分，同时缓解灾难性遗忘。
Result: 摘要报告大量实验表明 SCLoRA 不仅提升下游任务性能，还能有效保留预训练知识；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为谱裁剪能够在提升下游学习效果的同时减少预训练知识遗忘，为 LoRA 类方法提供了基于谱分析的改进思路。

papers.title: Thought-Aware KV Cache Compaction for Reasoning via Adaptive Attention Matching
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning language models generate lengthy chain-of-thought (CoT) sequences whose key-value (KV) cache grows linearly and becomes a memory bottleneck during decoding. Existing compaction methods treat reasoning trajectories as flat token sequences and apply uniform compression, ignoring the hierarchical structure of CoT reasoning where different steps vary drastically in importance. We propose \textbf{Thought-Aware Attention Matching (TAM)}, which exploits this structure through three mechanisms: (i)~thought segmentation that decomposes the trajectory into reasoning blocks, (ii)~adaptive budget allocation that assigns compression budget based on each segment's importance and size, and (iii)~pivotal token protection that preserves high-attention reasoning anchors. We prove that the allocation rule is optimal under a convex error model and that cumulative error under sequential compaction remains bounded. Experiments on AIME 2024 and MATH-500 with Qwen3-4B show that TAM improves accuracy over uniform compaction at the same memory footprint, with periodic compaction bounding peak memory to 3.1--3.2\,GB (a 65\% reduction) while maintaining competitive accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Thought-Aware Attention Matching (TAM)，针对推理语言模型长 chain-of-thought (CoT) 序列的 KV cache 内存瓶颈，利用推理轨迹的分层结构进行缓存压缩。TAM 包含三个机制：thought segmentation、adaptive budget allocation 和 pivotal token protection，并证明在凸误差模型下预算分配最优且顺序压缩的累积误差有界。在 AIME 2024 和 MATH-500 上使用 Qwen3-4B 的实验显示，相比均匀压缩，TAM 在相同内存占用下提升准确率，并且周期性压缩可将峰值内存限制在 3.1–3.2 GB（降低 65%）同时保持有竞争力的准确率。
Motivation: 推理语言模型生成的长 CoT 序列使 KV cache 线性增长，成为解码期间的内存瓶颈。现有压缩方法把推理轨迹视为扁平 token 序列并做均匀压缩，忽略了 CoT 中不同推理步骤重要性差异很大的分层结构。
Method: TAM 通过三个机制利用 CoT 的层级结构：将轨迹分解为推理块的 thought segmentation、根据各段重要性和规模分配压缩预算的 adaptive budget allocation，以及保留高注意力推理锚点的 pivotal token protection。作者还给出了分配规则在凸误差模型下最优、顺序压缩下累积误差有界的理论证明。
Result: 在 AIME 2024 和 MATH-500 上以 Qwen3-4B 评估，TAM 在相同内存占用下相比均匀压缩提高了准确率；周期性压缩将峰值内存限制在 3.1–3.2 GB（降低 65%），同时保持有竞争力的准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用 CoT 的分层结构来做缓存压缩可以在同等内存下获得更好准确率，并给出最优预算分配与误差有界性的理论保证。

papers.title: AnchorSIPS: A Synthetic Dataset and Evaluation Resource for Evidence-Supported Psychosis-Risk Symptom Measurement
papers.abstract_en: Progress on AI for psychosis-risk assessment is limited by a data-access bottleneck. Real clinical interviews are difficult to share because of privacy, governance, and consent constraints. We present AnchorSIPS, a synthetic dataset of 10K structured psychosis-risk interviews with transcript-grounded measurement targets. Each interview is modeled on Mini-SIPS, a clinician-administered psychosis-risk interview. It captures history, 24 symptom questions, follow-up evidence for items the patient affirms, decisions about delusion-like symptoms (unusual beliefs), hallucination-like symptoms (unusual perceptions), and disorganized communication, exclusion of clear psychotic-level symptoms ("frank psychosis"), and a final attenuated psychosis syndrome (APS) diagnosis, a high-risk state of milder or early psychotic symptoms. The APS diagnosis is not a standalone label. It depends on earlier endorsements, supporting follow-up details, symptom-class decisions, and the frank-psychosis check. Every intermediate decision is anchored to its supporting transcript turns. AnchorSIPS is generated by a plan-then-realize pipeline. A hidden case sheet specifies the patient's clinical state, a deterministic planner fixes the interview structure, and an LLM realizes only the patient utterances under validation and bounded repair. Fixing labels and structure before generation avoids the inter-turn inconsistencies typical of multi-turn LLM dialogue. Across seven LLM baselines, models recover coarse decisions but fail to extract follow-up details or cite supporting transcript turns, so final-label performance overstates interview competence. AnchorSIPS is intended for research on evidence extraction, transcript-grounded measurement, and uncertainty under partial disclosure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AnchorSIPS，一个包含 10K 次结构化精神病风险访谈的合成数据集，基于 Mini-SIPS 访谈结构建模，每条记录都带有转录文本锚定的测量目标。作者采用 plan-then-realize 生成管道：先用隐藏病例表指定临床状态，再用确定性规划器固定访谈结构，最后仅由 LLM 在验证和有界修复下生成患者话语，以避免多轮对话中常见的跨轮不一致。在七个 LLM 基线上的评估显示，模型能恢复粗略决策，但难以提取随访细节或引用支持性转录片段，因此最终标签性能高估了访谈能力。
Motivation: 精神病风险评估的 AI 进展受数据获取瓶颈限制：真实临床访谈因隐私、治理和同意约束而难以共享。
Method: 提出 plan-then-realize 管道：隐藏病例表指定患者的临床状态，确定性规划器固定访谈结构，LLM 只负责在验证和有界修复下生成患者话语；标签和结构在生成前固定，每个中间决策都锚定到其支持性转录轮次。
Result: 在七个 LLM 基线中，模型可以恢复粗略决策，但无法提取随访细节或引用支持性转录片段，说明仅凭最终标签评估会高估访谈能力。
Conclusion: AnchorSIPS 旨在用于证据提取、转录锚定测量以及部分披露下不确定性的研究，并强调合成数据需配合细粒度评估才能反映真实能力。
